401.g: ਗੁਰੂ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਹਉ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਆਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
401.t: guroo viTahu hau vaariaa jis mil sach suaau ||1|| rahaau ||
401.e: I am a sacrifice to the Guru; meeting Him, I am absorbed into the True Lord. ||1||Pause||

401.g: ਸਗੁਨ ਅਪਸਗੁਨ ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਲਗਹਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਚੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
401.t: sagun apasagun tis kau lageh jis cheet na aavai ||
401.e: Good omens and bad omens affect those who do not keep the Lord in the mind.

401.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਮੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
401.t: tis jam neR na aaviee jo har prabh bhaavai ||2||
401.e: The Messenger of Death does not approach those who are pleasing to the Lord God. ||2||

401.g: ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ ਜਪ ਤਪ ਜੇਤੇ ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
401.t: pu(n)n dhaan jap tap jete sabh uoopar naam ||
401.e: Donations to charity, meditation and penance - above all of them is the Naam.

401.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਜੋ ਜਪੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਾਮੁ ॥੩॥
401.t: har har rasanaa jo japai tis pooran kaam ||3||
401.e: One who chants with his tongue the Name of the Lord, Har, Har - his works are brought to perfect completion. ||3||

401.g: ਭੈ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਮੋਹ ਗਏ ਕੋ ਦਿਸੈ ਨ ਬੀਆ ॥
401.t: bhai binase bhram moh ge ko dhisai na beeaa ||
401.e: His fears are removed, and his doubts and attachments are gone; he sees none other than God.

401.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਖੇ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਥੀਆ ॥੪॥੧੮॥੧੨੦॥
401.t: naanak raakhe paarabraham fir dhookh na theeaa ||4||18||120||
401.e: O Nanak, the Supreme Lord God preserves him, and no pain or sorrow afflicts him any longer. ||4||18||120||

401.g: ਆਸਾ ਘਰੁ ੯ ਮਹਲਾ ੫
401.t: aasaa ghar nauvaa mahalaa panjavaa
401.e: Aasaa, Ninth House, Fifth Mehla:

401.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
401.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
401.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

401.g: ਚਿਤਵਉ ਚਿਤਵਿ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਉ ਆਗੈ ਭਾਵਉ ਕਿ ਨ ਭਾਵਉ ॥
401.t: chitavau chitav sarab sukh paavau aagai bhaavau k na bhaavau ||
401.e: Contemplating Him within my consciousness, I obtain total peace; but hereafter, will I be pleasing to Him or not?

401.g: ਏਕੁ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਸਗਲ ਹੈ ਜਾਚਿਕ ਦੂਸਰ ਕੈ ਪਹਿ ਜਾਵਉ ॥੧॥
401.t: ek dhaataar sagal hai jaachik dhoosar kai peh jaavau ||1||
401.e: There is only One Giver; all others are beggars. Who else can we turn to? ||1||

401.g: ਹਉ ਮਾਗਉ ਆਨ ਲਜਾਵਉ ॥
401.t: hau maagau aan lajaavau ||
401.e: When I beg from others, I am ashamed.

401.g: ਸਗਲ ਛਤ੍ਰਪਤਿ ਏਕੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਕਉਨੁ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਲਾਵਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
401.t: sagal chhatrapat eko Thaakur kaun samasar laavau ||1|| rahaau ||
401.e: The One Lord Master is the Supreme King of all; who else is equal to Him? ||1||Pause||

401.g: ਊਠਉ ਬੈਸਉ ਰਹਿ ਭਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਉ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਖੋਜਿ ਖੋਜਾਵਉ ॥
401.t: uooThau baisau reh bh na saakau dharasan khoj khojaavau ||
401.e: Standing up and sitting down, I cannot live without Him. I search and search for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.

401.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਦਿਕ ਸਨਕਾਦਿਕ ਸਨਕ ਸਨੰਦਨ ਸਨਾਤਨ ਸਨਤਕੁਮਾਰ ਤਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਮਹਲੁ ਦੁਲਭਾਵਉ ॥੨॥
401.t: brahamaadhik sanakaadhik sanak sana(n)dhan sanaatan sanatakumaar tin(h) kau mahal dhulabhaavau ||2||
401.e: Even Brahma and the sages Sanak, Sanandan, Sanaatan and Sanat Kumar, find it difficult to obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||2||

401.g: ਅਗਮ ਅਗਮ ਆਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਰੈ ਨ ਪਾਵਉ ॥
401.t: agam agam aagaadh bodh keemat parai na paavau ||
401.e: He is unapproachable and unfathomable; His wisdom is deep and profound; His value cannot be appraised.

401.g: ਤਾਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਸਤਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਕੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਧਿਆਵਉ ॥੩॥
401.t: taakee saran sat purakh kee satigur purakh dhiaavau ||3||
401.e: I have taken to the Sanctuary of the True Lord, the Primal Being, and I meditate on the True Guru. ||3||

401.g: ਭਇਓ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਕਾਟਿਓ ਬੰਧੁ ਗਰਾਵਉ ॥
401.t: bhio kirapaal dhiaal prabh Thaakur kaaTio ba(n)dh garaavau ||
401.e: God, the Lord Master, has become kind and compassionate; He has cut the noose of death away from my neck.

401.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਉ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਤਉ ਫਿਰਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਉ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੨੧॥
401.t: kahu naanak jau saadhasa(n)g paio tau fir janam na aavau ||4||1||121||
401.e: Says Nanak, now that I have obtained the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I shall not have to be reincarnated again. ||4||1||121||

401.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
401.t: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
401.e: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

401.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗਾਵਉ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਗਾਵਉ ਗਾਵਉ ਜਾਗਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥
401.t: a(n)tar gaavau baahar gaavau gaavau jaag savaaree ||
401.e: Inwardly, I sing His Praises, and outwardly, I sing His Praises; I sing His Praises while awake and asleep.

401.g: ਸੰਗਿ ਚਲਨ ਕਉ ਤੋਸਾ ਦੀਨੑਾ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਾਮ ਕੇ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
401.t: sa(n)g chalan kau tosaa dheen(h)aa gobi(n)dh naam ke biauhaaree ||1||
401.e: I am a trader in the Name of the Lord of the Universe; He has given it to me as my supplies, to carry with me. ||1||

401.g: ਅਵਰ ਬਿਸਾਰੀ ਬਿਸਾਰੀ ॥
401.t: avar bisaaree bisaaree ||
401.e: I have forgotten and forsaken other things.

401.g: ਨਾਮ ਦਾਨੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਦੀਓ ਮੈ ਏਹੋ ਆਧਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
401.t: naam dhaan gur poorai dheeo mai eho aadhaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
401.e: The Perfect Guru has given me the Gift of the Naam; this alone is my Support. ||1||Pause||

401.g: ਦੂਖਨਿ ਗਾਵਉ ਸੁਖਿ ਭੀ ਗਾਵਉ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪੰਥਿ ਸਮੑਾਰੀ ॥
401.t: dhookhan gaavau sukh bhee gaavau maarag pa(n)th sam(h)aaree ||
401.e: I sing His Praises while suffering, and I sing His Praises while I am at peace as well. I contemplate Him while I walk along the Path.

401.g: ਨਾਮ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਦੀਆ ਮੋਰੀ ਤਿਸਾ ਬੁਝਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
401.t: naam dhiraR gur man meh dheeaa moree tisaa bujhaaree ||2||
401.e: The Guru has implanted the Naam within my mind, and my thirst has been quenched. ||2||

401.g: ਦਿਨੁ ਭੀ ਗਾਵਉ ਰੈਨੀ ਗਾਵਉ ਗਾਵਉ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਰਸਨਾਰੀ ॥
401.t: dhin bhee gaavau rainee gaavau gaavau saas saas rasanaaree ||
401.e: I sing His Praises during the day, and I sing His Praises during the night; I sing them with each and every breath.

401.g: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਬਿਸਾਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰਤ ਸੰਗਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
401.t: satasa(n)gat meh bisaas hoi har jeevat marat sa(n)gaaree ||3||
401.e: In the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, this faith is established, that the Lord is with us, in life and in death. ||3||

401.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਇਹੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਵਉ ਸੰਤ ਰੇਨ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
401.t: jan naanak kau ih dhaan dheh prabh paavau sa(n)t ren ur dhaaree ||
401.e: Bless servant Nanak with this gift, O God, that he may obtain, and enshrine in his heart, the dust of the feet of the Saints.

401.g: ਸ੍ਰਵਨੀ ਕਥਾ ਨੈਨ ਦਰਸੁ ਪੇਖਉ ਮਸਤਕੁ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੨੨॥
401.t: sravanee kathaa nain dharas pekhau masatak gur charanaaree ||4||2||122||
401.e: Hear the Lord's Sermon with your ears, and behold the Blessed Vision of His Darshan with your eyes; place your forehead upon the Guru's Feet. ||4||2||122||

401.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
401.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
401.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: Aasaa, Tenth House, Fifth Mehla:

401.g: ਆਸਾ ਘਰੁ ੧੦ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
401.t: aasaa ghar dasvaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
401.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: Aasaa, Tenth House, Fifth Mehla:

401.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂੰ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਹਿ ਤੇ ਪਾਹੁਨ ਦੋ ਦਾਹਾ ॥
401.t: jis no too(n) asathir kar maaneh te paahun dho dhaahaa ||
401.e: That which you believe to be permanent, is a guest here for only a few days.

402.g: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਸਗਲ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਸਭ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਅਸਨਾਹਾ ॥੧॥
402.t: putr kalatr gireh sagal samagree sabh mithiaa asanaahaa ||1||
402.e: Children, wives, homes, and all possessions - attachment to all of these is false. ||1||

402.g: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਹੈ ਹਾ ਹਾ ॥
402.t: re man kiaa kareh hai haa haa ||
402.e: O mind, why do you burst out laughing?

402.g: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦੇਖੁ ਜੈਸੇ ਹਰਿਚੰਦਉਰੀ ਇਕੁ ਰਾਮ ਭਜਨੁ ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
402.t: dhirasaT dhekh jaise haricha(n)dhauree ik raam bhajan lai laahaa ||1|| rahaau ||
402.e: See with your eyes, that these things are only mirages. So earn the profit of meditation on the One Lord. ||1||Pause||

402.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਬਸਤਰ ਦੇਹ ਓਢਾਨੇ ਦਿਨ ਦੋਇ ਚਾਰਿ ਭੋਰਾਹਾ ॥
402.t: jaise basatar dheh oddaane dhin dhoi chaar bhoraahaa ||
402.e: It is like the clothes which you wear on your body - they wear off in a few days.

402.g: ਭੀਤਿ ਊਪਰੇ ਕੇਤਕੁ ਧਾਈਐ ਅੰਤਿ ਓਰਕੋ ਆਹਾ ॥੨॥
402.t: bheet uoopare ketak dhaieeaai a(n)t orako aahaa ||2||
402.e: How long can you run upon a wall? Ultimately, you come to its end. ||2||

402.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਅੰਭ ਕੁੰਡ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਪਰਤ ਸਿੰਧੁ ਗਲਿ ਜਾਹਾ ॥
402.t: jaise a(n)bh ku(n)dd kar raakhio parat si(n)dh gal jaahaa ||
402.e: It is like salt, preserved in its container; when it is put into water, it dissolves.

402.g: ਆਵਗਿ ਆਗਿਆ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੀ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਸੀ ਮੁਹਤ ਚਸਾਹਾ ॥੩॥
402.t: aavag aagiaa paarabraham kee uTh jaasee muhat chasaahaa ||3||
402.e: When the Order of the Supreme Lord God comes, the soul arises, and departs in an instant. ||3||

402.g: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਲੇਖੈ ਚਾਲਹਿ ਲੇਖੈ ਬੈਸਹਿ ਲੇਖੈ ਲੈਦਾ ਸਾਹਾ ॥
402.t: re man lekhai chaaleh lekhai baiseh lekhai laidhaa saahaa ||
402.e: O mind, your steps are numbered, your moments spent sitting are numbered, and the breaths you are to take are numbered.

402.g: ਸਦਾ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਉਬਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਣ ਓਟਾਹਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੨੩॥
402.t: sadhaa keerat kar naanak har kee ubare satigur charan oTaahaa ||4||1||123||
402.e: Sing forever the Praises of the Lord, O Nanak, and you shall be saved, under the Shelter of the Feet of the True Guru. ||4||1||123||

402.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
402.t: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
402.e: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

402.g: ਅਪੁਸਟ ਬਾਤ ਤੇ ਭਈ ਸੀਧਰੀ ਦੂਤ ਦੁਸਟ ਸਜਨਈ ॥
402.t: apusaT baat te bhiee seedharee dhoot dhusaT sajaniee ||
402.e: That which was upside-down has been set upright; the deadly enemies and adversaries have become friends.

402.g: ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਮਹਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਿਓ ਮਲੀਨ ਬੁਧਿ ਹਛਨਈ ॥੧॥
402.t: a(n)dhakaar meh ratan pragaasio maleen budh hachhaniee ||1||
402.e: In the darkness, the jewel shines forth, and the impure understanding has become pure. ||1||

402.g: ਜਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਭਈ ॥
402.t: jau kirapaa gobi(n)dh bhiee ||
402.e: When the Lord of the Universe became merciful,

402.g: ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
402.t: sukh sa(n)pat har naam fal paae satigur miliee ||1|| rahaau ||
402.e: I found peace, wealth and the fruit of the Lord's Name; I have met the True Guru. ||1||Pause||

402.g: ਮੋਹਿ ਕਿਰਪਨ ਕਉ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਨਤ ਸਗਲ ਭਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਈ ॥
402.t: moh kirapan kau koi na jaanat sagal bhavan pragaTiee ||
402.e: No one knew me, the miserable miser, but now, I have become famous all over the world.

402.g: ਸੰਗਿ ਬੈਠਨੋ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਪਾਵਤ ਹੁਣਿ ਸਗਲ ਚਰਣ ਸੇਵਈ ॥੨॥
402.t: sa(n)g baiThano kahee na paavat hun sagal charan seviee ||2||
402.e: Before, no one would even sit with me, but now, all worship my feet. ||2||

402.g: ਆਢ ਆਢ ਕਉ ਫਿਰਤ ਢੂੰਢਤੇ ਮਨ ਸਗਲ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਬੁਝਿ ਗਈ ॥
402.t: aadd aadd kau firat ddoo(n)ddate man sagal tirasan bujh giee ||
402.e: I used to wander in search of pennies, but now, all the desires of my mind are satisfied.

402.g: ਏਕੁ ਬੋਲੁ ਭੀ ਖਵਤੋ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੀਤਲਈ ॥੩॥
402.t: ek bol bhee khavato naahee saadhasa(n)gat seetaliee ||3||
402.e: I could not bear even one criticism, but now, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I am cooled and soothed. ||3||

402.g: ਏਕ ਜੀਹ ਗੁਣ ਕਵਨ ਵਖਾਨੈ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਮਈ ॥
402.t: ek jeeh gun kavan vakhaanai agam agam agamiee ||
402.e: What Glorious Virtues of the Inaccessible, Unfathomable, Profound Lord can one mere tongue describe?

402.g: ਦਾਸੁ ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸ ਕੋ ਕਰੀਅਹੁ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਈ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੨੪॥
402.t: dhaas dhaas dhaas ko kareeahu jan naanak har saraniee ||4||2||124||
402.e: Please, make me the slave of the slave of Your slaves; servant Nanak seeks the Lord's Sanctuary. ||4||2||124||

402.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
402.t: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
402.e: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

402.g: ਰੇ ਮੂੜੇ ਲਾਹੇ ਕਉ ਤੂੰ ਢੀਲਾ ਢੀਲਾ ਤੋਟੇ ਕਉ ਬੇਗਿ ਧਾਇਆ ॥
402.t: re mooRe laahe kau too(n) ddeelaa ddeelaa toTe kau beg dhaiaa ||
402.e: O fool, you are so slow to earn your profits, and so quick to run up losses.

402.g: ਸਸਤ ਵਖਰੁ ਤੂੰ ਘਿੰਨਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਪਾਪੀ ਬਾਧਾ ਰੇਨਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
402.t: sasat vakhar too(n) ghi(n)neh naahee paapee baadhaa renaiaa ||1||
402.e: You do not purchase the inexpensive merchandise; O sinner, you are tied to your debts. ||1||

402.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇਰੀ ਆਸਾਇਆ ॥
402.t: satigur teree aasaiaa ||
402.e: O True Guru, You are my only hope.

402.g: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਮੈ ਏਹਾ ਓਟਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
402.t: patit paavan tero naam paarabraham mai ehaa oTaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
402.e: Your Name is the Purifier of sinners, O Supreme Lord God; You are my only Shelter. ||1||Pause||

402.g: ਗੰਧਣ ਵੈਣ ਸੁਣਹਿ ਉਰਝਾਵਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਤ ਅਲਕਾਇਆ ॥
402.t: ga(n)dhan vain suneh urajhaaveh naam lait alakaiaa ||
402.e: Listening to the evil talk, you are caught up in it, but you are hesitant to chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

402.g: ਨਿੰਦ ਚਿੰਦ ਕਉ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਉਮਾਹਿਓ ਬੂਝੀ ਉਲਟਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
402.t: ni(n)dh chi(n)dh kau bahut umaahio boojhee ulaTaiaa ||2||
402.e: You are delighted by slanderous talk; your understanding is corrupt. ||2||

402.g: ਪਰ ਧਨ ਪਰ ਤਨ ਪਰ ਤੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਅਖਾਧਿ ਖਾਹਿ ਹਰਕਾਇਆ ॥
402.t: par dhan par tan par tee ni(n)dhaa akhaadh khaeh harakaiaa ||
402.e: Others' wealth, others' wives and the slander of others - eating the uneatable, you have gone crazy.

402.g: ਸਾਚ ਧਰਮ ਸਿਉ ਰੁਚਿ ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ ਸਤਿ ਸੁਨਤ ਛੋਹਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
402.t: saach dharam siau ruch nahee aavai sat sunat chhohaiaa ||3||
402.e: You have not enshrined love for the True Faith of Dharma; hearing the Truth, you are enraged. ||3||

402.g: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਭਗਤ ਟੇਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇਆ ॥
402.t: dheen dhiaal kirapaal prabh Thaakur bhagat Tek har naiaa ||
402.e: O God, Merciful to the meek, Compassionate Lord Master, Your Name is the Support of Your devotees.

402.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਹਿ ਸਰਣ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਇਓ ਰਾਖੁ ਲਾਜ ਅਪਨਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੨੫॥
402.t: naanak aaeh saran prabh aaio raakh laaj apanaiaa ||4||3||125||
402.e: Nanak has come to Your Sanctuary; O God, make him Your Own, and preserve his honor. ||4||3||125||

402.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
402.t: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
402.e: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla

402.g: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਪਟਾਏ ਮੋਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਬਾਧੇ ॥
402.t: mithiaa sa(n)g sa(n)g lapaTaae moh maiaa kar baadhe ||
402.e: They are attached to falsehood; clinging to the transitory, they are trapped in emotional attachment to Maya.

402.g: ਜਹ ਜਾਨੋ ਸੋ ਚੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਭਏ ਆਂਧੇ ॥੧॥
402.t: jeh jaano so cheet na aavai aha(n)budh bhe aa(n)dhe ||1||
402.e: Wherever they go, they do not think of the Lord; they are blinded by intellectual egotism. ||1||

402.g: ਮਨ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਕਿਉ ਨ ਅਰਾਧੇ ॥
402.t: man bairaagee kiau na araadhe ||
402.e: O mind, O renunciate, why don't you adore Him?

402.g: ਕਾਚ ਕੋਠਰੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਬਸਤਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਖੈ ਕੀ ਬਿਆਧੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
402.t: kaach koTharee maeh too(n) basataa sa(n)g sagal bikhai kee biaadhe ||1|| rahaau ||
402.e: You dwell in that flimsy chamber, with all the sins of corruption. ||1||Pause||

402.g: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਤ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਪਲੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਛੀਜੈ ਅਰਜਾਧੇ ॥
402.t: meree meree karat dhin rain bihaavai pal khin chheejai arajaadhe ||
402.e: Crying out, ""Mine, mine"", your days and nights pass away; moment by moment, your life is running out.

403.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਮੀਠੈ ਸਾਦਿ ਲੋਭਾਏ ਝੂਠ ਧੰਧਿ ਦੁਰਗਾਧੇ ॥੨॥
403.t: jaise meeThai saadh lobhaae jhooTh dha(n)dh dhuragaadhe ||2||
403.e: The sweet flavors tempt you, and you are occupied by your false and filthy business. ||2||

403.g: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਅਰੁ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਇਹ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਰਸਿ ਲਪਟਾਧੇ ॥
403.t: kaam karodh ar lobh moh ieh i(n)dhree ras lapaTaadhe ||
403.e: Your senses are beguiled by sensual pleasures of sex, by anger, greed and emotional attachment.

403.g: ਦੀਈ ਭਵਾਰੀ ਪੁਰਖਿ ਬਿਧਾਤੈ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਜਨਮਾਧੇ ॥੩॥
403.t: dheeiee bhavaaree purakh bidhaatai bahur bahur janamaadhe ||3||
403.e: The All-powerful Architect of Destiny has ordained that you shall be reincarnated over and over again. ||3||

403.g: ਜਉ ਭਇਓ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਤਉ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਭ ਸੁਖ ਲਾਧੇ ॥
403.t: jau bhio kirapaal dheen dhukh bha(n)jan tau gur mil sabh sukh laadhe ||
403.e: When the Destroyer of the pains of the poor becomes merciful, then, as Gurmukh, you shall find absolute peace.

403.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਧਿਆਵਉ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਾਢੀ ਸਗਲ ਉਪਾਧੇ ॥੪॥
403.t: kahu naanak dhin rain dhiaavau maar kaaddee sagal upaadhe ||4||
403.e: Says Nanak, meditate on the Lord, day and night, and all your sickness shall be banished. ||4||

403.g: ਇਉ ਜਪਿਓ ਭਾਈ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ॥
403.t: eiau japio bhaiee purakh bidhaate ||
403.e: Meditate in this way, O Siblings of Destiny, on the Lord, the Architect of Destiny.

403.g: ਭਇਓ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖ ਲਾਥੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੨੬॥
403.t: bhio kirapaal dheen dhukh bha(n)jan janam maran dhukh laathe ||1|| rahaau dhoojaa ||4||4||126||
403.e: The Destroyer of the pains of the poor has become merciful; He has removed the pains of birth and death. ||1||Second Pause||4||4||126||

403.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
403.t: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
403.e: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

403.g: ਨਿਮਖ ਕਾਮ ਸੁਆਦ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਦਿਨਸ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
403.t: nimakh kaam suaadh kaaran koT dhinas dhukh paaveh ||
403.e: For a moment of sexual pleasure, you shall suffer in pain for millions of days.

403.g: ਘਰੀ ਮੁਹਤ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਵਹਿ ॥੧॥
403.t: gharee muhat ra(n)g maaneh fir bahur bahur pachhutaaveh ||1||
403.e: For an instant, you may savor pleasure, but afterwards, you shall regret it, again and again. ||1||

403.g: ਅੰਧੇ ਚੇਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
403.t: a(n)dhe chet har har raiaa ||
403.e: O blind man, meditate on the Lord, the Lord, your King.

403.g: ਤੇਰਾ ਸੋ ਦਿਨੁ ਨੇੜੈ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
403.t: teraa so dhin neRai aaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
403.e: Your day is drawing near. ||1||Pause||

403.g: ਪਲਕ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਭੂਲੋ ਆਕ ਨੀਮ ਕੋ ਤੂੰਮਰੁ ॥
403.t: palak dhirasaT dhekh bhoolo aak neem ko too(n)mar ||
403.e: You are deceived, beholding with your eyes, the bitter melon and swallow-wort.

403.g: ਜੈਸਾ ਸੰਗੁ ਬਿਸੀਅਰ ਸਿਉ ਹੈ ਰੇ ਤੈਸੋ ਹੀ ਇਹੁ ਪਰ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ॥੨॥
403.t: jaisaa sa(n)g biseear siau hai re taiso hee ih par girahu ||2||
403.e: But, like the companionship of a poisonous snake, so is the desire for another's spouse. ||2||

403.g: ਬੈਰੀ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਪਾਪ ਕਰਤਾ ਬਸਤੁ ਰਹੀ ਅਮਾਨਾ ॥
403.t: bairee kaaran paap karataa basat rahee amaanaa ||
403.e: For the sake of your enemy, you commit sins, while you neglect the reality of your faith.

403.g: ਛੋਡਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਸਿਉ ਸੰਗੀ ਸਾਜਨ ਸਿਉ ਬੈਰਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
403.t: chhodd jaeh tin hee siau sa(n)gee saajan siau bairaanaa ||3||
403.e: Your friendship is with those who abandon you, and you are angry with your friends. ||3||

403.g: ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਇਹੈ ਬਿਧਿ ਬਿਆਪਿਓ ਸੋ ਉਬਰਿਓ ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
403.t: sagal sa(n)saar ihai bidh biaapio so ubario jis gur pooraa ||
403.e: The entire world is entangled in this way; he alone is saved, who has the Perfect Guru.

403.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰਿਓ ਭਏ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੨੭॥
403.t: kahu naanak bhav saagar tario bhe puneet sareeraa ||4||5||127||
403.e: Says Nanak, I have crossed over the terrifying world-ocean; my body has become sanctified. ||4||5||127||

403.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
403.t: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa dhupadhe ||
403.e: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla Dho-Padhay:

403.g: ਲੂਕਿ ਕਮਾਨੋ ਸੋਈ ਤੁਮੑ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਮੂੜ ਮੁਗਧ ਮੁਕਰਾਨੀ ॥
403.t: look kamaano soiee tum(h) pekhio mooR mugadh mukaraanee ||
403.e: O Lord, You behold whatever we do in secrecy; the fool may stubbornly deny it.

403.g: ਆਪ ਕਮਾਨੇ ਕਉ ਲੇ ਬਾਂਧੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
403.t: aap kamaane kau le baa(n)dhe fir paachhai pachhutaanee ||1||
403.e: By his own actions, he is tied down, and in the end, he regrets and repents. ||1||

403.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਆਗੈ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
403.t: prabh mere sabh bidh aagai jaanee ||
403.e: My God knows, ahead of time, all things.

403.g: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕੇ ਮੂਸੇ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਖਤ ਪਰਦਾ ਪਾਛੈ ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਮਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
403.t: bhram ke moose too(n) raakhat paradhaa paachhai jeea kee maanee ||1|| rahaau ||
403.e: Deceived by doubt, you may hide your actions, but in the end, you shall have to confess the secrets of your mind. ||1||Pause||

403.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਾਗੇ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਕਰੈ ਪਰਾਨੀ ॥
403.t: jit jit laae tit tit laage kiaa ko karai paraanee ||
403.e: Whatever they are attached to, they remain joined to that. What can any mere mortal do?

403.g: ਬਖਸਿ ਲੈਹੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੀ ॥੨॥੬॥੧੨੮॥
403.t: bakhas laih paarabraham suaamee naanak sadh kurabaanee ||2||6||128||
403.e: Please, forgive me, O Supreme Lord Master. Nanak is forever a sacrifice to You. ||2||6||128||

403.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
403.t: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
403.e: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

403.g: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਆਪੇ ਰਾਖੈ ਆਪੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਵੈ ॥
403.t: apune sevak kee aape raakhai aape naam japaavai ||
403.e: He Himself preserves His servants; He causes them to chant His Name.

403.g: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਕਾਜ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਤਹਾ ਤਹਾ ਉਠਿ ਧਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
403.t: jeh jeh kaaj kirat sevak kee tahaa tahaa uTh dhaavai ||1||
403.e: Wherever the business and affairs of His servants are, there the Lord hurries to be. ||1||

403.g: ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਨਿਕਟੀ ਹੋਇ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ॥
403.t: sevak kau nikaTee hoi dhikhaavai ||
403.e: The Lord appears near at hand to His servant.

403.g: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕਹੈ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਤਤਕਾਲ ਹੋਇ ਆਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
403.t: jo jo kahai Thaakur peh sevak tatakaal hoi aavai ||1|| rahaau ||
403.e: Whatever the servant asks of his Lord and Master, immediately comes to pass. ||1||Pause||

403.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੈ ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਜੋ ਅਪਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
403.t: tis sevak kai hau balihaaree jo apane prabh bhaavai ||
403.e: I am a sacrifice to that servant, who is pleasing to his God.

403.g: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਸੋਇ ਸੁਣੀ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਰਸਣਿ ਆਵੈ ॥੨॥੭॥੧੨੯॥
403.t: tis kee soi sunee man hariaa tis naanak parasan aavai ||2||7||129||
403.e: Hearing of his glory, the mind is rejuvenated; Nanak comes to touch his feet. ||2||7||129||

403.g: ਆਸਾ ਘਰੁ ੧੧ ਮਹਲਾ ੫
403.t: aasaa ghar gayaarvaa mahalaa panjavaa
403.e: Aasaa, Eleventh House, Fifth Mehla:

403.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
403.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
403.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

403.g: ਨਟੂਆ ਭੇਖ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਜੈਸਾ ਹੈ ਓਹੁ ਤੈਸਾ ਰੇ ॥
403.t: naTooaa bhekh dhikhaavai bahu bidh jaisaa hai oh taisaa re ||
403.e: The actor displays himself in many disguises, but he remains just as he is.

403.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਜੋਨਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿਓ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਸੁਖਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਪਰਵੇਸਾ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
403.t: anik jon bhramio bhram bheetar sukheh naahee paravesaa re ||1||
403.e: The soul wanders through countless incarnations in doubt, but it does not come to dwell in peace. ||1||

404.g: ਸਾਜਨ ਸੰਤ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਮੀਤਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਨੀਤਾ ਰੇ ॥
404.t: saajan sa(n)t hamaare meetaa bin har har aaneetaa re ||
404.e: O Saints, my friends and companions, without the Lord, Har, Har, you shall perish.

404.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ਇਹੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਜੀਤਾ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
404.t: saadhasa(n)g mil har gun gaae ih janam padhaarath jeetaa re ||1|| rahaau ||
404.e: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and win this precious treasure of human life. ||1||Pause||

404.g: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਾਇਆ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੀ ਕੀਨੑੀ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਵਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਤਰੀਐ ਰੇ ॥
404.t: trai gun maiaa braham kee keen(h)ee kahahu kavan bidh tareeaai re ||
404.e: God has created Maya of the three qualities; tell me, how can it be crossed over?

404.g: ਘੂਮਨ ਘੇਰ ਅਗਾਹ ਗਾਖਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਰੀਐ ਰੇ ॥੨॥
404.t: ghooman gher agaeh gaakharee gur sabadhee paar utareeaai re ||2||
404.e: The whirlpool is awesome and unfathomable; only through the Word of the Guru's Shabad is one carried across. ||2||

404.g: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ਤਤੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਜਾਨਾ ਰੇ ॥
404.t: khojat khojat khoj beechaario tat naanak ih jaanaa re ||
404.e: Searching and searching endlessly, seeking and deliberating, Nanak has realized the true essence of reality.

404.g: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਨਿਰਮੋਲਕੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਣਕੁ ਪਤੀਆਨਾ ਰੇ ॥੩॥੧॥੧੩੦॥
404.t: simarat naam nidhaan niramolak man maanak pateeaanaa re ||3||1||130||
404.e: Meditating on the invaluable treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the jewel of the mind is satisfied. ||3||1||130||

404.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
404.t: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa dhupadhe ||
404.e: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla, Dho-Padhay:

404.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਜੋ ਮਾਗਉ ਸੋ ਪਾਵਉ ਰੇ ॥
404.t: gur parasaadh merai man vasiaa jo maagau so paavau re ||
404.e: By Guru's Grace, He dwells within my mind; whatever I ask for, I receive.

404.g: ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਨਾ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਕਤਹੂੰ ਧਾਵਉ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
404.t: naam ra(n)g ih man tirapataanaa bahur na katahoo(n) dhaavau re ||1||
404.e: This mind is satisfied with the Love of the Naam, the Name of the Lord; it does not go out, anywhere, anymore. ||1||

404.g: ਹਮਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਗਾਵਉ ਰੇ ॥
404.t: hamaraa Thaakur sabh te uoochaa rain dhinas tis gaavau re ||
404.e: My Lord and Master is the highest of all; night and day, I sing the Glories of His Praises.

404.g: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਨਹਾਰਾ ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਡਰਾਵਉ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
404.t: khin meh thaap uthaapanahaaraa tis te tujheh ddaraavau re ||1|| rahaau ||
404.e: In an instant, He establishes and disestablishes; through Him, I frighten you. ||1||Pause||

404.g: ਜਬ ਦੇਖਉ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਉ ਅਵਰਹਿ ਚੀਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਵਉ ਰੇ ॥
404.t: jab dhekhau prabh apunaa suaamee tau avareh cheet na paavau re ||
404.e: When I behold my God, my Lord and Master, I do not pay any attention to any other.

404.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਪਹਿਰਾਇਆ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਮੇਟਿ ਲਿਖਾਵਉ ਰੇ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੩੧॥
404.t: naanak dhaas prabh aap pahiraiaa bhram bhau meT likhaavau re ||2||2||131||
404.e: God Himself has adorned servant Nanak; his doubts and fears have been dispelled, and he writes the account of the Lord. ||2||2||131||

404.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
404.t: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
404.e: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

404.g: ਚਾਰਿ ਬਰਨ ਚਉਹਾ ਕੇ ਮਰਦਨ ਖਟੁ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਰ ਤਲੀ ਰੇ ॥
404.t: chaar baran chauhaa ke maradhan khaT dharasan kar talee re ||
404.e: The four castes and social classes, and the preachers with the six Shaastras on their finger-tips,

404.g: ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸੁਘਰ ਸਰੂਪ ਸਿਆਨੇ ਪੰਚਹੁ ਹੀ ਮੋਹਿ ਛਲੀ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
404.t: su(n)dhar sughar saroop siaane pa(n)chahu hee moh chhalee re ||1||
404.e: the beautiful, the refined, the shapely and the wise - the five passions have enticed and beguiled them all. ||1||

404.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਮਾਰੇ ਪੰਚ ਸੂਰਬੀਰ ਐਸੋ ਕਉਨੁ ਬਲੀ ਰੇ ॥
404.t: jin mil maare pa(n)ch soorabeer aaiso kaun balee re ||
404.e: Who has seized and conquered the five powerful fighters? Is there anyone strong enough?

404.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਪੰਚ ਮਾਰਿ ਬਿਦਾਰਿ ਗੁਦਾਰੇ ਸੋ ਪੂਰਾ ਇਹ ਕਲੀ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
404.t: jin pa(n)ch maar bidhaar gudhaare so pooraa ieh kalee re ||1|| rahaau ||
404.e: He alone, who conquers and defeats the five demons, is perfect in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga. ||1||Pause||

404.g: ਵਡੀ ਕੋਮ ਵਸਿ ਭਾਗਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੁਹਕਮ ਫਉਜ ਹਠਲੀ ਰੇ ॥
404.t: vaddee kom vas bhaageh naahee muhakam fauj haThalee re ||
404.e: They are so awesome and great; they cannot be controlled, and they do not run away. Their army is mighty and unyielding.

404.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨਿ ਜਨਿ ਨਿਰਦਲਿਆ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਝਲੀ ਰੇ ॥੨॥੩॥੧੩੨॥
404.t: kahu naanak tin jan niradhaliaa saadhasa(n)gat kai jhalee re ||2||3||132||
404.e: Says Nanak, that humble being who is under the protection of the Saadh Sangat, crushes those terrible demons. ||2||3||132||

404.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
404.t: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
404.e: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

404.g: ਨੀਕੀ ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਊਤਮ ਆਨ ਸਗਲ ਰਸ ਫੀਕੀ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
404.t: neekee jeea kee har kathaa uootam aan sagal ras feekee re ||1|| rahaau ||
404.e: The Sublime Sermon of the Lord is the best thing for the soul. All other tastes are insipid. ||1||Pause||

404.g: ਬਹੁ ਗੁਨਿ ਧੁਨਿ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਖਟੁ ਬੇਤੇ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਿਛੁ ਲਾਈਕੀ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
404.t: bahu gun dhun mun jan khaT bete avar na kichh laieekee re ||1||
404.e: The worthy beings, heavenly singers, silent sages and the knowers of the six Shaastras proclaim that nothing else is worthy of consideration. ||1||

404.g: ਬਿਖਾਰੀ ਨਿਰਾਰੀ ਅਪਾਰੀ ਸਹਜਾਰੀ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪੀਕੀ ਰੇ ॥੨॥੪॥੧੩੩॥
404.t: bikhaaree niraaree apaaree sahajaaree saadhasa(n)g naanak peekee re ||2||4||133||
404.e: It is the cure for evil passions, unique, unequalled and peace-giving; in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O Nanak, drink it in. ||2||4||133||

404.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
404.t: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
404.e: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

404.g: ਹਮਾਰੀ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਧਾਰੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਟਾਰੀ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
404.t: hamaaree piaaree a(n)mirat dhaaree gur nimakh na man te Taaree re ||1|| rahaau ||
404.e: My Beloved has brought forth a river of nectar. The Guru has not held it back from my mind, even for an instant. ||1||Pause||

404.g: ਦਰਸਨ ਪਰਸਨ ਸਰਸਨ ਹਰਸਨ ਰੰਗਿ ਰੰਗੀ ਕਰਤਾਰੀ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
404.t: dharasan parasan sarasan harasan ra(n)g ra(n)gee karataaree re ||1||
404.e: Beholding it, and touching it, I am sweetened and delighted. It is imbued with the Creator's Love. ||1||

404.g: ਖਿਨੁ ਰਮ ਗੁਰ ਗਮ ਹਰਿ ਦਮ ਨਹ ਜਮ ਹਰਿ ਕੰਠਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਉਰਿ ਹਾਰੀ ਰੇ ॥੨॥੫॥੧੩੪॥
404.t: khin ram gur gam har dham neh jam har ka(n)Th naanak ur haaree re ||2||5||134||
404.e: Chanting it even for a moment, I rise to the Guru; meditating on it, one is not trapped by the Messenger of Death. The Lord has placed it as a garland around Nanak's neck, and within his heart. ||2||5||134||

404.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
404.t: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
404.e: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

404.g: ਨੀਕੀ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਾਨੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
404.t: neekee saadh sa(n)gaanee || rahaau ||
404.e: The Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, is exalted and sublime. ||Pause||

404.g: ਪਹਰ ਮੂਰਤ ਪਲ ਗਾਵਤ ਗਾਵਤ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਵਖਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
404.t: pahar moorat pal gaavat gaavat govi(n)dh govi(n)dh vakhaanee ||1||
404.e: Every day, hour and moment, I continually sing and speak of Govind, Govind, the Lord of the Universe. ||1||

404.g: ਚਾਲਤ ਬੈਸਤ ਸੋਵਤ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਚਰਨ ਖਟਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
404.t: chaalat baisat sovat har jas man tan charan khaTaanee ||2||
404.e: Walking, sitting and sleeping, I chant the Lord's Praises; I treasure His Feet in my mind and body. ||2||

404.g: ਹਂਉ ਹਉਰੋ ਤੂ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਗਉਰੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਛਾਨੀ ॥੩॥੬॥੧੩੫॥
404.t: ha(n)au hauro too Thaakur gauro naanak saran pachhaanee ||3||6||135||
404.e: I am so small, and You are so great, O Lord and Master; Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary. ||3||6||135||

405.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧੨
405.t: raag aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ghar baarvaa
405.e: Raag Aasaa, Fifth Mehla, Twelfth House:

405.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
405.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
405.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

405.g: ਤਿਆਗਿ ਸਗਲ ਸਿਆਨਪਾ ਭਜੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
405.t: tiaag sagal siaanapaa bhaj paarabraham nira(n)kaar ||
405.e: Renounce all your cleverness and remember the Supreme, Formless Lord God.

405.g: ਏਕ ਸਾਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਸਗਲ ਦੀਸੈ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
405.t: ek saache naam baajhahu sagal dheesai chhaar ||1||
405.e: Without the One True Name, everything appears as dust. ||1||

405.g: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਸਦ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
405.t: so prabh jaaneeaai sadh sa(n)g ||
405.e: Know that God is always with you.

405.g: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦੀ ਬੂਝੀਐ ਏਕ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
405.t: gur prasaadhee boojheeaai ek har kai ra(n)g ||1|| rahaau ||
405.e: By Guru's Grace, one understands, and is imbued with the Love of the One Lord. ||1||Pause||

405.g: ਸਰਣਿ ਸਮਰਥ ਏਕ ਕੇਰੀ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਠਾਉ ॥
405.t: saran samarath ek keree dhoojaa naahee Thaau ||
405.e: Seek the Shelter of the One All-powerful Lord; there is no other place of rest.

405.g: ਮਹਾ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਲੰਘੀਐ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥੨॥
405.t: mahaa bhaujal la(n)gheeaai sadhaa har gun gaau ||2||
405.e: The vast and terrifying world-ocean is crossed over, singing continually the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

405.g: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੀਐ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
405.t: janam maran nivaareeaai dhukh na jam pur hoi ||
405.e: Birth and death are overcome, and one does not have to suffer in the City of Death.

405.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਸੋਈ ਪਾਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
405.t: naam nidhaan soiee paae kirapaa kare prabh soi ||3||
405.e: He alone obtains the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, unto whom God shows His Mercy. ||3||

405.g: ਏਕ ਟੇਕ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਏਕੋ ਏਕ ਕਾ ਮਨਿ ਜੋਰੁ ॥
405.t: ek Tek adhaar eko ek kaa man jor ||
405.e: The One Lord is my Anchor and Support; the One Lord alone is the power of my mind.

405.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਪੀਐ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਹੋਰੁ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੩੬॥
405.t: naanak japeeaai mil saadhasa(n)gat har bin avar na hor ||4||1||136||
405.e: O Nanak, joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, meditate on Him; without the Lord, there is no other at all. ||4||1||136||

405.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
405.t: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
405.e: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

405.g: ਜੀਉ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਦੀਏ ਸਭਿ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ॥
405.t: jeeau man tan praan prabh ke dhe'ee sabh ras bhog ||
405.e: The soul, the mind, the body and the breath of life belong to God. He has given all tastes and pleasures.

405.g: ਦੀਨ ਬੰਧਪ ਜੀਅ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਰਣਿ ਰਾਖਣ ਜੋਗੁ ॥੧॥
405.t: dheen ba(n)dhap jeea dhaataa saran raakhan jog ||1||
405.e: He is the Friend of the poor, the Giver of life, the Protector of those who seek His Sanctuary. ||1||

405.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਧਿਆਇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
405.t: mere man dhiaai har har naau ||
405.e: O my mind, meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

405.g: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਸਹਾਇ ਸੰਗੇ ਏਕ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
405.t: halat palat sahai sa(n)ge ek siau liv laau ||1|| rahaau ||
405.e: Here and hereafter, He is our Helper and Companion; embrace love and affection for the One Lord. ||1||Pause||

405.g: ਬੇਦ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਜਨ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਤਰਣ ਕਉ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
405.t: bedh saasatr jan dhiaaveh taran kau sa(n)saar ||
405.e: They meditate on the Vedas and the Shaastras, to swim across the world-ocean.

405.g: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਅਨੇਕ ਕਿਰਿਆ ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਚਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
405.t: karam dharam anek kiriaa sabh uoopar naam achaar ||2||
405.e: The many religious rituals, good deeds of karma and Dharmic worship - above all of these is the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||

405.g: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੇਵ ॥
405.t: kaam karodh aha(n)kaar binasai milai satigur dhev ||
405.e: Sexual desire, anger, and egotism depart, meeting with the Divine True Guru.

405.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਕਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਲੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ॥੩॥
405.t: naam dhiraR kar bhagat har kee bhalee prabh kee sev ||3||
405.e: Implant the Naam within, perform devotional worship to the Lord and serve God - this is good. ||3||

405.g: ਚਰਣ ਸਰਣ ਦਇਆਲ ਤੇਰੀ ਤੂੰ ਨਿਮਾਣੇ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
405.t: charan saran dhiaal teree too(n) nimaane maan ||
405.e: I seek the Sanctuary of Your Feet, O Merciful Lord; You are the Honor of the dishonored.

405.g: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੩੭॥
405.t: jeea praan adhaar teraa naanak kaa prabh taan ||4||2||137||
405.e: You are the Support of my soul, my breath of life; O God, You are Nanak's strength. ||4||2||137||

405.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
405.t: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
405.e: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

405.g: ਡੋਲਿ ਡੋਲਿ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਬਿਨਾ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗ ॥
405.t: ddol ddol mahaa dhukh paiaa binaa saadhoo sa(n)g ||
405.e: He wavers and falters, and suffers such great pain, without the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

405.g: ਖਾਟਿ ਲਾਭੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਇਕ ਰੰਗ ॥੧॥
405.t: khaaT laabh gobi(n)dh har ras paarabraham ik ra(n)g ||1||
405.e: The profit of the sublime essence of the Lord of the Universe is obtained, by the Love of the One Supreme Lord God. ||1||

405.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀਐ ਨੀਤਿ ॥
405.t: har ko naam japeeaai neet ||
405.e: Chant continually the Name of the Lord.

405.g: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਅਵਰ ਪਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
405.t: saas saas dhiaai so prabh tiaag avar pareet ||1|| rahaau ||
405.e: With each and every breath, meditate on God, and renounce other love. ||1||Pause||

405.g: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜੀਅ ਦਾਤਾ ਆਪਿ ॥
405.t: karan kaaran samarath so prabh jeea dhaataa aap ||
405.e: God is the Doer, the All-powerful Cause of causes; He Himself is the Giver of life.

405.g: ਤਿਆਗਿ ਸਗਲ ਸਿਆਣਪਾ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਪਿ ॥੨॥
405.t: tiaag sagal siaanapaa aaTh pahar prabh jaap ||2||
405.e: So renounce all your cleverness, and meditate on God, twenty-four hours a day. ||2||

405.g: ਮੀਤੁ ਸਖਾ ਸਹਾਇ ਸੰਗੀ ਊਚ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
405.t: meet sakhaa sahai sa(n)gee uooch agam apaar ||
405.e: He is our best friend and companion, our help and support; He is lofty, inaccessible and infinite.

405.g: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਬਸਾਇ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਜੀਅ ਕੋ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
405.t: charan kamal basai hiradhai jeea ko aadhaar ||3||
405.e: Enshrine His Lotus Feet within your heart; He is the Support of the soul. ||3||

405.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਉ ॥
405.t: kar kirapaa prabh paarabraham gun teraa jas gaau ||
405.e: Show Your Mercy, O Supreme Lord God, that I may sing Your Glorious Praises.

405.g: ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨਾਉ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੩੮॥
405.t: sarab sookh vaddee vaddiaaiee jap jeevai naanak naau ||4||3||138||
405.e: Total peace, and the greatest greatness, O Nanak, are obtained by living to chant the Name of the Lord. ||4||3||138||

405.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
405.t: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
405.e: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

405.g: ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰਉ ਕਰਾਵਹੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪੇਖਤ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
405.t: audham karau karaavahu Thaakur pekhat saadhoo sa(n)g ||
405.e: I make the effort, as You cause me to do, my Lord and Master, to behold You in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

405.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਚਰਾਵਹੁ ਰੰਗਨਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੧॥
405.t: har har naam charaavahu ra(n)gan aape hee prabh ra(n)g ||1||
405.e: I am imbued with the color of the Love of the Lord, Har, Har; God Himself has colored me in His Love. ||1||

405.g: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਾ ਜਾਪਿ ॥
405.t: man meh raam naamaa jaap ||
405.e: I chant the Lord's Name within my mind.

405.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਵਸਹੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹੋਇ ਸਹਾਈ ਆਪਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
405.t: kar kirapaa vasahu merai hiradhai hoi sahaiee aap ||1|| rahaau ||
405.e: Bestow Your Mercy, and dwell within my heart; please, become my Helper. ||1||Pause||

405.g: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪੇਖਨ ਕਾ ਚਾਉ ॥
405.t: sun sun naam tumaaraa preetam prabh pekhan kaa chaau ||
405.e: Listening continually to Your Name, O Beloved God, I yearn to behold You.

406.g: ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਕਿਰਮ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਉ ਇਹੈ ਮਨੋਰਥੁ ਸੁਆਉ ॥੨॥
406.t: dhiaa karahu kiram apune kau ihai manorath suaau ||2||
406.e: Please, be kind to me - I am just a worm. This is my object and purpose. ||2||

406.g: ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਮਰੈ ਵਸਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
406.t: tan dhan teraa too(n) prabh meraa hamarai vas kichh naeh ||
406.e: My body and wealth are Yours; You are my God - nothing is in my power.

406.g: ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਤਿਉ ਰਹਣਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਦੀਆ ਖਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
406.t: jiau jiau raakheh tiau tiau rahanaa teraa dheeaa khaeh ||3||
406.e: As You keep me, so do I live; I eat what You give me. ||3||

406.g: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਕਾਟੈ ਮਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
406.t: janam janam ke kilavikh kaaTai majan har jan dhoor ||
406.e: The sins of countless incarnations are washed away, by bathing in the dust of the Lord's humble servants.

406.g: ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਰਮ ਭਉ ਨਾਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੩੯॥
406.t: bhai bhagat bharam bhau naasai har naanak sadhaa hajoor ||4||4||139||
406.e: By loving devotional worship, doubt and fear depart; O Nanak, the Lord is Ever-present. ||4||4||139||

406.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
406.t: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
406.e: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

406.g: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ॥
406.t: agam agochar dharas teraa so paae jis masatak bhaag ||
406.e: The Blessed Vision of Your Darshan is unapproachable and incomprehensible; he alone obtains it, who has such good destiny recorded upon his forehead.

406.g: ਆਪਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਧਾਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਬਖਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥
406.t: aap kirapaal kirapaa prabh dhaaree satigur bakhasiaa har naam ||1||
406.e: The Merciful Lord God has bestowed His Mercy, and the True Guru has granted the Lord's Name. ||1||

406.g: ਕਲਿਜੁਗੁ ਉਧਾਰਿਆ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥
406.t: kalijug udhaariaa gurdhev ||
406.e: The Divine Guru is the Saving Grace in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga.

406.g: ਮਲ ਮੂਤ ਮੂੜ ਜਿ ਮੁਘਦ ਹੋਤੇ ਸਭਿ ਲਗੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
406.t: mal moot mooR j mughadh hote sabh lage teree sev ||1|| rahaau ||
406.e: Even those fools and idiots, stained with feces and urine, have all taken to Your service. ||1||Pause||

406.g: ਤੂ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਧਰਤਾ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
406.t: too aap karataa sabh sirasaT dharataa sabh meh rahiaa samai ||
406.e: You Yourself are the Creator, who established the entire world. You are contained in all.

406.g: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਜਾ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਹੋਆ ਸਭ ਪਈ ਪੈਰੀ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
406.t: dharam raajaa bisamaadh hoaa sabh piee pairee aai ||2||
406.e: The Righteous Judge of Dharma is wonder-struck, at the sight of everyone falling at the Lord's Feet. ||2||

406.g: ਸਤਜੁਗੁ ਤ੍ਰੇਤਾ ਦੁਆਪਰੁ ਭਣੀਐ ਕਲਿਜੁਗੁ ਊਤਮੋ ਜੁਗਾ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
406.t: satajug tretaa dhuaapar bhaneeaai kalijug uootamo jugaa maeh ||
406.e: The Golden Age of Sat Yuga, the Silver Age of Trayta Yuga, and the Brass Age of Dwaapar Yuga are good; but the best is the Dark Age, the Iron Age, of Kali Yuga.

406.g: ਅਹਿ ਕਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਅਹਿ ਕਰੁ ਪਾਏ ਕੋਈ ਨ ਪਕੜੀਐ ਕਿਸੈ ਥਾਇ ॥੩॥
406.t: eh kar kare su eh kar paae koiee na pakaReeaai kisai thai ||3||
406.e: As we act, so are the rewards we receive; no one can take the place of another. ||3||

406.g: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਹਿ ਜਿ ਭਗਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਜਾਚਹਿ ਏਹੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਬਿਰਦੁ ॥
406.t: har jeeau soiee kareh j bhagat tere jaacheh eh teraa biradh ||
406.e: O Dear Lord, whatever Your devotees ask for, You do. This is Your Way, Your very nature.

406.g: ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਨੁ ਮਾਗੈ ਅਪਣਿਆ ਸੰਤਾ ਦੇਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸੁ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੪੦॥
406.t: kar joR naanak dhaan maagai apaniaa sa(n)taa dheh har dharas ||4||5||140||
406.e: With my palms pressed together, O Nanak, I beg for this gift; Lord, please bless Your Saints with Your Vision. ||4||5||140||

406.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧੩
406.t: raag aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ghar tayrvaa
406.e: Raag Aasaa, Fifth Mehla, Thirteenth House:

406.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
406.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
406.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

406.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ॥
406.t: satigur bachan tum(h)aare ||
406.e: O True Guru, by Your Words,

406.g: ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
406.t: niragun nisataare ||1|| rahaau ||
406.e: even the worthless have been saved. ||1||Pause||

406.g: ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖਾਦੀ ਦੁਸਟ ਅਪਵਾਦੀ ਤੇ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਸੰਗਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
406.t: mahaa bikhaadhee dhusaT apavaadhee te puneet sa(n)gaare ||1||
406.e: Even the most argumentative, vicious and indecent people, have been purified in Your company. ||1||

406.g: ਜਨਮ ਭਵੰਤੇ ਨਰਕਿ ਪੜੰਤੇ ਤਿਨੑ ਕੇ ਕੁਲ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
406.t: janam bhava(n)te narak paRa(n)te tin(h) ke kul udhaare ||2||
406.e: Those who have wandered in reincarnation, and those who have been consigned to hell - even their families have been redeemed. ||2||

406.g: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮਾਨੈ ਸੇ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹਰਿ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥੩॥
406.t: koi na jaanai koi na maanai se paragaT har dhuaare ||3||
406.e: Those whom no one knew, and those whom no one respected - even they have become famous and respected at the Court of the Lord. ||3||

406.g: ਕਵਨ ਉਪਮਾ ਦੇਉ ਕਵਨ ਵਡਾਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਵਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੪੧॥
406.t: kavan upamaa dheau kavan vaddaiee naanak khin khin vaare ||4||1||141||
406.e: What praise, and what greatness should I attribute to You? Nanak is a sacrifice to You, each and every moment. ||4||1||141||

406.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
406.t: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
406.e: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

406.g: ਬਾਵਰ ਸੋਇ ਰਹੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
406.t: baavar soi rahe ||1|| rahaau ||
406.e: The crazy people are asleep. ||1||Pause||

406.g: ਮੋਹ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਬਿਖੈ ਰਸ ਮਾਤੇ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਗਹਨ ਗਹੇ ॥੧॥
406.t: moh kuTa(n)b bikhai ras maate mithiaa gahan gahe ||1||
406.e: They are intoxicated with attachment to their families and sensory pleasures; they are held in the grip of falsehood. ||1||

406.g: ਮਿਥਨ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਸੁਪਨ ਆਨੰਦ ਉਲਾਸ ਮਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਹੇ ॥੨॥
406.t: mithan manorath supan aana(n)dh ulaas man mukh sat kahe ||2||
406.e: The false desires, and the dream-like delights and pleasures - these, the self-willed manmukhs call true. ||2||

406.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਸੰਗੇ ਤਿਲੁ ਮਰਮੁ ਨ ਲਹੇ ॥੩॥
406.t: a(n)mrit naam padhaarath sa(n)ge til maram na lahe ||3||
406.e: The wealth of the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, is with them, but they do not find even a tiny bit of its mystery. ||3||

406.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਰਾਖੇ ਸਤਸੰਗੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਆਹੇ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੪੨॥
406.t: kar kirapaa raakhe satasa(n)ge naanak saran aahe ||4||2||142||
406.e: By Your Grace, O Lord, You save those, who take to the Sanctuary of the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. ||4||2||142||

406.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਤਿਪਦੇ ॥
406.t: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa tipadhe ||
406.e: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla, Thi-Padhay:

406.g: ਓਹਾ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
406.t: ohaa prem piree ||1|| rahaau ||
406.e: I seek the Love of my Beloved. ||1||Pause||

406.g: ਕਨਿਕ ਮਾਣਿਕ ਗਜ ਮੋਤੀਅਨ ਲਾਲਨ ਨਹ ਨਾਹ ਨਹੀ ॥੧॥
406.t: kanik maanik gaj moteean laalan neh naeh nahee ||1||
406.e: Gold, jewels, giant pearls and rubies - I have no need for them. ||1||

406.g: ਰਾਜ ਨ ਭਾਗ ਨ ਹੁਕਮ ਨ ਸਾਦਨ ॥
406.t: raaj na bhaag na hukam na saadhan ||
406.e: Imperial power, fortunes, royal command and mansions

407.e: - I have no desire for these. ||2||
The Sanctuary of the Lord's Feet, and dedication to the Saints
these bring me peace and pleasure.
O Nanak, my burning fire has been put out,
obtaining the Love of the Beloved. ||3||3||143||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
The Guru has revealed Him to my eyes. ||1||Pause||

407.g: ਈਤਹਿ ਊਤਹਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਤੂੰਹੀ ਤੂੰਹੀ ਮੋਹਿਨਾ ॥੧॥
407.t: e'eeteh uooteh ghaT ghaT ghaT ghaT too(n)hee too(n)hee mohinaa ||1||
407.e: Here and there, in each and every heart, and each and every being, You, O Fascinating Lord, You exist. ||1||

407.g: ਕਾਰਨ ਕਰਨਾ ਧਾਰਨ ਧਰਨਾ ਏਕੈ ਏਕੈ ਸੋਹਿਨਾ ॥੨॥
407.t: kaaran karanaa dhaaran dharanaa ekai ekai sohinaa ||2||
407.e: You are the Creator, the Cause of causes, the Support of the earth; You are the One and only, Beauteous Lord. ||2||

407.g: ਸੰਤਨ ਪਰਸਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਦਰਸਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਸੋਇਨਾ ॥੩॥੪॥੧੪੪॥
407.t: sa(n)tan parasan balihaaree dharasan naanak sukh sukh soinaa ||3||4||144||
407.e: Meeting the Saints, and beholding the Blessed Vision of their Darshan, Nanak is a sacrifice to them; he sleeps in absolute peace. ||3||4||144||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is priceless.
It brings peace and poise. ||1||Pause||

407.g: ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਓਹੁ ਅਗਹ ਅਤੋਲਾ ॥੧॥
407.t: sa(n)g sahaiee chhodd na jaiee oh ageh atolaa ||1||
407.e: The Lord is my Companion and Helper; He shall not forsake me or leave me. He is unfathomable and unequalled. ||1||

407.g: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਭਾਈ ਬਾਪੁ ਮੋਰੋ ਮਾਈ ਭਗਤਨ ਕਾ ਓਲੑਾ ॥੨॥
407.t: preetam bhaiee baap moro maiee bhagatan kaa ol(h)aa ||2||
407.e: He is my Beloved, my brother, father and mother; He is the Support of His devotees. ||2||

407.g: ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਚੋਲੑਾ ॥੩॥੫॥੧੪੫॥
407.t: alakh lakhaiaa gur te paiaa naanak ih har kaa chol(h)aa ||3||5||145||
407.e: The Invisible Lord is seen through the Guru; O Nanak, this is the wondrous play of the Lord. ||3||5||145||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
Please help me sustain my devotion.
O Lord Master, I have come to You. ||1||Pause||

407.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਹੋਇ ਸਕਾਰਥੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਚਰਨ ਬਸਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
407.t: naam padhaarath hoi sakaarath hiradhai charan basaeh ||1||
407.e: With the wealth of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, life becomes fruitful. Lord, please place Your Feet within my heart. ||1||

407.g: ਏਹ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਏਹ ਜੁਗਤਾ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਸੰਗਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
407.t: eh mukataa eh jugataa raakhahu sa(n)t sa(n)gaeh ||2||
407.e: This is liberation, and this is the best way of life; please, keep me in the Society of the Saints. ||2||

407.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਉ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਹਿ ॥੩॥੬॥੧੪੬॥
407.t: naam dhiaavau sahaj samaavau naanak har gun gaeh ||3||6||146||
407.e: Meditating on the Naam, I am absorbed in celestial peace; O Nanak, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||6||146||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
The Feet of my Lord and Master are so Beautiful!
The Lord's Saints obtain them. ||1||Pause||

407.g: ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਇਆ ਗੁਨ ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿ ਗਾਵੇ ॥੧॥
407.t: aap gavaiaa sev kamaiaa gun ras ras gaave ||1||
407.e: They eradicate their self-conceit and serve the Lord; drenched in His Love, they sing His Glorious Praises. ||1||

407.g: ਏਕਹਿ ਆਸਾ ਦਰਸ ਪਿਆਸਾ ਆਨ ਨ ਭਾਵੇ ॥੨॥
407.t: ekeh aasaa dharas piaasaa aan na bhaave ||2||
407.e: They place their hopes in Him, and they thirst for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. Nothing else is pleasing to them. ||2||

407.g: ਦਇਆ ਤੁਹਾਰੀ ਕਿਆ ਜੰਤ ਵਿਚਾਰੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਵੇ ॥੩॥੭॥੧੪੭॥
407.t: dhiaa tuhaaree kiaa ja(n)t vichaaree naanak bal bal jaave ||3||7||147||
407.e: This is Your Mercy, Lord; what can Your poor creatures do? Nanak is devoted, a sacrifice to You. ||3||7||147||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
Remember the One Lord in meditation within your mind. ||1||Pause||

407.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਬਸਾਵਹੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
407.t: naam dhiaavahu ridhai basaavahu tis bin ko naahee ||1||
407.e: Meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and enshrine Him within your heart. Without Him there is no other. ||1||

407.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਨੀ ਆਈਐ ਸਰਬ ਫਲ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਗਲੇ ਦੁਖ ਜਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
407.t: prabh saranee aaieeaai sarab fal paieeaai sagale dhukh jaahee ||2||
407.e: Entering God's Sanctuary, all rewards are obtained, and all pains are taken away. ||2||

407.g: ਜੀਅਨ ਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਆਹੀ ॥੩॥੮॥੧੪੮॥
407.t: jeean ko dhaataa purakh bidhaataa naanak ghaT ghaT aahee ||3||8||148||
407.e: He is the Giver of all beings, the Architect of Destiny; O Nanak, He is contained in each and every heart. ||3||8||148||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
One who forgets the Lord is dead. ||1||Pause||

407.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ਸਰਬ ਫਲ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਸੁਖੀਆ ਹੂਆ ॥੧॥
407.t: naam dhiaavai sarab fal paavai so jan sukheeaa hooaa ||1||
407.e: One who meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, obtains all rewards. That person becomes happy. ||1||

407.g: ਰਾਜੁ ਕਹਾਵੈ ਹਉ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਬਾਧਿਓ ਨਲਿਨੀ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਸੂਆ ॥੨॥
407.t: raaj kahaavai hau karam kamaavai baadhio nalinee bhram sooaa ||2||
407.e: One who calls himself a king, and acts in ego and pride, is caught by his doubts, like a parrot in a trap. ||2||

407.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਥੀਆ ॥੩॥੯॥੧੪੯॥
407.t: kahu naanak jis satigur bheTiaa so jan nihachal theeaa ||3||9||149||
407.e: Says Nanak, one who meets the True Guru, becomes permanent and immortal. ||3||9||149||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla, Fourteenth House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
That love is forever fresh and new,

407.g: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
407.t: apune preetam siau laag rahai ||1|| rahaau ||
407.e: which is for the Beloved Lord. ||1||Pause||

407.g: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
407.t: jo prabh bhaavai janam na aavai ||
407.e: One who is pleasing to God shall not be reincarnated again.

407.g: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਰਚੈ ॥੧॥
407.t: har prem bhagat har preet rachai ||1||
407.e: He remains absorbed in the loving devotional worship of the Lord, in the Love of the Lord. ||1||

408.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲੀਜੈ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
408.t: prabh sa(n)g mileejai ih man dheejai ||
408.e: He is blended with God, by dedicating his mind to Him.

408.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਅਪਨੀ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ॥੨॥੧॥੧੫੦॥
408.t: naanak naam milai apanee dhiaa karahu ||2||1||150||
408.e: Bless Nanak with Your Name, O Lord - please, shower Your Mercy upon him! ||2||1||150||

408.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
408.t: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
408.e: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

408.g: ਮਿਲੁ ਰਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤੁਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਧੀਰਜੁ ਕੋ ਨ ਕਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
408.t: mil raam piaare tum bin dheeraj ko na karai ||1|| rahaau ||
408.e: Please, come to me, O Beloved Lord; without You, no one can comfort me. ||1||Pause||

408.g: ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮਰੇ ਦਰਸ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
408.t: si(n)mirat saasatr bahu karam kamaae prabh tumare dharas bin sukh naahee ||1||
408.e: One may read the Simritees and the Shaastras, and perform all sorts of religious rituals; and yet, without the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, God, there is no peace at all. ||1||

408.g: ਵਰਤ ਨੇਮ ਸੰਜਮ ਕਰਿ ਥਾਕੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧ ਸਰਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਗਿ ਵਸੈ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੫੧॥
408.t: varat nem sa(n)jam kar thaake naanak saadh saran prabh sa(n)g vasai ||2||2||151||
408.e: People have grown weary of observing fasts, vows and rigorous self-discipline; Nanak abides with God, in the Sanctuary of the Saints. ||2||2||151||

408.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧੫ ਪੜਤਾਲ
408.t: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ghar pandaravaa paRataal
408.e: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla, Fifteenth House, Partaal:

408.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
408.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
408.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

408.g: ਬਿਕਾਰ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਾਦਿ ਸੋਇਓ ਸੂਝ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
408.t: bikaar maiaa maadh soio soojh boojh na aavai ||
408.e: He sleeps, intoxicated by corruption and Maya; he does not come to realize or understand.

408.g: ਪਕਰਿ ਕੇਸ ਜਮਿ ਉਠਾਰਿਓ ਤਦ ਹੀ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
408.t: pakar kes jam uThaario tadh hee ghar jaavai ||1||
408.e: Seizing him by the hair, the Messenger of Death pulls him up; then, he comes to his senses. ||1||

408.g: ਲੋਭ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਬਿਖੈ ਲਾਗੇ ਹਿਰਿ ਵਿਤ ਚਿਤ ਦੁਖਾਹੀ ॥
408.t: lobh bikhiaa bikhai laage hir vit chit dhukhaahee ||
408.e: Those who are attached to the poison of greed and sin grab at the wealth of others; they only bring pain on themselves.

408.g: ਖਿਨ ਭੰਗੁਨਾ ਕੈ ਮਾਨਿ ਮਾਤੇ ਅਸੁਰ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
408.t: khin bha(n)gunaa kai maan maate asur jaaneh naahee ||1|| rahaau ||
408.e: They are intoxicated by their pride in those things which shall be destroyed in an instant; those demons do not understand. ||1||Pause||

408.g: ਬੇਦ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਜਨ ਪੁਕਾਰਹਿ ਸੁਨੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਡੋਰਾ ॥
408.t: bedh saasatr jan pukaareh sunai naahee ddoraa ||
408.e: The Vedas, the Shaastras and the holy men proclaim it, but the deaf do not hear it.

408.g: ਨਿਪਟਿ ਬਾਜੀ ਹਾਰਿ ਮੂਕਾ ਪਛੁਤਾਇਓ ਮਨਿ ਭੋਰਾ ॥੨॥
408.t: nipaT baajee haar mookaa pachhutaio man bhoraa ||2||
408.e: When the game of life is over, and he has lost, and he breathes his last, then the fool regrets and repents in his mind. ||2||

408.g: ਡਾਨੁ ਸਗਲ ਗੈਰ ਵਜਹਿ ਭਰਿਆ ਦੀਵਾਨ ਲੇਖੈ ਨ ਪਰਿਆ ॥
408.t: ddaan sagal gair vajeh bhariaa dheevaan lekhai na pariaa ||
408.e: He paid the fine, but it is in vain - in the Court of the Lord, his account is not credited.

408.g: ਜੇਂਹ ਕਾਰਜਿ ਰਹੈ ਓਲੑਾ ਸੋਇ ਕਾਮੁ ਨ ਕਰਿਆ ॥੩॥
408.t: je(n)h kaaraj rahai ol(h)aa soi kaam na kariaa ||3||
408.e: Those deeds which would have covered him - those deeds, he has not done. ||3||

408.g: ਐਸੋ ਜਗੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਓ ਤਉ ਏਕ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
408.t: aaiso jag moh gur dhikhaio tau ek keerat gaiaa ||
408.e: The Guru has shown me the world to be thus; I sing the Kirtan of the Praises of the One Lord.

408.g: ਮਾਨੁ ਤਾਨੁ ਤਜਿ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਸਰਣਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਇਆ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੫੨॥
408.t: maan taan taj siaanap saran naanak aaiaa ||4||1||152||
408.e: Renouncing his pride in strength and cleverness, Nanak has come to the Lord's Sanctuary. ||4||1||152||

408.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
408.t: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
408.e: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

408.g: ਬਾਪਾਰਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਨਾਏ ॥
408.t: baapaar govi(n)dh naae ||
408.e: Dealing in the Name of the Lord of the Universe,

408.g: ਸਾਧ ਸੰਤ ਮਨਾਏ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ਪੰਚ ਨਾਦ ਤੂਰ ਬਜਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
408.t: saadh sa(n)t manaae pria paae gun gaae pa(n)ch naadh toor bajaae ||1|| rahaau ||
408.e: and pleasing the Saints and holy men, obtain the Beloved Lord and sing His Glorious Praises; play the sound current of the Naad with the five instruments. ||1||Pause||

408.g: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪਾਏ ਸਹਜਾਏ ਦਰਸਾਏ ਅਬ ਰਾਤਿਆ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਸਿਉ ॥
408.t: kirapaa paae sahajaae dharasaae ab raatiaa govi(n)dh siau ||
408.e: Obtaining His Mercy, I easily gained the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; now, I am imbued with the Love of the Lord of the Universe.

408.g: ਸੰਤ ਸੇਵਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨਾਥ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਲਨ ਲਾਏ ॥੧॥
408.t: sa(n)t sev preet naath ra(n)g laalan laae ||1||
408.e: Serving the Saints, I feel love and affection for my Beloved Lord Master. ||1||

408.g: ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਮਨਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ਰਹਸਾਏ ਨਹੀ ਆਏ ਸਹਜਾਏ ਮਨਿ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
408.t: gur giaan man dhiraRaae rahasaae nahee aae sahajaae man nidhaan paae ||
408.e: The Guru has implanted spiritual wisdom within my mind, and I rejoice that I shall not have to come back again. I have obtained celestial poise, and the treasure within my mind.

408.g: ਸਭ ਤਜੀ ਮਨੈ ਕੀ ਕਾਮ ਕਰਾ ॥
408.t: sabh tajee manai kee kaam karaa ||
408.e: I have renounced all of the affairs of my mind's desires.

408.g: ਚਿਰੁ ਚਿਰੁ ਚਿਰੁ ਚਿਰੁ ਭਇਆ ਮਨਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਪਿਆਸ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
408.t: chir chir chir chir bhiaa man bahut piaas laagee ||
408.e: It has been so long, so long, so long, so very long, since my mind has felt such a great thirst.

408.g: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨੋ ਦਿਖਾਵਹੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਤੁਮ ਬਤਾਵਹੁ ॥
408.t: har dharasano dhikhaavahu moh tum bataavahu ||
408.e: Please, reveal to me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, and show Yourself to me.

408.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੀਨ ਸਰਣਿ ਆਏ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਏ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੫੩॥
408.t: naanak dheen saran aae gal laae ||2||2||153||
408.e: Nanak the meek has entered Your Sanctuary; please, take me in Your embrace. ||2||2||153||

408.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
408.t: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
408.e: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

408.g: ਕੋਊ ਬਿਖਮ ਗਾਰ ਤੋਰੈ ॥
408.t: kouoo bikham gaar torai ||
408.e: Who can destroy the fortress of sin,

408.g: ਆਸ ਪਿਆਸ ਧੋਹ ਮੋਹ ਭਰਮ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਹੋਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
408.t: aas piaas dhoh moh bharam hee te horai ||1|| rahaau ||
408.e: and release me from hope, thirst, deception, attachment and doubt? ||1||Pause||

408.g: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਲੋਭ ਮਾਨ ਇਹ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਛੋਰੈ ॥੧॥
408.t: kaam karodh lobh maan ieh biaadh chhorai ||1||
408.e: How can I escape the afflictions of sexual desire, anger, greed and pride? ||1||

408.g: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਗੁਨ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗਾਵਉ ॥
408.t: sa(n)tasa(n)g naam ra(n)g gun govi(n)dh gaavau ||
408.e: In the Society of the Saints, love the Naam, and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

408.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਿਆਵਉ ॥
408.t: anadhino prabh dhiaavau ||
408.e: Night and day, meditate on God.

408.g: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੀਤਿ ਜੀਤਿ ਮਿਟਾਵਉ ॥
408.t: bhram bheet jeet miTaavau ||
408.e: I have captured and demolished the walls of doubt.

408.t: nidh naam naanak morai ||2||3||154||
408.e: O Nanak, the Naam is my only treasure. ||2||3||154||

408.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
408.t: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
408.e: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

408.g: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਤਿਆਗੁ ॥
408.t: kaam karodh lobh tiaag ||
408.e: Renounce sexual desire, anger and greed;

408.g: ਮਨਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਾਮ ॥
408.t: man simar gobi(n)dh naam ||
408.e: remember the Name of the Lord of the Universe in your mind.

408.g: ਹਰਿ ਭਜਨ ਸਫਲ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
408.t: har bhajan safal kaam ||1|| rahaau ||
408.e: Meditation on the Lord is the only fruitful action. ||1||Pause||

409.g: ਤਜਿ ਮਾਨ ਮੋਹ ਵਿਕਾਰ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਜਪਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ॥
409.t: taj maan moh vikaar mithiaa jap raam raam raam ||
409.e: Renounce pride, attachment, corruption and falsehood, and chant the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam.
O mortal, attach yourself to the Feet of the Saints. ||1||

409.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਜਾਗੁ ॥
409.t: prabh gopaal dheen dhiaal patit paavan paarabraham har charan simar jaag ||
409.e: God is the Sustainer of the world, Merciful to the meek, the Purifier of sinners, the Transcendent Lord God. Awaken, and meditate on His Feet.
Perform His devotional worship, O Nanak, and your destiny shall be fulfilled. ||2||4||155||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

409.g: ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਬੈਰਾਗ ਅਨੰਦੀ ਖੇਲੁ ਰੀ ਦਿਖਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
409.t: harakh sog bairaag ana(n)dhee khel ree dhikhaio ||1|| rahaau ||
409.e: Pleasure and pain, detachment and ecstasy - the Lord has revealed His Play. ||1||Pause||

409.g: ਖਿਨਹੂੰ ਭੈ ਨਿਰਭੈ ਖਿਨਹੂੰ ਖਿਨਹੂੰ ਉਠਿ ਧਾਇਓ ॥
409.t: khinahoo(n) bhai nirabhai khinahoo(n) khinahoo(n) uTh dhaio ||
409.e: One moment, the mortal is in fear, and the next moment he is fearless; in a moment, he gets up and departs.

409.g: ਖਿਨਹੂੰ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਨ ਖਿਨਹੂੰ ਖਿਨਹੂ ਤਜਿ ਜਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
409.t: khinahoo(n) ras bhogan khinahoo(n) khinahoo taj jaio ||1||
409.e: One moment, he enjoys pleasures, and the next moment, he leaves and goes away. ||1||

409.g: ਖਿਨਹੂੰ ਜੋਗ ਤਾਪ ਬਹੁ ਪੂਜਾ ਖਿਨਹੂੰ ਭਰਮਾਇਓ ॥
409.t: khinahoo(n) jog taap bahu poojaa khinahoo(n) bharamaio ||
409.e: One moment, he practices Yoga and intense meditation, and all sorts of worship; the next moment, he wanders in doubt.

409.g: ਖਿਨਹੂੰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇਓ ॥੨॥੫॥੧੫੬॥
409.t: khinahoo(n) kirapaa saadhoo sa(n)g naanak har ra(n)g laio ||2||5||156||
409.e: One moment, O Nanak, the Lord bestows His Mercy and blesses him with His Love, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||2||5||156||

409.t: raag aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ghar sataaravaa aasaavaree
409.e: Raag Aasaa, Fifth Mehla, Seventeenth House, Aasaavaree:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Meditate on the Lord, the Lord of the Universe.
Cherish the Beloved Lord, Har, Har, in your mind.

409.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਕਹਿਆ ਸੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਧਰਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
409.t: gur kahiaa su chit dhar haa(n) ||
409.e: The Guru says to install it in your consciousness.
Turn away from others, and turn to Him.

409.g: ਐਸੇ ਲਾਲਨੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਰੀ ਸਖੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
409.t: aaise laalan paio ree sakhee ||1|| rahaau ||
409.e: Thus you shall obtain your Beloved, O my companion. ||1||Pause||
In the pool of the world is the mud of attachment.
Stuck in it, his feet cannot walk towards the Lord.
The fool is stuck;
he cannot do anything else.

409.g: ਤਉ ਨਿਕਸੈ ਸਰਨਿ ਪੈ ਰੀ ਸਖੀ ॥੧॥
409.t: tau nikasai saran pai ree sakhee ||1||
409.e: Only by entering the Lord's Sanctuary, O my companion, will you be released. ||1||
Thus your consciousness shall be stable and steady and firm.
Wilderness and household are the same.
Deep within dwells the One Husband Lord;
outwardly, there are many distractions.
Practice Raja Yoga, the Yoga of meditation and success.

409.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਲੋਗ ਅਲੋਗੀ ਰੀ ਸਖੀ ॥੨॥੧॥੧੫੭॥
409.t: kahu naanak log alogee ree sakhee ||2||1||157||
409.e: Says Nanak, this is the way to dwell with the people, and yet remain apart from them. ||2||1||157||
Aasaavaree, Fifth Mehla:
Cherish one desire only:
meditate continually on the Guru.
Install the wisdom of the Saints' Mantra.
Serve the Feet of the Guru,

409.g: ਤਉ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਨਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
409.t: tau mileeaai gur kirapaan mere manaa ||1|| rahaau ||
409.e: and you shall meet Him, by Guru's Grace, O my mind. ||1||Pause||
All doubts are dispelled,
and the Lord is seen to be pervading all places.
The fear of death is dispelled,
and the primal place is obtained.
Then, all subservience is removed. ||1||
One who has such destiny recorded upon his forehead, obtains it;
he crosses over the terrifying ocean of fire.
He obtains a place in the home of his own self,
and enjoys the most sublime essence of the Lord's essence.
His hunger is appeased;
Nanak, he is absorbed in celestial peace, O my mind. ||2||2||158||
Aasaavaree, Fifth Mehla:
Sing the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, Har.
Meditate on the celestial music.
The tongues of the holy Saints repeat it.
I have heard that this is the way to emancipation.

409.g: ਪਾਈਐ ਵਡ ਪੁਨੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
409.t: paieeaai vadd punee mere manaa ||1|| rahaau ||
409.e: This is found by the greatest merit, O my mind. ||1||Pause||
The silent sages search for Him.
God is the Master of all.
It is so difficult to find Him in this world, in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga.
He is the Dispeller of distress.
God is the Fulfiller of desires, O my mind. ||1||
O my mind, serve Him.

410.e: He is unknowable and inscrutable.
Enshrine love for Him.
He does not perish, or go away, or die.
He is known only through the Guru.
Nanak, my mind is satisfied with the Lord, O my mind. ||2||3||159||
Aasaavaree, Fifth Mehla:
Grab hold of the Support of the One Lord.
Chant the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
Submit to the Order of the True Lord.
Receive the treasure in your mind.
Thus you shall be absorbed in peace, O my mind. ||1||Pause||
One who is dead while yet alive,
crosses over the terrifying world-ocean.
One who becomes the dust of all
he alone is called fearless.
His anxieties are removed
by the Teachings of the Saints, O my mind. ||1||
That humble being, who takes happiness in the Naam, the Name of the Lord

410.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਕਦੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਹਾਂ ॥
410.t: tis nikaT na kadhe dhukh haa(n) ||
410.e: pain never draws near him.

410.g: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਨੇ ਹਾਂ ॥
410.t: jo har har jas sune haa(n) ||
410.e: One who listens to the Praise of the Lord, Har, Har,
is obeyed by all men.
How fortunate it is that he came into the world;
Nanak, he is pleasing to God, O my mind. ||2||4||160||
Aasaavaree, Fifth Mehla:
Meeting together, let us sing the Praises of the Lord,
and attain the supreme state.
Those who obtain that sublime essence,
obtain all of the spiritual powers of the Siddhas.
They remain awake and aware night and day;
Nanak, they are blessed by great good fortune, O my mind. ||1||Pause||
Let us wash the feet of the Saints;
our evil-mindedness shall be cleansed.
Becoming the dust of the feet of the Lord's slaves,
one shall not be afflicted with pain.
Taking to the Sanctuary of His devotees,
he is no longer subject to birth and death.
They alone become eternal,

410.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਿਨੑ ਜਪਿ ਲਏ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੧॥
410.t: har har jin(h) jap le mere manaa ||1||
410.e: who chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my mind. ||1||
You are my Friend, my Best Friend.
Please, implant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within me.
Without Him, there is not any other.
Within my mind, I worship Him in adoration.
I do not forget Him, even for an instant.
How can I live without Him?
I am a sacrifice to the Guru.
Nanak, chant the Name, O my mind. ||2||5||161||
Aasaavaree, Fifth Mehla:
You are the Creator, the Cause of causes.
I cannot think of any other.
Whatever You do, comes to pass.
I sleep in peace and poise.
My mind has become patient,

410.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਦਰਿ ਪਏ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
410.t: prabh kai dhar pe mere manaa ||1|| rahaau ||
410.e: since I fell at God's Door, O my mind. ||1||Pause||
Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy,
I gained perfect control over my senses.
Ever since I rid myself of my self-conceit,
my sufferings have ended.
He has showered His Mercy upon me.
The Creator Lord has preserved my honor, O my mind. ||1||
Know that this is the only peace;
accept whatever the Lord does.
No one is bad.
Become the dust of the Feet of the Saints.
He Himself preserves those

410.g: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸੋ ਚਖੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੨॥
410.t: har a(n)mrit so chakhai mere manaa ||2||
410.e: who taste the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord, O my mind. ||2||
One who has no one to call his own
God belongs to him.
God knows the state of our innermost being.
He knows everything.
Please, Lord, save the sinners.
This is Nanak's prayer, O my mind. ||3||6||162||
Aasaavaree, Fifth Mehla, Ek-Thukay:
O my stranger soul,
listen to the call. ||1||Pause||
Whatever you are attached to,

411.e: you shall have to leave it all behind.
These things seem like only a dream,
to one who takes the Lord's Name. ||1||
Forsaking the Lord, and clinging to another,
they run toward death and reincarnation.
But those humble beings, who attach themselves to the Lord, Har, Har,
continue to live.
One who is blessed with the Lord's Mercy,
O Nanak, becomes His devotee. ||2||7||163||232||
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Raag Aasaa, Ninth Mehla:

411.g: ਬਿਰਥਾ ਕਹਉ ਕਉਨ ਸਿਉ ਮਨ ਕੀ ॥
411.t: birathaa kahau kaun siau man kee ||
411.e: Who should I tell the condition of the mind?

411.g: ਲੋਭਿ ਗ੍ਰਸਿਓ ਦਸ ਹੂ ਦਿਸ ਧਾਵਤ ਆਸਾ ਲਾਗਿਓ ਧਨ ਕੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
411.t: lobh grasio dhas hoo dhis dhaavat aasaa laagio dhan kee ||1|| rahaau ||
411.e: Engrossed in greed, running around in the ten directions, you hold to your hopes of wealth. ||1||Pause||

411.g: ਸੁਖ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਤ ਸੇਵ ਕਰਤ ਜਨ ਜਨ ਕੀ ॥
411.t: sukh kai het bahut dhukh paavat sev karat jan jan kee ||
411.e: For the sake of pleasure, you suffer such great pain, and you have to serve each and every person.

411.g: ਦੁਆਰਹਿ ਦੁਆਰਿ ਸੁਆਨ ਜਿਉ ਡੋਲਤ ਨਹ ਸੁਧ ਰਾਮ ਭਜਨ ਕੀ ॥੧॥
411.t: dhuaareh dhuaar suaan jiau ddolat neh sudh raam bhajan kee ||1||
411.e: You wander from door to door like a dog, unconscious of the Lord's meditation. ||1||

411.g: ਮਾਨਸ ਜਨਮ ਅਕਾਰਥ ਖੋਵਤ ਲਾਜ ਨ ਲੋਕ ਹਸਨ ਕੀ ॥
411.t: maanas janam akaarath khovat laaj na lok hasan kee ||
411.e: You lose this human life in vain, and You are not even ashamed when others laugh at you.

411.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਕਿਉ ਨਹੀ ਗਾਵਤ ਕੁਮਤਿ ਬਿਨਾਸੈ ਤਨ ਕੀ ॥੨॥੧॥੨੩੩॥
411.t: naanak har jas kiau nahee gaavat kumat binaasai tan kee ||2||1||233||
411.e: O Nanak, why not sing the Lord's Praises, so that you may be rid of the body's evil disposition? ||2||1||233||

411.t: raag aasaa mahalaa pehilaa asaTapadheeaa ghar doojaa
411.e: Raag Aasaa, First Mehla, Ashtpadheeyaa, Second House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
He descends the treacherous precipice, to bathe in the cleansing pool;

411.g: ਬਕੈ ਨ ਬੋਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
411.t: bakai na bolai har gun gaavai ||
411.e: without speaking or saying anything, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
Like water vapor in the sky, he remains absorbed in the Lord.

411.g: ਰਸੁ ਸਤੁ ਝੋਲਿ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
411.t: ras sat jhol mahaa ras paavai ||1||
411.e: He churns the true pleasures to obtain the supreme nectar. ||1||
Listen to such spiritual wisdom, O my mind.

411.g: ਭਰਿਪੁਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਭ ਠਉਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
411.t: bharipur dhaar rahiaa sabh Thaure ||1|| rahaau ||
411.e: The Lord is totally pervading and permeating all places. ||1||Pause||

411.g: ਸਚੁ ਬ੍ਰਤੁ ਨੇਮੁ ਨ ਕਾਲੁ ਸੰਤਾਵੈ ॥
411.t: sach brat nem na kaal sa(n)taavai ||
411.e: One who makes Truthfulness his fast and religious vows, does not suffer the pain of death.
Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he burns away his anger.
He dwells in the Tenth Gate, immersed in the Samaadhi of deep meditation.
Touching the philosopher's stone, he obtains the supreme status. ||2||
For the benefit of the mind, churn the true essence of reality;
bathing in the over-flowing tank of nectar, filth is washed away.
We become like the One with whom we are imbued.
Whatever the Creator does, comes to pass. ||3||
The Guru is cool and soothing like ice; He puts out the fire of the mind.
Smear your body with the ashes of dedicated service,
and live in the home of peace - make this your religious order.
Let the Immaculate Bani of the Word be your playing of the flute. ||4||
Spiritual wisdom within is the supreme, sublime nectar.
Contemplation of the Guru is one's bathing at holy places of pilgrimage.
Worship and adoration within is the Lord's dwelling.
He is the One who blends one's light with the Divine Light. ||5||
He delights in the delightful wisdom of loving the One Lord.
He is one of the self-elect - he merges with the Lord, who occupies the throne.
He performs his works in obedience to the Will of his Lord and Master.
The Unknowable Lord cannot be understood. ||6||

411.g: ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਜਲ ਤੇ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
411.t: jal meh upajai jal te dhoor ||
411.e: The lotus originates in the water, and yet it remains distinct from the water.
Just so, the Divine Light pervades and permeates the water of the world.
Who is near, and who is far away?
I sing the Glories of the Lord, the treasure of virtue; I behold Him ever-present. ||7||
Inwardly and outwardly, there is none other than Him.

412.g: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਫੁਨਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
412.t: jo tis bhaavai so fun hoi ||
412.e: Whatever pleases Him, comes to pass.
Listen, O Bharthari Yogi - Nanak speaks after deliberation;
the Immaculate Name is my only Support. ||8||1||
Aasaa, First Mehla:

412.g: ਸਭਿ ਜਪ ਸਭਿ ਤਪ ਸਭ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
412.t: sabh jap sabh tap sabh chaturaiee ||
412.e: All meditation, all austerities, and all clever tricks,
lead one to wander in the wilderness, but he does not find the Path.

412.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਕੋ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
412.t: bin boojhe ko thai na paiee ||
412.e: Without understanding, he is not approved;
without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, ashes are thrown upon one's head. ||1||
True is the Master; the world comes and goes.
The mortal is emancipated, as Gurmukh, as the Lord's slave. ||1||Pause||
The world is bound by its attachments to the many desires.
Through the Guru's Teachings, some become free of desire.
Within them is the Naam, and their heart lotus blossoms forth.

412.g: ਤਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਾਸਾ ॥੨॥
412.t: tin(h) kau naahee jam kee traasaa ||2||
412.e: They have no fear of death. ||2||
The men of the world are conquered by woman; they love the ladies.
Attached to children and wife, they forget the Naam.
They waste this human life in vain, and lose the game in the gamble.
Serving the True Guru is the best occupation. ||3||
One who speaks egotistically in public,

412.g: ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਲੇਪੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਲਾਏ ॥
412.t: a(n)dharahu mukat lep kadhe na laae ||
412.e: never attains liberation within.
One who burns away his attachment to Maya, by the Word of the Guru's Shabad,
meditates forever within his heart on the Immaculate Naam. ||4||
He restrains his wandering mind, and keeps it under control.
The company of such a Sikh is obtained only by Grace.
Without the Guru, he goes astray and continues coming and going.
Bestowing His Mercy, the Lord unites him in Union. ||5||
I cannot describe the Beauteous Lord.
I speak the unspoken; I cannot estimate His value.
All pain and pleasure come by Your Will.
All pain is eradicated by the True Name. ||6||

412.g: ਕਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਵਾਜਾ ਪਗ ਬਿਨੁ ਤਾਲਾ ॥
412.t: kar bin vaajaa pag bin taalaa ||
412.e: He plays the instrument without hands, and dances without feet.

412.g: ਜੇ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੁਝੈ ਤਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ ॥
412.t: je sabadh bujhai taa sach nihaalaa ||
412.e: But if he understands the Word of the Shabad, then he shall behold the True Lord.
With the True Lord within the self, all happiness comes.
Showering His Mercy, the Preserving Lord preserves him. ||7||
He understands the three worlds; he eliminates his self-conceit.
He understands the Bani of the Word, and he is absorbed into the True Lord.
Contemplating the Shabad, he enshrines love for the One Lord.
O Nanak, blessed is the Lord, the Embellisher. ||8||2||
Aasaa, First Mehla:
There are innumerable writings; those who write them take pride in them.
When one's mind accepts the Truth, he understands, and speaks of it.
Words, spoken and read again and again, are useless loads.
There are innumerable writings, but the Infinite Lord remains unwritten. ||1||
Know that such a True Lord is the One and only.
Understand that birth and death come according to the Lord's Will. ||1||Pause||
Because of attachment to Maya, the world is bound by the Messenger of Death.
These bonds are released when one remembers the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
The Guru is the Giver of peace; do not look for any other.
In this world, and the next, He shall stand by you. ||2||

412.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਤਾਂ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
412.t: sabadh marai taa(n) ek liv laae ||
412.e: One who dies in the Word of the Shabad, embraces love for the One Lord.
One who eats the uneatable, has his doubts dispelled.
He is Jivan Mukta - liberated while yet alive; the Naam abides in his mind.
Becoming Gurmukh, he merges into the True Lord. ||3||
The One who created the earth and the Akaashic ethers of the sky,
established all; He establishes and disestablishes.
He Himself is permeating all.
He does not consult anyone; He Himself forgives. ||4||
You are the Ocean, over-flowing with jewels and rubies.
You are immaculate and pure, the true treasure of virtue.

413.e: Peace is enjoyed, meeting the Guru, the Spiritual Teacher.
The Lord is the only Master; He is the only Minister. ||5||
The world is held in bondage; he alone is emancipated, who conquers his ego.
How rare in the world is that wise person, who practices this.
How rare in this world is that scholar who reflects upon this.

413.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੇ ਸਭ ਫਿਰੈ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥੬॥
413.t: bin satigur bheTe sabh firai aha(n)kaaree ||6||
413.e: Without meeting the True Guru, all wander in ego. ||6||
The world is unhappy; only a few are happy.
The world is diseased, from its indulgences; it weeps over its lost virtue.
The world wells up, and then subsides, losing its honor.
He alone, who becomes Gurmukh, understands. ||7||
His price is so costly; His weight is unbearable.
He is immovable and undeceivable; enshrine Him in your mind, through the Guru's Teachings.
Meet Him through love, become pleasing to Him, and act in fear of Him.
Nanak the lowly says this, after deep contemplation. ||8||3||
Aasaa, First Mehla:
When someone dies, the five passions meet and mourn his death.
Overcoming self-conceit, he washes off his filth with the Word of the Shabad.
One who knows and understands, enters the home of peace and poise.
Without understanding, he loses all his honor. ||1||
Who dies, and who weeps for him?

413.g: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਭਸੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਤੋਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
413.t: karan kaaran sabhasai sir tohee ||1|| rahaau ||
413.e: O Lord, Creator, Cause of causes, You are over the heads of all. ||1||Pause||
Who weeps over the pain of the dead?
Those who weep, do so over their own troubles.
God knows the condition of those who are so affected.
Whatever the Creator does, comes to pass. ||2||
One who remains dead while yet alive, is saved, and saves others as well.
Celebrate the Victory of the Lord; taking to His Sanctuary, the supreme status is obtained.
I am a sacrifice to the feet of the True Guru.
The Guru is the boat; through the Shabad of His Word, the terrifying world-ocean is crossed over. ||3||
He Himself is Fearless; His Divine Light is contained in all.
Without the Name, the world is defiled and untouchable.
Through evil-mindedness, they are ruined; why should they cry out and weep?
They are born only to die, without hearing the music of devotional worship. ||4||
Only one's true friends mourn one's death.
Those under the sway of the three dispositions continue to mourn on and on.
Disregarding pain and pleasure, center your consciousness on the Lord.
Dedicate your body and mind to the Love of the Lord. ||5||
The One Lord dwells within the various and countless beings.
There are so many rituals and religious faiths, their number is innumerable.
Without the Fear of God, and devotional worship, one's life is in vain.
Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the supreme wealth is obtained. ||6||
He Himself dies, and He Himself kills.
He Himself establishes, and having established, disestablishes.
He created the Universe, and by His Divine Nature, instilled His Divine Light into it.
One who reflects upon the Word of the Shabad, meets the Lord, without doubt. ||7||
Pollution is the burning fire, which is consuming the world.

413.g: ਸੂਤਕੁ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਥਾਇ ॥
413.t: sootak jal thal sabh hee thai ||
413.e: Pollution is in the water, upon the land, and everywhere.
O Nanak, people are born and die in pollution.
By Guru's Grace, they drink in the Lord's sublime elixir. ||8||4||
Aasaa, First Mehla:
One who contemplates his own self, tests the worth of the jewel.
With a single glance, the Perfect Guru saves him.

413.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਮਾਨੈ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰਾ ॥੧॥
413.t: gur maanai man te man dheeraa ||1||
413.e: When the Guru is pleased, one's mind comforts itself. ||1||
He is such a banker, who tests us.

413.g: ਸਾਚੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਤਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
413.t: saachee nadhar ek liv tarai ||1|| rahaau ||
413.e: By His True Glance of Grace, we are blessed with the Love of the One Lord, and are saved. ||1||Pause||
The capital of the Naam is immaculate and sublime.
That peddler is rendered pure, who is imbued with the Truth.
Praising the Lord, in the house of poise, he attains the Guru, the Creator. ||2||
One who burns away hope and desire through the Word of the Shabad,
chants the Lord's Name, and inspires others to chant it as well.

413.g: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਵਾਟ ਮਹਲੁ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
413.t: gur te vaaT mahal ghar paae ||3||
413.e: Through the Guru, he finds the Path home, to the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||3||

414.e: His body becomes golden, by the Lord's Incomparable Light.
He beholds the divine beauty in all the three worlds.

414.g: ਮੈ ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਅਖੂਟੁ ॥੪॥
414.t: mai so dhan palai saach akhooT ||4||
414.e: That inexhaustible wealth of Truth is now in my lap. ||4||
In the five elements, the three worlds, the nine regions and the four directions, the Lord is pervading.
He supports the earth and the sky, exercising His almighty power.
He turns the outgoing mind around. ||5||
The fool does not realize what he sees with his eyes.
He does not taste with his tongue, and does not understand what is said.

414.g: ਬਿਖੁ ਕਾ ਮਾਤਾ ਜਗ ਸਿਉ ਲੂਝੈ ॥੬॥
414.t: bikh kaa maataa jag siau loojhai ||6||
414.e: Intoxicated with poison, he argues with the world. ||6||
In the uplifting society, one is uplifted.
He chases after virtue and washes off his sins.

414.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਸਹਜੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ॥੭॥
414.t: bin gur seve sahaj na hovai ||7||
414.e: Without serving the Guru, celestial poise is not obtained. ||7||
The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is a diamond, a jewel, a ruby.

414.g: ਮਨੁ ਮੋਤੀ ਹੈ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਮਾਲੁ ॥
414.t: man motee hai tis kaa maal ||
414.e: The pearl of the mind is the inner wealth.
O Nanak, the Lord tests us, and blesses us with His Glance of Grace. ||8||5||
Aasaa, First Mehla:
The Gurmukh obtains spiritual wisdom, meditation and satisfaction of the mind.
The Gurmukh realizes the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.
The Gurmukh is attuned to the Word of the Shabad, as his Insignia. ||1||
Such is the loving devotional worship of the Lord's contemplation.
The Gurmukh realizes the True Name, the Destroyer of ego. ||1||Pause||
Day and night, he remains immaculately pure, and abides in the sublime place.
He gains the wisdom of the three worlds.
Through the True Guru, the Command of the Lord's Will is realized. ||2||
He enjoys true pleasure, and suffers no pain.
He enjoys the ambrosial wisdom, and the highest sublime essence.
He overcomes the five evil passions, and becomes the happiest of all men. ||3||
Your Divine Light is contained in all; everyone belongs to You.
You Yourself join and separate again.
Whatever the Creator does, comes to pass. ||4||
He demolishes, and He builds; by His Order, he merges us into Himself.
Whatever is pleasing to His Will, happens.

414.g: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੫॥
414.t: gur bin pooraa koi na paavai ||5||
