414.e: Without the Guru, no one obtains the Perfect Lord. ||5||
In childhood and old age, he does not understand.
In the prime of youth, he is drowned in his pride.
Without the Name, what can the fool obtain? ||6||

414.g: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਅਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ॥
414.t: jis kaa an dhan sahaj na jaanaa ||
414.e: He does not know the One who blesses him with nourishment and wealth.
Deluded by doubt, he later regrets and repents.
The noose of death is around the neck of that crazy madman. ||7||

414.g: ਬੂਡਤ ਜਗੁ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਤਉ ਡਰਿ ਭਾਗੇ ॥
414.t: booddat jag dhekhiaa tau ddar bhaage ||
414.e: I saw the world drowning, and I ran away in fear.
How very fortunate are those who have been saved by the True Guru.
O Nanak, they are attached to the feet of the Guru. ||8||6||
Aasaa, First Mehla:
They sing religious songs, but their consciousness is wicked.
They sing the songs, and call themselves divine,
but without the Name, their minds are false and wicked. ||1||
Where are you going? O mind, remain in your own home.

414.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੇ ਖੋਜਤ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਹਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
414.t: gurmukh raam naam tirapataase khojat paavahu sahaj hare ||1|| rahaau ||
414.e: The Gurmukhs are satisfied with the Lord's Name; searching, they easily find the Lord. ||1||Pause||
Sexual desire, anger and emotional attachment fill the mind and body;
greed and egotism lead only to pain.

414.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰਾ ॥੨॥
414.t: raam naam bin kiau man dheeraa ||2||
414.e: How can the mind be comforted without the Lord's Name? ||2||
One who cleanses himself within, knows the True Lord.
The Gurmukh knows the condition of his innermost being.

414.g: ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦ ਬਿਨੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥੩॥
414.t: saach sabadh bin mahal na pachhaanai ||3||
414.e: Without the True Word of the Shabad, the Mansion of the Lord's Presence is not realized. ||3||
One who merges his form into the Formless Lord,
abides in the True Lord, the Powerful, beyond power.

414.g: ਸੋ ਨਰੁ ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ ॥੪॥
414.t: so nar garabh jon nahee aavai ||4||
414.e: Such a person does not enter into the womb of reincarnation again. ||4||
Go there, where you may obtain the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

415.e: By Guru's Grace, perform good deeds.
Imbued with the Naam, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||5||
Serving the Guru, I have come to understand myself.
The Ambrosial Naam, the Giver of Peace, abides within my mind.
Night and day, I am imbued with the Word of the Guru's Bani, and the Naam. ||6||

415.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲਾਏ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
415.t: meraa prabh laae taa ko laagai ||
415.e: When my God attaches someone to Him, only then is that person attached.
Conquering ego, he remains awake to the Word of the Shabad.
Here and hereafter, he enjoys lasting peace. ||7||
The fickle mind does not know the way.
The filthy self-willed manmukh does not understand the Shabad.
The Gurmukh chants the Immaculate Naam. ||8||
I offer my prayer to the Lord,
that I might dwell in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

415.g: ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਦੁਖ ਕਾਟੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ॥੯॥
415.t: kilavikh dhukh kaaTe har naam pragaas ||9||
415.e: There, sins and sufferings are erased, and one is illumined with the Lord's Name. ||9||
In reflective meditation, I have come to love good conduct.
Through the Word of the True Guru, I recognize the One Lord.
O Nanak, my mind is imbued with the Lord's Name. ||10||7||
Aasaa, First Mehla:
The mind of the faithless cynic is like a crazy elephant.
It wanders around the forest, distracted by attachment to Maya.

415.g: ਇਤ ਉਤ ਜਾਹਿ ਕਾਲ ਕੇ ਚਾਪੇ ॥
415.t: eit ut jaeh kaal ke chaape ||
415.e: It goes here and there, hounded by death.
The Gurmukh seeks, and finds his own home. ||1||

415.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੈ ਮਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਠਉਰਾ ॥
415.t: bin gur sabadhai man nahee Thauraa ||
415.e: Without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the mind finds no place of rest.

415.g: ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਅਵਰ ਤਿਆਗਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਉਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
415.t: simarahu raam naam at niramal avar tiaagahu haumai kauraa ||1|| rahaau ||
415.e: Remember in meditation the Lord's Name, the most pure and sublime; renounce your bitter egotism. ||1||Pause||

415.g: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਉ ਰਹਸੀ ॥
415.t: eih man mugadh kahahu kiau rahasee ||
415.e: Tell me, how can this stupid mind be rescued?

415.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਮਝੇ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਹਸੀ ॥
415.t: bin samajhe jam kaa dhukh sahasee ||
415.e: Without understanding, it shall suffer the pains of death.
The Lord Himself forgives us, and unites us with the True Guru.
The True Lord conquers and overcomes the tortures of death. ||2||

415.g: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਰਮਾ ॥
415.t: eih man karamaa ih man dharamaa ||
415.e: This mind commits its deeds of karma, and this mind follows the Dharma.

415.g: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਤੇ ਜਨਮਾ ॥
415.t: eih man pa(n)ch tat te janamaa ||
415.e: This mind is born of the five elements.
This foolish mind is perverted and greedy.
Chanting the Naam, the mind of the Gurmukh becomes beautiful. ||3||
The mind of the Gurmukh finds the Lord's home.
The Gurmukh comes to know the three worlds.

415.g: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਜੋਗੀ ਭੋਗੀ ਤਪੁ ਤਾਪੈ ॥
415.t: eih man jogee bhogee tap taapai ||
415.e: This mind is a Yogi, an enjoyer, a practicer of austerities.
The Gurmukh understands the Lord God Himself. ||4||
This mind is a detached renunciate, forsaking egotism.
Desire and duality afflict each and every heart.
The Gurmukh drinks in the Lord's sublime essence;

415.g: ਦਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਮਹਲੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖੈ ॥੫॥
415.t: dhar ghar mahalee har pat raakhai ||5||
415.e: at His Door, in the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, He preserves his honor. ||5||
This mind is the king, the hero of cosmic battles.
The mind of the Gurmukh becomes fearless through the Naam.
Overpowering and subduing the five passions,
holding ego in its grip, it confines them to one place. ||6||
The Gurmukh renounces other songs and tastes.
The mind of the Gurmukh is awakened to devotion.
Hearing the unstruck music of the sound current, this mind contemplates the Shabad, and accepts it.
Understanding itself, this soul becomes attuned to the Formless Lord. ||7||

415.g: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਦਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
415.t: eih man niramal dhar ghar soiee ||
415.e: This mind becomes immaculately pure, in the Court and the Home of the Lord.
The Gurmukh shows his love through loving devotional worship.
Night and day, by Guru's Grace, sing the Lord's Praises.

415.g: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ॥੮॥
415.t: ghaT ghaT so prabh aadh jugaadh ||8||
415.e: God dwells in each and every heart, since the very beginning of time, and throughout the ages. ||8||
This mind is intoxicated with the sublime essence of the Lord;
The Gurmukh realizes the essence of totality.
For the sake of devotional worship, he dwells at the Guru's Feet.

415.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਾ ॥੯॥੮॥
415.t: naanak har jan ke dhaasan dhaasaa ||9||8||
415.e: Nanak is the humble servant of the slave of the Lord's slaves. ||9||8||

416.e: Aasaa, First Mehla:

416.g: ਤਨੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਧਨੁ ਕਾ ਕੋ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
416.t: tan binasai dhan kaa ko kaheeaai ||
416.e: When the body perishes, whose wealth is it?

416.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਤ ਲਹੀਐ ॥
416.t: bin gur raam naam kat laheeaai ||
416.e: Without the Guru, how can the Lord's Name be obtained?
The wealth of the Lord's Name is my Companion and Helper.
Night and day, center your loving attention on the Immaculate Lord. ||1||
Without the Lord's Name, who is ours?

416.g: ਸੁਖ ਦੁਖ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਛੋਡਉ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
416.t: sukh dhukh sam kar naam na chhoddau aape bakhas milaavanahaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
416.e: I look upon pleasure and pain alike; I shall not forsake the Naam, the Name of the Lord. The Lord Himself forgives me, and blends me with Himself. ||1||Pause||
The fool loves gold and women.
Attached to duality, he has forgotten the Naam.
O Lord, he alone chants the Naam, whom You have forgiven.

416.g: ਦੂਤੁ ਨ ਲਾਗਿ ਸਕੈ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ॥੨॥
416.t: dhoot na laag sakai gun gai ||2||
416.e: Death cannot touch one who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||
The Lord, the Guru, is the Giver; the Lord, the Sustainer of the World.
If it is pleasing to Your Will, please preserve me, O Merciful Lord.
As Gurmukh, my mind is pleased with the Lord.
My diseases are cured, and my pains are taken away. ||3||

416.g: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਤੰਤ ਨ ਮੰਤਾ ॥
416.t: avar na aaukhadh ta(n)t na ma(n)taa ||
416.e: There is no other medicine, Tantric charm or mantra.
Meditative remembrance upon the Lord, Har, Har, destroys sins.
You Yourself cause us to stray from the path, and forget the Naam.
Showering Your Mercy, You Yourself save us. ||4||
The mind is diseased with doubt, superstition and duality.

416.g: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਜਪਹਿ ਜਪੁ ਦੂਜਾ ॥
416.t: gur bin bharam japeh jap dhoojaa ||
416.e: Without the Guru, it dwells in doubt, and contemplates duality.

416.g: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸ ਨ ਦੇਖਹਿ ॥
416.t: aadh purakh gur dharas na dhekheh ||
416.e: The Guru reveals the Darshan, the Blessed Vision of the Primal Lord.

416.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੈ ਜਨਮੁ ਕਿ ਲੇਖਹਿ ॥੫॥
416.t: vin gur sabadhai janam k lekheh ||5||
416.e: Without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, what use is human life? ||5||
Beholding the Marvellous Lord, I am wonder-struck and astonished.

416.g: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸੁਰ ਨਰ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ॥
416.t: ghaT ghaT sur nar sahaj samaadh ||
416.e: In each and every heart, of the angels and holy men, He dwells in celestial Samaadhi.
I have enshrined the All-pervading Lord within my mind.
There is no one else equal to You. ||6||

416.g: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਹੇਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
416.t: jaa kee bhagat het mukh naam ||
416.e: For the sake of devotional worship, we chant Your Name.
The Lord's devotees dwell in the Society of the Saints.
Breaking his bonds, one comes to meditate on the Lord.
The Gurmukhs are emancipated, by the Guru-given knowledge of the Lord. ||7||
The Messenger of Death cannot touch him with pain;

416.g: ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਜਾਗੈ ॥
416.t: jo jan raam naam liv jaagai ||
416.e: the Lord's humble servant remains awake to the Love of the Naam.
The Lord is the Lover of His devotees; He dwells with His devotees.
O Nanak, they are liberated, through the Love of the Lord. ||8||9||
Aasaa, First Mehla, Ik-Tukee:
One who serves the Guru, knows his Lord and Master.
His pains are erased, and he realizes the True Word of the Shabad. ||1||
Meditate on the Lord, O my friends and companions.

416.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨੈਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
416.t: satigur sev dhekhahu prabh nainee ||1|| rahaau ||
416.e: Serving the True Guru, you shall behold God with your eyes. ||1||Pause||
People are entangled with mother, father and the world.
They are entangled with sons, daughters and spouses. ||2||
They are entangled with religious rituals, and religious faith, acting in ego.
They are entangled with sons, wives and others in their minds. ||3||
The farmers are entangled by farming.

416.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਡੰਨੁ ਸਹੈ ਰਾਜਾ ਮੰਗੈ ਦਾਨ ॥੪॥
416.t: haumai dda(n)n sahai raajaa ma(n)gai dhaan ||4||
416.e: People suffer punishment in ego, and the Lord King exacts the penalty from them. ||4||
They are entangled in trade without contemplation.
They are not satisfied by attachment to the expanse of Maya. ||5||
They are entangled with that wealth, amassed by bankers.

416.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਪਵਈ ਥਾਇ ॥੬॥
416.t: bin har bhagat na paviee thai ||6||
416.e: Without devotion to the Lord, they do not become acceptable. ||6||
They are entangled with the Vedas, religious discussions and egotism.
They are entangled, and perish in attachment and corruption. ||7||
Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord's Name.
One who is saved by the True Guru, does not suffer entanglement. ||8||10||

417.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਘਰੁ ੩
417.t: raag aasaa mahalaa pehilaa asaTapadheeaa ghar teejaa
417.e: Raag Aasaa, First Mehla, Ashtpadheeyaa, Third House:

417.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
417.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
417.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

417.g: ਜਿਨ ਸਿਰਿ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਪਟੀਆ ਮਾਂਗੀ ਪਾਇ ਸੰਧੂਰੁ ॥
417.t: jin sir sohan paTeeaa maa(n)gee pai sa(n)dhoor ||
417.e: Those heads adorned with braided hair, with their parts painted with vermillion

417.g: ਸੇ ਸਿਰ ਕਾਤੀ ਮੁੰਨੀਅਨਿੑ ਗਲ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਵੈ ਧੂੜਿ ॥
417.t: se sir kaatee mu(n)neeani(h) gal vich aavai dhooR ||
417.e: those heads were shaved with scissors, and their throats were choked with dust.

417.g: ਮਹਲਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਹੋਦੀਆ ਹੁਣਿ ਬਹਣਿ ਨ ਮਿਲਨਿੑ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥੧॥
417.t: mahalaa a(n)dhar hodheeaa hun bahan na milani(h) hadhoor ||1||
417.e: They lived in palatial mansions, but now, they cannot even sit near the palaces. ||1||

417.g: ਆਦੇਸੁ ਬਾਬਾ ਆਦੇਸੁ ॥
417.t: aadhes baabaa aadhes ||
417.e: Hail to You, O Father Lord, Hail to You!

417.g: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖਹਿ ਵੇਸ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
417.t: aadh purakh teraa a(n)t na paiaa kar kar dhekheh ves ||1|| rahaau ||
417.e: O Primal Lord. Your limits are not known; You create, and create, and behold the scenes. ||1||Pause||

417.g: ਜਦਹੁ ਸੀਆ ਵੀਆਹੀਆ ਲਾੜੇ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
417.t: jadhahu seeaa veeaaheeaa laaRe sohan paas ||
417.e: When they were married, their husbands looked so handsome beside them.

417.g: ਹੀਡੋਲੀ ਚੜਿ ਆਈਆ ਦੰਦ ਖੰਡ ਕੀਤੇ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
417.t: heeddolee chaR aaieeaa dha(n)dh kha(n)dd keete raas ||
417.e: They came in palanquins, decorated with ivory;

417.g: ਉਪਰਹੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਵਾਰੀਐ ਝਲੇ ਝਿਮਕਨਿ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
417.t: auparahu paanee vaareeaai jhale jhimakan paas ||2||
417.e: water was sprinkled over their heads, and glittering fans were waved above them. ||2||

417.g: ਇਕੁ ਲਖੁ ਲਹਨਿੑ ਬਹਿਠੀਆ ਲਖੁ ਲਹਨਿੑ ਖੜੀਆ ॥
417.t: eik lakh lahani(h) bahiTheeaa lakh lahani(h) khaReeaa ||
417.e: They were given hundreds of thousands of coins when they sat, and hundreds of thousands of coins when they stood.

417.g: ਗਰੀ ਛੁਹਾਰੇ ਖਾਂਦੀਆ ਮਾਣਨਿੑ ਸੇਜੜੀਆ ॥
417.t: garee chhuhaare khaa(n)dheeaa maanani(h) sejaReeaa ||
417.e: They ate coconuts and dates, and rested comfortably upon their beds.

417.g: ਤਿਨੑ ਗਲਿ ਸਿਲਕਾ ਪਾਈਆ ਤੁਟਨਿੑ ਮੋਤਸਰੀਆ ॥੩॥
417.t: tin(h) gal silakaa paieeaa tuTani(h) motasareeaa ||3||
417.e: But ropes were put around their necks, and their strings of pearls were broken. ||3||

417.g: ਧਨੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਦੁਇ ਵੈਰੀ ਹੋਏ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਰਖੇ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
417.t: dhan joban dhui vairee hoe jin(h)ee rakhe ra(n)g lai ||
417.e: Their wealth and youthful beauty, which gave them so much pleasure, have now become their enemies.

417.g: ਦੂਤਾ ਨੋ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ ਲੈ ਚਲੇ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
417.t: dhootaa no furamaiaa lai chale pat gavai ||
417.e: The order was given to the soldiers, who dishonored them, and carried them away.

417.g: ਜੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜੇ ਭਾਵੈ ਦੇਇ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੪॥
417.t: je tis bhaavai dhe vaddiaaiee je bhaavai dhei sajai ||4||
417.e: If it is pleasing to God's Will, He bestows greatness; if is pleases His Will, He bestows punishment. ||4||

417.g: ਅਗੋ ਦੇ ਜੇ ਚੇਤੀਐ ਤਾਂ ਕਾਇਤੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
417.t: ago dhe je cheteeaai taa(n) kait milai sajai ||
417.e: If someone focuses on the Lord beforehand, then why should he be punished?

417.g: ਸਾਹਾਂ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਗਵਾਈਆ ਰੰਗਿ ਤਮਾਸੈ ਚਾਇ ॥
417.t: saahaa(n) surat gavaieeaa ra(n)g tamaasai chai ||
417.e: The kings had lost their higher consciousness, reveling in pleasure and sensuality.

417.g: ਬਾਬਰਵਾਣੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਗਈ ਕੁਇਰੁ ਨ ਰੋਟੀ ਖਾਇ ॥੫॥
417.t: baabaravaanee fir giee kuir na roTee khai ||5||
417.e: Since Baabar's rule has been proclaimed, even the princes have no food to eat. ||5||

417.g: ਇਕਨਾ ਵਖਤ ਖੁਆਈਅਹਿ ਇਕਨੑਾ ਪੂਜਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
417.t: eikanaa vakhat khuaaie'eeh ikan(h)aa poojaa jai ||
417.e: The Muslims have lost their five times of daily prayer, and the Hindus have lost their worship as well.

417.g: ਚਉਕੇ ਵਿਣੁ ਹਿੰਦਵਾਣੀਆ ਕਿਉ ਟਿਕੇ ਕਢਹਿ ਨਾਇ ॥
417.t: chauke vin hi(n)dhavaaneeaa kiau Tike kaddeh nai ||
417.e: Without their sacred squares, how shall the Hindu women bathe and apply the frontal marks to their foreheads?

417.g: ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਹੁਣਿ ਕਹਣਿ ਨ ਮਿਲੈ ਖੁਦਾਇ ॥੬॥
417.t: raam na kabahoo chetio hun kahan na milai khudhai ||6||
417.e: They never remembered their Lord as Raam, and now they cannot even chant Khudaa-i||6||

417.g: ਇਕਿ ਘਰਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਇਕਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਪੁਛਹਿ ਸੁਖ ॥
417.t: eik ghar aaveh aapanai ik mil mil puchheh sukh ||
417.e: Some have returned to their homes, and meeting their relatives, they ask about their safety.

417.g: ਇਕਨੑਾ ਏਹੋ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਬਹਿ ਬਹਿ ਰੋਵਹਿ ਦੁਖ ॥
417.t: eikan(h)aa eho likhiaa beh beh roveh dhukh ||
417.e: For some, it is pre-ordained that they shall sit and cry out in pain.

417.g: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਆ ਮਾਨੁਖ ॥੭॥੧੧॥
417.t: jo tis bhaavai so theeaai naanak kiaa maanukh ||7||11||
417.e: Whatever pleases Him, comes to pass. O Nanak, what is the fate of mankind? ||7||11||

417.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
417.t: aasaa mahalaa pehilaa ||
417.e: Aasaa, First Mehla:

417.g: ਕਹਾ ਸੁ ਖੇਲ ਤਬੇਲਾ ਘੋੜੇ ਕਹਾ ਭੇਰੀ ਸਹਨਾਈ ॥
417.t: kahaa su khel tabelaa ghoRe kahaa bheree sahanaiee ||
417.e: Where are the games, the stables, the horses? Where are the drums and the bugles?

417.g: ਕਹਾ ਸੁ ਤੇਗਬੰਦ ਗਾਡੇਰੜਿ ਕਹਾ ਸੁ ਲਾਲ ਕਵਾਈ ॥
417.t: kahaa su tegaba(n)dh gaadderaR kahaa su laal kavaiee ||
417.e: Where are the sword-belts and chariots? Where are those scarlet uniforms?

417.g: ਕਹਾ ਸੁ ਆਰਸੀਆ ਮੁਹ ਬੰਕੇ ਐਥੈ ਦਿਸਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
417.t: kahaa su aaraseeaa muh ba(n)ke aaithai dhiseh naahee ||1||
417.e: Where are the rings and the beautiful faces? They are no longer to be seen here. ||1||

417.g: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂ ਗੋਸਾਈ ॥
417.t: eih jag teraa too gosaiee ||
417.e: This world is Yours; You are the Lord of the Universe.

417.g: ਏਕ ਘੜੀ ਮਹਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪੇ ਜਰੁ ਵੰਡਿ ਦੇਵੈ ਭਾਂਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
417.t: ek ghaRee meh thaap uthaape jar va(n)dd dhevai bhaa(n)iee ||1|| rahaau ||
417.e: In an instant, You establish and disestablish. You distribute wealth as it pleases You. ||1||Pause||

417.g: ਕਹਾਂ ਸੁ ਘਰ ਦਰ ਮੰਡਪ ਮਹਲਾ ਕਹਾ ਸੁ ਬੰਕ ਸਰਾਈ ॥
417.t: kahaa(n) su ghar dhar ma(n)ddap mahalaa kahaa su ba(n)k saraiee ||
417.e: Where are the houses, the gates, the hotels and palaces? Where are those beautiful way-stations?

417.g: ਕਹਾਂ ਸੁ ਸੇਜ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਵੇਖਿ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
417.t: kahaa(n) su sej sukhaalee kaaman jis vekh needh na paiee ||
417.e: Where are those beautiful women, reclining on their beds, whose beauty would not allow one to sleep?

417.g: ਕਹਾ ਸੁ ਪਾਨ ਤੰਬੋਲੀ ਹਰਮਾ ਹੋਈਆ ਛਾਈ ਮਾਈ ॥੨॥
417.t: kahaa su paan ta(n)bolee haramaa hoieeaa chhaiee maiee ||2||
417.e: Where are those betel leaves, their sellers, and the haremees? They have vanished like shadows. ||2||

417.g: ਇਸੁ ਜਰ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਘਣੀ ਵਿਗੁਤੀ ਇਨਿ ਜਰ ਘਣੀ ਖੁਆਈ ॥
417.t: eis jar kaaran ghanee vigutee in jar ghanee khuaaiee ||
417.e: For the sake of this wealth, so many were ruined; because of this wealth, so many have been disgraced.

417.g: ਪਾਪਾ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੁਇਆ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
417.t: paapaa baajhahu hovai naahee muiaa saath na jaiee ||
417.e: It was not gathered without sin, and it does not go along with the dead.

417.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਖੁਆਏ ਕਰਤਾ ਖੁਸਿ ਲਏ ਚੰਗਿਆਈ ॥੩॥
417.t: jis no aap khuaae karataa khus le cha(n)giaaiee ||3||
417.e: Those, whom the Creator Lord would destroy - first He strips them of virtue. ||3||

417.g: ਕੋਟੀ ਹੂ ਪੀਰ ਵਰਜਿ ਰਹਾਏ ਜਾ ਮੀਰੁ ਸੁਣਿਆ ਧਾਇਆ ॥
417.t: koTee hoo peer varaj rahaae jaa meer suniaa dhaiaa ||
417.e: Millions of religious leaders failed to halt the invader, when they heard of the Emperor's invasion.

418.g: ਥਾਨ ਮੁਕਾਮ ਜਲੇ ਬਿਜ ਮੰਦਰ ਮੁਛਿ ਮੁਛਿ ਕੁਇਰ ਰੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
418.t: thaan mukaam jale bij ma(n)dhar muchh muchh kuir rulaiaa ||
418.e: He burned the rest-houses and the ancient temples; he cut the princes limb from limb, and cast them into the dust.

418.g: ਕੋਈ ਮੁਗਲੁ ਨ ਹੋਆ ਅੰਧਾ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਰਚਾ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
418.t: koiee mugal na hoaa a(n)dhaa kinai na parachaa laiaa ||4||
418.e: None of the Mugals went blind, and no one performed any miracle. ||4||

418.g: ਮੁਗਲ ਪਠਾਣਾ ਭਈ ਲੜਾਈ ਰਣ ਮਹਿ ਤੇਗ ਵਗਾਈ ॥
418.t: mugal paThaanaa bhiee laRaiee ran meh teg vagaiee ||
418.e: The battle raged between the Mugals and the Pat'haans, and the swords clashed on the battlefield.

418.g: ਓਨੑੀ ਤੁਪਕ ਤਾਣਿ ਚਲਾਈ ਓਨੑੀ ਹਸਤਿ ਚਿੜਾਈ ॥
418.t: on(h)ee tupak taan chalaiee on(h)ee hasat chiRaiee ||
418.e: They took aim and fired their guns, and they attacked with their elephants.

418.g: ਜਿਨੑ ਕੀ ਚੀਰੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਟੀ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਮਰਣਾ ਭਾਈ ॥੫॥
418.t: jin(h) kee cheeree dharageh paaTee tin(h)aa maranaa bhaiee ||5||
418.e: Those men whose letters were torn in the Lord's Court, were destined to die, O Siblings of Destiny. ||5||

418.g: ਇਕ ਹਿੰਦਵਾਣੀ ਅਵਰ ਤੁਰਕਾਣੀ ਭਟਿਆਣੀ ਠਕੁਰਾਣੀ ॥
418.t: eik hi(n)dhavaanee avar turakaanee bhaTiaanee Thakuraanee ||
418.e: The Hindu women, the Muslim women, the Bhattis and the Rajputs

418.g: ਇਕਨੑਾ ਪੇਰਣ ਸਿਰ ਖੁਰ ਪਾਟੇ ਇਕਨੑਾ ਵਾਸੁ ਮਸਾਣੀ ॥
418.t: eikan(h)aa peran sir khur paaTe ikan(h)aa vaas masaanee ||
418.e: some had their robes torn away, from head to foot, while others came to dwell in the cremation ground.

418.g: ਜਿਨੑ ਕੇ ਬੰਕੇ ਘਰੀ ਨ ਆਇਆ ਤਿਨੑ ਕਿਉ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ ॥੬॥
418.t: jin(h) ke ba(n)ke gharee na aaiaa tin(h) kiau rain vihaanee ||6||
418.e: Their husbands did not return home - how did they pass their night? ||6||

418.g: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਈਐ ॥
418.t: aape kare karaae karataa kis no aakh sunaieeaai ||
418.e: The Creator Himself acts, and causes others to act. Unto whom should we complain?

418.g: ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਿਸ ਥੈ ਜਾਇ ਰੂਆਈਐ ॥
418.t: dhukh sukh terai bhaanai hovai kis thai jai rooaaieeaai ||
418.e: Pleasure and pain come by Your Will; unto whom should we go and cry?

418.g: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਚਲਾਏ ਵਿਗਸੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੭॥੧੨॥
418.t: hukamee hukam chalaae vigasai naanak likhiaa paieeaai ||7||12||
418.e: The Commander issues His Command, and is pleased. O Nanak, we receive what is written in our destiny. ||7||12||

418.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
418.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
418.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

418.g: ਆਸਾ ਕਾਫੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੮ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ॥
418.t: aasaa kaafee mahalaa pehilaa ghar atthvaa asaTapadheeaa ||
418.e: Aasaa, Kaafee, First Mehla, Eighth House, Ashtpadheeyaa:

418.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਗੋਇਲਿ ਗੋਇਲੀ ਤੈਸੇ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
418.t: jaise goil goilee taise sa(n)saaraa ||
418.e: As the shepherd is in the field for only a short time, so is one in the world.

418.g: ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਆਦਮੀ ਬਾਂਧਹਿ ਘਰ ਬਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
418.t: kooR kamaaveh aadhamee baa(n)dheh ghar baaraa ||1||
418.e: Practicing falsehood, they build their homes. ||1||

418.g: ਜਾਗਹੁ ਜਾਗਹੁ ਸੂਤਿਹੋ ਚਲਿਆ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
418.t: jaagahu jaagahu sootiho chaliaa vanajaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
418.e: Wake up! Wake up! O sleepers, see that the travelling merchant is leaving. ||1||Pause||

418.g: ਨੀਤ ਨੀਤ ਘਰ ਬਾਂਧੀਅਹਿ ਜੇ ਰਹਣਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
418.t: neet neet ghar baa(n)dhe'eeh je rahanaa hoiee ||
418.e: Go ahead and build your houses, if you think you will stay here forever and ever.

418.g: ਪਿੰਡੁ ਪਵੈ ਜੀਉ ਚਲਸੀ ਜੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੨॥
418.t: pi(n)dd pavai jeeau chalasee je jaanai koiee ||2||
418.e: The body shall fall, and the soul shall depart; if only they knew this. ||2||

418.g: ਓਹੀ ਓਹੀ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਹੈ ਹੋਸੀ ਸੋਈ ॥
418.t: ohee ohee kiaa karahu hai hosee soiee ||
418.e: Why do you cry out and mourn for the dead? The Lord is, and shall always be.

418.g: ਤੁਮ ਰੋਵਹੁਗੇ ਓਸ ਨੋ ਤੁਮੑ ਕਉ ਕਉਣੁ ਰੋਈ ॥੩॥
418.t: tum rovahuge os no tum(h) kau kaun roiee ||3||
418.e: You mourn for that person, but who will mourn for you? ||3||

418.g: ਧੰਧਾ ਪਿਟਿਹੁ ਭਾਈਹੋ ਤੁਮੑ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵਹੁ ॥
418.t: dha(n)dhaa piTih bhaieeho tum(h) kooR kamaavahu ||
418.e: You are engrossed in worldly entanglements, O Siblings of Destiny, and you are practicing falsehood.

418.g: ਓਹੁ ਨ ਸੁਣਈ ਕਤ ਹੀ ਤੁਮੑ ਲੋਕ ਸੁਣਾਵਹੁ ॥੪॥
418.t: oh na suniee kat hee tum(h) lok sunaavahu ||4||
418.e: The dead person does not hear anything at all; your cries are heard only by other people. ||4||

418.g: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਸੁਤਾ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਾਗਾਏ ਸੋਈ ॥
418.t: jis te sutaa naanakaa jaagaae soiee ||
418.e: Only the Lord, who causes the mortal to sleep, O Nanak, can awaken him again.

418.g: ਜੇ ਘਰੁ ਬੂਝੈ ਆਪਣਾ ਤਾਂ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੫॥
418.t: je ghar boojhai aapanaa taa(n) needh na hoiee ||5||
418.e: One who understands his true home, does not sleep. ||5||

418.g: ਜੇ ਚਲਦਾ ਲੈ ਚਲਿਆ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੰਪੈ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
418.t: je chaladhaa lai chaliaa kichh sa(n)pai naale ||
418.e: If the departing mortal can take his wealth with him,

418.g: ਤਾ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਹੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਕੈ ਬੂਝਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥੬॥
418.t: taa dhan sa(n)chahu dhekh kai boojhahu beechaare ||6||
418.e: then go ahead and gather wealth yourself. See this, reflect upon it, and understand. ||6||

418.g: ਵਣਜੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਮਖਸੂਦੁ ਲੈਹੁ ਮਤ ਪਛੋਤਾਵਹੁ ॥
418.t: vanaj karahu makhasoodh laih mat pachhotaavahu ||
418.e: Make your deals, and obtain the true merchandise, or else you shall regret it later.

418.g: ਅਉਗਣ ਛੋਡਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਕਰਹੁ ਐਸੇ ਤਤੁ ਪਰਾਵਹੁ ॥੭॥
418.t: aaugan chhoddahu gun karahu aaise tat paraavahu ||7||
418.e: Abandon your vices, and practice virtue, and you shall obtain the essence of reality. ||7||

418.g: ਧਰਮੁ ਭੂਮਿ ਸਤੁ ਬੀਜੁ ਕਰਿ ਐਸੀ ਕਿਰਸ ਕਮਾਵਹੁ ॥
418.t: dharam bhoom sat beej kar aaisee kiras kamaavahu ||
418.e: Plant the seed of Truth in the soil of Dharmic faith, and practice such farming.

418.g: ਤਾਂ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਜਾਣੀਅਹੁ ਲਾਹਾ ਲੈ ਜਾਵਹੁ ॥੮॥
418.t: taa(n) vaapaaree jaaneeahu laahaa lai jaavahu ||8||
418.e: Only then will you be known as a merchant, if you take your profits with you. ||8||

418.g: ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
418.t: karam hovai satigur milai boojhai beechaaraa ||
418.e: If the Lord shows His Mercy, one meets the True Guru; contemplating Him, one comes to understand.

418.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਸੁਣੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਬਿਉਹਾਰਾ ॥੯॥
418.t: naam vakhaanai sune naam naame biauhaaraa ||9||
418.e: Then, one chants the Naam, hears the Naam, and deals only in the Naam. ||9||

418.g: ਜਿਉ ਲਾਹਾ ਤੋਟਾ ਤਿਵੈ ਵਾਟ ਚਲਦੀ ਆਈ ॥
418.t: jiau laahaa toTaa tivai vaaT chaladhee aaiee ||
418.e: As is the profit, so is the loss; this is the way of the world.

418.g: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸਾਈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧੦॥੧੩॥
418.t: jo tis bhaavai naanakaa saiee vaddiaaiee ||10||13||
418.e: Whatever pleases His Will, O Nanak, is glory for me. ||10||13||

418.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
418.t: aasaa mahalaa pehilaa ||
418.e: Aasaa, First Mehla:

418.g: ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਢੂਢੀਆ ਕੋ ਨੀਮੑੀ ਮੈਡਾ ॥
418.t: chaare ku(n)ddaa ddooddeeaa ko neem(h)ee maiddaa ||
418.e: I have searched in the four directions, but no one is mine.

418.g: ਜੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਤੂ ਮੈ ਹਉ ਤੈਡਾ ॥੧॥
418.t: je tudh bhaavai saahibaa too mai hau taiddaa ||1||
418.e: If it pleases You, O Lord Master, then You are mine, and I am Yours. ||1||

418.g: ਦਰੁ ਬੀਭਾ ਮੈ ਨੀਮਿੑ ਕੋ ਕੈ ਕਰੀ ਸਲਾਮੁ ॥
418.t: dhar beebhaa mai neemi(h) ko kai karee salaam ||
418.e: There is no other door for me; where shall I go to worship?

418.g: ਹਿਕੋ ਮੈਡਾ ਤੂ ਧਣੀ ਸਾਚਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
418.t: hiko maiddaa too dhanee saachaa mukh naam ||1|| rahaau ||
418.e: You are my only Lord; Your True Name is in my mouth. ||1||Pause||

418.g: ਸਿਧਾ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸਿਧ ਪੀਰ ਮਾਗਹਿ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ॥
418.t: sidhaa sevan sidh peer maageh ridh sidh ||
418.e: Some serve the Siddhas, the beings of spiritual perfection, and some serve spiritual teachers; they beg for wealth and miraculous powers.

418.g: ਮੈ ਇਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਗੁਰ ਬੁਧਿ ॥੨॥
418.t: mai ik naam na veesarai saache gur budh ||2||
418.e: May I never forget the Naam, the Name of the One Lord. This is the wisdom of the True Guru. ||2||

419.g: ਜੋਗੀ ਭੋਗੀ ਕਾਪੜੀ ਕਿਆ ਭਵਹਿ ਦਿਸੰਤਰ ॥
419.t: jogee bhogee kaapaRee kiaa bhaveh dhisa(n)tar ||
419.e: Why do the Yogis, the revellers, and the beggars wander in foreign lands?

419.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਚੀਨੑਹੀ ਤਤੁ ਸਾਰੁ ਨਿਰੰਤਰ ॥੩॥
419.t: gur kaa sabadh na cheen(h)hee tat saar nira(n)tar ||3||
419.e: They do not understand the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and the essence of excellence within them. ||3||

419.g: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪਾਧੇ ਜੋਇਸੀ ਨਿਤ ਪੜ੍ਹਹਿ ਪੁਰਾਣਾ ॥
419.t: pa(n)ddit paadhe joisee nit paRheh puraanaa ||
419.e: The Pandits, the religious scholars, the teachers and astrologers, and those who endlessly read the Puraanas,

419.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੑੀ ਘਟਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਲੁਕਾਣਾ ॥੪॥
419.t: a(n)tar vasat na jaanan(h)ee ghaT braham lukaanaa ||4||
419.e: do not know what is within; God is hidden deep within them. ||4||

419.g: ਇਕਿ ਤਪਸੀ ਬਨ ਮਹਿ ਤਪੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਤੀਰਥ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
419.t: eik tapasee ban meh tap kareh nit teerath vaasaa ||
419.e: Some penitents perform penance in the forests, and some dwell forever at sacred shrines.

419.g: ਆਪੁ ਨ ਚੀਨਹਿ ਤਾਮਸੀ ਕਾਹੇ ਭਏ ਉਦਾਸਾ ॥੫॥
419.t: aap na cheeneh taamasee kaahe bhe udhaasaa ||5||
419.e: The unenlightened people do not understand themselves - why have they become renunciates? ||5||

419.g: ਇਕਿ ਬਿੰਦੁ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖਦੇ ਸੇ ਜਤੀ ਕਹਾਵਹਿ ॥
419.t: eik bi(n)dh jatan kar raakhadhe se jatee kahaaveh ||
419.e: Some control their sexual energy, and are known as celibates.

419.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਨ ਛੂਟਹੀ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ॥੬॥
419.t: bin gur sabadh na chhooTahee bhram aaveh jaaveh ||6||
419.e: But without the Guru's Word, they are not saved, and they wander in reincarnation. ||6||

419.g: ਇਕਿ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਸੇਵਕ ਸਾਧਿਕਾ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
419.t: eik girahee sevak saadhikaa gurmatee laage ||
419.e: Some are householders, servants, and seekers, attached to the Guru's Teachings.

419.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਸੁ ਜਾਗੇ ॥੭॥
419.t: naam dhaan isanaan dhiraR har bhagat su jaage ||7||
419.e: They hold fast to the Naam, to charity, to cleansing and purification; they remain awake in devotion to the Lord. ||7||

419.g: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਦਰੁ ਘਰੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਸੋ ਜਾਇ ਸਿਞਾਣੈ ॥
419.t: gur te dhar ghar jaaneeaai so jai sin(j)aanai ||
419.e: Through the Guru, the Gate of the Lord's Home is found, and that place is recognized.

419.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ ॥੮॥੧੪॥
419.t: naanak naam na veesarai saache man maanai ||8||14||
419.e: Nanak does not forget the Naam; his mind has surrendered to the True Lord. ||8||14||

419.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
419.t: aasaa mahalaa pehilaa ||
419.e: Aasaa, First Mehla:

419.g: ਮਨਸਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਮਾਇਲੇ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਸਚਿ ਤਰਣਾ ॥
419.t: manasaa maneh samaile bhaujal sach taranaa ||
419.e: Stilling the desires of the mind, the mortal truly crosses over the terrifying world-ocean.

419.g: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤੂ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾ ॥੧॥
419.t: aadh jugaadh dhiaal too Thaakur teree saranaa ||1||
419.e: In the very beginning, and throughout the ages, You have been the Merciful Lord and Master; I seek Your Sanctuary. ||1||

419.g: ਤੂ ਦਾਤੌ ਹਮ ਜਾਚਿਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
419.t: too dhaatau ham jaachikaa har dharasan dheejai ||
419.e: You are the Giver, and I am a mere beggar. Lord, please grant me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

419.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਮਨ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਭੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
419.t: gurmukh naam dhiaaieeaai man ma(n)dhar bheejai ||1|| rahaau ||
419.e: The Gurmukh meditates on the Naam; the temple of his mind resounds with joy. ||1||Pause||

419.g: ਕੂੜਾ ਲਾਲਚੁ ਛੋਡੀਐ ਤਉ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
419.t: kooRaa laalach chhoddeeaai tau saach pachhaanai ||
419.e: Renouncing false greed, one comes to realize the Truth.

419.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ਪਰਮਾਰਥੁ ਜਾਣੈ ॥੨॥
419.t: gur kai sabadh samaieeaai paramaarath jaanai ||2||
419.e: So let yourself be absorbed in the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and know this supreme realization. ||2||

419.g: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਜਾ ਲੋਭੀਆ ਲੁਭਤਉ ਲੋਭਾਈ ॥
419.t: eih man raajaa lobheeaa lubhatau lobhaiee ||
419.e: This mind is a greedy king, engrossed in greed.

419.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ॥੩॥
419.t: gurmukh lobh nivaareeaai har siau ban aaiee ||3||
419.e: The Gurmukh eliminates his greed, and comes to an understanding with the Lord. ||3||

419.g: ਕਲਰਿ ਖੇਤੀ ਬੀਜੀਐ ਕਿਉ ਲਾਹਾ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
419.t: kalar khetee beejeeaai kiau laahaa paavai ||
419.e: Planting the seeds in the rocky soil, how can one reap a profit?

419.g: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਸਚਿ ਨ ਭੀਜਈ ਕੂੜੁ ਕੂੜਿ ਗਡਾਵੈ ॥੪॥
419.t: manmukh sach na bheejiee kooR kooR gaddaavai ||4||
419.e: The self-willed manmukh is not pleased with Truth; the false are buried in falsehood. ||4||

419.g: ਲਾਲਚੁ ਛੋਡਹੁ ਅੰਧਿਹੋ ਲਾਲਚਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
419.t: laalach chhoddahu a(n)dhiho laalach dhukh bhaaree ||
419.e: So renounce greed - you are blind! Greed only brings pain.

419.g: ਸਾਚੌ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਰੀ ॥੫॥
419.t: saachau saahib man vasai haumai bikh maaree ||5||
419.e: When the True Lord dwells within the mind, the poisonous ego is conquered. ||5||

419.g: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਛੋਡਿ ਕੁਵਾਟੜੀ ਮੂਸਹੁਗੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
419.t: dhubidhaa chhodd kuvaaTaRee moosahuge bhaiee ||
419.e: Renounce the evil way of duality, or you shall be plundered, O Siblings of Destiny.

419.g: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੬॥
419.t: ahinis naam salaaheeaai satigur saranaiee ||6||
419.e: Day and night, praise the Naam, in the Sanctuary of the True Guru's protection. ||6||

419.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਪਥਰੁ ਸੈਲੁ ਹੈ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਫੀਕਾ ॥
419.t: manmukh pathar sail hai dhirag jeevan feekaa ||
419.e: The self-willed manmukh is a rock, a stone. His life is cursed and useless.

419.g: ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਕੇਤਾ ਰਾਖੀਐ ਅਭ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੂਕਾ ॥੭॥
419.t: jal meh ketaa raakheeaai abh a(n)tar sookaa ||7||
419.e: No matter now long a stone is kept under water, it still remains dry at its core. ||7||

419.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ॥
419.t: har kaa naam nidhaan hai poorai gur dheeaa ||
419.e: The Name of the Lord is the treasure; the Perfect Guru has given it to me.

419.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਮਥਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆ ॥੮॥੧੫॥
419.t: naanak naam na veesarai math a(n)mrit peeaa ||8||15||
419.e: O Nanak, one who does not forget the Naam, churns and drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar. ||8||15||

419.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
419.t: aasaa mahalaa pehilaa ||
419.e: Aasaa, First Mehla:

419.g: ਚਲੇ ਚਲਣਹਾਰ ਵਾਟ ਵਟਾਇਆ ॥
419.t: chale chalanahaar vaaT vaTaiaa ||
419.e: The travellers travel from one road to another.

419.g: ਧੰਧੁ ਪਿਟੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਨ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
419.t: dha(n)dh piTe sa(n)saar sach na bhaiaa ||1||
419.e: The world is engrossed in its entanglements, and does not appreciate the Truth. ||1||

419.g: ਕਿਆ ਭਵੀਐ ਕਿਆ ਢੂਢੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
419.t: kiaa bhaveeaai kiaa ddooddeeaai gur sabadh dhikhaiaa ||
419.e: Why wander around, and why go searching, when the Guru's Shabad reveals Him to us?

419.g: ਮਮਤਾ ਮੋਹੁ ਵਿਸਰਜਿਆ ਅਪਨੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
419.t: mamataa moh visarajiaa apanai ghar aaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
419.e: Leaving behind egotism and attachment, I have arrived at my own home. ||1||Pause||

419.g: ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚਿਆਰੁ ਕੂੜਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
419.t: sach milai sachiaar kooR na paieeaai ||
419.e: Through Truth, one meets the True One; He is not obtained through falsehood.

419.g: ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਆਈਐ ॥੨॥
419.t: sache siau chit lai bahuR na aaieeaai ||2||
419.e: Centering your consciousness on the True Lord, you shall not have to come into the world again. ||2||

419.g: ਮੋਇਆ ਕਉ ਕਿਆ ਰੋਵਹੁ ਰੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਣਹੂ ॥
419.t: moiaa kau kiaa rovahu roi na jaanahoo ||
419.e: Why do you weep for the dead? You do not know how to weep.

419.g: ਰੋਵਹੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਹੂ ॥੩॥
419.t: rovahu sach salaeh hukam pachhaanahoo ||3||
419.e: Weep by praising the True Lord, and recognize His Command. ||3||

419.g: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਵਜਹੁ ਲਿਖਾਇ ਆਇਆ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
419.t: hukamee vajahu likhai aaiaa jaaneeaai ||
419.e: Blessed is the birth of one who is destined to abide by the Lord's Command.

419.g: ਲਾਹਾ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸਿਞਾਣੀਐ ॥੪॥
419.t: laahaa palai pai hukam sin(j)aaneeaai ||4||
419.e: He obtains the true profit, realizing the Lord's Command. ||4||

420.g: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਪੈਧਾ ਜਾਇ ਦਰਗਹ ਭਾਣੀਐ ॥
420.t: hukamee paidhaa jai dharageh bhaaneeaai ||
420.e: If it pleases the Commander, one goes to His Court, robed in honor.

420.g: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਹੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਮਾਰ ਬੰਦਿ ਰਬਾਣੀਐ ॥੫॥
420.t: hukame hee sir maar ba(n)dh rabaaneeaai ||5||
420.e: By His Command, God's slaves are hit over the head. ||5||

420.g: ਲਾਹਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਿਆਉ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਾਈਐ ॥
420.t: laahaa sach niaau man vasaieeaai ||
420.e: The profit is earned by enshrining Truth and justice in the mind.

420.g: ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ਗਰਬੁ ਵਞਾਈਐ ॥੬॥
420.t: likhiaa palai pai garab van(j)aieeaai ||6||
420.e: They obtain what is written in their destiny, and overcome pride. ||6||

420.g: ਮਨਮੁਖੀਆ ਸਿਰਿ ਮਾਰ ਵਾਦਿ ਖਪਾਈਐ ॥
420.t: manmukheeaa sir maar vaadh khapaieeaai ||
420.e: The self-willed manmukhs are hit over the head, and consumed by conflict.

420.g: ਠਗਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ਬੰਨਿੑ ਚਲਾਈਐ ॥੭॥
420.t: Thag muThee kooRiaar ba(n)ni(h) chalaieeaai ||7||
420.e: The cheaters are plundered by falsehood; they are chained and led away. ||7||

420.g: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸਾਇ ਨ ਪਛੋਤਾਵਹੀ ॥
420.t: saahib ridhai vasai na pachhotaavahee ||
420.e: Enshrine the Lord Master in your mind, and you shall not have to repent.

420.g: ਗੁਨਹਾਂ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਵਹੀ ॥੮॥
420.t: gunahaa(n) bakhasanahaar sabadh kamaavahee ||8||
420.e: He forgives our sins, when we practice the Teachings of the Guru's Word. ||8||

420.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਸਚੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਘਾਲੀਐ ॥
420.t: naanak ma(n)gai sach gurmukh ghaaleeaai ||
420.e: Nanak begs for the True Name, which is obtained by the Gurmukh.

420.g: ਮੈ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੀਐ ॥੯॥੧੬॥
420.t: mai tujh bin avar na koi nadhar nihaaleeaai ||9||16||
420.e: Without You, I have no other at all; please, bless me with Your Glance of Grace. ||9||16||

420.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
420.t: aasaa mahalaa pehilaa ||
420.e: Aasaa, First Mehla:

420.g: ਕਿਆ ਜੰਗਲੁ ਢੂਢੀ ਜਾਇ ਮੈ ਘਰਿ ਬਨੁ ਹਰੀਆਵਲਾ ॥
420.t: kiaa ja(n)gal ddooddee jai mai ghar ban hareeaavalaa ||
420.e: Why should I go searching in the forests, when the woods of my home are so green?

420.g: ਸਚਿ ਟਿਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਇ ਸਬਦਿ ਉਤਾਵਲਾ ॥੧॥
420.t: sach Tikai ghar aai sabadh utaavalaa ||1||
420.e: The True Word of the Shabad has instantaneously come and settled in my heart. ||1||

420.g: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਸੋਇ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
420.t: jeh dhekhaa teh soi avar na jaaneeaai ||
420.e: Wherever I look, there He is; I know no other.

420.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
420.t: gur kee kaar kamai mahal pachhaaneeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
420.e: Working for the Guru, one realizes the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||1||Pause||

420.g: ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਸਚੁ ਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਈ ॥
420.t: aap milaavai sach taa man bhaaviee ||
420.e: The True Lord blends us with Himself, when it is pleasing to His Mind.

420.g: ਚਲੈ ਸਦਾ ਰਜਾਇ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਵਈ ॥੨॥
420.t: chalai sadhaa rajai a(n)k samaaviee ||2||
420.e: One who ever walks in accordance with His Will, merges into His Being. ||2||

420.g: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
420.t: sachaa saahib man vasai vasiaa man soiee ||
420.e: When the True Lord dwells in the mind, that mind flourishes.

420.g: ਆਪੇ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਦੇ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੩॥
420.t: aape dhe vaddiaaieeaa dhe toT na hoiee ||3||
420.e: He Himself grants greatness; His Gifts are never exhausted. ||3||

420.g: ਅਬੇ ਤਬੇ ਕੀ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਕਿਉ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
420.t: abe tabe kee chaakaree kiau dharageh paavai ||
420.e: Serving this and that person, how can one obtain the Lord's Court?

420.g: ਪਥਰ ਕੀ ਬੇੜੀ ਜੇ ਚੜੈ ਭਰ ਨਾਲਿ ਬੁਡਾਵੈ ॥੪॥
420.t: pathar kee beRee je chaRai bhar naal buddaavai ||4||
420.e: If someone embarks on a boat of stone, he shall drown with its cargo. ||4||

420.g: ਆਪਨੜਾ ਮਨੁ ਵੇਚੀਐ ਸਿਰੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
420.t: aapanaRaa man vecheeaai sir dheejai naale ||
420.e: So offer your mind, and surrender your head with it.

420.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਅਪਨਾ ਘਰੁ ਭਾਲੇ ॥੫॥
420.t: gurmukh vasat pachhaaneeaai apanaa ghar bhaale ||5||
420.e: The Gurmukh realizes the true essence, and finds the home of his own self. ||5||

420.g: ਜੰਮਣ ਮਰਣਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਤਿਨਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਕੀਆ ॥
420.t: ja(n)man maranaa aakheeaai tin karatai keeaa ||
420.e: People discuss birth and death; the Creator created this.

420.g: ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਮਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਥੀਆ ॥੬॥
420.t: aap gavaiaa mar rahe fir maran na theeaa ||6||
420.e: Those who conquer their selfhood and remain dead, shall never have to die again. ||6||

420.g: ਸਾਈ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਧੁਰ ਕੀ ਫੁਰਮਾਈ ॥
420.t: saiee kaar kamaavanee dhur kee furamaiee ||
420.e: Do those deeds which the Primal Lord has ordered for you.

420.g: ਜੇ ਮਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਕਿਨਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੭॥
420.t: je man satigur dhe milai kin keemat paiee ||7||
420.e: If one surrenders his mind upon meeting the True Guru, who can estimate its value? ||7||

420.g: ਰਤਨਾ ਪਾਰਖੁ ਸੋ ਧਣੀ ਤਿਨਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
420.t: ratanaa paarakh so dhanee tin keemat paiee ||
420.e: That Lord Master is the Assayer of the jewel of the mind; He places the value on it.

420.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਚੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੮॥੧੭॥
420.t: naanak saahib man vasai sachee vaddiaaiee ||8||17||
420.e: O Nanak, True is the Glory of that one, in whose mind the Lord Master dwells. ||8||17||

420.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
420.t: aasaa mahalaa pehilaa ||
420.e: Aasaa, First Mehla:

420.g: ਜਿਨੑੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਈ ॥
420.t: jin(h)ee naam visaariaa dhoojai bharam bhulaiee ||
420.e: Those who have forgotten the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are deluded by doubt and duality.

420.g: ਮੂਲੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਡਾਲੀ ਲਗੇ ਕਿਆ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਛਾਈ ॥੧॥
420.t: mool chhodd ddaalee lage kiaa paaveh chhaiee ||1||
420.e: Those who abandon the roots and cling to the branches, shall obtain only ashes. ||1||

420.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕਿਉ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਜੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
420.t: bin naavai kiau chhooTeeaai je jaanai koiee ||
420.e: Without the Name, how can one be emancipated? Who knows this?

420.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਤ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
420.t: gurmukh hoi ta chhooTeeaai manmukh pat khoiee ||1|| rahaau ||
420.e: One who becomes Gurmukh is emancipated; the self-willed manmukhs lose their honor. ||1||Pause||

420.g: ਜਿਨੑੀ ਏਕੋ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਪੂਰੀ ਮਤਿ ਭਾਈ ॥
420.t: jin(h)ee eko seviaa pooree mat bhaiee ||
420.e: Those who serve the One Lord become perfect in their understanding, O Siblings of Destiny.

420.g: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਾ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੨॥
420.t: aadh jugaadh nira(n)janaa jan har saranaiee ||2||
420.e: The Lord's humble servant finds Sanctuary in Him, the Immaculate One, from the very beginning, and throughout the ages. ||2||

420.g: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਈ ॥
420.t: saahib meraa ek hai avar nahee bhaiee ||
420.e: My Lord and Master is the One; there is no other, O Siblings of Destiny.

420.g: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਾਚੇ ਪਰਥਾਈ ॥੩॥
420.t: kirapaa te sukh paiaa saache parathaiee ||3||
420.e: By the Grace of the True Lord, celestial peace is obtained. ||3||

420.g: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਕੇਤੀ ਕਹੈ ਕਹਾਏ ॥
420.t: gur bin kinai na paio ketee kahai kahaae ||
420.e: Without the Guru, no one has obtained Him, although many may claim to have done so.

420.g: ਆਪਿ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ਵਾਟੜੀਂ ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ॥੪॥
420.t: aap dhikhaavai vaaTaRee(n) sachee bhagat dhiraRaae ||4||
420.e: He Himself reveals the Way, and implants true devotion within. ||4||

420.g: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਜੇ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ ਭੀ ਉਝੜਿ ਜਾਏ ॥
420.t: manmukh je samajhaieeaai bhee ujhaR jaae ||
420.e: Even if the self-willed manmukh is instructed, he stills goes into the wilderness.

420.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨ ਛੂਟਸੀ ਮਰਿ ਨਰਕ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੫॥
420.t: bin har naam na chhooTasee mar narak samaae ||5||
420.e: Without the Lord's Name, he shall not be emancipated; he shall die, and sink into hell. ||5||

420.g: ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰੈ ਭਰਮਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਲੇਵੈ ॥
420.t: janam marai bharamaieeaai har naam na levai ||
420.e: He wanders through birth and death, and never chants the Lord's Name.

420.g: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵੈ ॥੬॥
420.t: taa kee keemat naa pavai bin gur kee sevai ||6||
420.e: He never realizes his own value, without serving the Guru. ||6||

421.g: ਜੇਹੀ ਸੇਵ ਕਰਾਈਐ ਕਰਣੀ ਭੀ ਸਾਈ ॥
421.t: jehee sev karaieeaai karanee bhee saiee ||
421.e: Whatever service the Lord causes us to do, that is just what we do.

421.g: ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਵੇਖੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੭॥
421.t: aap kare kis aakheeaai vekhai vaddiaaiee ||7||
421.e: He Himself acts; who else should be mentioned? He beholds His own greatness. ||7||

421.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
421.t: gur kee sevaa so kare jis aap karaae ||
421.e: He alone serves the Guru, whom the Lord Himself inspires to do so.

421.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਿਰੁ ਦੇ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੮॥੧੮॥
421.t: naanak sir dhe chhooTeeaai dharageh pat paae ||8||18||
421.e: O Nanak, offering his head, one is emancipated, and honored in the Court of the Lord. ||8||18||

421.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
421.t: aasaa mahalaa pehilaa ||
421.e: Aasaa, First Mehla:

421.g: ਰੂੜੋ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਮਾਹਰੋ ਰੂੜੀ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ॥
421.t: rooRo Thaakur maaharo rooRee gurbaanee ||
421.e: Beautiful is the Supreme Lord and Master, and beautiful is the Word of the Guru's Bani.

421.g: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਪਾਈਐ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
421.t: vaddai bhaag satigur milai paieeaai padh nirabaanee ||1||
421.e: By great good fortune, one meets the True Guru, and the supreme status of Nirvaanaa is obtained. ||1||

421.g: ਮੈ ਓਲੑਗੀਆ ਓਲੑਗੀ ਹਮ ਛੋਰੂ ਥਾਰੇ ॥
421.t: mai ol(h)geeaa ol(h)gee ham chhoroo thaare ||
421.e: I am the lowest slave of Your slaves; I am Your most humble servant.

421.g: ਜਿਉ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਰਹਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
421.t: jiau too(n) raakheh tiau rahaa mukh naam hamaare ||1|| rahaau ||
421.e: As You keep me, I live. Your Name is in my mouth. ||1||Pause||

421.g: ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਸਾ ਘਣੀ ਭਾਣੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈਐ ॥
421.t: dharasan kee piaasaa ghanee bhaanai man bhaieeaai ||
421.e: I have such a great thirst for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan; my mind accepts Your Will, and so You are pleased with me.

421.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹਾਥਿ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਭਾਣੈ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
421.t: mere Thaakur haath vaddiaaieeaa bhaanai pat paieeaai ||2||
421.e: Greatness is in the Hands of my Lord and Master; by His Will, honor is obtained. ||2||

421.g: ਸਾਚਉ ਦੂਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
421.t: saachau dhoor na jaaneeaai a(n)tar hai soiee ||
421.e: Do not think that the True Lord is far away; He is deep within.

421.g: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੇ ਕਿਨਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥੩॥
421.t: jeh dhekhaa teh rav rahe kin keemat hoiee ||3||
421.e: Wherever I look, there I find Him pervading; how can I estimate His value? ||3||

421.g: ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਆਪੇ ਹਰੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
421.t: aap kare aape hare vekhai vaddiaaiee ||
421.e: He Himself does, and He Himself undoes. He Himself beholds His glorious greatness.

421.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਹਾਲੀਐ ਇਉ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥
421.t: gurmukh hoi nihaaleeaai iau keemat paiee ||4||
421.e: Becoming Gurmukh, one beholds Him, and so, His value is appraised. ||4||

421.g: ਜੀਵਦਿਆ ਲਾਹਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਰ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
421.t: jeevadhiaa laahaa milai gur kaar kamaavai ||
421.e: So earn your profits while you are alive, by serving the Guru.

421.g: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੫॥
421.t: poorab hovai likhiaa taa satigur paavai ||5||
421.e: If it is so pre-ordained, then one finds the True Guru. ||5||

421.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਤੋਟਾ ਨਿਤ ਹੈ ਭਰਮਹਿ ਭਰਮਾਏ ॥
421.t: manmukh toTaa nit hai bharameh bharamaae ||
421.e: The self-willed manmukhs continually lose, and wander around, deluded by doubt.

421.g: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਅੰਧੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਈ ਕਿਉ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੬॥
421.t: manmukh a(n)dh na chetiee kiau dharasan paae ||6||
421.e: The blind manmukhs do not remember the Lord; how can they obtain the Blessed Vision of His Darshan? ||6||

421.g: ਤਾ ਜਗਿ ਆਇਆ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਸਾਚੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
421.t: taa jag aaiaa jaaneeaai saachai liv laae ||
421.e: One's coming into the world is judged worthwhile only if one lovingly attunes oneself to the True Lord.

421.g: ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਭਏ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੭॥
421.t: gur bheTe paaras bhe jotee jot milaae ||7||
421.e: Meeting the Guru, one becomes invaluable; his light merges into the Light. ||7||

421.g: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੋ ਕਾਰ ਧੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਰਣੀ ॥
421.t: ahinis rahai niraalamo kaar dhur kee karanee ||
421.e: Day and night, he remains detached, and serves the Primal Lord.

421.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆ ਰਾਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ॥੮॥੧੯॥
421.t: naanak naam sa(n)tokheeaa raate har charanee ||8||19||
421.e: O Nanak, those who are imbued with the Lord's Lotus Feet, are content with the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||8||19||

421.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
421.t: aasaa mahalaa pehilaa ||
421.e: Aasaa, First Mehla:

421.g: ਕੇਤਾ ਆਖਣੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਅੰਤ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
421.t: ketaa aakhan aakheeaai taa ke a(n)t na jaanaa ||
421.e: No matter how much one may describe the Lord, His limits still cannot be known.

421.g: ਮੈ ਨਿਧਰਿਆ ਧਰ ਏਕ ਤੂੰ ਮੈ ਤਾਣੁ ਸਤਾਣਾ ॥੧॥
421.t: mai nidhariaa dhar ek too(n) mai taan sataanaa ||1||
421.e: I am without any support; You, O Lord, are my only Support; You are my almighty power. ||1||

421.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਹੈ ਸਚ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ॥
421.t: naanak kee aradhaas hai sach naam suhelaa ||
421.e: This is Nanak's prayer, that he may be adorned with the True Name.

421.g: ਆਪੁ ਗਇਆ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਮੇਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
421.t: aap giaa sojhee piee gur sabadhee melaa ||1|| rahaau ||
421.e: When self-conceit is eradicated, and understanding is obtained, one meets the Lord, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||Pause||

421.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਗਰਬੁ ਗਵਾਈਐ ਪਾਈਐ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
421.t: haumai garab gavaieeaai paieeaai veechaar ||
421.e: Abandoning egotism and pride, one obtains contemplative understanding.

421.g: ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਦੇ ਸਾਚੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
421.t: saahib siau man maaniaa dhe saach adhaar ||2||
421.e: When the mind surrenders to the Lord Master, He bestows the support of the Truth. ||2||

421.g: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਈ ॥
421.t: ahinis naam sa(n)tokheeaa sevaa sach saiee ||
421.e: Day and night, remain content with the Naam, the Name of the Lord; that is the true service.

421.g: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗਈ ਚਾਲੈ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਰਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
421.t: taa kau bighan na laagiee chaalai hukam rajaiee ||3||
421.e: No misfortune troubles one who follows the Command of the Lord's Will. ||3||

421.g: ਹੁਕਮਿ ਰਜਾਈ ਜੋ ਚਲੈ ਸੋ ਪਵੈ ਖਜਾਨੈ ॥
421.t: hukam rajaiee jo chalai so pavai khajaanai ||
421.e: One who follows the Command of the Lord's Will is taken into the Lord's Treasury.

421.g: ਖੋਟੇ ਠਵਰ ਨ ਪਾਇਨੀ ਰਲੇ ਜੂਠਾਨੈ ॥੪॥
421.t: khoTe Thavar na painee rale jooThaanai ||4||
421.e: The counterfeit find no place there; they are mixed with the false ones. ||4||

421.g: ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਖਰਾ ਸਮਾਲੀਐ ਸਚੁ ਸਉਦਾ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
421.t: nit nit kharaa samaaleeaai sach saudhaa paieeaai ||
421.e: Forever and ever, the genuine coins are treasured; with them, the true merchandise is purchased.

421.g: ਖੋਟੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਵਨੀ ਲੇ ਅਗਨਿ ਜਲਾਈਐ ॥੫॥
421.t: khoTe nadhar na aavanee le agan jalaieeaai ||5||
421.e: The false ones are not seen in the Lord's Treasury; they are seized and cast into the fire again. ||5||

421.g: ਜਿਨੀ ਆਤਮੁ ਚੀਨਿਆ ਪਰਮਾਤਮੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
421.t: jinee aatam cheeniaa paramaatam soiee ||
421.e: Those who understand their own souls, are themselves the Supreme Soul.

421.g: ਏਕੋ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਫਲੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੬॥
421.t: eko a(n)mirat birakh hai fal a(n)mrit hoiee ||6||
421.e: The One Lord is the tree of ambrosial nectar, which bears the ambrosial fruit. ||6||

421.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੇ ਅਘਾਈ ॥
421.t: a(n)mirat fal jinee chaakhiaa sach rahe aghaiee ||
421.e: Those who taste the ambrosial fruit remain satisfied with Truth.

421.g: ਤਿੰਨਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਭੇਦੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਈ ॥੭॥
421.t: ti(n)naa bharam na bhedh hai har rasan rasaiee ||7||
421.e: They have no doubt or sense of separation - their tongues taste the divine taste. ||7||

421.g: ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਆਇਆ ਚਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਰਜਾਈ ॥
421.t: hukam sa(n)jogee aaiaa chal sadhaa rajaiee ||
421.e: By His Command, and through your past actions, you came into the world; walk forever according to His Will.

421.g: ਅਉਗਣਿਆਰੇ ਕਉ ਗੁਣੁ ਨਾਨਕੈ ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਾਈ ॥੮॥੨੦॥
421.t: aauganiaare kau gun naanakai sach milai vaddaiee ||8||20||
421.e: Please, grant virtue to Nanak, the virtueless one; bless him with the glorious greatness of the Truth. ||8||20||

421.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
421.t: aasaa mahalaa pehilaa ||
421.e: Aasaa, First Mehla:

421.g: ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਉ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇ ਸਚੁ ਵਖਾਣਿਆ ॥
421.t: man raatau har nai sach vakhaaniaa ||
421.e: One whose mind is attuned to the Lord's Name speaks the truth.

421.g: ਲੋਕਾ ਦਾ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਇ ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
421.t: lokaa dhaa kiaa jai jaa tudh bhaaniaa ||1||
421.e: What would the people lose, if I became pleasing to You, O Lord? ||1||

422.g: ਜਉ ਲਗੁ ਜੀਉ ਪਰਾਣ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
422.t: jau lag jeeau paraan sach dhiaaieeaai ||
422.e: As long as there is the breath of life, meditate on the True Lord.

422.g: ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
422.t: laahaa har gun gai milai sukh paieeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
422.e: You shall receive the profit of singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and find peace. ||1||Pause||

422.g: ਸਚੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਕਾਰ ਦੇਹਿ ਦਇਆਲ ਤੂੰ ॥
422.t: sachee teree kaar dheh dhiaal too(n) ||
422.e: True is Your Service; bless me with it, O Merciful Lord.

422.g: ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਮੈ ਟੇਕ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਤੂੰ ॥੨॥
422.t: hau jeevaa tudh saalaeh mai Tek adhaar too(n) ||2||
422.e: I live by praising You; You are my Anchor and Support. ||2||

422.g: ਦਰਿ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਦਰਵਾਨੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਤੂੰ ਜਾਣਹੀ ॥
422.t: dhar sevak dharavaan dharadh too(n) jaanahee ||
422.e: I am Your servant, the gate-keeper at Your Gate; You alone know my pain.

422.g: ਭਗਤਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਹੈਰਾਨੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਗਵਾਵਹੀ ॥੩॥
422.t: bhagat teree hairaan dharadh gavaavahee ||3||
422.e: How wonderful is Your devotional worship! It removes all pains. ||3||

422.g: ਦਰਗਹ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਦੂਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਣਸੀ ॥
422.t: dharageh naam hadhoor gurmukh jaanasee ||
422.e: The Gurmukhs know that by chanting the Naam, they shall dwell in His Court, in His Presence.

422.g: ਵੇਲਾ ਸਚੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣਸੀ ॥੪॥
422.t: velaa sach paravaan sabadh pachhaanasee ||4||
422.e: True and acceptable is that time, when one recognizes the Word of the Shabad. ||4||

422.g: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਕਰਿ ਭਾਉ ਤੋਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੇਇ ॥
422.t: sat sa(n)tokh kar bhaau tosaa har naam sei ||
422.e: Those who practice Truth, contentment and love, obtain the supplies of the Lord's Name.

422.g: ਮਨਹੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਦੇਇ ॥੫॥
422.t: manahu chhodd vikaar sachaa sach dhei ||5||
422.e: So banish corruption from your mind, and the True One will grant you Truth. ||5||

422.g: ਸਚੇ ਸਚਾ ਨੇਹੁ ਸਚੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
422.t: sache sachaa neh sachai laiaa ||
422.e: The True Lord inspires true love in the truthful.

422.g: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਆਉ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
422.t: aape kare niaau jo tis bhaiaa ||6||
422.e: He Himself administers justice, as it pleases His Will. ||6||

422.g: ਸਚੇ ਸਚੀ ਦਾਤਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੈ ॥
422.t: sache sachee dhaat dheh dhiaal hai ||
422.e: True is the gift of the True, Compassionate Lord.

422.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲੁ ਹੈ ॥੭॥
422.t: tis sevee dhin raat naam amol hai ||7||
422.e: Day and night, I serve the One whose Name is priceless. ||7||

422.g: ਤੂੰ ਉਤਮੁ ਹਉ ਨੀਚੁ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਕਾਂਢੀਆ ॥
422.t: too(n) utam hau neech sevak kaa(n)ddeeaa ||
422.e: You are so sublime, and I am so lowly, but I am called Your slave.

422.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਹੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਵਾਂਢੀਆ ॥੮॥੨੧॥
422.t: naanak nadhar kareh milai sach vaa(n)ddeeaa ||8||21||
422.e: Please, shower Nanak with Your Glance of Grace, that he, the separated one, may merge with You again, O Lord. ||8||21||

422.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
422.t: aasaa mahalaa pehilaa ||
422.e: Aasaa, First Mehla:

422.g: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਕਿਉ ਰਹੈ ਕਿਉ ਮੇਲਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
422.t: aavan jaanaa kiau rahai kiau melaa hoiee ||
422.e: How can coming and going, the cycle of reincarnation be ended? And how can one meet the Lord?

422.g: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਘਣੋ ਨਿਤ ਸਹਸਾ ਦੋਈ ॥੧॥
422.t: janam maran kaa dhukh ghano nit sahasaa dhoiee ||1||
422.e: The pain of birth and death is so great, in constant skepticism and duality. ||1||

422.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕਿਆ ਜੀਵਨਾ ਫਿਟੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
422.t: bin naavai kiaa jeevanaa fiT dhirag chaturaiee ||
422.e: Without the Name, what is life? Cleverness is detestable and cursed.

422.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਾਧੁ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਭਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
422.t: satigur saadh na seviaa har bhagat na bhaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
422.e: One who does not serve the Holy True Guru, is not pleased by devotion to the Lord. ||1||Pause||

422.g: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਵਣੁ ਤਉ ਰਹੈ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
422.t: aavan jaavan tau rahai paieeaai gur pooraa ||
422.e: Coming and going is ended only when one finds the True Guru.

422.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਦੇਇ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਕੂਰਾ ॥੨॥
422.t: raam naam dhan raas dhei binasai bhram kooraa ||2||
422.e: He gives the wealth and capital of the Lord's Name, and false doubt is destroyed. ||2||

422.g: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੈ ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਏ ॥
422.t: sa(n)t janaa kau mil rahai dhan dhan jas gaae ||
422.e: Joining the humble Saintly beings, let us sing the blessed, blessed Praises of the Lord.

422.g: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
422.t: aadh purakh apara(n)paraa gurmukh har paae ||3||
422.e: The Primal Lord, the Infinite, is obtained by the Gurmukh. ||3||

422.g: ਨਟੂਐ ਸਾਂਗੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ ਬਾਜੀ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
422.t: naTooaai saa(n)g banaiaa baajee sa(n)saaraa ||
422.e: The drama of the world is staged like the show of a buffoon.

422.g: ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਬਾਜੀ ਦੇਖੀਐ ਉਝਰਤ ਨਹੀ ਬਾਰਾ ॥੪॥
422.t: khin pal baajee dhekheeaai ujharat nahee baaraa ||4||
422.e: For an instant, for a moment, the show is seen, but it disappears in no time at all. ||4||

422.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਚਉਪੜਿ ਖੇਲਣਾ ਝੂਠੇ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
422.t: haumai chaupaR khelanaa jhooThe aha(n)kaaraa ||
422.e: The game of chance is played on the board of egotism, with the pieces of falsehood and ego.

422.g: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਹਾਰੈ ਸੋ ਜਿਣੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੫॥
422.t: sabh jag haarai so jinai gur sabadh veechaaraa ||5||
422.e: The whole world loses; he alone wins, who reflects upon the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||5||

422.g: ਜਿਉ ਅੰਧੁਲੈ ਹਥਿ ਟੋਹਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰੈ ॥
422.t: jiau a(n)dhulai hath Tohanee har naam hamaarai ||
422.e: As is the cane in the hand of the blind man, so is the Lord's Name for me.

422.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਟੇਕ ਹੈ ਨਿਸਿ ਦਉਤ ਸਵਾਰੈ ॥੬॥
422.t: raam naam har Tek hai nis dhaut savaarai ||6||
422.e: The Lord's Name is my Support, night and day and morning. ||6||

422.g: ਜਿਉ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਰਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥
422.t: jiau too(n) raakheh tiau rahaa har naam adhaaraa ||
422.e: As You keep me, Lord, I live; the Lord's Name is my only Support.

422.g: ਅੰਤਿ ਸਖਾਈ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥੭॥
422.t: a(n)t sakhaiee paiaa jan mukat dhuaaraa ||7||
422.e: It is my only comfort in the end; the gate of salvation is found by His humble servants. ||7||

422.g: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖ ਮੇਟਿਆ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ॥
422.t: janam maran dhukh meTiaa jap naam muraare ||
422.e: The pain of birth and death is removed, by chanting and meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

422.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਤਾਰੇ ॥੮॥੨੨॥
422.t: naanak naam na veesarai pooraa gur taare ||8||22||
422.e: O Nanak, one who does not forget the Naam, is saved by the Perfect Guru. ||8||22||

422.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਘਰੁ ੨
422.t: aasaa mahalaa teejaa asaTapadheeaa ghar doojaa
422.e: Aasaa, Third Mehla, Ashtpadheeyaa, Second House:

422.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
422.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
422.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

422.g: ਸਾਸਤੁ ਬੇਦੁ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸੁਰਸਰੀ ਚਰਣ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
422.t: saasat bedh si(n)mirat sar teraa surasaree charan samaanee ||
422.e: The Shaastras, the Vedas and the Simritees are contained in the ocean of Your Name; the River Ganges is held in Your Feet.

422.g: ਸਾਖਾ ਤੀਨਿ ਮੂਲੁ ਮਤਿ ਰਾਵੈ ਤੂੰ ਤਾਂ ਸਰਬ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
422.t: saakhaa teen mool mat raavai too(n) taa(n) sarab viddaanee ||1||
422.e: The intellect can understand the world of the three modes, but You, O Primal Lord, are totally astounding. ||1||

422.g: ਤਾ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਜਪੈ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬੋਲੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
422.t: taa ke charan japai jan naanak bole a(n)mirat baanee ||1|| rahaau ||
422.e: Servant Nanak meditates on His Feet, and chants the Ambrosial Word of His Bani. ||1||Pause||

422.g: ਤੇਤੀਸ ਕਰੋੜੀ ਦਾਸ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਅਧਾਰੀ ॥
422.t: tetees karoRee dhaas tum(h)aare ridh sidh praan adhaaree ||
422.e: Three hundred thirty million gods are Your servants. You bestow wealth, and the supernatural powers of the Siddhas; You are the Support of the breath of life.

423.g: ਤਾ ਕੇ ਰੂਪ ਨ ਜਾਹੀ ਲਖਣੇ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਆਖਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
423.t: taa ke roop na jaahee lakhane kiaa kar aakh veechaaree ||2||
423.e: His beauteous forms cannot be comprehended; what can anyone accomplish by discussing and debating? ||2||

423.g: ਤੀਨਿ ਗੁਣਾ ਤੇਰੇ ਜੁਗ ਹੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਚਾਰੇ ਤੇਰੀਆ ਖਾਣੀ ॥
423.t: teen gunaa tere jug hee a(n)tar chaare tereeaa khaanee ||
423.e: Throughout the ages, You are the three qualities, and the four sources of creation.

423.g: ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਾ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਥੇ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
423.t: karam hovai taa param padh paieeaai kathe akath kahaanee ||3||
423.e: If You show Your Mercy, then one obtains the supreme status, and speaks the Unspoken Speech. ||3||

423.g: ਤੂੰ ਕਰਤਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਕਰੇ ਪਰਾਣੀ ॥
423.t: too(n) karataa keeaa sabh teraa kiaa ko kare paraanee ||
423.e: You are the Creator; all are created by You. What can any mortal being do?

423.g: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਅਪਣੀ ਸਾਈ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥੪॥
423.t: jaa kau nadhar kareh too(n) apanee saiee sach samaanee ||4||
423.e: He alone, upon whom You shower Your Grace, is absorbed into the Truth. ||4||

423.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਲੇਤੁ ਹੈ ਜੇਤੀ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
423.t: naam teraa sabh koiee let hai jetee aavan jaanee ||
423.e: Everyone who comes and goes chants Your Name.

423.g: ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਹੋਰ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਫਿਰੈ ਇਆਣੀ ॥੫॥
423.t: jaa tudh bhaavai taa gurmukh boojhai hor manmukh firai iaanee ||5||
423.e: When it is pleasing to Your Will, then the Gurmukh understands. Otherwise, the self-willed manmukhs wander in ignorance. ||5||

423.g: ਚਾਰੇ ਵੇਦ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇ ਕਉ ਦੀਏ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
423.t: chaare vedh brahame kau dhe'ee paR paR kare veechaaree ||
423.e: You gave the four Vedas to Brahma, for him to read and read continually, and reflect upon.

423.g: ਤਾ ਕਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਬਪੁੜਾ ਨਰਕਿ ਸੁਰਗਿ ਅਵਤਾਰੀ ॥੬॥
423.t: taa kaa hukam na boojhai bapuRaa narak surag avataaree ||6||
423.e: The wretched one does not understand His Command, and is reincarnated into heaven and hell. ||6||

423.g: ਜੁਗਹ ਜੁਗਹ ਕੇ ਰਾਜੇ ਕੀਏ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਕਰਿ ਅਵਤਾਰੀ ॥
423.t: jugeh jugeh ke raaje ke'ee gaaveh kar avataaree ||
423.e: In each and every age, He creates the kings, who are sung of as His Incarnations.

423.g: ਤਿਨ ਭੀ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਆਖਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੭॥
423.t: tin bhee a(n)t na paiaa taa kaa kiaa kar aakh veechaaree ||7||
423.e: Even they have not found His limits; what can I speak of and contemplate? ||7||

423.g: ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਦੇਹਿ ਤ ਸਾਚੁ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
423.t: too(n) sachaa teraa keeaa sabh saachaa dheh ta saach vakhaanee ||
423.e: You are True, and all that You do is True. If You bless me with the Truth, I will speak on it.

423.g: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਸਚੁ ਬੁਝਾਵਹਿ ਅਪਣਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥੮॥੧॥੨੩॥
423.t: jaa kau sach bujhaaveh apanaa sahaje naam samaanee ||8||1||23||
423.e: One whom You inspire to understand the Truth, is easily absorbed into the Naam. ||8||1||23||
Aasaa, Third Mehla:
The True Guru has dispelled my doubts.
He has enshrined the Immaculate Name of the Lord within my mind.
Focusing on the Word of the Shabad, I have obtained lasting peace. ||1||
Listen, O my mind, to the essence of spiritual wisdom.

423.g: ਦੇਵਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
423.t: dhevan vaalaa sabh bidh jaanai gurmukh paieeaai naam nidhaan ||1|| rahaau ||
423.e: The Great Giver knows our condition completely; the Gurmukh obtains the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
The great glory of meeting the True Guru is
that it has quenched the fire of possessiveness and desire;
imbued with peace and poise, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

423.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
423.t: vin gur poore koi na jaanee ||
423.e: Without the Perfect Guru, no one knows the Lord.
Attached to Maya, they are engrossed in duality.
The Gurmukh receives the Naam, and the Bani of the Lord's Word. ||3||

423.g: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤਪਾਂ ਸਿਰਿ ਤਪੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
423.t: gur sevaa tapaa(n) sir tap saar ||
423.e: Service to the Guru is the most excellent and sublime penance of penances.

423.g: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਭ ਦੂਖ ਵਿਸਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
423.t: har jeeau man vasai sabh dhookh visaaranahaar ||
423.e: The Dear Lord dwells in the mind, and all suffering departs.
Then, at the Gate of the True Lord, one appears truthful. ||4||

423.g: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
423.t: gur sevaa te tirabhavan sojhee hoi ||
423.e: Serving the Guru, one comes to know the three worlds.
Understanding his own self, he obtains the Lord.
Through the True Word of His Bani, we enter the Mansion of His Presence. ||5||

423.g: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਸਭ ਕੁਲ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥
423.t: gur sevaa te sabh kul udhaare ||
423.e: Serving the Guru, all of one's generations are saved.
Keep the Immaculate Naam enshrined within your heart.
In the Court of the True Lord, you shall be adorned with True Glory. ||6||

423.g: ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਏ ॥
423.t: se vaddabhaagee j gur sevaa laae ||
423.e: How very fortunate are they, who are committed to the Guru's service.
Night and day, they are engaged in devotional worship; the True Name is implanted within them.
Through the Naam, all of one's generations are saved. ||7||
Nanak chants the true thought.

423.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਖਹੁ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
423.t: har kaa naam rakhahu ur dhaar ||
423.e: Keep the Name of the Lord enshrined within your heart.
Imbued with devotion to the Lord, the gate of salvation is found. ||8||2||24||
Aasaa, Third Mehla:
Everyone lives, hoping in hope.
Understanding His Command, one becomes free of desire.
So many are asleep in hope.
He alone wakes up, whom the Lord awakens. ||1||

423.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੁਝਾਇਆ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
423.t: satigur naam bujhaiaa vin naavai bhukh na jaiee ||
423.e: The True Guru has led me to understand the Naam, the Name of the Lord; without the Naam, hunger does not go away.

424.g: ਨਾਮੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਿਸੈ ਰਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
424.t: naame tirasanaa agan bujhai naam milai tisai rajaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
424.e: Through the Naam, the fire of desire is extinguished; the Naam is obtained by His Will. ||1||Pause||
In the Dark Age of Kali Yuga, realize the Word of the Shabad.
By this devotional worship, egotism is eliminated.
Serving the True Guru, one becomes approved.

424.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਆਸਾ ਕੀਤੀ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਜਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
424.t: jin aasaa keetee tis no jaan ||2||
424.e: So know the One, who created hope and desire. ||2||

424.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਕਿਆ ਦੀਜੈ ਜਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
424.t: tis kiaa dheejai j sabadh sunaae ||
424.e: What shall we offer to one who proclaims the Word of the Shabad?
By His Grace, the Naam is enshrined within our minds.
Offer your head, and shed your self-conceit.
One who understands the Lord's Command finds lasting peace. ||3||
He Himself does, and causes others to do.
He Himself enshrines His Name in the mind of the Gurmukh.
He Himself misleads us, and He Himself puts us back on the Path.
Through the True Word of the Shabad, we merge into the True Lord. ||4||
True is the Shabad, and True is the Word of the Lord's Bani.
In each and every age, the Gurmukhs speak it and chant it.
The self-willed manmukhs are deluded by doubt and attachment.
Without the Name, everyone wanders around insane. ||5||
Throughout the three worlds, is the one Maya.

424.g: ਮੂਰਖਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ॥
424.t: moorakh paR paR dhoojaa bhaau dhiraRaiaa ||
424.e: The fool reads and reads, but holds tight to duality.
He performs all sorts of rituals, but still suffers terrible pain.
Serving the True Guru, eternal peace is obtained. ||6||
Reflective meditation upon the Shabad is such sweet nectar.
Night and day, one enjoys it, subduing his ego.
When the Lord showers His Mercy, we enjoy celestial bliss.
Imbued with the Naam, love the True Lord forever. ||7||

424.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਪੜੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
424.t: har jap paReeaai gur sabadh veechaar ||
424.e: Meditate on the Lord, and read and reflect upon the Guru's Shabad.
Subdue your ego and meditate on the Lord.
Meditate on the Lord, and be imbued with fear and love of the True One.
O Nanak, enshrine the Naam within your heart, through the Guru's Teachings. ||8||3||25||
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

424.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਘਰੁ ੮ ਕਾਫੀ ॥
424.t: raag aasaa mahalaa teejaa asaTapadheeaa ghar atthvaa kaafee ||
424.e: Raag Aasaa, Third Mehla, Ashtpadheeyaa, Eighth House, Kaafee:

424.g: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਊਪਜੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
424.t: gur te saa(n)t uoopajai jin tirasanaa agan bujhaiee ||
424.e: Peace emanates from the Guru; He puts out the fire of desire.

424.g: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧॥
424.t: gur te naam paieeaai vaddee vaddiaaiee ||1||
424.e: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is obtained from the Guru; it is the greatest greatness. ||1||
Keep the One Name in your consciousness, O my Siblings of Destiny.

424.g: ਜਗਤੁ ਜਲੰਦਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਕੈ ਭਜਿ ਪਏ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
424.t: jagat jala(n)dhaa dhekh kai bhaj pe saranaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
424.e: Seeing the world on fire, I have hurried to the Lord's Sanctuary. ||1||Pause||

424.g: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਮਹਾ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
424.t: gur te giaan uoopajai mahaa tat beechaaraa ||
424.e: Spiritual wisdom emanates from the Guru; reflect upon the supreme essence of reality.

424.g: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਘਰੁ ਦਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਭਗਤੀ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
424.t: gur te ghar dhar paiaa bhagatee bhare bha(n)ddaaraa ||2||
424.e: Through the Guru, the Lord's Mansion and His Court are attained; His devotional worship is overflowing with treasures. ||2||
The Gurmukh meditates on the Naam; he achieves reflective meditation and understanding.

424.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਲਾਹ ਹੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
424.t: gurmukh bhagat salaeh hai a(n)tar sabadh apaaraa ||3||
424.e: The Gurmukh is the Lord's devotee, immersed in His Praises; the Infinite Word of the Shabad dwells within him. ||3||

424.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੂਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
424.t: gurmukh sookh uoopajai dhukh kadhe na hoiee ||
424.e: Happiness emanates from the Gurmukh; he never suffers pain.

424.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀਐ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥
424.t: gurmukh haumai maareeaai man niramal hoiee ||4||
424.e: The Gurmukh conquers his ego, and his mind is immaculately pure. ||4||

424.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਆਪੁ ਗਇਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
424.t: satigur miliaai aap giaa tirabhavan sojhee paiee ||
424.e: Meeting the True Guru, self-conceit is removed, and understanding of the three worlds is obtained.

424.g: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੋਤਿ ਪਸਰਿ ਰਹੀ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੫॥
424.t: niramal jot pasar rahee jotee jot milaiee ||5||
424.e: The Immaculate Divine Light is pervading and permeating everywhere; one's light merges into the Light. ||5||

424.g: ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਮਝਾਇਆ ਮਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਹੋਈ ॥
424.t: poorai gur samajhaiaa mat uootam hoiee ||
424.e: The Perfect Guru instructs, and one's intellect becomes sublime.

424.g: ਅੰਤਰੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਨਾਮੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੬॥
424.t: a(n)tar seetal saa(n)t hoi naame sukh hoiee ||6||
424.e: A cooling and soothing peace comes within, and through the Naam, peace is obtained. ||6||

424.g: ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤਾਂ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਾਂ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਈ ॥
424.t: pooraa satigur taa(n) milai jaa(n) nadhar kareiee ||
424.e: One meets the Perfect True Guru only when the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace.

424.g: ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਪਾਪ ਸਭ ਕਟੀਅਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੭॥
424.t: kilavikh paap sabh kaTe'eeh fir dhukh bighan na hoiee ||7||
424.e: All sins and vices are eradicated, and one shall never again suffer pain or distress. ||7||

425.g: ਆਪਣੈ ਹਥਿ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਦੇ ਨਾਮੇ ਲਾਏ ॥
425.t: aapanai hath vaddiaaieeaa dhe naame laae ||
425.e: Glory is in His Hands; He bestows His Name, and attaches us to it.

425.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਪਾਏ ॥੮॥੪॥੨੬॥
425.t: naanak naam nidhaan man vasiaa vaddiaaiee paae ||8||4||26||
425.e: O Nanak, the treasure of the Naam abides within the mind, and glory is obtained. ||8||4||26||

425.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
425.t: aasaa mahalaa teejaa ||
425.e: Aasaa, Third Mehla:

425.g: ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਆਇ ਮਿਲੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
425.t: sun man ma(n)n vasai too(n) aape aai milai mere bhaiee ||
425.e: Listen, O mortal: enshrine His Name within your mind; He shall come to meet with you, O my Sibling of Destiny.

425.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈ ॥੧॥
425.t: anadhin sachee bhagat kar sachai chit laiee ||1||
425.e: Night and day, center your consciousness on true devotional worship of the True Lord. ||1||

425.g: ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂੰ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
425.t: eko naam dhiaai too(n) sukh paaveh mere bhaiee ||
425.e: Meditate on the One Naam, and you shall find peace, O my Siblings of Destiny.

425.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
425.t: haumai dhoojaa dhoor kar vaddee vaddiaaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
425.e: Eradicate egotism and duality, and your glory shall be glorious. ||1||Pause||

425.g: ਇਸੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਨੋ ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਲੋਚਦੇ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
425.t: eis bhagatee no sur nar mun jan lochadhe vin satigur paiee na jai ||
425.e: The angels, humans and silent sages long for this devotional worship, but without the True Guru, it cannot be attained.

425.g: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੜਦੇ ਜੋਤਿਕੀ ਤਿਨ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
425.t: pa(n)ddit paRadhe jotikee tin boojh na pai ||2||
425.e: The Pandits, the religious scholars, and the astrologers read their books, but they do not understand. ||2||

425.g: ਆਪੈ ਥੈ ਸਭੁ ਰਖਿਓਨੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
425.t: aapai thai sabh rakhion kichh kahan na jaiee ||
425.e: He Himself keeps all in His Hand; nothing else can be said.

425.g: ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਸੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰਿ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੩॥
425.t: aape dhei su paieeaai gur boojh bujhaiee ||3||
425.e: Whatever He gives, is received. The Guru has imparted this understanding to me. ||3||

425.g: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਤਿਸ ਦੇ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
425.t: jeea ja(n)t sabh tis dhe sabhanaa kaa soiee ||
425.e: All beings and creatures are His; He belongs to all.

425.g: ਮੰਦਾ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਜੇ ਦੂਜਾ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥
425.t: ma(n)dhaa kis no aakheeaai je dhoojaa hoiee ||4||
425.e: So who can we call bad, since there is no other? ||4||

425.g: ਇਕੋ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਏਕਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਰਾ ॥
425.t: eiko hukam varatadhaa ekaa sir kaaraa ||
425.e: The Command of the One Lord is pervading throughout; duty to the One Lord is upon the heads of all.

425.g: ਆਪਿ ਭਵਾਲੀ ਦਿਤੀਅਨੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਵਿਕਾਰਾ ॥੫॥
425.t: aap bhavaalee dhiteean a(n)tar lobh vikaaraa ||5||
425.e: He Himself has led them astray, and placed greed and corruption within their hearts. ||5||

425.g: ਇਕ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੀਤਿਅਨੁ ਬੂਝਨਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
425.t: eik aape gurmukh keetian boojhan veechaaraa ||
425.e: He has sanctified those few Gurmukhs who understand Him, and reflect upon Him.

425.g: ਭਗਤਿ ਭੀ ਓਨਾ ਨੋ ਬਖਸੀਅਨੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥੬॥
425.t: bhagat bhee onaa no bakhaseean a(n)tar bha(n)ddaaraa ||6||
425.e: He grants devotional worship to them, and within them is the treasure. ||6||

425.g: ਗਿਆਨੀਆ ਨੋ ਸਭੁ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
425.t: giaaneeaa no sabh sach hai sach sojhee hoiee ||
425.e: The spiritual teachers know nothing but the Truth; they obtain true understanding.

425.g: ਓਇ ਭੁਲਾਏ ਕਿਸੈ ਦੇ ਨ ਭੁਲਨੑੀ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਣਨਿ ਸੋਈ ॥੭॥
425.t: oi bhulaae kisai dhe na bhulan(h)ee sach jaanan soiee ||7||
425.e: They are led astray by Him, but they do not go astray, because they know the True Lord. ||7||

425.g: ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਪੰਚ ਵਰਤਦੇ ਪੰਚੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
425.t: ghar meh pa(n)ch varatadhe pa(n)che veechaaree ||
425.e: Within the homes of their bodies, the five passions are pervading, but here, the five are well-behaved.

425.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਸਿ ਨ ਆਵਨੑੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀ ॥੮॥੫॥੨੭॥
425.t: naanak bin satigur vas na aavan(h)ee naam haumai maaree ||8||5||27||
425.e: O Nanak, without the True Guru, they are not overcome; through the Naam, the ego is conquered. ||8||5||27||

425.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
425.t: aasaa mahalaa teejaa ||
425.e: Aasaa, Third Mehla:

425.g: ਘਰੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਭੁ ਵਥੁ ਹੈ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
425.t: gharai a(n)dhar sabh vath hai baahar kichh naahee ||
425.e: Everything is within the home of your own self; there is nothing beyond it.

425.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਪਟ ਖੁਲਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
425.t: gur parasaadhee paieeaai a(n)tar kapaT khulaahee ||1||
425.e: By Guru's Grace, it is obtained, and the doors of the inner heart are opened wide. ||1||

425.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਭਾਈ ॥
425.t: satigur te har paieeaai bhaiee ||
425.e: From the True Guru, the Lord's Name is obtained, O Siblings of Destiny.

425.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਦਿਖਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
425.t: a(n)tar naam nidhaan hai poorai satigur dheeaa dhikhaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
425.e: The treasure of the Naam is within; the Perfect True Guru has shown this to me. ||1||Pause||

425.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਗਾਹਕੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਲਏ ਪਾਏ ਰਤਨੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
425.t: har kaa gaahak hovai so le paae ratan veechaaraa ||
425.e: One who is a buyer of the Lord's Name, finds it, and obtains the jewel of contemplation.

425.g: ਅੰਦਰੁ ਖੋਲੈ ਦਿਬ ਦਿਸਟਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
425.t: a(n)dhar kholai dhib dhisaT dhekhai mukat bha(n)ddaaraa ||2||
425.e: He opens the doors deep within, and through the Eyes of Divine Vision, beholds the treasure of liberation. ||2||

425.g: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਮਹਲ ਅਨੇਕ ਹਹਿ ਜੀਉ ਕਰੇ ਵਸੇਰਾ ॥
425.t: a(n)dhar mahal anek heh jeeau kare vaseraa ||
425.e: There are so many mansions within the body; the soul dwells within them.

425.g: ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਸੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਫੇਰਾ ॥੩॥
425.t: man chi(n)dhiaa fal paisee fir hoi na feraa ||3||
425.e: He obtains the fruits of his mind's desires, and he shall not have to go through reincarnation again. ||3||

425.g: ਪਾਰਖੀਆ ਵਥੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਲਈ ਗੁਰ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
425.t: paarakheeaa vath samaal liee gur sojhee hoiee ||
425.e: The appraisers cherish the commodity of the Name; they obtain understanding from the Guru.

425.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਅਮੁਲੁ ਸਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੪॥
425.t: naam padhaarath amul saa gurmukh paavai koiee ||4||
425.e: The wealth of the Naam is priceless; how few are the Gurmukhs who obtain it. ||4||

425.g: ਬਾਹਰੁ ਭਾਲੇ ਸੁ ਕਿਆ ਲਹੈ ਵਥੁ ਘਰੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਭਾਈ ॥
425.t: baahar bhaale su kiaa lahai vath gharai a(n)dhar bhaiee ||
425.e: Searching outwardly, what can anyone find? The commodity is deep within the home of the self, O Siblings of Destiny.

425.g: ਭਰਮੇ ਭੂਲਾ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਫਿਰੈ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੫॥
425.t: bharame bhoolaa sabh jag firai manmukh pat gavaiee ||5||
425.e: The entire world is wandering around, deluded by doubt; the self-willed manmukhs lose their honor. ||5||

425.g: ਘਰੁ ਦਰੁ ਛੋਡੇ ਆਪਣਾ ਪਰ ਘਰਿ ਝੂਠਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
425.t: ghar dhar chhodde aapanaa par ghar jhooThaa jaiee ||
425.e: The false one leaves his own hearth and home, and goes out to another's home.

425.g: ਚੋਰੈ ਵਾਂਗੂ ਪਕੜੀਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਈ ॥੬॥
425.t: chorai vaa(n)goo pakaReeaai bin naavai choTaa khaiee ||6||
425.e: Like a thief, he is caught, and without the Naam, he is beaten and struck down. ||6||

425.g: ਜਿਨੑੀ ਘਰੁ ਜਾਤਾ ਆਪਣਾ ਸੇ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਭਾਈ ॥
425.t: jin(h)ee ghar jaataa aapanaa se sukhe'ee bhaiee ||
425.e: Those who know their own home, are happy, O Siblings of Destiny.

425.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੭॥
425.t: a(n)tar braham pachhaaniaa gur kee vaddiaaiee ||7||
425.e: They realize God within their own hearts, through the glorious greatness of the Guru. ||7||

425.g: ਆਪੇ ਦਾਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
425.t: aape dhaan kare kis aakheeaai aape dhei bujhaiee ||
425.e: He Himself gives gifts, and He Himself bestows understanding; unto whom can we complain?

425.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂੰ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ ॥੮॥੬॥੨੮॥
425.t: naanak naam dhiaai too(n) dhar sachai sobhaa paiee ||8||6||28||
425.e: O Nanak, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and you shall obtain glory in the True Court. ||8||6||28||

426.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
426.t: aasaa mahalaa teejaa ||
426.e: Aasaa, Third Mehla:

426.g: ਆਪੈ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਸਾਦੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਭਾਈ ॥
426.t: aapai aap pachhaaniaa saadh meeThaa bhaiee ||
426.e: Those who recognize their own selves, enjoy the sweet flavor, O Siblings of Destiny.

426.g: ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਚਾਖਿਐ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਭਏ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਸਾਚੋ ਭਾਈ ॥੧॥
426.t: har ras chaakhiaai mukat bhe jin(h)aa saacho bhaiee ||1||
426.e: Those who drink in the sublime essence of the Lord are emancipated; they love the Truth. ||1||

426.g: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਮਨਿ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
426.t: har jeeau niramal niramalaa niramal man vaasaa ||
426.e: The Beloved Lord is the purest of the pure; He comes to dwell in the pure mind.

426.g: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਾਹਿ ਉਦਾਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
426.t: gurmatee saalaaheeaai bikhiaa maeh udhaasaa ||1|| rahaau ||
426.e: Praising the Lord, through the Guru's Teachings, one remains unaffected by corruption. ||1||Pause||

426.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਆਪੁ ਨ ਜਾਪਈ ਸਭ ਅੰਧੀ ਭਾਈ ॥
426.t: bin sabadhai aap na jaapiee sabh a(n)dhee bhaiee ||
426.e: Without the Word of the Shabad, they do not understand themselves -they are totally blind, O Siblings of Destiny.

426.g: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੨॥
426.t: gurmatee ghaT chaananaa naam a(n)t sakhaiee ||2||
426.e: Through the Guru's Teachings, the heart is illuminated, and in the end, only the Naam shall be your companion. ||2||

426.g: ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਰਤਦੇ ਨਾਮੇ ਵਰਤਾਰਾ ॥
426.t: naame hee naam varatadhe naame varataaraa ||
426.e: They are occupied with the Naam, and only the Naam; they deal only in the Naam.

426.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
426.t: a(n)tar naam mukh naam hai naame sabadh veechaaraa ||3||
426.e: Deep within their hearts is the Naam; upon their lips is the Naam; they contemplate the Word of God, and the Naam. ||3||

426.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨੀਐ ਨਾਮੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
426.t: naam suneeaai naam ma(n)neeaai naame vaddiaaiee ||
426.e: They listen to the Naam, believe in the Naam, and through the Naam, they obtain glory.

426.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਮੇ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥
426.t: naam salaahe sadhaa sadhaa naame mahal paiee ||4||
426.e: They praise the Naam, forever and ever, and through the Naam, they obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||4||

426.g: ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣਾ ਨਾਮੇ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ ॥
426.t: naame hee ghaT chaananaa naame sobhaa paiee ||
426.e: Through the Naam, their hearts are illumined, and through the Naam, they obtain honor.

426.g: ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੫॥
426.t: naame hee sukh uoopajai naame saranaiee ||5||
426.e: Through the Naam, peace wells up; I seek the Sanctuary of the Naam. ||5||

426.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੰਨੀਐ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
426.t: bin naavai koi na ma(n)neeaai manmukh pat gavaiee ||
426.e: Without the Naam, no one is accepted; the self-willed manmukhs lose their honor.

426.g: ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਬਾਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਹਿ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੬॥
426.t: jam pur baadhe maare'eh birathaa janam gavaiee ||6||
426.e: In the City of Death, they are tied down and beaten, and they lose their lives in vain. ||6||

426.g: ਨਾਮੈ ਕੀ ਸਭ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
426.t: naamai kee sabh sevaa karai gurmukh naam bujhaiee ||
