458.g: ਬਸੁਧ ਕਾਗਦ ਬਨਰਾਜ ਕਲਮਾ ਲਿਖਣ ਕਉ ਜੇ ਹੋਇ ਪਵਨ ॥
458.t: basudh kaagadh banaraaj kalamaa likhan kau je hoi pavan ||
458.e: The earth is the paper, the forest is the pen and the wind is the writer,

458.g: ਬੇਅੰਤ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਪਾਇਆ ਗਹੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਚਰਣ ਸਰਨ ॥੪॥੫॥੮॥
458.t: bea(n)t a(n)t na jai paiaa gahee naanak charan saran ||4||5||8||
458.e: but still, the end of the endless Lord cannot be found. O Nanak, I have taken to the Sanctuary of His lotus feet. ||4||5||8||

458.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
458.t: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
458.e: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

458.g: ਪੁਰਖ ਪਤੇ ਭਗਵਾਨ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਗਹੀ ॥
458.t: purakh pate bhagavaan taa kee saran gahee ||
458.e: The Primal Lord is the Lord God of all beings. I have taken to His Sanctuary.

458.g: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਭਏ ਪਰਾਨ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਸਗਲ ਲਹੀ ॥
458.t: nirabhau bhe paraan chi(n)taa sagal lahee ||
458.e: My life has become fearless, and all my anxieties have been removed.

458.g: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਮੀਤ ਸੁਰਿਜਨ ਇਸਟ ਬੰਧਪ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
458.t: maat pitaa sut meet surijan isaT ba(n)dhap jaaniaa ||
458.e: I know the Lord as my mother, father, son, friend, well-wisher and close relative.

458.g: ਗਹਿ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਜਸੁ ਬਿਮਲ ਸੰਤ ਵਖਾਣਿਆ ॥
458.t: geh ka(n)Th laiaa gur milaiaa jas bimal sa(n)t vakhaaniaa ||
458.e: The Guru has led me to embrace Him; the Saints chant His Pure Praises.

458.g: ਬੇਅੰਤ ਗੁਣ ਅਨੇਕ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਕਹੀ ॥
458.t: bea(n)t gun anek mahimaa keemat kachhoo na jai kahee ||
458.e: His Glorious Virtues are infinite, and His greatness is unlimited. His value cannot be described at all.

458.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਏਕ ਅਨਿਕ ਅਲਖ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਓਟ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਗਹੀ ॥੧॥
458.t: prabh ek anik alakh Thaakur oT naanak tis gahee ||1||
458.e: God is the One and only, the Unseen Lord and Master; O Nanak, I have grasped His protection. ||1||

458.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਨੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਹਾਈ ਆਪਿ ਭਏ ॥
458.t: a(n)mirat ban sa(n)saar sahaiee aap bhe ||
458.e: The world is a pool of nectar, when the Lord becomes our helper.

458.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰ ਹਾਰੁ ਬਿਖੁ ਕੇ ਦਿਵਸ ਗਏ ॥
458.t: raam naam ur haar bikh ke dhivas ge ||
458.e: One who wears the necklace of the Lord's Name - his days of suffering are ended.

458.g: ਗਤੁ ਭਰਮ ਮੋਹ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਜੋਨਿ ਆਵਣ ਸਭ ਰਹੇ ॥
458.t: gat bharam moh bikaar binase jon aavan sabh rahe ||
458.e: His state of doubt, attachment and sin is erased, and the cycle of reincarnation into the womb is totally ended.

458.g: ਅਗਨਿ ਸਾਗਰ ਭਏ ਸੀਤਲ ਸਾਧ ਅੰਚਲ ਗਹਿ ਰਹੇ ॥
458.t: agan saagar bhe seetal saadh a(n)chal geh rahe ||
458.e: The ocean of fire becomes cool, when one grasps the hem of the robe of the Holy Saint.

458.g: ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਿਥ ਬੋਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਹਰਿ ਜੈ ਜਏ ॥
458.t: govi(n)dh gupaal dhiaal sa(n)mrith bol saadhoo har jai je ||
458.e: The Lord of the Universe, the Sustainer of the World, the merciful all-powerful Lord - the Holy Saints proclaim the victory of the Lord.

458.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਈ ਪਰਮ ਗਤੇ ॥੨॥
458.t: naanak naam dhiaai pooran saadhasa(n)g paiee param gate ||2||
458.e: O Nanak, meditating on the Naam, in the perfect Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I have obtained the supreme status. ||2||

458.g: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਹ ਸੰਗਿ ਏਕੋ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥
458.t: jeh dhekhau teh sa(n)g eko rav rahiaa ||
458.e: Wherever I look, there I find the One Lord permeating and pervading all.

458.g: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਵਾਸੀ ਆਪਿ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਕਿਨੈ ਲਹਿਆ ॥
458.t: ghaT ghaT vaasee aap viralai kinai lahiaa ||
458.e: In each and every heart, He Himself dwells, but how rare is that person who realizes this.

458.g: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਕੀਟ ਹਸਤਿ ਸਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
458.t: jal thal maheeal poor pooran keeT hasat samaaniaa ||
458.e: The Lord is permeating and pervading the water, the land and the sky; He is contained in the ant and the elephant.

458.g: ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤੇ ਮਧਿ ਸੋਈ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦੀ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
458.t: aadh a(n)te madh soiee gur prasaadhee jaaniaa ||
458.e: In the beginning, in the middle and in the end, He exists. By Guru's Grace, He is known.

458.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਸਰਿਆ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਲੀਲਾ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਜਨਿ ਕਹਿਆ ॥
458.t: braham pasariaa braham leelaa govi(n)dh gun nidh jan kahiaa ||
458.e: God created the expanse of the universe, God created the play of the world. His humble servants call Him the Lord of the Universe, the treasure of virtue.

458.g: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥੩॥
458.t: simar suaamee a(n)tarajaamee har ek naanak rav rahiaa ||3||
458.e: Meditate in remembrance on the Lord Master, the Searcher of hearts; O Nanak, He is the One, pervading and permeating all. ||3||

458.g: ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੜੀ ਆਈ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰੇ ॥
458.t: dhin rain suhaavaRee aaiee simarat naam hare ||
458.e: Day and night, become beauteous by remembering the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

459.g: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਲਮਲ ਪਾਪ ਟਰੇ ॥
459.t: charan kamal sa(n)g preet kalamal paap Tare ||
459.e: In love with the Lord's Lotus Feet, corruption and sin depart.

459.g: ਦੂਖ ਭੂਖ ਦਾਰਿਦ੍ਰ ਨਾਠੇ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਮਗੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
459.t: dhookh bhookh dhaaridhr naaThe pragaT mag dhikhaiaa ||
459.e: Pain, hunger and poverty run away, and the path is clearly revealed.

459.g: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੇ ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗੇ ਮਨਿ ਲੋੜੀਦਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
459.t: mil saadhasa(n)ge naam ra(n)ge man loReedhaa paiaa ||
459.e: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, one is attuned to the Naam, and obtains the desires of the mind.

459.g: ਹਰਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਇਛ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਕੁਲ ਸੰਬੂਹਾ ਸਭਿ ਤਰੇ ॥
459.t: har dhekh dharasan ichh pu(n)nee kul sa(n)boohaa sabh tare ||
459.e: Beholding the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, desires are fulfilled; all one's family and relatives are saved.

459.g: ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਅਨੰਦ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰੰਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ॥੪॥੬॥੯॥
459.t: dhinas rain ana(n)dh anadhin simara(n)t naanak har hare ||4||6||9||
459.e: Day and night, he is in bliss, night and day, remembering the Lord in meditation, O Nanak. ||4||6||9||

459.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਛੰਤ ਘਰੁ ੭
459.t: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa chha(n)t ghar satvaa
459.e: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla, Chhant, Seventh House:

459.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
459.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
459.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

459.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
459.t: salok ||
459.e: Shalok:

459.g: ਸੁਭ ਚਿੰਤਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਰਮਣ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗ ॥
459.t: subh chi(n)tan gobi(n)dh raman niramal saadhoo sa(n)g ||
459.e: It is the most sublime contemplation, to speak of the Lord of the Universe in the pure Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

459.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵਿਸਰਉ ਇਕ ਘੜੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥੧॥
459.t: naanak naam na visarau ik ghaRee kar kirapaa bhagava(n)t ||1||
459.e: O Nanak, never forget the Naam, even for a moment; bless me with Your Grace, Lord God! ||1||

459.g: ਛੰਤ ॥
459.t: chha(n)t ||
459.e: Chhant:

459.g: ਭਿੰਨੀ ਰੈਨੜੀਐ ਚਾਮਕਨਿ ਤਾਰੇ ॥
459.t: bhi(n)nee rainaReeaai chaamakan taare ||
459.e: The night is wet with dew, and the stars twinkle in the heavens.

459.g: ਜਾਗਹਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
459.t: jaageh sa(n)t janaa mere raam piaare ||
459.e: The Saints remain wakeful; they are the Beloveds of my Lord.

459.g: ਰਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਜਾਗਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੋ ॥
459.t: raam piaare sadhaa jaageh naam simareh anadhino ||
459.e: The Beloveds of the Lord remain ever wakeful, remembering the Naam, the Name of the Lord, day and night.

459.g: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਸਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੋ ॥
459.t: charan kamal dhiaan hiradhai prabh bisar naahee ik khino ||
459.e: In their hearts, they meditate on the lotus feet of God; they do not forget Him, even for an instant.

459.g: ਤਜਿ ਮਾਨੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਬਿਕਾਰੁ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਕਲਮਲਾ ਦੁਖ ਜਾਰੇ ॥
459.t: taj maan moh bikaar man kaa kalamalaa dhukh jaare ||
459.e: They renounce their pride, emotional attachment and mental corruption, and burn away the pain of wickedness.

459.g: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦਾ ਜਾਗਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸ ਸੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੧॥
459.t: binava(n)t naanak sadhaa jaageh har dhaas sa(n)t piaare ||1||
459.e: Prays Nanak, the Saints, the beloved servants of the Lord, remain ever wakeful. ||1||

459.g: ਮੇਰੀ ਸੇਜੜੀਐ ਆਡੰਬਰੁ ਬਣਿਆ ॥
459.t: meree sejaReeaai aadda(n)bar baniaa ||
459.e: My bed is adorned in splendor.

459.g: ਮਨਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਵਤ ਸੁਣਿਆ ॥
459.t: man anadh bhiaa prabh aavat suniaa ||
459.e: My mind is filled with bliss, since I heard that God is coming.

459.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੁਖਹ ਗਾਮੀ ਚਾਵ ਮੰਗਲ ਰਸ ਭਰੇ ॥
459.t: prabh mile suaamee sukheh gaamee chaav ma(n)gal ras bhare ||
459.e: Meeting God, the Lord and Master, I have entered the realm of peace; I am filled with joy and delight.

459.g: ਅੰਗ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਦੂਖ ਭਾਗੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਸਭਿ ਹਰੇ ॥
459.t: a(n)g sa(n)g laage dhookh bhaage praan man tan sabh hare ||
459.e: He is joined to me, in my very fiber; my sorrows have departed, and my body, mind and soul are all rejuvenated.

459.g: ਮਨ ਇਛ ਪਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਿਆਈ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਸਾਹਾ ਸੁਭ ਗਣਿਆ ॥
459.t: man ichh paiee prabh dhiaaiee sa(n)jog saahaa subh ganiaa ||
459.e: I have obtained the fruits of my mind's desires, meditating on God; the day of my wedding is auspicious.

459.g: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲੇ ਸ੍ਰੀਧਰ ਸਗਲ ਆਨੰਦ ਰਸੁ ਬਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
459.t: binava(n)t naanak mile sreedhar sagal aana(n)dh ras baniaa ||2||
459.e: Prays Nanak, when I meet the Lord of excellence, I came to experience all pleasure and bliss. ||2||

459.g: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਖੀਆ ਪੁਛਹਿ ਕਹੁ ਕੰਤ ਨੀਸਾਣੀ ॥
459.t: mil sakheeaa puchheh kahu ka(n)t neesaanee ||
459.e: I meet with my companions and say, ""Show me the insignia of my Husband Lord.""

459.g: ਰਸਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਰੀ ਕਛੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
459.t: ras prem bharee kachh bol na jaanee ||
459.e: I am filled with the sublime essence of His Love, and I do not know how to say anything.

459.g: ਗੁਣ ਗੂੜ ਗੁਪਤ ਅਪਾਰ ਕਰਤੇ ਨਿਗਮ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹੇ ॥
459.t: gun gooR gupat apaar karate nigam a(n)t na paavahe ||
459.e: The Glorious Virtues of the Creator are profound, mysterious and infinite; even the Vedas cannot find His limits.

459.g: ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਧਿਆਇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੇ ॥
459.t: bhagat bhai dhiaai suaamee sadhaa har gun gaavahe ||
459.e: With loving devotion, I meditate on the Lord Master, and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord forever.

459.g: ਸਗਲ ਗੁਣ ਸੁਗਿਆਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਪਣੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣੀ ॥
459.t: sagal gun sugiaan pooran aapane prabh bhaanee ||
459.e: Filled with all virtues and spiritual wisdom, I have become pleasing to my God.

459.g: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
459.t: binava(n)t naanak ra(n)g raatee prem sahaj samaanee ||3||
459.e: Prays Nanak, imbued with the color of the Lord's Love, I am imperceptibly absorbed into Him. ||3||

459.g: ਸੁਖ ਸੋਹਿਲੜੇ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਵਣ ਲਾਗੇ ॥ ਸਾਜਨ ਸਰਸਿਅੜੇ ਦੁਖ ਦੁਸਮਨ ਭਾਗੇ ॥
459.t: sukh sohilaRe har gaavan laage || saajan sarasiaRe dhukh dhusaman bhaage ||
459.e: When I began to sing the songs of rejoicing to the Lord, my friends became glad, and my troubles and enemies departed.

459.g: ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਸਰਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀਆ ॥
459.t: sukh sahaj sarase har naam rahase prabh aap kirapaa dhaareeaa ||
459.e: My peace and happiness increased; I rejoiced in the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and God Himself blessed me with His mercy.

459.g: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਲਾਗੇ ਸਦਾ ਜਾਗੇ ਮਿਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਨਵਾਰੀਆ ॥
459.t: har charan laage sadhaa jaage mile prabh banavaareeaa ||
459.e: I have grasped the Lord's feet, and remaining ever wakeful, I have met the Lord, the Creator.

459.g: ਸੁਭ ਦਿਵਸ ਆਏ ਸਹਜਿ ਪਾਏ ਸਗਲ ਨਿਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਗੇ ॥
459.t: subh dhivas aae sahaj paae sagal nidh prabh paage ||
459.e: The appointed day came, and I attained peace and poise; all treasures are in the feet of God.

459.g: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਤਾਗੇ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੦॥
459.t: binava(n)t naanak saran suaamee sadhaa har jan taage ||4||1||10||
459.e: Prays Nanak, the Lord's humble servants always seek the Sanctuary of the Lord and Master. ||4||1||10||

459.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
459.t: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
459.e: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

459.g: ਉਠਿ ਵੰਞੁ ਵਟਾਊੜਿਆ ਤੈ ਕਿਆ ਚਿਰੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
459.t: auTh va(n)n(j) vaTaauooRiaa tai kiaa chir laiaa ||
459.e: Rise up and go forth, O traveller; why do you delay?

459.g: ਮੁਹਲਤਿ ਪੁੰਨੜੀਆ ਕਿਤੁ ਕੂੜਿ ਲੋਭਾਇਆ ॥
459.t: muhalat pu(n)naReeaa kit kooR lobhaiaa ||
459.e: Your allotted time is now complete - why are you engrossed in falsehood?

459.g: ਕੂੜੇ ਲੁਭਾਇਆ ਧੋਹੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਾਪ ਅਮਿਤਿਆ ॥
459.t: kooRe lubhaiaa dhoh maiaa kareh paap amitiaa ||
459.e: You desire that which is false; deceived by Maya, you commit innumerable sins.

459.g: ਤਨੁ ਭਸਮ ਢੇਰੀ ਜਮਹਿ ਹੇਰੀ ਕਾਲਿ ਬਪੁੜੈ ਜਿਤਿਆ ॥
459.t: tan bhasam dderee jameh heree kaal bapuRai jitiaa ||
459.e: Your body shall become a pile of dust; the Messenger of Death has spotted you, and will conquer you.

460.g: ਮਾਲੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਵੈਸੀ ਰਹਿਓ ਪੈਨਣੁ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
460.t: maal joban chhodd vaisee rahio painan khaiaa ||
460.e: Abandoning your wealth and youth, you will have to leave, without any food or clothing.

460.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਮਾਣਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਜੁਲਿਆ ਨਹ ਜਾਇ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
460.t: naanak kamaanaa sa(n)g juliaa neh jai kirat miTaiaa ||1||
460.e: O Nanak, only your actions shall go with you; the consequences of your actions cannot be erased. ||1||

460.g: ਫਾਥੋਹੁ ਮਿਰਗ ਜਿਵੈ ਪੇਖਿ ਰੈਣਿ ਚੰਦ੍ਰਾਇਣੁ ॥
460.t: faathoh mirag jivai pekh rain cha(n)dhrain ||
460.e: Like the deer, captured on a moon-lit night,

460.g: ਸੂਖਹੁ ਦੂਖ ਭਏ ਨਿਤ ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਇਣੁ ॥
460.t: sookhahu dhookh bhe nit paap kamain ||
460.e: so does the constant commission of sins turn pleasure into pain.

460.g: ਪਾਪਾ ਕਮਾਣੇ ਛਡਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਲੈ ਚਲੇ ਘਤਿ ਗਲਾਵਿਆ ॥
460.t: paapaa kamaane chhaddeh naahee lai chale ghat galaaviaa ||
460.e: The sins you have committed shall not leave you; placing the noose around your neck, they shall lead you away.

460.g: ਹਰਿਚੰਦਉਰੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਮੂਠਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਸੇਜਾ ਰਾਵਿਆ ॥
460.t: haricha(n)dhauree dhekh mooThaa kooR sejaa raaviaa ||
460.e: Beholding an illusion, you are deceived, and on your bed, you enjoy a false lover.

460.g: ਲਬਿ ਲੋਭਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ਮਾਤਾ ਗਰਬਿ ਭਇਆ ਸਮਾਇਣੁ ॥
460.t: lab lobh aha(n)kaar maataa garab bhiaa samain ||
460.e: You are intoxicated with greed, avarice and egotism; you are engrossed in self-conceit.

460.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਅਗਿਆਨਿ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਨਹ ਮਿਟੈ ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਇਣੁ ॥੨॥
460.t: naanak mirag agiaan binase neh miTai aavan jain ||2||
460.e: O Nanak, like the deer, you are being destroyed by your ignorance; your comings and goings shall never end. ||2||

460.g: ਮਿਠੈ ਮਖੁ ਮੁਆ ਕਿਉ ਲਏ ਓਡਾਰੀ ॥
460.t: miThai makh muaa kiau le oddaaree ||
460.e: The fly is caught in the sweet candy - how can it fly away?

460.g: ਹਸਤੀ ਗਰਤਿ ਪਇਆ ਕਿਉ ਤਰੀਐ ਤਾਰੀ ॥
460.t: hasatee garat piaa kiau tareeaai taaree ||
460.e: The elephant has fallen into the pit - how can it escape?

460.g: ਤਰਣੁ ਦੁਹੇਲਾ ਭਇਆ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਖਸਮੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਇਓ ॥
460.t: taran dhuhelaa bhiaa khin meh khasam chit na aaio ||
460.e: It shall be so difficult to swim across, for one who does not remember the Lord and Master, even for an instant.

460.g: ਦੂਖਾ ਸਜਾਈ ਗਣਤ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੀਆ ਅਪਣਾ ਪਾਇਓ ॥
460.t: dhookhaa sajaiee ganat naahee keeaa apanaa paio ||
460.e: His sufferings and punishments are beyond reckoning; he receives the consequences of his own actions.

460.g: ਗੁਝਾ ਕਮਾਣਾ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਆ ਈਤ ਉਤਹਿ ਖੁਆਰੀ ॥
460.t: gujhaa kamaanaa pragaT hoaa ieet uteh khuaaree ||
460.e: His secret deeds are exposed, and he is ruined here and hereafter.

460.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਝੁ ਮੂਠਾ ਮਨਮੁਖੋ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
460.t: naanak satigur baajh mooThaa manmukho aha(n)kaaree ||3||
460.e: O Nanak, without the True Guru, the self-willed egotistical manmukh is defrauded. ||3||

460.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਦਾਸ ਜੀਵੇ ਲਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ॥
460.t: har ke dhaas jeeve lag prabh kee charanee ||
460.e: The Lord's slaves live by holding on to God's feet.

460.g: ਕੰਠਿ ਲਗਾਇ ਲੀਏ ਤਿਸੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਰਣੀ ॥
460.t: ka(n)Th lagai le'ee tis Thaakur saranee ||
460.e: The Lord and Master embraces those who seek His Sanctuary.

460.g: ਬਲ ਬੁਧਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਅਪਣਾ ਆਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਇਆ ॥
460.t: bal budh giaan dhiaan apanaa aap naam japaiaa ||
460.e: He blesses them with power, wisdom, knowledge and meditation; He Himself inspires them to chant His Name.

460.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਆਪਿ ਹੋਆ ਆਪਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਤਰਾਇਆ ॥
460.t: saadhasa(n)gat aap hoaa aap jagat taraiaa ||
460.e: He Himself is the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and He Himself saves the world.

460.g: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਏ ਰਖਣਹਾਰੈ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਕਰਣੀ ॥
460.t: raakh le'ee rakhanahaarai sadhaa niramal karanee ||
460.e: The Preserver preserves those whose actions are always pure.

460.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਰਕਿ ਨ ਜਾਹਿ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸਰਣੀ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੧॥
460.t: naanak narak na jaeh kabahoo(n) har sa(n)t har kee saranee ||4||2||11||
460.e: O Nanak, they never have to go to hell; the Lord's Saints are under the Lord's Protection. ||4||2||11||

460.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
460.t: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
460.e: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

460.g: ਵੰਞੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਆਲਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਸਿ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ॥
460.t: va(n)n(j) mere aalasaa har paas bena(n)tee ||
460.e: Be gone, O my laziness, that I may pray to the Lord.

460.g: ਰਾਵਉ ਸਹੁ ਆਪਨੜਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੋਹੰਤੀ ॥
460.t: raavau sahu aapanaRaa prabh sa(n)g soha(n)tee ||
460.e: I enjoy my Husband Lord, and look beautiful with my God.

460.g: ਸੰਗੇ ਸੋਹੰਤੀ ਕੰਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣੀ ਰਾਵੀਐ ॥
460.t: sa(n)ge soha(n)tee ka(n)t suaamee dhinas rainee raaveeaai ||
460.e: I look beautiful in the Company of my Husband Lord; I enjoy my Lord Master day and night.

460.g: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਚਿਤਾਰਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪੇਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੀਐ ॥
460.t: saas saas chitaar jeevaa prabh pekh har gun gaaveeaai ||
460.e: I live by remembering God with each and every breath, beholding the Lord, and singing His Glorious Praises.

460.g: ਬਿਰਹਾ ਲਜਾਇਆ ਦਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਮਿਉ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਿੰਚੰਤੀ ॥
460.t: birahaa lajaiaa dharas paiaa amiau dhirasaT si(n)cha(n)tee ||
460.e: The pain of separation has grown shy, for I have obtained the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; His Ambrosial Glance of Grace has filled me with bliss.

460.g: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਇਛ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਮਿਲੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਖੋਜੰਤੀ ॥੧॥
460.t: binava(n)t naanak meree ichh pu(n)nee mile jis khoja(n)tee ||1||
460.e: Prays Nanak, my desires are fulfilled; I have met the One I was seeking. ||1||

460.g: ਨਸਿ ਵੰਞਹੁ ਕਿਲਵਿਖਹੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
460.t: nas va(n)n(j)h kilavikhahu karataa ghar aaiaa ||
460.e: Run away, O sins; the Creator has entered my home.

460.g: ਦੂਤਹ ਦਹਨੁ ਭਇਆ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਇਆ ॥
460.t: dhooteh dhahan bhiaa govi(n)dh pragaTaiaa ||
460.e: The demons within me have been burnt; the Lord of the Universe has revealed Himself to me.

460.g: ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਲਾਲਨ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਵਖਾਣਿਆ ॥
460.t: pragaTe gupaal gobi(n)dh laalan saadhasa(n)g vakhaaniaa ||
460.e: The Beloved Lord of the Universe, the Lord of the World has revealed Himself; in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I chant His Name.

460.g: ਆਚਰਜੁ ਡੀਠਾ ਅਮਿਉ ਵੂਠਾ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦੀ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
460.t: aacharaj ddeeThaa amiau vooThaa gur prasaadhee jaaniaa ||
460.e: I have seen the Wondrous Lord; He showers His Ambrosial Nectar upon me, and by Guru's Grace, I know Him.

460.g: ਮਨਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਆਈ ਵਜੀ ਵਧਾਈ ਨਹ ਅੰਤੁ ਜਾਈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
460.t: man saa(n)t aaiee vajee vadhaiee neh a(n)t jaiee paiaa ||
460.e: My mind is at peace, resounding with the music of bliss; the Lord's limits cannot be found.

460.g: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜਿ ਮੇਲਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਆਪਿ ਬਣਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
460.t: binava(n)t naanak sukh sahaj melaa prabhoo aap banaiaa ||2||
460.e: Prays Nanak, God brings us to union with Himself, in the poise of celestial peace. ||2||

460.g: ਨਰਕ ਨ ਡੀਠੜਿਆ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ॥
460.t: narak na ddeeThaRiaa simarat naarain ||
460.e: They do not have to see hell, if they remember the Lord in meditation.

460.g: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਧਰਮੁ ਕਰੇ ਦੂਤ ਭਏ ਪਲਾਇਣ ॥
460.t: jai jai dharam kare dhoot bhe palain ||
460.e: The Righteous Judge of Dharma applauds them, and the Messenger of Death runs away from them.

460.g: ਧਰਮ ਧੀਰਜ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਜੇ ॥
460.t: dharam dheeraj sahaj sukhe'ee saadhasa(n)gat har bhaje ||
460.e: Dharmic faith, patience, peace and poise are obtained by vibrating upon the Lord in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

460.g: ਕਰਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਨੇ ਮੋਹ ਮਮਤਾ ਸਭ ਤਜੇ ॥
460.t: kar anugrahu raakh leene moh mamataa sabh taje ||
460.e: Showering His Blessings, He saves those who renounce all attachments and egotism.

460.g: ਗਹਿ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਏ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਜਪਤ ਅਘਾਇਣ ॥
460.t: geh ka(n)Th laae gur milaae govi(n)dh japat aghain ||
460.e: The Lord embraces us; the Guru unites us with Him. Meditating on the Lord of the Universe, we are satisfied.

460.g: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਗਲ ਆਸ ਪੁਜਾਇਣ ॥੩॥
460.t: binava(n)t naanak simar suaamee sagal aas pujain ||3||
460.e: Prays Nanak, remembering the Lord and Master in meditation, all hopes are fulfilled. ||3||

461.g: ਨਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਚਰਣ ਗਹੇ ਤਾ ਕੇਹਾ ਕਾੜਾ ॥
461.t: nidh sidh charan gahe taa kehaa kaaRaa ||
461.e: Grasping the Lord's Feet, the treasure of the Siddhas, what suffering can I feel?

461.g: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਵਸਿ ਜਿਸੈ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਅਸਾੜਾ ॥
461.t: sabh kichh vas jisai so prabhoo asaaRaa ||
461.e: Everything is in His Power - He is my God.

461.g: ਗਹਿ ਭੁਜਾ ਲੀਨੇ ਨਾਮ ਦੀਨੇ ਕਰੁ ਧਾਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ॥
461.t: geh bhujaa leene naam dheene kar dhaar masatak raakhiaa ||
461.e: Holding me by the arm, He blesses me with His Name; placing His Hand upon my forehead, He saves me.

461.g: ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਨਹ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਅਮਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ॥
461.t: sa(n)saar saagar neh viaapai amiau har ras chaakhiaa ||
461.e: The world-ocean does not trouble me, for I have drunk the sublime elixir of the Lord.

461.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗੇ ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗੇ ਰਣੁ ਜੀਤਿ ਵਡਾ ਅਖਾੜਾ ॥
461.t: saadhasa(n)ge naam ra(n)ge ran jeet vaddaa akhaaRaa ||
461.e: In the Saadh Sangat, imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, I am victorious on the great battlefield of life.

461.g: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਜਮਿ ਨ ਉਪਾੜਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੨॥
461.t: binava(n)t naanak saran suaamee bahuR jam na upaaRaa ||4||3||12||
461.e: Prays Nanak, I have entered the Sanctuary of the Lord and Master; the Messenger of Death shall not destroy me again. ||4||3||12||

461.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
461.t: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
461.e: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

461.g: ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਕਮਾਇਅੜੋ ਸੋ ਆਇਓ ਮਾਥੈ ॥
461.t: dhin raat kamaiaRo so aaio maathai ||
461.e: Those actions you perform, day and night, are recorded upon your forehead.

461.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਪਾਸਿ ਲੁਕਾਇਦੜੋ ਸੋ ਵੇਖੀ ਸਾਥੈ ॥
461.t: jis paas lukaidhaRo so vekhee saathai ||
461.e: And the One, from whom you hide these actions - He sees them, and is always with you.

461.g: ਸੰਗਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਕਰਣਹਾਰਾ ਕਾਇ ਪਾਪੁ ਕਮਾਈਐ ॥
461.t: sa(n)g dhekhai karanahaaraa kai paap kamaieeaai ||
461.e: The Creator Lord is with you; He sees you, so why commit sins?

461.g: ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੀਜੈ ਨਰਕਿ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
461.t: sukirat keejai naam leejai narak mool na jaieeaai ||
461.e: So perform good deeds, and chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord; you shall never have to go to hell.

461.g: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਚਲੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਸਾਥੇ ॥
461.t: aaTh pahar har naam simarahu chalai terai saathe ||
461.e: Twenty-four hours a day, dwell upon the Lord's Name in meditation; it alone shall go along with you.

461.g: ਭਜੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਦੋਖ ਕਮਾਤੇ ॥੧॥
461.t: bhaj saadhasa(n)gat sadhaa naanak miTeh dhokh kamaate ||1||
461.e: So vibrate continually in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O Nanak, and the sins you committed shall be erased. ||1||

461.g: ਵਲਵੰਚ ਕਰਿ ਉਦਰੁ ਭਰਹਿ ਮੂਰਖ ਗਾਵਾਰਾ ॥
461.t: valava(n)ch kar udhar bhareh moorakh gaavaaraa ||
461.e: Practicing deceit, you fill your belly, you ignorant fool!

461.g: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਦੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
461.t: sabh kichh dhe rahiaa har dhevanahaaraa ||
461.e: The Lord, the Great Giver, continues to give you everything.

461.g: ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕਾਇ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ॥
461.t: dhaataar sadhaa dhiaal suaamee kai manahu visaareeaai ||
461.e: The Great Giver is always merciful. Why should we forget the Lord Master from our minds?

461.g: ਮਿਲੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੇ ਭਜੁ ਨਿਸੰਗੇ ਕੁਲ ਸਮੂਹਾ ਤਾਰੀਐ ॥
461.t: mil saadhasa(n)ge bhaj nisa(n)ge kul samoohaa taareeaai ||
461.e: Join the Saadh Sangat, and vibrate fearlessly; all your relations shall be saved.

461.g: ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਦੇਵ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਭਗਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥
461.t: sidh saadhik dhev mun jan bhagat naam adhaaraa ||
461.e: The Siddhas, the seekers, the demi-gods, the silent sages and the devotees, all take the Naam as their support.

461.g: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦਾ ਭਜੀਐ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੁ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
461.t: binava(n)t naanak sadhaa bhajeeaai prabh ek karanaihaaraa ||2||
461.e: Prays Nanak, vibrate continually upon God, the One Creator Lord. ||2||

461.g: ਖੋਟੁ ਨ ਕੀਚਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਰਖਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
461.t: khoT na keechiee prabh parakhanahaaraa ||
461.e: Do not practice deception - God is the Assayer of all.

461.g: ਕੂੜੁ ਕਪਟੁ ਕਮਾਵਦੜੇ ਜਨਮਹਿ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
461.t: kooR kapaT kamaavadhaRe janameh sa(n)saaraa ||
461.e: Those who practice falsehood and deceit are reincarnated in the world.

461.g: ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਿਨੑੀ ਤਰਿਆ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਏਕੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
461.t: sa(n)saar saagar tin(h)ee tariaa jin(h)ee ek dhiaaiaa ||
461.e: Those who meditate on the One Lord, cross over the world-ocean.

461.g: ਤਜਿ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਨਿੰਦ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਆਇਆ ॥
461.t: taj kaam karodh ani(n)dh ni(n)dhaa prabh saranaiee aaiaa ||
461.e: Renouncing sexual desire, anger, flattery and slander, they enter the Sanctuary of God.

461.g: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਊਚ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
461.t: jal thal maheeal raviaa suaamee uooch agam apaaraa ||
461.e: The lofty, inaccessible and infinite Lord and Master is pervading the water, the land and the sky.

461.g: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਟੇਕ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
461.t: binava(n)t naanak Tek jan kee charan kamal adhaaraa ||3||
461.e: Prays Nanak, He is the support of His servants; His Lotus Feet are their only sustenance. ||3||

461.g: ਪੇਖੁ ਹਰਿਚੰਦਉਰੜੀ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
461.t: pekh haricha(n)dhauraRee asathir kichh naahee ||
461.e: Behold - the world is a mirage; nothing here is permanent.

461.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਰੰਗ ਜੇਤੇ ਸੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਜਾਹੀ ॥
461.t: maiaa ra(n)g jete se sa(n)g na jaahee ||
461.e: The pleasures of Maya which are here, shall not go with you.

461.g: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਥੀ ਸਦਾ ਤੇਰੈ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਸਮਾਲੀਐ ॥
461.t: har sa(n)g saathee sadhaa terai dhinas rain samaaleeaai ||
461.e: The Lord, your companion, is always with you; remember Him day and night.

461.g: ਹਰਿ ਏਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਛੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਭਾਉ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਜਾਲੀਐ ॥
461.t: har ek bin kachh avar naahee bhaau dhuteeaa jaaleeaai ||
461.e: Without the One Lord, there is no other; burn away the love of duality.

461.g: ਮੀਤੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਮਾਲੁ ਸਰਬਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
461.t: meet joban maal sarabas prabh ek kar man maahee ||
461.e: Know in your mind, that the One God is your friend, youth, wealth and everything.

461.g: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵਡਭਾਗਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਸੂਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਹੀ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੩॥
461.t: binava(n)t naanak vaddabhaag paieeaai sookh sahaj samaahee ||4||4||13||
461.e: Prays Nanak, by great good fortune, we find the Lord, and merge in peace and celestial poise. ||4||4||13||

461.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਛੰਤ ਘਰੁ ੮
461.t: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa chha(n)t ghar atthvaa
461.e: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla, Chhant, Eighth House:

461.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
461.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
461.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

461.g: ਕਮਲਾ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੀਤਿ ਕਮਲਾ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੀਤਿ ਹੇ ਤੀਖਣ ਮਦ ਬਿਪਰੀਤਿ ਹੇ ਅਵਧ ਅਕਾਰਥ ਜਾਤ ॥
461.t: kamalaa bhram bheet kamalaa bhram bheet he teekhan madh bipareet he avadh akaarath jaat ||
461.e: Maya is the wall of doubt - Maya is the wall of doubt. It is such a powerful and destructive intoxicant; it corrupts and wastes away one's life.

461.g: ਗਹਬਰ ਬਨ ਘੋਰ ਗਹਬਰ ਬਨ ਘੋਰ ਹੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮੂਸਤ ਮਨ ਚੋਰ ਹੇ ਦਿਨਕਰੋ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਖਾਤ ॥
461.t: gahabar ban ghor gahabar ban ghor he gireh moosat man chor he dhinakaro anadhin khaat ||
461.e: In the terrible, impenetrable world-forest - in the terrible, impenetrable world-forest, the thieves are plundering man's house in broad daylight; night and day, this life is being consumed.

461.g: ਦਿਨ ਖਾਤ ਜਾਤ ਬਿਹਾਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਨੁ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਪਤੇ ॥
461.t: dhin khaat jaat bihaat prabh bin milahu prabh karunaa pate ||
461.e: The days of your life are being consumed; they are passing away without God. So meet God, the Merciful Lord.

462.g: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਅਨੇਕ ਬੀਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਸੰਗ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਛੁ ਨਹ ਗਤੇ ॥
462.t: janam maran anek beete pria sa(n)g bin kachh neh gate ||
462.e: I passed through so many births and deaths; without Union with the Beloved, I did not obtain salvation.

462.g: ਕੁਲ ਰੂਪ ਧੂਪ ਗਿਆਨਹੀਨੀ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਕਵਨ ਮਾਤ ॥
462.t: kul roop dhoop giaanaheenee tujh binaa moh kavan maat ||
462.e: I am without the status of high birth, beauty, glory or spiritual wisdom; without You, who is mine, O Mother?

462.g: ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਆਇਓ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਨਾਥ ਨਰਹਰ ਕਰਹੁ ਗਾਤ ॥੧॥
462.t: kar joR naanak saran aaio pria naath narahar karahu gaat ||1||
462.e: With my palms pressed together, O Nanak, I enter the Lord's Sanctuary; O beloved almighty Lord and Master, please, save me! ||1||

462.g: ਮੀਨਾ ਜਲਹੀਨ ਮੀਨਾ ਜਲਹੀਨ ਹੇ ਓਹੁ ਬਿਛੁਰਤ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਖੀਨ ਹੇ ਕਤ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਬਿਨੁ ਹੋਤ ॥
462.t: meenaa jalaheen meenaa jalaheen he oh bichhurat man tan kheen he kat jeevan pria bin hot ||
462.e: Like a fish out of water - like a fish out of water, separated from the Lord, the mind and body perish; how can I live, without my Beloved?

462.g: ਸਨਮੁਖ ਸਹਿ ਬਾਨ ਸਨਮੁਖ ਸਹਿ ਬਾਨ ਹੇ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਅਰਪੇ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਹੇ ਓਹੁ ਬੇਧਿਓ ਸਹਜ ਸਰੋਤ ॥
462.t: sanamukh seh baan sanamukh seh baan he mirag arape man tan praan he oh bedhio sahaj sarot ||
462.e: Facing the arrow head-on - facing the arrow head-on, the deer surrenders his mind, body and breath of life; he is struck by the hunter's soothing music.

462.g: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਮਿਲੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਖਿਨੁ ਰਹਨੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਤਨੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨਾ ॥
462.t: pria preet laagee mil bairaagee khin rahan dhirag tan tis binaa ||
462.e: I have enshrined love for my Beloved. In order to meet Him, I have become a renunciate. Cursed is that body which remains without Him, even for an instant.

462.g: ਪਲਕਾ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਾਗੈ ਚਿਤਵੰਤਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਨਾ ॥
462.t: palakaa na laagai pria prem paagai chitava(n)t anadhin prabh manaa ||
462.e: My eyelids do not close, for I am absorbed in the love of my Beloved. Day and night, my mind thinks only of God.

462.g: ਸ੍ਰੀਰੰਗ ਰਾਤੇ ਨਾਮ ਮਾਤੇ ਭੈ ਭਰਮ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਸਗਲ ਖੋਤ ॥
462.t: sreera(n)g raate naam maate bhai bharam dhuteeaa sagal khot ||
462.e: Attuned to the Lord, intoxicated with the Naam, fear, doubt and duality have all left me.

462.g: ਕਰਿ ਮਇਆ ਦਇਆ ਦਇਆਲ ਪੂਰਨ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਗਨ ਹੋਤ ॥੨॥
462.t: kar miaa dhiaa dhiaal pooran har prem naanak magan hot ||2||
462.e: Bestow Your mercy and compassion, O merciful and perfect Lord, that Nanak may be intoxicated with Your Love. ||2||

462.g: ਅਲੀਅਲ ਗੁੰਜਾਤ ਅਲੀਅਲ ਗੁੰਜਾਤ ਹੇ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਰਸ ਬਾਸਨ ਮਾਤ ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਮਲ ਬੰਧਾਵਤ ਆਪ ॥
462.t: aleeal gu(n)jaat aleeal gu(n)jaat he makara(n)dh ras baasan maat he preet kamal ba(n)dhaavat aap ||
462.e: The bumble-bee is buzzing - the bumble-bee is buzzing, intoxicated with the honey, the flavor and the fragrance; because of its love for the lotus, it entangles itself.

462.g: ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਚਿਤ ਪਿਆਸ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਚਿਤ ਪਿਆਸ ਹੇ ਘਨ ਬੂੰਦ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਆਸ ਹੇ ਅਲ ਪੀਵਤ ਬਿਨਸਤ ਤਾਪ ॥
462.t: chaatirak chit piaas chaatirak chit piaas he ghan boo(n)dh bachitr man aas he al peevat binasat taap ||
462.e: The mind of the rainbird thirsts - the mind of the rainbird thirsts; its mind longs for the beautiful rain-drops from the clouds. Drinking them in, its fever departs.

462.g: ਤਾਪਾ ਬਿਨਾਸਨ ਦੂਖ ਨਾਸਨ ਮਿਲੁ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਅਤਿ ਘਨਾ ॥
462.t: taapaa binaasan dhookh naasan mil prem man tan at ghanaa ||
462.e: O Destroyer of fever, Remover of pain, please unite me with You. My mind and body have such great love for You.

462.g: ਸੁੰਦਰੁ ਚਤੁਰੁ ਸੁਜਾਨ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕਵਨ ਰਸਨਾ ਗੁਣ ਭਨਾ ॥
462.t: su(n)dhar chatur sujaan suaamee kavan rasanaa gun bhanaa ||
462.e: O my beautiful, wise and all-knowing Lord and Master, with what tongue should I chant Your Praises?

462.g: ਗਹਿ ਭੁਜਾ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਧਾਰਤ ਮਿਟਤ ਪਾਪ ॥
462.t: geh bhujaa levahu naam dhevahu dhirasaT dhaarat miTat paap ||
462.e: Take me by the arm, and grant me Your Name. One who is blessed with Your Glance of Grace, has his sins erased.

462.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜੰਪੈ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਪੇਖਤ ਨਹ ਸੰਤਾਪ ॥੩॥
462.t: naanak ja(n)pai patit paavan har dharas pekhat neh sa(n)taap ||3||
462.e: Nanak meditates on the Lord, the Purifier of sinners; beholding His Vision, he suffers no more. ||3||

462.g: ਚਿਤਵਉ ਚਿਤ ਨਾਥ ਚਿਤਵਉ ਚਿਤ ਨਾਥ ਹੇ ਰਖਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਅਨਾਥ ਹੇ ਮਿਲੁ ਚਾਉ ਚਾਈਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ॥
462.t: chitavau chit naath chitavau chit naath he rakh levahu saran anaath he mil chaau chaieele praan ||
462.e: I focus my consciousness on the Lord - I focus my consciousness upon the Lord; I am helpless - please, keep me under Your Protection. I yearn to meet You, my soul hungers for You.

462.g: ਸੁੰਦਰ ਤਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਤਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਹੇ ਮਨੁ ਲੁਬਧ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਗਿਆਨ ਹੇ ਜਾਚਿਕ ਜਨ ਰਾਖਤ ਮਾਨ ॥
462.t: su(n)dhar tan dhiaan su(n)dhar tan dhiaan he man lubadh gopaal giaan he jaachik jan raakhat maan ||
462.e: I meditate on Your beautiful body - I meditate on Your beautiful body; my mind is fascinated by Your spiritual wisdom, O Lord of the world. Please, preserve the honor of Your humble servants and beggars.

462.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਾਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਦੁਖ ਬਿਦੀਰਨ ਸਗਲ ਇਛ ਪੁਜੰਤੀਆ ॥
462.t: prabh maan pooran dhukh bidheeran sagal ichh puja(n)teeaa ||
462.e: God bestows perfect honor and destroys pain; He has fulfilled all my desires.

462.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਦਿਨ ਸਭਾਗੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਨਾਹ ਸੇਜ ਸੋਹੰਤੀਆ ॥
462.t: har ka(n)Th laage dhin sabhaage mil naeh sej soha(n)teeaa ||
462.e: How very blessed was that day when the Lord embraced me; meeting my Husband Lord, my bed was beautified.

462.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਧਾਰੀ ਮਿਲੇ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ਸਗਲ ਕਲਮਲ ਭਏ ਹਾਨ ॥
462.t: prabh dhirasaT dhaaree mile muraaree sagal kalamal bhe haan ||
462.e: When God granted His Grace and met me, all my sins were erased.

462.g: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਰੀ ਆਸ ਪੂਰਨ ਮਿਲੇ ਸ੍ਰੀਧਰ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੪॥
462.t: binava(n)t naanak meree aas pooran mile sreedhar gun nidhaan ||4||1||14||
462.e: Prays Nanak, my hopes are fulfilled; I have met the Lord, the Lord of Lakshmi, the treasure of excellence. ||4||1||14||

462.g: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
462.t: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaadh ||
462.e: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

462.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
462.t: aasaa mahalaa pehilaa ||
462.e: Aasaa, First Mehla:

462.g: ਵਾਰ ਸਲੋਕਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਸਲੋਕ ਭੀ ਮਹਲੇ ਪਹਿਲੇ ਕੇ ਲਿਖੇ ਟੁੰਡੇ ਅਸ ਰਾਜੈ ਕੀ ਧੁਨੀ ॥
462.t: vaar salokaa naal salok bhee mahale pahile ke likhe Tu(n)dde as raajai kee dhunee ||
462.e: Vaar With Shaloks, And Shaloks Written By The First Mehla. To Be Sung To The Tune Of 'Tunda-Asraajaa':

462.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
462.t: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
462.e: Shalok, First Mehla:

462.g: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਦਿਉਹਾੜੀ ਸਦ ਵਾਰ ॥
462.t: balihaaree gur aapane dhiauhaaRee sadh vaar ||
462.e: A hundred times a day, I am a sacrifice to my Guru;

462.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਮਾਣਸ ਤੇ ਦੇਵਤੇ ਕੀਏ ਕਰਤ ਨ ਲਾਗੀ ਵਾਰ ॥੧॥
462.t: jin maanas te dhevate ke'ee karat na laagee vaar ||1||
462.e: He made angels out of men, without delay. ||1||

463.e: Second Mehla:

463.g: ਜੇ ਸਉ ਚੰਦਾ ਉਗਵਹਿ ਸੂਰਜ ਚੜਹਿ ਹਜਾਰ ॥
463.t: je sau cha(n)dhaa ugaveh sooraj chaReh hajaar ||
463.e: If a hundred moons were to rise, and a thousand suns appeared,

463.g: ਏਤੇ ਚਾਨਣ ਹੋਦਿਆਂ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੋਰ ਅੰਧਾਰ ॥੨॥
463.t: ete chaanan hodhiaa(n) gur bin ghor a(n)dhaar ||2||
463.e: even with such light, there would still be pitch darkness without the Guru. ||2||
First Mehla:

463.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੂ ਨ ਚੇਤਨੀ ਮਨਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਸੁਚੇਤ ॥
463.t: naanak guroo na chetanee man aapanai suchet ||
463.e: O Nanak, those who do not think of the Guru, and who think of themselves as clever,

463.g: ਛੁਟੇ ਤਿਲ ਬੂਆੜ ਜਿਉ ਸੁੰਞੇ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਖੇਤ ॥
463.t: chhuTe til booaaR jiau su(n)n(j)e a(n)dhar khet ||
463.e: shall be left abandoned in the field, like the scattered sesame.

463.g: ਖੇਤੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਛੁਟਿਆ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਉ ਨਾਹ ॥
463.t: khetai a(n)dhar chhuTiaa kahu naanak sau naeh ||
463.e: They are abandoned in the field, says Nanak, and they have a hundred masters to please.

463.g: ਫਲੀਅਹਿ ਫੁਲੀਅਹਿ ਬਪੁੜੇ ਭੀ ਤਨ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੁਆਹ ॥੩॥
463.t: fale'eeh fule'eeh bapuRe bhee tan vich suaaeh ||3||
463.e: The wretches bear fruit and flower, but within their bodies, they are filled with ashes. ||3||
Pauree:

463.g: ਆਪੀਨੑੈ ਆਪੁ ਸਾਜਿਓ ਆਪੀਨੑੈ ਰਚਿਓ ਨਾਉ ॥
463.t: aapeen(h)ai aap saajio aapeen(h)ai rachio naau ||
463.e: He Himself created Himself; He Himself assumed His Name.

463.g: ਦੁਯੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਸਾਜੀਐ ਕਰਿ ਆਸਣੁ ਡਿਠੋ ਚਾਉ ॥
463.t: dhuyee kudharat saajeeaai kar aasan ddiTho chaau ||
463.e: Secondly, He fashioned the creation; seated within the creation, He beholds it with delight.

463.g: ਦਾਤਾ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਤੂੰ ਤੁਸਿ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਸਾਉ ॥
463.t: dhaataa karataa aap too(n) tus dheveh kareh pasaau ||
463.e: You Yourself are the Giver and the Creator; by Your Pleasure, You bestow Your Mercy.

463.g: ਤੂੰ ਜਾਣੋਈ ਸਭਸੈ ਦੇ ਲੈਸਹਿ ਜਿੰਦੁ ਕਵਾਉ ॥
463.t: too(n) jaanoiee sabhasai dhe laiseh ji(n)dh kavaau ||
463.e: You are the Knower of all; You give life, and take it away again with a word.
Seated within the creation, You behold it with delight. ||1||
Shalok, First Mehla:
True are Your worlds, True are Your solar Systems.
True are Your realms, True is Your creation.
True are Your actions, and all Your deliberations.
True is Your Command, and True is Your Court.
True is the Command of Your Will, True is Your Order.
True is Your Mercy, True is Your Insignia.
Hundreds of thousands and millions call You True.

463.g: ਸਚੈ ਸਭਿ ਤਾਣਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਭਿ ਜੋਰਿ ॥
463.t: sachai sabh taan sachai sabh jor ||
463.e: In the True Lord is all power, in the True Lord is all might.
True is Your Praise, True is Your Adoration.
True is Your almighty creative power, True King.
O Nanak, true are those who meditate on the True One.

463.g: ਜੋ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੇ ਸੁ ਕਚੁ ਨਿਕਚੁ ॥੧॥
463.t: jo mar ja(n)me su kach nikach ||1||
463.e: Those who are subject to birth and death are totally false. ||1||
First Mehla:
Great is His greatness, as great as His Name.
Great is His greatness, as True is His justice.
Great is His greatness, as permanent as His Throne.
Great is His greatness, as He knows our utterances.
Great is His greatness, as He understands all our affections.

463.g: ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜਾ ਪੁਛਿ ਨ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
463.t: vaddee vaddiaaiee jaa puchh na dhaat ||
463.e: Great is His greatness, as He gives without being asked.
Great is His greatness, as He Himself is all-in-all.
O Nanak, His actions cannot be described.
Whatever He has done, or will do, is all by His Own Will. ||2||
Second Mehla:

463.g: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਸਚੈ ਕੀ ਹੈ ਕੋਠੜੀ ਸਚੇ ਕਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
463.t: eih jag sachai kee hai koThaRee sache kaa vich vaas ||
463.e: This world is the room of the True Lord; within it is the dwelling of the True Lord.

463.g: ਇਕਨੑਾ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ਲਏ ਇਕਨੑਾ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਕਰੇ ਵਿਣਾਸੁ ॥
463.t: eikan(h)aa hukam samai le ikan(h)aa hukame kare vinaas ||
463.e: By His Command, some are merged into Him, and some, by His Command, are destroyed.

463.g: ਇਕਨੑਾ ਭਾਣੈ ਕਢਿ ਲਏ ਇਕਨੑਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
463.t: eikan(h)aa bhaanai kadd le ikan(h)aa maiaa vich nivaas ||
463.e: Some, by the Pleasure of His Will, are lifted up out of Maya, while others are made to dwell within it.

463.g: ਏਵ ਭਿ ਆਖਿ ਨ ਜਾਪਈ ਜਿ ਕਿਸੈ ਆਣੇ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
463.t: ev bh aakh na jaapiee j kisai aane raas ||
463.e: No one can say who will be rescued.

463.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥੩॥
463.t: naanak gurmukh jaaneeaai jaa kau aap kare paragaas ||3||
463.e: O Nanak, he alone is known as Gurmukh, unto whom the Lord reveals Himself. ||3||
Pauree:

463.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਅ ਉਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਲਿਖਿ ਨਾਵੈ ਧਰਮੁ ਬਹਾਲਿਆ ॥
463.t: naanak jeea upai kai likh naavai dharam bahaaliaa ||
463.e: O Nanak, having created the souls, the Lord installed the Righteous Judge of Dharma to read and record their accounts.

463.g: ਓਥੈ ਸਚੇ ਹੀ ਸਚਿ ਨਿਬੜੈ ਚੁਣਿ ਵਖਿ ਕਢੇ ਜਜਮਾਲਿਆ ॥
463.t: othai sache hee sach nibaRai chun vakh kadde jajamaaliaa ||
463.e: There, only the Truth is judged true; the sinners are picked out and separated.

463.g: ਥਾਉ ਨ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ਮੁਹ ਕਾਲੑੈ ਦੋਜਕਿ ਚਾਲਿਆ ॥
463.t: thaau na pain kooRiaar muh kaal(h)ai dhojak chaaliaa ||
463.e: The false find no place there, and they go to hell with their faces blackened.

463.g: ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਇ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਜਿਣਿ ਗਏ ਹਾਰਿ ਗਏ ਸਿ ਠਗਣ ਵਾਲਿਆ ॥
463.t: terai nai rate se jin ge haar ge s Thagan vaaliaa ||
463.e: Those who are imbued with Your Name win, while the cheaters lose.
The Lord installed the Righteous Judge of Dharma to read and record the accounts. ||2||
Shalok, First Mehla:
Wonderful is the sound current of the Naad, wonderful is the knowledge of the Vedas.
Wonderful are the beings, wonderful are the species.
Wonderful are the forms, wonderful are the colors.
Wonderful are the beings who wander around naked.

464.e: Wonderful is the wind, wonderful is the water.
Wonderful is fire, which works wonders.
Wonderful is the earth, wonderful the sources of creation.
Wonderful are the tastes to which mortals are attached.
Wonderful is union, and wonderful is separation.
Wonderful is hunger, wonderful is satisfaction.
Wonderful is His Praise, wonderful is His adoration.
Wonderful is the wilderness, wonderful is the path.
Wonderful is closeness, wonderful is distance.
How wonderful to behold the Lord, ever-present here.
Beholding His wonders, I am wonder-struck.
O Nanak, those who understand this are blessed with perfect destiny. ||1||
First Mehla:

464.g: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਦਿਸੈ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਭਉ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
464.t: kudharat dhisai kudharat suneeaai kudharat bhau sukh saar ||
464.e: By His Power we see, by His Power we hear; by His Power we have fear, and the essence of happiness.

464.g: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਪਾਤਾਲੀ ਆਕਾਸੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਸਰਬ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
464.t: kudharat paataalee aakaasee kudharat sarab aakaar ||
464.e: By His Power the nether worlds exist, and the Akaashic ethers; by His Power the entire creation exists.

464.g: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਵੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਕਤੇਬਾ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਸਰਬ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
464.t: kudharat vedh puraan katebaa kudharat sarab veechaar ||
464.e: By His Power the Vedas and the Puraanas exist, and the Holy Scriptures of the Jewish, Christian and Islamic religions. By His Power all deliberations exist.

464.g: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਖਾਣਾ ਪੀਣਾ ਪੈਨੑਣੁ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਸਰਬ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
464.t: kudharat khaanaa peenaa pain(h)n kudharat sarab piaar ||
464.e: By His Power we eat, drink and dress; by His Power all love exists.

464.g: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਜਾਤੀ ਜਿਨਸੀ ਰੰਗੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਜੀਅ ਜਹਾਨ ॥
464.t: kudharat jaatee jinasee ra(n)gee kudharat jeea jahaan ||
464.e: - By His Power come the species of all kinds and colors; by His Power the living beings of the world exist.

464.g: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਨੇਕੀਆ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਬਦੀਆ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਮਾਨੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
464.t: kudharat nekeeaa kudharat badheeaa kudharat maan abhimaan ||
464.e: By His Power virtues exist, and by His Power vices exist. By His Power come honor and dishonor.

464.g: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਧਰਤੀ ਖਾਕੁ ॥
464.t: kudharat paun paanee baisa(n)tar kudharat dharatee khaak ||
464.e: By His Power wind, water and fire exist; by His Power earth and dust exist.

464.g: ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਤੂੰ ਕਾਦਿਰੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪਾਕੀ ਨਾਈ ਪਾਕੁ ॥
464.t: sabh teree kudharat too(n) kaadhir karataa paakee naiee paak ||
464.e: Everything is in Your Power, Lord; You are the all-powerful Creator. Your Name is the Holiest of the Holy.

464.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਵਰਤੈ ਤਾਕੋ ਤਾਕੁ ॥੨॥
464.t: naanak hukamai a(n)dhar vekhai varatai taako taak ||2||
464.e: O Nanak, through the Command of His Will, He beholds and pervades the creation; He is absolutely unrivalled. ||2||
Pauree:

464.g: ਆਪੀਨੑੈ ਭੋਗ ਭੋਗਿ ਕੈ ਹੋਇ ਭਸਮੜਿ ਭਉਰੁ ਸਿਧਾਇਆ ॥
464.t: aapeen(h)ai bhog bhog kai hoi bhasamaR bhaur sidhaiaa ||
464.e: Enjoying his pleasures, one is reduced to a pile of ashes, and the soul passes away.

464.g: ਵਡਾ ਹੋਆ ਦੁਨੀਦਾਰੁ ਗਲਿ ਸੰਗਲੁ ਘਤਿ ਚਲਾਇਆ ॥
464.t: vaddaa hoaa dhuneedhaar gal sa(n)gal ghat chalaiaa ||
464.e: He may be great, but when he dies, the chain is thrown around his neck, and he is led away.

464.g: ਅਗੈ ਕਰਣੀ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਵਾਚੀਐ ਬਹਿ ਲੇਖਾ ਕਰਿ ਸਮਝਾਇਆ ॥
464.t: agai karanee keerat vaacheeaai beh lekhaa kar samajhaiaa ||
464.e: There, his good and bad deeds are added up; sitting there, his account is read.

464.g: ਥਾਉ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਪਉਦੀਈ ਹੁਣਿ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਕਿਆ ਰੂਆਇਆ ॥
464.t: thaau na hovee paudheeiee hun suneeaai kiaa rooaaiaa ||
464.e: He is whipped, but finds no place of rest, and no one hears his cries of pain.
The blind man has wasted his life away. ||3||
Shalok, First Mehla:
In the Fear of God, the wind and breezes ever blow.
In the Fear of God, thousands of rivers flow.
In the Fear of God, fire is forced to labor.
In the Fear of God, the earth is crushed under its burden.

464.g: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਇੰਦੁ ਫਿਰੈ ਸਿਰ ਭਾਰਿ ॥
464.t: bhai vich i(n)dh firai sir bhaar ||
464.e: In the Fear of God, the clouds move across the sky.
In the Fear of God, the Righteous Judge of Dharma stands at His Door.

464.g: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਚੰਦੁ ॥
464.t: bhai vich sooraj bhai vich cha(n)dh ||
464.e: In the Fear of God, the sun shines, and in the Fear of God, the moon reflects.
They travel millions of miles, endlessly.

464.g: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਿਧ ਬੁਧ ਸੁਰ ਨਾਥ ॥
464.t: bhai vich sidh budh sur naath ||
464.e: In the Fear of God, the Siddhas exist, as do the Buddhas, the demi-gods and Yogis.
In the Fear of God, the Akaashic ethers are stretched across the sky.
In the Fear of God, the warriors and the most powerful heroes exist.
In the Fear of God, multitudes come and go.
God has inscribed the Inscription of His Fear upon the heads of all.
O Nanak, the Fearless Lord, the Formless Lord, the True Lord, is One. ||1||
First Mehla:

464.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਹੋਰਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਵਾਲ ॥
464.t: naanak nirabhau nira(n)kaar hor kete raam ravaal ||
464.e: O Nanak, the Lord is fearless and formless; myriads of others, like Rama, are mere dust before Him.

464.g: ਕੇਤੀਆ ਕੰਨੑ ਕਹਾਣੀਆ ਕੇਤੇ ਬੇਦ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥
464.t: keteeaa ka(n)n(h) kahaaneeaa kete bedh beechaar ||
464.e: There are so many stories of Krishna, so many who reflect over the Vedas.

464.g: ਕੇਤੇ ਨਚਹਿ ਮੰਗਤੇ ਗਿੜਿ ਮੁੜਿ ਪੂਰਹਿ ਤਾਲ ॥
464.t: kete nacheh ma(n)gate giR muR pooreh taal ||
464.e: So many beggars dance, spinning around to the beat.

464.g: ਬਾਜਾਰੀ ਬਾਜਾਰ ਮਹਿ ਆਇ ਕਢਹਿ ਬਾਜਾਰ ॥
464.t: baajaaree baajaar meh aai kaddeh baajaar ||
464.e: The magicians perform their magic in the market place, creating a false illusion.

464.g: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਰਾਜੇ ਰਾਣੀਆ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਆਲ ਪਤਾਲ ॥
464.t: gaaveh raaje raaneeaa boleh aal pataal ||
464.e: They sing as kings and queens, and speak of this and that.

464.g: ਲਖ ਟਕਿਆ ਕੇ ਮੁੰਦੜੇ ਲਖ ਟਕਿਆ ਕੇ ਹਾਰ ॥
464.t: lakh Takiaa ke mu(n)dhaRe lakh Takiaa ke haar ||
464.e: They wear earrings, and necklaces worth thousands of dollars.

464.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਤਨਿ ਪਾਈਅਹਿ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸੇ ਤਨ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਛਾਰ ॥
464.t: jit tan paie'eeh naanakaa se tan hoveh chhaar ||
464.e: Those bodies on which they are worn, O Nanak, those bodies turn to ashes.

465.g: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਗਲੀਈ ਢੂਢੀਐ ਕਥਨਾ ਕਰੜਾ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
465.t: giaan na galeeiee ddooddeeaai kathanaa karaRaa saar ||
465.e: Wisdom cannot be found through mere words. To explain it is as hard as iron.

465.g: ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਹੋਰ ਹਿਕਮਤਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
465.t: karam milai taa paieeaai hor hikamat hukam khuaar ||2||
465.e: When the Lord bestows His Grace, then alone it is received; other tricks and orders are useless. ||2||
Pauree:

465.g: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਜੇ ਆਪਣੀ ਤਾ ਨਦਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
465.t: nadhar kareh je aapanee taa nadharee satigur paiaa ||
465.e: If the Merciful Lord shows His Mercy, then the True Guru is found.

465.g: ਏਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਬਹੁਤੇ ਜਨਮ ਭਰੰਮਿਆ ਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ॥
465.t: eh jeeau bahute janam bhara(n)miaa taa satigur sabadh sunaiaa ||
465.e: This soul wandered through countless incarnations, until the True Guru instructed it in the Word of the Shabad.

465.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਣਿਅਹੁ ਲੋਕ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
465.t: satigur jevadd dhaataa ko nahee sabh suniahu lok sabaiaa ||
465.e: There is no giver as great as the True Guru; hear this, all you people.

465.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
465.t: satigur miliaai sach paiaa jin(h)ee vichahu aap gavaiaa ||
465.e: Meeting the True Guru, the True Lord is found; He removes self-conceit from within,
and instructs us in the Truth of Truths. ||4||
Shalok, First Mehla:

465.g: ਘੜੀਆ ਸਭੇ ਗੋਪੀਆ ਪਹਰ ਕੰਨੑ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥
465.t: ghaReeaa sabhe gopeeaa pahar ka(n)n(h) gopaal ||
465.e: All the hours are the milk-maids, and the quarters of the day are the Krishnas.

465.g: ਗਹਣੇ ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਅਵਤਾਰ ॥
465.t: gahane paun paanee baisa(n)tar cha(n)dh sooraj avataar ||
465.e: The wind, water and fire are the ornaments; the sun and moon are the incarnations.

465.g: ਸਗਲੀ ਧਰਤੀ ਮਾਲੁ ਧਨੁ ਵਰਤਣਿ ਸਰਬ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥
465.t: sagalee dharatee maal dhan varatan sarab ja(n)jaal ||
465.e: All of the earth, property, wealth and articles are all entanglements.

465.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੁਸੈ ਗਿਆਨ ਵਿਹੂਣੀ ਖਾਇ ਗਇਆ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ॥੧॥
465.t: naanak musai giaan vihoonee khai giaa jamakaal ||1||
465.e: O Nanak, without divine knowledge, one is plundered, and devoured by the Messenger of Death. ||1||
First Mehla:
The disciples play the music, and the gurus dance.
They move their feet and roll their heads.
The dust flies and falls upon their hair.
Beholding them, the people laugh, and then go home.
They beat the drums for the sake of bread.
They throw themselves upon the ground.
They sing of the milk-maids, they sing of the Krishnas.
They sing of Sitas, and Ramas and kings.
The Lord is fearless and formless; His Name is True.
The entire universe is His Creation.
Those servants, whose destiny is awakened, serve the Lord.
The night of their lives is cool with dew; their minds are filled with love for the Lord.
Contemplating the Guru, I have been taught these teachings;
granting His Grace, He carries His servants across.
The oil-press, the spinning wheel, the grinding stones, the potter's wheel,
the numerous, countless whirlwinds in the desert,
the spinning tops, the churning sticks, the threshers,
the breathless tumblings of the birds,
and the men moving round and round on spindles
O Nanak, the tumblers are countless and endless.
The Lord binds us in bondage - so do we spin around.
According to their actions, so do all people dance.

465.g: ਨਚਿ ਨਚਿ ਹਸਹਿ ਚਲਹਿ ਸੇ ਰੋਇ ॥
465.t: nach nach haseh chaleh se roi ||
465.e: Those who dance and dance and laugh, shall weep on their ultimate departure.

465.g: ਉਡਿ ਨ ਜਾਹੀ ਸਿਧ ਨ ਹੋਹਿ ॥
465.t: audd na jaahee sidh na hoh ||
465.e: They do not fly to the heavens, nor do they become Siddhas.
They dance and jump around on the urgings of their minds.

465.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨੑ ਮਨਿ ਭਉ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਉ ॥੨॥
465.t: naanak jin(h) man bhau tin(h)aa man bhaau ||2||
465.e: O Nanak, those whose minds are filled with the Fear of God, have the love of God in their minds as well. ||2||
Pauree:

465.g: ਨਾਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਇ ਲਇਐ ਨਰਕਿ ਨ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
465.t: naau teraa nira(n)kaar hai nai liaai narak na jaieeaai ||
465.e: Your Name is the Fearless Lord; chanting Your Name, one does not have to go to hell.

465.g: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਦੇ ਖਾਜੈ ਆਖਿ ਗਵਾਈਐ ॥
465.t: jeeau pi(n)dd sabh tis dhaa dhe khaajai aakh gavaieeaai ||
465.e: Soul and body all belong to Him; asking Him to give us sustenance is a waste.

465.g: ਜੇ ਲੋੜਹਿ ਚੰਗਾ ਆਪਣਾ ਕਰਿ ਪੁੰਨਹੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਸਦਾਈਐ ॥
465.t: je loReh cha(n)gaa aapanaa kar pu(n)nahu neech sadhaieeaai ||
465.e: If you yearn for goodness, then perform good deeds and feel humble.

465.g: ਜੇ ਜਰਵਾਣਾ ਪਰਹਰੈ ਜਰੁ ਵੇਸ ਕਰੇਦੀ ਆਈਐ ॥
465.t: je jaravaanaa paraharai jar ves karedhee aaieeaai ||
465.e: Even if you remove the signs of old age, old age shall still come in the guise of death.
No one remains here when the count of the breaths is full. ||5||
Shalok, First Mehla:

465.g: ਮੁਸਲਮਾਨਾ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਰੀਅਤਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
465.t: musalamaanaa sifat sareeat paR paR kareh beechaar ||
465.e: The Muslims praise the Islamic law; they read and reflect upon it.

465.g: ਬੰਦੇ ਸੇ ਜਿ ਪਵਹਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਬੰਦੀ ਵੇਖਣ ਕਉ ਦੀਦਾਰੁ ॥
465.t: ba(n)dhe se j paveh vich ba(n)dhee vekhan kau dheedhaar ||
465.e: The Lord's bound servants are those who bind themselves to see the Lord's Vision.

465.g: ਹਿੰਦੂ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਾਲਾਹਨਿ ਦਰਸਨਿ ਰੂਪਿ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
465.t: hi(n)dhoo saalaahee saalaahan dharasan roop apaar ||
465.e: The Hindus praise the Praiseworthy Lord; the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, His form is incomparable.

465.g: ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਵਹਿ ਅਰਚਾ ਪੂਜਾ ਅਗਰ ਵਾਸੁ ਬਹਕਾਰੁ ॥
465.t: teerath naaveh arachaa poojaa agar vaas bahakaar ||
465.e: They bathe at sacred shrines of pilgrimage, making offerings of flowers, and burning incense before idols.

465.g: ਜੋਗੀ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਧਿਆਵਨਿੑ ਜੇਤੇ ਅਲਖ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
465.t: jogee su(n)n dhiaavani(h) jete alakh naam karataar ||
465.e: The Yogis meditate on the absolute Lord there; they call the Creator the Unseen Lord.

466.g: ਸੂਖਮ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਕਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
466.t: sookham moorat naam nira(n)jan kaiaa kaa aakaar ||
466.e: But to the subtle image of the Immaculate Name, they apply the form of a body.

466.g: ਸਤੀਆ ਮਨਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਦੇਣੈ ਕੈ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
466.t: sateeaa man sa(n)tokh upajai dhenai kai veechaar ||
466.e: In the minds of the virtuous, contentment is produced, thinking about their giving.

466.g: ਦੇ ਦੇ ਮੰਗਹਿ ਸਹਸਾ ਗੂਣਾ ਸੋਭ ਕਰੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
466.t: dhe dhe ma(n)geh sahasaa goonaa sobh kare sa(n)saar ||
466.e: They give and give, but ask a thousand-fold more, and hope that the world will honor them.

466.g: ਚੋਰਾ ਜਾਰਾ ਤੈ ਕੂੜਿਆਰਾ ਖਾਰਾਬਾ ਵੇਕਾਰ ॥
466.t: choraa jaaraa tai kooRiaaraa khaaraabaa vekaar ||
466.e: The thieves, adulterers, perjurers, evil-doers and sinners

466.g: ਇਕਿ ਹੋਦਾ ਖਾਇ ਚਲਹਿ ਐਥਾਊ ਤਿਨਾ ਭਿ ਕਾਈ ਕਾਰ ॥
466.t: eik hodhaa khai chaleh aaithaauoo tinaa bh kaiee kaar ||
466.e: - after using up what good karma they had, they depart; have they done any good deeds here at all?

466.g: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਜੀਆ ਪੁਰੀਆ ਲੋਆ ਆਕਾਰਾ ਆਕਾਰ ॥
466.t: jal thal jeeaa pureeaa loaa aakaaraa aakaar ||
466.e: There are beings and creatures in the water and on the land, in the worlds and universes, form upon form.

466.g: ਓਇ ਜਿ ਆਖਹਿ ਸੁ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਤਿਨਾ ਭਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਾਰ ॥
466.t: oi j aakheh su too(n)hai jaaneh tinaa bh teree saar ||
466.e: Whatever they say, You know; You care for them all.

466.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤਾ ਭੁਖ ਸਾਲਾਹਣੁ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
466.t: naanak bhagataa bhukh saalaahan sach naam aadhaar ||
466.e: O Nanak, the hunger of the devotees is to praise You; the True Name is their only support.

466.g: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਗੁਣਵੰਤਿਆ ਪਾ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
466.t: sadhaa ana(n)dh raheh dhin raatee gunava(n)tiaa paa chhaar ||1||
466.e: They live in eternal bliss, day and night; they are the dust of the feet of the virtuous. ||1||

466.t: mahalaa pehilaa ||
466.e: First Mehla:

466.g: ਮਿਟੀ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਨ ਕੀ ਪੇੜੈ ਪਈ ਕੁਮਿੑਆਰ ॥
466.t: miTee musalamaan kee peRai piee kumi(h)aar ||
466.e: The clay of the Muslim's grave becomes clay for the potter's wheel.

466.g: ਘੜਿ ਭਾਂਡੇ ਇਟਾ ਕੀਆ ਜਲਦੀ ਕਰੇ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
466.t: ghaR bhaa(n)dde iTaa keeaa jaladhee kare pukaar ||
466.e: Pots and bricks are fashioned from it, and it cries out as it burns.

466.g: ਜਲਿ ਜਲਿ ਰੋਵੈ ਬਪੁੜੀ ਝੜਿ ਝੜਿ ਪਵਹਿ ਅੰਗਿਆਰ ॥
466.t: jal jal rovai bapuRee jhaR jhaR paveh a(n)giaar ||
466.e: The poor clay burns, burns and weeps, as the fiery coals fall upon it.

466.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕੀਆ ਸੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
466.t: naanak jin karatai kaaran keeaa so jaanai karataar ||2||
466.e: O Nanak, the Creator created the creation; the Creator Lord alone knows. ||2||

466.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
466.t: pauRee ||
466.e: Pauree:

466.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
466.t: bin satigur kinai na paio bin satigur kinai na paiaa ||
466.e: Without the True Guru, no one has obtained the Lord; without the True Guru, no one has obtained the Lord.

466.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਪੁ ਰਖਿਓਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ॥
466.t: satigur vich aap rakhion kar paragaT aakh sunaiaa ||
466.e: He has placed Himself within the True Guru; revealing Himself, He declares this openly.

466.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸਦਾ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
466.t: satigur miliaai sadhaa mukat hai jin vichahu moh chukaiaa ||
466.e: Meeting the True Guru, eternal liberation is obtained; He has banished attachment from within.

466.g: ਉਤਮੁ ਏਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
466.t: autam eh beechaar hai jin sache siau chit laiaa ||
466.e: This is the highest thought, that one's consciousness is attached to the True Lord.

466.g: ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
466.t: jagajeevan dhaataa paiaa ||6||
466.e: Thus the Lord of the World, the Great Giver is obtained. ||6||

466.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
466.t: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
466.e: Shalok, First Mehla:

466.g: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਇਆ ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
466.t: hau vich aaiaa hau vich giaa ||
466.e: In ego they come, and in ego they go.

466.g: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੰਮਿਆ ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਮੁਆ ॥
466.t: hau vich ja(n)miaa hau vich muaa ||
466.e: In ego they are born, and in ego they die.

466.g: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਦਿਤਾ ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਲਇਆ ॥
466.t: hau vich dhitaa hau vich liaa ||
466.e: In ego they give, and in ego they take.

466.g: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਖਟਿਆ ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
466.t: hau vich khaTiaa hau vich giaa ||
466.e: In ego they earn, and in ego they lose.

466.g: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਚਿਆਰੁ ਕੂੜਿਆਰੁ ॥
466.t: hau vich sachiaar kooRiaar ||
466.e: In ego they become truthful or false.

466.g: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਾਪ ਪੁੰਨ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
466.t: hau vich paap pu(n)n veechaar ||
466.e: In ego they reflect on virtue and sin.

466.g: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਰਕਿ ਸੁਰਗਿ ਅਵਤਾਰੁ ॥
466.t: hau vich narak surag avataar ||
466.e: In ego they go to heaven or hell.

466.g: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਹਸੈ ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਰੋਵੈ ॥
466.t: hau vich hasai hau vich rovai ||
466.e: In ego they laugh, and in ego they weep.

466.g: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਭਰੀਐ ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਧੋਵੈ ॥
466.t: hau vich bhareeaai hau vich dhovai ||
466.e: In ego they become dirty, and in ego they are washed clean.

466.g: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਾਤੀ ਜਿਨਸੀ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
466.t: hau vich jaatee jinasee khovai ||
466.e: In ego they lose social status and class.

466.g: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਿਆਣਾ ॥
466.t: hau vich moorakh hau vich siaanaa ||
466.e: In ego they are ignorant, and in ego they are wise.

466.g: ਮੋਖ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
466.t: mokh mukat kee saar na jaanaa ||
466.e: They do not know the value of salvation and liberation.

466.g: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਛਾਇਆ ॥
466.t: hau vich maiaa hau vich chhaiaa ||
466.e: In ego they love Maya, and in ego they are kept in darkness by it.

466.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
466.t: haumai kar kar ja(n)t upaiaa ||
466.e: Living in ego, mortal beings are created.

466.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਤਾ ਦਰੁ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
466.t: haumai boojhai taa dhar soojhai ||
466.e: When one understands ego, then the Lord's gate is known.

466.g: ਗਿਆਨ ਵਿਹੂਣਾ ਕਥਿ ਕਥਿ ਲੂਝੈ ॥
466.t: giaan vihoonaa kath kath loojhai ||
466.e: Without spiritual wisdom, they babble and argue.

466.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਲਿਖੀਐ ਲੇਖੁ ॥
466.t: naanak hukamee likheeaai lekh ||
466.e: O Nanak, by the Lord's Command, destiny is recorded.

466.g: ਜੇਹਾ ਵੇਖਹਿ ਤੇਹਾ ਵੇਖੁ ॥੧॥
466.t: jehaa vekheh tehaa vekh ||1||
466.e: As the Lord sees us, so are we seen. ||1||

466.g: ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
466.t: mahalaa doojaa ||
466.e: Second Mehla:

466.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਏਹਾ ਜਾਤਿ ਹੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
466.t: haumai ehaa jaat hai haumai karam kamaeh ||
466.e: This is the nature of ego, that people perform their actions in ego.

466.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਏਈ ਬੰਧਨਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
466.t: haumai eiee ba(n)dhanaa fir fir jonee paeh ||
466.e: This is the bondage of ego, that time and time again, they are reborn.

466.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਕਿਥਹੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਕਿਤੁ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਇਹ ਜਾਇ ॥
466.t: haumai kithahu uoopajai kit sa(n)jam ieh jai ||
466.e: Where does ego come from? How can it be removed?

466.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਏਹੋ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਹੈ ਪਇਐ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਫਿਰਾਹਿ ॥
466.t: haumai eho hukam hai piaai kirat firaeh ||
466.e: This ego exists by the Lord's Order; people wander according to their past actions.

466.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਦੀਰਘ ਰੋਗੁ ਹੈ ਦਾਰੂ ਭੀ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
466.t: haumai dheeragh rog hai dhaaroo bhee is maeh ||
466.e: Ego is a chronic disease, but it contains its own cure as well.

466.g: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਜੇ ਆਪਣੀ ਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
466.t: kirapaa kare je aapanee taa gur kaa sabadh kamaeh ||
466.e: If the Lord grants His Grace, one acts according to the Teachings of the Guru's Shabad.

466.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਜਨਹੁ ਇਤੁ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਦੁਖ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
466.t: naanak kahai sunahu janahu it sa(n)jam dhukh jaeh ||2||
466.e: Nanak says, listen, people: in this way, troubles depart. ||2||

466.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
466.t: pauRee ||
466.e: Pauree:

466.g: ਸੇਵ ਕੀਤੀ ਸੰਤੋਖੀੲਂੀ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
466.t: sev keetee sa(n)tokhe'ee(n)ee jin(h)ee sacho sach dhiaaiaa ||
466.e: Those who serve are content. They meditate on the Truest of the True.

467.g: ਓਨੑੀ ਮੰਦੈ ਪੈਰੁ ਨ ਰਖਿਓ ਕਰਿ ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
467.t: on(h)ee ma(n)dhai pair na rakhio kar sukirat dharam kamaiaa ||
467.e: They do not place their feet in sin, but do good deeds and live righteously in Dharma.

467.g: ਓਨੑੀ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਤੋੜੇ ਬੰਧਨਾ ਅੰਨੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਥੋੜਾ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
467.t: on(h)ee dhuneeaa toRe ba(n)dhanaa a(n)n paanee thoRaa khaiaa ||
467.e: They burn away the bonds of the world, and eat a simple diet of grain and water.

467.g: ਤੂੰ ਬਖਸੀਸੀ ਅਗਲਾ ਨਿਤ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਚੜਹਿ ਸਵਾਇਆ ॥
467.t: too(n) bakhaseesee agalaa nit dheveh chaReh savaiaa ||
467.e: You are the Great Forgiver; You give continually, more and more each day.

467.g: ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵਡਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੭॥
467.t: vaddiaaiee vaddaa paiaa ||7||
467.e: By His greatness, the Great Lord is obtained. ||7||

467.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
467.t: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
467.e: Shalok, First Mehla:

467.g: ਪੁਰਖਾਂ ਬਿਰਖਾਂ ਤੀਰਥਾਂ ਤਟਾਂ ਮੇਘਾਂ ਖੇਤਾਂਹ ॥
467.t: purakhaa(n) birakhaa(n) teerathaa(n) taTaa(n) meghaa(n) khetaa(n)h ||
467.e: Men, trees, sacred shrines of pilgrimage, banks of sacred rivers, clouds, fields,

467.g: ਦੀਪਾਂ ਲੋਆਂ ਮੰਡਲਾਂ ਖੰਡਾਂ ਵਰਭੰਡਾਂਹ ॥
467.t: dheepaa(n) loaa(n) ma(n)ddalaa(n) kha(n)ddaa(n) varabha(n)ddaa(n)h ||
467.e: islands, continents, worlds, solar systems, and universes;

467.g: ਅੰਡਜ ਜੇਰਜ ਉਤਭੁਜਾਂ ਖਾਣੀ ਸੇਤਜਾਂਹ ॥
467.t: a(n)ddaj jeraj utabhujaa(n) khaanee setajaa(n)h ||
467.e: the four sources of creation - born of eggs, born of the womb, born of the earth and born of sweat;

467.g: ਸੋ ਮਿਤਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸਰਾਂ ਮੇਰਾਂ ਜੰਤਾਹ ॥
467.t: so mit jaanai naanakaa saraa(n) meraa(n) ja(n)taeh ||
467.e: oceans, mountains, and all beings - O Nanak, He alone knows their condition.

467.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਸੰਮਾਲੇ ਸਭਨਾਹ ॥
467.t: naanak ja(n)t upai kai sa(n)maale sabhanaeh ||
467.e: O Nanak, having created the living beings, He cherishes them all.

467.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਕਰਣਾ ਕੀਆ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਭਿ ਕਰਣੀ ਤਾਹ ॥
467.t: jin karatai karanaa keeaa chi(n)taa bh karanee taeh ||
467.e: The Creator who created the creation, takes care of it as well.

467.g: ਸੋ ਕਰਤਾ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਇਆ ਜਗੁ ॥
467.t: so karataa chi(n)taa kare jin upaiaa jag ||
467.e: He, the Creator who formed the world, cares for it.

467.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਜੋਹਾਰੀ ਸੁਅਸਤਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ਅਭਗੁ ॥
467.t: tis johaaree suasat tis tis dheebaan abhag ||
467.e: Unto Him I bow and offer my reverence; His Royal Court is eternal.

467.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਆ ਟਿਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਤਗੁ ॥੧॥
467.t: naanak sache naam bin kiaa Tikaa kiaa tag ||1||
467.e: O Nanak, without the True Name, of what use is the frontal mark of the Hindus, or their sacred thread? ||1||

467.t: mahalaa pehilaa ||
467.e: First Mehla:

467.g: ਲਖ ਨੇਕੀਆ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ਲਖ ਪੁੰਨਾ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
467.t: lakh nekeeaa cha(n)giaaieeaa lakh pu(n)naa paravaan ||
467.e: Hundreds of thousands of virtues and good actions, and hundreds of thousands of blessed charities,

467.g: ਲਖ ਤਪ ਉਪਰਿ ਤੀਰਥਾਂ ਸਹਜ ਜੋਗ ਬੇਬਾਣ ॥
467.t: lakh tap upar teerathaa(n) sahaj jog bebaan ||
467.e: hundreds of thousands of penances at sacred shrines, and the practice of Sehj Yoga in the wilderness,

467.g: ਲਖ ਸੂਰਤਣ ਸੰਗਰਾਮ ਰਣ ਮਹਿ ਛੁਟਹਿ ਪਰਾਣ ॥
467.t: lakh sooratan sa(n)garaam ran meh chhuTeh paraan ||
467.e: hundreds of thousands of courageous actions and giving up the breath of life on the field of battle,

467.g: ਲਖ ਸੁਰਤੀ ਲਖ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਪੜੀਅਹਿ ਪਾਠ ਪੁਰਾਣ ॥
467.t: lakh suratee lakh giaan dhiaan paRe'eh paaTh puraan ||
467.e: hundreds of thousands of divine understandings, hundreds of thousands of divine wisdoms and meditations and readings of the Vedas and the Puraanas

467.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਕਰਣਾ ਕੀਆ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
467.t: jin karatai karanaa keeaa likhiaa aavan jaan ||
467.e: - before the Creator who created the creation, and who ordained coming and going,

467.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਤੀ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਕਰਮੁ ਸਚਾ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
467.t: naanak matee mithiaa karam sachaa neesaan ||2||
467.e: O Nanak, all these things are false. True is the Insignia of His Grace. ||2||

467.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
467.t: pauRee ||
467.e: Pauree:

467.g: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਏਕੁ ਤੂੰ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤਾਇਆ ॥
467.t: sachaa saahib ek too(n) jin sacho sach varataiaa ||
467.e: You alone are the True Lord. The Truth of Truths is pervading everywhere.

467.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਤਾ ਤਿਨੑੀ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
467.t: jis too(n) dheh tis milai sach taa tin(h)ee sach kamaiaa ||
467.e: He alone receives the Truth, unto whom You give it; then, he practices Truth.

467.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਿਨੑ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਚੁ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
467.t: satigur miliaai sach paiaa jin(h) kai hiradhai sach vasaiaa ||
467.e: Meeting the True Guru, Truth is found. In His Heart, Truth is abiding.

467.g: ਮੂਰਖ ਸਚੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੑੀ ਮਨਮੁਖੀ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
467.t: moorakh sach na jaanan(h)ee manmukhee janam gavaiaa ||
467.e: The fools do not know the Truth. The self-willed manmukhs waste their lives away in vain.

467.g: ਵਿਚਿ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਕਾਹੇ ਆਇਆ ॥੮॥
467.t: vich dhuneeaa kaahe aaiaa ||8||
467.e: Why have they even come into the world? ||8||

467.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
467.t: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
467.e: Shalok, First Mehla:

467.g: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਗਡੀ ਲਦੀਅਹਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਭਰੀਅਹਿ ਸਾਥ ॥
467.t: paR paR gaddee ladhe'eeh paR paR bhare'eh saath ||
467.e: You may read and read loads of books; you may read and study vast multitudes of books.

467.g: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਬੇੜੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਗਡੀਅਹਿ ਖਾਤ ॥
467.t: paR paR beRee paieeaai paR paR gadde'eeh khaat ||
467.e: You may read and read boat-loads of books; you may read and read and fill pits with them.

467.g: ਪੜੀਅਹਿ ਜੇਤੇ ਬਰਸ ਬਰਸ ਪੜੀਅਹਿ ਜੇਤੇ ਮਾਸ ॥
467.t: paRe'eh jete baras baras paRe'eh jete maas ||
467.e: You may read them year after year; you may read them as many months are there are.

467.g: ਪੜੀਐ ਜੇਤੀ ਆਰਜਾ ਪੜੀਅਹਿ ਜੇਤੇ ਸਾਸ ॥
467.t: paReeaai jetee aarajaa paRe'eh jete saas ||
467.e: You may read them all your life; you may read them with every breath.

467.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਲੇਖੈ ਇਕ ਗਲ ਹੋਰੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਝਖਣਾ ਝਾਖ ॥੧॥
467.t: naanak lekhai ik gal hor haumai jhakhanaa jhaakh ||1||
467.e: O Nanak, only one thing is of any account: everything else is useless babbling and idle talk in ego. ||1||

467.t: mahalaa pehilaa ||
467.e: First Mehla:

467.g: ਲਿਖਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪੜਿਆ ॥
467.t: likh likh paRiaa ||
467.e: The more one writes and reads,

467.g: ਤੇਤਾ ਕੜਿਆ ॥
467.t: tetaa kaRiaa ||
467.e: the more one burns.

467.g: ਬਹੁ ਤੀਰਥ ਭਵਿਆ ॥
467.t: bahu teerath bhaviaa ||
467.e: The more one wanders at sacred shrines of pilgrimage,

467.g: ਤੇਤੋ ਲਵਿਆ ॥
467.t: teto laviaa ||
467.e: the more one talks uselessly.

467.g: ਬਹੁ ਭੇਖ ਕੀਆ ਦੇਹੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੀਆ ॥
467.t: bahu bhekh keeaa dhehee dhukh dheeaa ||
467.e: The more one wears religious robes, the more pain he causes his body.

467.g: ਸਹੁ ਵੇ ਜੀਆ ਅਪਣਾ ਕੀਆ ॥
467.t: sahu ve jeeaa apanaa keeaa ||
467.e: O my soul, you must endure the consequences of your own actions.

467.g: ਅੰਨੁ ਨ ਖਾਇਆ ਸਾਦੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
467.t: a(n)n na khaiaa saadh gavaiaa ||
467.e: One who does not eat the corn, misses out on the taste.

467.g: ਬਹੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
467.t: bahu dhukh paiaa dhoojaa bhaiaa ||
467.e: One obtains great pain, in the love of duality.

467.g: ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਨ ਪਹਿਰੈ ॥
467.t: basatr na pahirai ||
467.e: One who does not wear any clothes,

467.g: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਕਹਰੈ ॥
467.t: ahinis kaharai ||
467.e: suffers night and day.

467.g: ਮੋਨਿ ਵਿਗੂਤਾ ॥
467.t: mon vigootaa ||
467.e: Through silence, he is ruined.

467.g: ਕਿਉ ਜਾਗੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੂਤਾ ॥
467.t: kiau jaagai gur bin sootaa ||
467.e: How can the sleeping one be awakened without the Guru?

467.g: ਪਗ ਉਪੇਤਾਣਾ ॥
467.t: pag upetaanaa ||
467.e: One who goes barefoot

467.g: ਅਪਣਾ ਕੀਆ ਕਮਾਣਾ ॥
467.t: apanaa keeaa kamaanaa ||
467.e: suffers by his own actions.

467.g: ਅਲੁ ਮਲੁ ਖਾਈ ਸਿਰਿ ਛਾਈ ਪਾਈ ॥
467.t: al mal khaiee sir chhaiee paiee ||
467.e: One who eats filth and throws ashes on his head

467.g: ਮੂਰਖਿ ਅੰਧੈ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
467.t: moorakh a(n)dhai pat gavaiee ||
467.e: the blind fool loses his honor.

467.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
467.t: vin naavai kichh thai na paiee ||
467.e: Without the Name, nothing is of any use.

467.g: ਰਹੈ ਬੇਬਾਣੀ ਮੜੀ ਮਸਾਣੀ ॥
467.t: rahai bebaanee maRee masaanee ||
467.e: One who lives in the wilderness, in cemetaries and cremation grounds

467.g: ਅੰਧੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਣੀ ॥
467.t: a(n)dh na jaanai fir pachhutaanee ||
467.e: - that blind man does not know the Lord; he regrets and repents in the end.

468.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੇ ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
468.t: satigur bheTe so sukh paae ||
468.e: One who meets the True Guru finds peace.

468.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
468.t: har kaa naam ma(n)n vasaae ||
468.e: He enshrines the Name of the Lord in his mind.

468.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ॥
468.t: naanak nadhar kare so paae ||
468.e: O Nanak, when the Lord grants His Grace, He is obtained.

468.g: ਆਸ ਅੰਦੇਸੇ ਤੇ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਏ ॥੨॥
468.t: aas a(n)dhese te nihakeval haumai sabadh jalaae ||2||
468.e: He becomes free of hope and fear, and burns away his ego with the Word of the Shabad. ||2||

468.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
468.t: pauRee ||
468.e: Pauree:

468.g: ਭਗਤ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਦੇ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਗਾਵਦੇ ॥
468.t: bhagat terai man bhaavadhe dhar sohan keerat gaavadhe ||
468.e: Your devotees are pleasing to Your Mind, Lord. They look beautiful at Your door, singing Your Praises.

468.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਮਾ ਬਾਹਰੇ ਦਰਿ ਢੋਅ ਨ ਲਹਨੑੀ ਧਾਵਦੇ ॥
468.t: naanak karamaa baahare dhar ddoa na lahan(h)ee dhaavadhe ||
468.e: O Nanak, those who are denied Your Grace, find no shelter at Your Door; they continue wandering.

468.g: ਇਕਿ ਮੂਲੁ ਨ ਬੁਝਨਿੑ ਆਪਣਾ ਅਣਹੋਦਾ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਇਦੇ ॥
468.t: eik mool na bujhani(h) aapanaa anahodhaa aap ganaidhe ||
468.e: Some do not understand their origins, and without cause, they display their self-conceit.

468.g: ਹਉ ਢਾਢੀ ਕਾ ਨੀਚ ਜਾਤਿ ਹੋਰਿ ਉਤਮ ਜਾਤਿ ਸਦਾਇਦੇ ॥
468.t: hau ddaaddee kaa neech jaat hor utam jaat sadhaidhe ||
468.e: I am the Lord's minstrel, of low social status; others call themselves high caste.

468.g: ਤਿਨੑ ਮੰਗਾ ਜਿ ਤੁਝੈ ਧਿਆਇਦੇ ॥੯॥
468.t: tin(h) ma(n)gaa j tujhai dhiaaidhe ||9||
468.e: I seek those who meditate on You. ||9||

468.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
468.t: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
468.e: Shalok, First Mehla:

468.g: ਕੂੜੁ ਰਾਜਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਪਰਜਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਸਭੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
468.t: kooR raajaa kooR parajaa kooR sabh sa(n)saar ||
468.e: False is the king, false are the subjects; false is the whole world.

468.g: ਕੂੜੁ ਮੰਡਪ ਕੂੜੁ ਮਾੜੀ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੈਸਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
468.t: kooR ma(n)ddap kooR maaRee kooR baisanahaar ||
468.e: False is the mansion, false are the skyscrapers; false are those who live in them.

468.g: ਕੂੜੁ ਸੁਇਨਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਰੁਪਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਪੈਨੑਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
468.t: kooR suinaa kooR rupaa kooR pain(h)nahaar ||
468.e: False is gold, and false is silver; false are those who wear them.

468.g: ਕੂੜੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਪੜੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
468.t: kooR kaiaa kooR kapaR kooR roop apaar ||
468.e: False is the body, false are the clothes; false is incomparable beauty.

468.g: ਕੂੜੁ ਮੀਆ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੀਬੀ ਖਪਿ ਹੋਏ ਖਾਰੁ ॥
468.t: kooR meeaa kooR beebee khap hoe khaar ||
468.e: False is the husband, false is the wife; they mourn and waste away.

468.g: ਕੂੜਿ ਕੂੜੈ ਨੇਹੁ ਲਗਾ ਵਿਸਰਿਆ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
468.t: kooR kooRai neh lagaa visariaa karataar ||
468.e: The false ones love falsehood, and forget their Creator.

468.g: ਕਿਸੁ ਨਾਲਿ ਕੀਚੈ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਚਲਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
468.t: kis naal keechai dhosatee sabh jag chalanahaar ||
468.e: With whom should I become friends, if all the world shall pass away?

468.g: ਕੂੜੁ ਮਿਠਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਮਾਖਿਉ ਕੂੜੁ ਡੋਬੇ ਪੂਰੁ ॥
468.t: kooR miThaa kooR maakhiau kooR ddobe poor ||
468.e: False is sweetness, false is honey; through falsehood, boat-loads of men have drowned.

468.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਾਝੁ ਕੂੜੋ ਕੂੜੁ ॥੧॥
468.t: naanak vakhaanai benatee tudh baajh kooRo kooR ||1||
468.e: Nanak speaks this prayer: without You, Lord, everything is totally false. ||1||

468.t: mahalaa pehilaa ||
468.e: First Mehla:

468.g: ਸਚੁ ਤਾ ਪਰੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਚਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
468.t: sach taa par jaaneeaai jaa ridhai sachaa hoi ||
468.e: One knows the Truth only when the Truth is in his heart.

468.g: ਕੂੜ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਉਤਰੈ ਤਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਹਛਾ ਧੋਇ ॥
468.t: kooR kee mal utarai tan kare hachhaa dhoi ||
468.e: The filth of falsehood departs, and the body is washed clean.

468.g: ਸਚੁ ਤਾ ਪਰੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਸਚਿ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
468.t: sach taa par jaaneeaai jaa sach dhare piaar ||
468.e: One knows the Truth only when he bears love to the True Lord.

468.g: ਨਾਉ ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨੁ ਰਹਸੀਐ ਤਾ ਪਾਏ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
468.t: naau sun man rahaseeaai taa paae mokh dhuaar ||
468.e: Hearing the Name, the mind is enraptured; then, he attains the gate of salvation.

468.g: ਸਚੁ ਤਾ ਪਰੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਜੀਉ ॥
468.t: sach taa par jaaneeaai jaa jugat jaanai jeeau ||
468.e: One knows the Truth only when he knows the true way of life.

468.g: ਧਰਤਿ ਕਾਇਆ ਸਾਧਿ ਕੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਦੇਇ ਕਰਤਾ ਬੀਉ ॥
468.t: dharat kaiaa saadh kai vich dhei karataa beeau ||
468.e: Preparing the field of the body, he plants the Seed of the Creator.

468.g: ਸਚੁ ਤਾ ਪਰੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਸਿਖ ਸਚੀ ਲੇਇ ॥
468.t: sach taa par jaaneeaai jaa sikh sachee lei ||
468.e: One knows the Truth only when he receives true instruction.

468.g: ਦਇਆ ਜਾਣੈ ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
468.t: dhiaa jaanai jeea kee kichh pu(n)n dhaan karei ||
468.e: Showing mercy to other beings, he makes donations to charities.

468.g: ਸਚੁ ਤਾਂ ਪਰੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਆਤਮ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
468.t: sach taa(n) par jaaneeaai jaa aatam teerath kare nivaas ||
468.e: One knows the Truth only when he dwells in the sacred shrine of pilgrimage of his own soul.

468.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਨੋ ਪੁਛਿ ਕੈ ਬਹਿ ਰਹੈ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
468.t: satiguroo no puchh kai beh rahai kare nivaas ||
468.e: He sits and receives instruction from the True Guru, and lives in accordance with His Will.

468.g: ਸਚੁ ਸਭਨਾ ਹੋਇ ਦਾਰੂ ਪਾਪ ਕਢੈ ਧੋਇ ॥
468.t: sach sabhanaa hoi dhaaroo paap kaddai dhoi ||
468.e: Truth is the medicine for all; it removes and washes away our sins.

468.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਜਿਨ ਸਚੁ ਪਲੈ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
468.t: naanak vakhaanai benatee jin sach palai hoi ||2||
468.e: Nanak speaks this prayer to those who have Truth in their laps. ||2||

468.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
468.t: pauRee ||
468.e: Pauree:

468.g: ਦਾਨੁ ਮਹਿੰਡਾ ਤਲੀ ਖਾਕੁ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
468.t: dhaan mahi(n)ddaa talee khaak je milai ta masatak laieeaai ||
468.e: The gift I seek is the dust of the feet of the Saints; if I were to obtain it, I would apply it to my forehead.

468.g: ਕੂੜਾ ਲਾਲਚੁ ਛਡੀਐ ਹੋਇ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
468.t: kooRaa laalach chhaddeeaai hoi ik man alakh dhiaaieeaai ||
468.e: Renounce false greed, and meditate single-mindedly on the unseen Lord.

468.g: ਫਲੁ ਤੇਵੇਹੋ ਪਾਈਐ ਜੇਵੇਹੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਈਐ ॥
468.t: fal teveho paieeaai jevehee kaar kamaieeaai ||
468.e: As are the actions we commit, so are the rewards we receive.

468.g: ਜੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਾ ਧੂੜਿ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਦੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
468.t: je hovai poorab likhiaa taa dhooR tin(h)aa dhee paieeaai ||
468.e: If it is so pre-ordained, then one obtains the dust of the feet of the Saints.

468.g: ਮਤਿ ਥੋੜੀ ਸੇਵ ਗਵਾਈਐ ॥੧੦॥
468.t: mat thoRee sev gavaieeaai ||10||
468.e: But through small-mindedness, we forfeit the merits of selfless service. ||10||

468.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
468.t: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
468.e: Shalok, First Mehla:

468.g: ਸਚਿ ਕਾਲੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਵਰਤਿਆ ਕਲਿ ਕਾਲਖ ਬੇਤਾਲ ॥
468.t: sach kaal kooR varatiaa kal kaalakh betaal ||
468.e: There is a famine of Truth; falsehood prevails, and the blackness of the Dark Age of Kali Yuga has turned men into demons.

468.g: ਬੀਉ ਬੀਜਿ ਪਤਿ ਲੈ ਗਏ ਅਬ ਕਿਉ ਉਗਵੈ ਦਾਲਿ ॥
468.t: beeau beej pat lai ge ab kiau ugavai dhaal ||
468.e: Those who planted their seed have departed with honor; now, how can the shattered seed sprout?

468.g: ਜੇ ਇਕੁ ਹੋਇ ਤ ਉਗਵੈ ਰੁਤੀ ਹੂ ਰੁਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
468.t: je ik hoi ta ugavai rutee hoo rut hoi ||
468.e: If the seed is whole, and it is the proper season, then the seed will sprout.

468.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਹੈ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਕੋਰੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਸੋਇ ॥
468.t: naanak paahai baaharaa korai ra(n)g na soi ||
468.e: O Nanak, without treatment, the raw fabric cannot be dyed.

468.g: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਖੁੰਬਿ ਚੜਾਈਐ ਸਰਮੁ ਪਾਹੁ ਤਨਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
468.t: bhai vich khu(n)b chaRaieeaai saram paahu tan hoi ||
468.e: In the Fear of God it is bleached white, if the treatment of modesty is applied to the cloth of the body.

468.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤੀ ਜੇ ਰਪੈ ਕੂੜੈ ਸੋਇ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
468.t: naanak bhagatee je rapai kooRai soi na koi ||1||
468.e: O Nanak, if one is imbued with devotional worship, his reputation is not false. ||1||

468.t: mahalaa pehilaa ||
468.e: First Mehla:

468.g: ਲਬੁ ਪਾਪੁ ਦੁਇ ਰਾਜਾ ਮਹਤਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਹੋਆ ਸਿਕਦਾਰੁ ॥
468.t: lab paap dhui raajaa mahataa kooR hoaa sikadhaar ||
468.e: Greed and sin are the king and prime minister; falsehood is the treasurer.

468.g: ਕਾਮੁ ਨੇਬੁ ਸਦਿ ਪੁਛੀਐ ਬਹਿ ਬਹਿ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
468.t: kaam neb sadh puchheeaai beh beh kare beechaar ||
468.e: Sexual desire, the chief advisor, is summoned and consulted; they all sit together and contemplate their plans.

469.g: ਅੰਧੀ ਰਯਤਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਵਿਹੂਣੀ ਭਾਹਿ ਭਰੇ ਮੁਰਦਾਰੁ ॥
469.t: a(n)dhee rayat giaan vihoonee bhaeh bhare muradhaar ||
469.e: Their subjects are blind, and without wisdom, they try to please the will of the dead.

469.g: ਗਿਆਨੀ ਨਚਹਿ ਵਾਜੇ ਵਾਵਹਿ ਰੂਪ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
469.t: giaanee nacheh vaaje vaaveh roop kareh seegaar ||
469.e: The spiritually wise dance and play their musical instruments, adorning themselves with beautiful decorations.

469.g: ਊਚੇ ਕੂਕਹਿ ਵਾਦਾ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਜੋਧਾ ਕਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
469.t: uooche kookeh vaadhaa gaaveh jodhaa kaa veechaar ||
469.e: They shout out loud, and sing epic poems and heroic stories.

469.g: ਮੂਰਖ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਹਿਕਮਤਿ ਹੁਜਤਿ ਸੰਜੈ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
469.t: moorakh pa(n)ddit hikamat hujat sa(n)jai kareh piaar ||
469.e: The fools call themselves spiritual scholars, and by their clever tricks, they love to gather wealth.

469.g: ਧਰਮੀ ਧਰਮੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਗਾਵਾਵਹਿ ਮੰਗਹਿ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
469.t: dharamee dharam kareh gaavaaveh ma(n)geh mokh dhuaar ||
469.e: The righteous waste their righteousness, by asking for the door of salvation.

469.g: ਜਤੀ ਸਦਾਵਹਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਛਡਿ ਬਹਹਿ ਘਰ ਬਾਰੁ ॥
469.t: jatee sadhaaveh jugat na jaaneh chhadd baheh ghar baar ||
469.e: They call themselves celibate, and abandon their homes, but they do not know the true way of life.

469.g: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਪੂਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਘਟਿ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਆਖੈ ॥
469.t: sabh ko pooraa aape hovai ghaT na koiee aakhai ||
469.e: Everyone calls himself perfect; none call themselves imperfect.

469.g: ਪਤਿ ਪਰਵਾਣਾ ਪਿਛੈ ਪਾਈਐ ਤਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੋਲਿਆ ਜਾਪੈ ॥੨॥
469.t: pat paravaanaa pichhai paieeaai taa naanak toliaa jaapai ||2||
469.e: If the weight of honor is placed on the scale, then, O Nanak, one sees his true weight. ||2||

469.t: mahalaa pehilaa ||
469.e: First Mehla:

469.g: ਵਦੀ ਸੁ ਵਜਗਿ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸਚਾ ਵੇਖੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
469.t: vadhee su vajag naanakaa sachaa vekhai soi ||
469.e: Evil actions become publicly known; O Nanak, the True Lord sees everything.

469.g: ਸਭਨੀ ਛਾਲਾ ਮਾਰੀਆ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
469.t: sabhanee chhaalaa maareeaa karataa kare su hoi ||
469.e: Everyone makes the attempt, but that alone happens which the Creator Lord does.

469.g: ਅਗੈ ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਜੋਰੁ ਹੈ ਅਗੈ ਜੀਉ ਨਵੇ ॥
469.t: agai jaat na jor hai agai jeeau nave ||
469.e: In the world hereafter, social status and power mean nothing; hereafter, the soul is new.

469.g: ਜਿਨ ਕੀ ਲੇਖੈ ਪਤਿ ਪਵੈ ਚੰਗੇ ਸੇਈ ਕੇਇ ॥੩॥
469.t: jin kee lekhai pat pavai cha(n)ge seiee kei ||3||
469.e: Those few, whose honor is confirmed, are good. ||3||

469.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
469.t: pauRee ||
469.e: Pauree:

469.g: ਧੁਰਿ ਕਰਮੁ ਜਿਨਾ ਕਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਾ ਤਿਨੀ ਖਸਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
469.t: dhur karam jinaa kau tudh paiaa taa tinee khasam dhiaaiaa ||
469.e: Only those whose karma You have pre-ordained from the very beginning, O Lord, meditate on You.

469.g: ਏਨਾ ਜੰਤਾ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਵੇਕੀ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
469.t: enaa ja(n)taa kai vas kichh naahee tudh vekee jagat upaiaa ||
469.e: Nothing is in the power of these beings; You created the various worlds.

469.g: ਇਕਨਾ ਨੋ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਇਕਿ ਆਪਹੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਖੁਆਇਆ ॥
469.t: eikanaa no too(n) mel laih ik aapahu tudh khuaaiaa ||
469.e: Some, You unite with Yourself, and some, You lead astray.

469.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਜਿਥੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੁ ਬੁਝਾਇਆ ॥
469.t: gur kirapaa te jaaniaa jithai tudh aap bujhaiaa ||
469.e: By Guru's Grace You are known; through Him, You reveal Yourself.

469.g: ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੧੧॥
469.t: sahaje hee sach samaiaa ||11||
469.e: We are easily absorbed in You. ||11||

469.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
469.t: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
469.e: Shalok, First Mehla:

469.g: ਦੁਖੁ ਦਾਰੂ ਸੁਖੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਭਇਆ ਜਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਤਾਮਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
469.t: dhukh dhaaroo sukh rog bhiaa jaa sukh taam na hoiee ||
469.e: Suffering is the medicine, and pleasure the disease, because where there is pleasure, there is no desire for God.

469.g: ਤੂੰ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰਣਾ ਮੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾ ਹਉ ਕਰੀ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
469.t: too(n) karataa karanaa mai naahee jaa hau karee na hoiee ||1||
469.e: You are the Creator Lord; I can do nothing. Even if I try, nothing happens. ||1||

469.g: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਵਸਿਆ ॥
469.t: balihaaree kudharat vasiaa ||
469.e: I am a sacrifice to Your almighty creative power which is pervading everywhere.

469.g: ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਲਖਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
469.t: teraa a(n)t na jaiee lakhiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
469.e: Your limits cannot be known. ||1||Pause||

469.g: ਜਾਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਅਕਲ ਕਲਾ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥
469.t: jaat meh jot jot meh jaataa akal kalaa bharapoor rahiaa ||
469.e: Your Light is in Your creatures, and Your creatures are in Your Light; Your almighty power is pervading everywhere.

469.g: ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸੁਆਲਿੑਉ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤੀ ਸੋ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਇਆ ॥
469.t: too(n) sachaa saahib sifat suaali(h)au jin keetee so paar piaa ||
469.e: You are the True Lord and Master; Your Praise is so beautiful. One who sings it, is carried across.

469.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਤੇ ਕੀਆ ਬਾਤਾ ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥੨॥
469.t: kahu naanak karate keeaa baataa jo kichh karanaa su kar rahiaa ||2||
469.e: Nanak speaks the stories of the Creator Lord; whatever He is to do, He does. ||2||
