469.t: mahalaa doojaa ||
469.e: Second Mehla:

469.g: ਜੋਗ ਸਬਦੰ ਗਿਆਨ ਸਬਦੰ ਬੇਦ ਸਬਦੰ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣਹ ॥
469.t: jog sabadha(n) giaan sabadha(n) bedh sabadha(n) braahamaneh ||
469.e: The Way of Yoga is the Way of spiritual wisdom; the Vedas are the Way of the Brahmins.

469.g: ਖਤ੍ਰੀ ਸਬਦੰ ਸੂਰ ਸਬਦੰ ਸੂਦ੍ਰ ਸਬਦੰ ਪਰਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਤਹ ॥
469.t: khatree sabadha(n) soor sabadha(n) soodhr sabadha(n) paraa kirateh ||
469.e: The Way of the Khshatriya is the Way of bravery; the Way of the Shudras is service to others.

469.g: ਸਰਬ ਸਬਦੰ ਏਕ ਸਬਦੰ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਭੇਉ ॥ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਸੋਈ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਦੇਉ ॥੩॥
469.t: sarab sabadha(n) ek sabadha(n) je ko jaanai bheau || naanak taa kaa dhaas hai soiee nira(n)jan dheau ||3||
469.e: The Way of all is the Way of the One; Nanak is a slave to one who knows this secret; he himself is the Immaculate Divine Lord. ||3||

469.t: mahalaa doojaa ||
469.e: Second Mehla:

469.g: ਏਕ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨੰ ਸਰਬ ਦੇਵਾ ਦੇਵ ਦੇਵਾ ਤ ਆਤਮਾ ॥
469.t: ek kirasana(n) sarab dhevaa dhev dhevaa ta aatamaa ||
469.e: The One Lord Krishna is the Divine Lord of all; He is the Divinity of the individual soul.

469.g: ਆਤਮਾ ਬਾਸੁਦੇਵਸੵਿ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਭੇਉ ॥ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਸੋਈ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਦੇਉ ॥੪॥
469.t: aatamaa baasudhevasiye je ko jaanai bheau || naanak taa kaa dhaas hai soiee nira(n)jan dheau ||4||
469.e: Nanak is a slave to anyone who understands this mystery of the all-pervading Lord; he himself is the Immaculate Divine Lord. ||4||

469.t: mahalaa pehilaa ||
469.e: First Mehla:

469.g: ਕੁੰਭੇ ਬਧਾ ਜਲੁ ਰਹੈ ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੁੰਭੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
469.t: ku(n)bhe badhaa jal rahai jal bin ku(n)bh na hoi ||
469.e: Water remains confined within the pitcher, but without water, the pitcher could not have been formed;

469.g: ਗਿਆਨ ਕਾ ਬਧਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੫॥
469.t: giaan kaa badhaa man rahai gur bin giaan na hoi ||5||
469.e: just so, the mind is restrained by spiritual wisdom, but without the Guru, there is no spiritual wisdom. ||5||

469.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
469.t: pauRee ||
469.e: Pauree:

469.g: ਪੜਿਆ ਹੋਵੈ ਗੁਨਹਗਾਰੁ ਤਾ ਓਮੀ ਸਾਧੁ ਨ ਮਾਰੀਐ ॥
469.t: paRiaa hovai gunahagaar taa omee saadh na maareeaai ||
469.e: If an educated person is a sinner, then the illiterate holy man is not to be punished.

469.g: ਜੇਹਾ ਘਾਲੇ ਘਾਲਣਾ ਤੇਵੇਹੋ ਨਾਉ ਪਚਾਰੀਐ ॥
469.t: jehaa ghaale ghaalanaa teveho naau pachaareeaai ||
469.e: As are the deeds done, so is the reputation one acquires.

469.g: ਐਸੀ ਕਲਾ ਨ ਖੇਡੀਐ ਜਿਤੁ ਦਰਗਹ ਗਇਆ ਹਾਰੀਐ ॥
469.t: aaisee kalaa na kheddeeaai jit dharageh giaa haareeaai ||
469.e: So do not play such a game, which will bring you to ruin at the Court of the Lord.

469.g: ਪੜਿਆ ਅਤੈ ਓਮੀਆ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ਅਗੈ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਐ ॥
469.t: paRiaa atai omeeaa veechaar agai veechaareeaai ||
469.e: The accounts of the educated and the illiterate shall be judged in the world hereafter.

469.g: ਮੁਹਿ ਚਲੈ ਸੁ ਅਗੈ ਮਾਰੀਐ ॥੧੨॥
469.t: muh chalai su agai maareeaai ||12||
469.e: One who stubbornly follows his own mind shall suffer in the world hereafter. ||12||

470.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
470.t: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
470.e: Shalok, First Mehla:

470.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਰੁ ਸਰੀਰ ਕਾ ਇਕੁ ਰਥੁ ਇਕੁ ਰਥਵਾਹੁ ॥
470.t: naanak mer sareer kaa ik rath ik rathavaahu ||
470.e: O Nanak, the soul of the body has one chariot and one charioteer.

470.g: ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਫੇਰਿ ਵਟਾਈਅਹਿ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਬੁਝਹਿ ਤਾਹਿ ॥
470.t: jug jug fer vaTaie'eeh giaanee bujheh taeh ||
470.e: In age after age they change; the spiritually wise understand this.

470.g: ਸਤਜੁਗਿ ਰਥੁ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਕਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਅਗੈ ਰਥਵਾਹੁ ॥
470.t: satajug rath sa(n)tokh kaa dharam agai rathavaahu ||
470.e: In the Golden Age of Sat Yuga, contentment was the chariot and righteousness the charioteer.

470.g: ਤ੍ਰੇਤੈ ਰਥੁ ਜਤੈ ਕਾ ਜੋਰੁ ਅਗੈ ਰਥਵਾਹੁ ॥
470.t: tretai rath jatai kaa jor agai rathavaahu ||
470.e: In the Silver Age of Traytaa Yuga, celibacy was the chariot and power the charioteer.

470.g: ਦੁਆਪੁਰਿ ਰਥੁ ਤਪੈ ਕਾ ਸਤੁ ਅਗੈ ਰਥਵਾਹੁ ॥
470.t: dhuaapur rath tapai kaa sat agai rathavaahu ||
470.e: In the Brass Age of Dwaapar Yuga, penance was the chariot and truth the charioteer.

470.g: ਕਲਜੁਗਿ ਰਥੁ ਅਗਨਿ ਕਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਅਗੈ ਰਥਵਾਹੁ ॥੧॥
470.t: kalajug rath agan kaa kooR agai rathavaahu ||1||
470.e: In the Iron Age of Kali Yuga, fire is the chariot and falsehood the charioteer. ||1||

470.t: mahalaa pehilaa ||
470.e: First Mehla:

470.g: ਸਾਮ ਕਹੈ ਸੇਤੰਬਰੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਚ ਮਹਿ ਆਛੈ ਸਾਚਿ ਰਹੇ ॥ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
470.t: saam kahai seta(n)bar suaamee sach meh aachhai saach rahe || sabh ko sach samaavai ||
470.e: The Sama Veda says that the Lord Master is robed in white; in the Age of Truth, everyone desired Truth, abided in Truth, and was merged in the Truth.

470.g: ਰਿਗੁ ਕਹੈ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
470.t: rig kahai rahiaa bharapoor ||
470.e: The Rig Veda says that God is permeating and pervading everywhere;

470.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵਾ ਮਹਿ ਸੂਰੁ ॥
470.t: raam naam dhevaa meh soor ||
470.e: among the deities, the Lord's Name is the most exalted.

470.g: ਨਾਇ ਲਇਐ ਪਰਾਛਤ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
470.t: nai liaai paraachhat jaeh ||
470.e: Chanting the Name, sins depart;

470.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਉ ਮੋਖੰਤਰੁ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
470.t: naanak tau mokha(n)tar paeh ||
470.e: O Nanak, then, one obtains salvation.

470.g: ਜੁਜ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਰਿ ਛਲੀ ਚੰਦ੍ਰਾਵਲਿ ਕਾਨੑ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨੁ ਜਾਦਮੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
470.t: juj meh jor chhalee cha(n)dhraaval kaan(h) kirasan jaadham bhiaa ||
470.e: In the Jujar Veda, Kaan Krishna of the Yaadva tribe seduced Chandraavali by force.

470.g: ਪਾਰਜਾਤੁ ਗੋਪੀ ਲੈ ਆਇਆ ਬਿੰਦ੍ਰਾਬਨ ਮਹਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
470.t: paarajaat gopee lai aaiaa bi(n)dhraaban meh ra(n)g keeaa ||
470.e: He brought the Elysian Tree for his milk-maid, and revelled in Brindaaban.

470.g: ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਬੇਦੁ ਅਥਰਬਣੁ ਹੂਆ ਨਾਉ ਖੁਦਾਈ ਅਲਹੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
470.t: kal meh bedh atharaban hooaa naau khudhaiee alahu bhiaa ||
470.e: In the Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Atharva Veda became prominent; Allah became the Name of God.

470.g: ਨੀਲ ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਲੇ ਕਪੜੇ ਪਹਿਰੇ ਤੁਰਕ ਪਠਾਣੀ ਅਮਲੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
470.t: neel basatr le kapaRe pahire turak paThaanee amal keeaa ||
470.e: Men began to wear blue robes and garments; Turks and Pat'haans assumed power.

470.g: ਚਾਰੇ ਵੇਦ ਹੋਏ ਸਚਿਆਰ ॥
470.t: chaare vedh hoe sachiaar ||
470.e: The four Vedas each claim to be true.

470.g: ਪੜਹਿ ਗੁਣਹਿ ਤਿਨੑ ਚਾਰ ਵੀਚਾਰ ॥
470.t: paReh guneh tin(h) chaar veechaar ||
470.e: Reading and studying them, four doctrines are found.

470.g: ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਨੀਚੁ ਸਦਾਏ ॥ ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੋਖੰਤਰੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੨॥
470.t: bhaau bhagat kar neech sadhaae || tau naanak mokha(n)tar paae ||2||
470.e: With loving devotional worship, abiding in humility, O Nanak, salvation is attained. ||2||

470.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
470.t: pauRee ||
470.e: Pauree:

470.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਖਸਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿਆ ॥
470.t: satigur viTahu vaariaa jit miliaai khasam samaaliaa ||
470.e: I am a sacrifice to the True Guru; meeting Him, I have come to cherish the Lord Master.

470.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਦੀਆ ਇਨੑੀ ਨੇਤ੍ਰੀ ਜਗਤੁ ਨਿਹਾਲਿਆ ॥
470.t: jin kar upadhes giaan a(n)jan dheeaa in(h)ee netree jagat nihaaliaa ||
470.e: He has taught me and given me the healing ointment of spiritual wisdom, and with these eyes, I behold the world.

470.g: ਖਸਮੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਗੇ ਡੁਬੇ ਸੇ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ॥
470.t: khasam chhodd dhoojai lage ddube se vanajaariaa ||
470.e: Those dealers who abandon their Lord and Master and attach themselves to another, are drowned.

470.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਕਿਨੈ ਵੀਚਾਰਿਆ ॥
470.t: satiguroo hai bohithaa viralai kinai veechaariaa ||
470.e: The True Guru is the boat, but few are those who realize this.

470.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਿਆ ॥੧੩॥
470.t: kar kirapaa paar utaariaa ||13||
470.e: Granting His Grace, He carries them across. ||13||

470.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
470.t: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
470.e: Shalok, First Mehla:

470.g: ਸਿੰਮਲ ਰੁਖੁ ਸਰਾਇਰਾ ਅਤਿ ਦੀਰਘ ਅਤਿ ਮੁਚੁ ॥
470.t: si(n)mal rukh sarairaa at dheeragh at much ||
470.e: The simmal tree is straight as an arrow; it is very tall, and very thick.

470.g: ਓਇ ਜਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਆਸ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਨਿਰਾਸੇ ਕਿਤੁ ॥
470.t: oi j aaveh aas kar jaeh niraase kit ||
470.e: But those birds which visit it hopefully, depart disappointed.

470.g: ਫਲ ਫਿਕੇ ਫੁਲ ਬਕਬਕੇ ਕੰਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਹਿ ਪਤ ॥
470.t: fal fike ful bakabake ka(n)m na aaveh pat ||
470.e: Its fruits are tasteless, its flowers are nauseating, and its leaves are useless.

470.g: ਮਿਠਤੁ ਨੀਵੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਗੁਣ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ਤਤੁ ॥
470.t: miThat neevee naanakaa gun cha(n)giaaieeaa tat ||
470.e: Sweetness and humility, O Nanak, are the essence of virtue and goodness.

470.g: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਨਿਵੈ ਆਪ ਕਉ ਪਰ ਕਉ ਨਿਵੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
470.t: sabh ko nivai aap kau par kau nivai na koi ||
470.e: Everyone bows down to himself; no one bows down to another.

470.g: ਧਰਿ ਤਾਰਾਜੂ ਤੋਲੀਐ ਨਿਵੈ ਸੁ ਗਉਰਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
470.t: dhar taaraajoo toleeaai nivai su gauraa hoi ||
470.e: When something is placed on the balancing scale and weighed, the side which descends is heavier.

470.g: ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਦੂਣਾ ਨਿਵੈ ਜੋ ਹੰਤਾ ਮਿਰਗਾਹਿ ॥
470.t: aparaadhee dhoonaa nivai jo ha(n)taa miragaeh ||
470.e: The sinner, like the deer hunter, bows down twice as much.

470.g: ਸੀਸਿ ਨਿਵਾਇਐ ਕਿਆ ਥੀਐ ਜਾ ਰਿਦੈ ਕੁਸੁਧੇ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
470.t: sees nivaiaai kiaa theeaai jaa ridhai kusudhe jaeh ||1||
470.e: But what can be achieved by bowing the head, when the heart is impure? ||1||

470.t: mahalaa pehilaa ||
470.e: First Mehla:

470.g: ਪੜਿ ਪੁਸਤਕ ਸੰਧਿਆ ਬਾਦੰ ॥
470.t: paR pusatak sa(n)dhiaa baadha(n) ||
470.e: You read your books and say your prayers, and then engage in debate;

470.g: ਸਿਲ ਪੂਜਸਿ ਬਗੁਲ ਸਮਾਧੰ ॥
470.t: sil poojas bagul samaadha(n) ||
470.e: you worship stones and sit like a stork, pretending to be in Samaadhi.

470.g: ਮੁਖਿ ਝੂਠ ਬਿਭੂਖਣ ਸਾਰੰ ॥
470.t: mukh jhooTh bibhookhan saara(n) ||
470.e: With your mouth you utter falsehood, and you adorn yourself with precious decorations;

470.g: ਤ੍ਰੈਪਾਲ ਤਿਹਾਲ ਬਿਚਾਰੰ ॥
470.t: traipaal tihaal bichaara(n) ||
470.e: you recite the three lines of the Gayatri three times a day.

470.g: ਗਲਿ ਮਾਲਾ ਤਿਲਕੁ ਲਿਲਾਟੰ ॥
470.t: gal maalaa tilak lilaaTa(n) ||
470.e: Around your neck is a rosary, and on your forehead is a sacred mark;

470.g: ਦੁਇ ਧੋਤੀ ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਕਪਾਟੰ ॥
470.t: dhui dhotee basatr kapaaTa(n) ||
470.e: upon your head is a turban, and you wear two loin cloths.

470.g: ਜੇ ਜਾਣਸਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰ ਕਰਮੰ ॥
470.t: je jaanas brahama(n) karama(n) ||
470.e: If you knew the nature of God,

470.g: ਸਭਿ ਫੋਕਟ ਨਿਸਚਉ ਕਰਮੰ ॥
470.t: sabh fokaT nisachau karama(n) ||
470.e: you would know that all of these beliefs and rituals are in vain.

470.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਹਚਉ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
470.t: kahu naanak nihachau dhiaavai ||
470.e: Says Nanak, meditate with deep faith;

470.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਾਟ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
470.t: vin satigur vaaT na paavai ||2||
470.e: without the True Guru, no one finds the Way. ||2||

470.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
470.t: pauRee ||
470.e: Pauree:

470.g: ਕਪੜੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਾ ਛਡਿ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜਾਵਣਾ ॥
470.t: kapaR roop suhaavanaa chhadd dhuneeaa a(n)dhar jaavanaa ||
470.e: Abandoning the world of beauty, and beautiful clothes, one must depart.

470.g: ਮੰਦਾ ਚੰਗਾ ਆਪਣਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਕੀਤਾ ਪਾਵਣਾ ॥
470.t: ma(n)dhaa cha(n)gaa aapanaa aape hee keetaa paavanaa ||
470.e: He obtains the rewards of his good and bad deeds.

470.g: ਹੁਕਮ ਕੀਏ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਦੇ ਰਾਹਿ ਭੀੜੈ ਅਗੈ ਜਾਵਣਾ ॥
470.t: hukam ke'ee man bhaavadhe raeh bheeRai agai jaavanaa ||
470.e: He may issue whatever commands he wishes, but he shall have to take to the narrow path hereafter.

471.g: ਨੰਗਾ ਦੋਜਕਿ ਚਾਲਿਆ ਤਾ ਦਿਸੈ ਖਰਾ ਡਰਾਵਣਾ ॥
471.t: na(n)gaa dhojak chaaliaa taa dhisai kharaa ddaraavanaa ||
471.e: He goes to hell naked, and he looks hideous then.
He regrets the sins he committed. ||14||
Shalok, First Mehla:

471.g: ਦਇਆ ਕਪਾਹ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਸੂਤੁ ਜਤੁ ਗੰਢੀ ਸਤੁ ਵਟੁ ॥
471.t: dhiaa kapaeh sa(n)tokh soot jat ga(n)ddee sat vaT ||
471.e: Make compassion the cotton, contentment the thread, modesty the knot and truth the twist.

471.g: ਏਹੁ ਜਨੇਊ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ਹਈ ਤ ਪਾਡੇ ਘਤੁ ॥
471.t: eh janeuoo jeea kaa hiee ta paadde ghat ||
471.e: This is the sacred thread of the soul; if you have it, then go ahead and put it on me.

471.g: ਨਾ ਏਹੁ ਤੁਟੈ ਨਾ ਮਲੁ ਲਗੈ ਨਾ ਏਹੁ ਜਲੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
471.t: naa eh tuTai naa mal lagai naa eh jalai na jai ||
471.e: It does not break, it cannot be soiled by filth, it cannot be burnt, or lost.

471.g: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਮਾਣਸ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜੋ ਗਲਿ ਚਲੇ ਪਾਇ ॥
471.t: dha(n)nu su maanas naanakaa jo gal chale pai ||
471.e: Blessed are those mortal beings, O Nanak, who wear such a thread around their necks.

471.g: ਚਉਕੜਿ ਮੁਲਿ ਅਣਾਇਆ ਬਹਿ ਚਉਕੈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
471.t: chaukaR mul anaiaa beh chaukai paiaa ||
471.e: You buy the thread for a few shells, and seated in your enclosure, you put it on.

471.g: ਸਿਖਾ ਕੰਨਿ ਚੜਾਈਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣੁ ਥਿਆ ॥
471.t: sikhaa ka(n)n chaRaieeaa gur braahaman thiaa ||
471.e: Whispering instructions into others' ears, the Brahmin becomes a guru.

471.g: ਓਹੁ ਮੁਆ ਓਹੁ ਝੜਿ ਪਇਆ ਵੇਤਗਾ ਗਇਆ ॥੧॥
471.t: oh muaa oh jhaR piaa vetagaa giaa ||1||
471.e: But he dies, and the sacred thread falls away, and the soul departs without it. ||1||
First Mehla:

471.g: ਲਖ ਚੋਰੀਆ ਲਖ ਜਾਰੀਆ ਲਖ ਕੂੜੀਆ ਲਖ ਗਾਲਿ ॥
471.t: lakh choreeaa lakh jaareeaa lakh kooReeaa lakh gaal ||
471.e: He commits thousands of robberies, thousands of acts of adultery, thousands of falsehoods and thousands of abuses.

471.g: ਲਖ ਠਗੀਆ ਪਹਿਨਾਮੀਆ ਰਾਤਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਜੀਅ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
471.t: lakh Thageeaa pahinaameeaa raat dhinas jeea naal ||
471.e: He practices thousands of deceptions and secret deeds, night and day, against his fellow beings.

471.g: ਤਗੁ ਕਪਾਹਹੁ ਕਤੀਐ ਬਾਮੑਣੁ ਵਟੇ ਆਇ ॥
471.t: tag kapaahahu kateeaai baam(h)n vaTe aai ||
471.e: The thread is spun from cotton, and the Brahmin comes and twists it.

471.g: ਕੁਹਿ ਬਕਰਾ ਰਿੰਨਿੑ ਖਾਇਆ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਆਖੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
471.t: kuh bakaraa ri(n)ni(h) khaiaa sabh ko aakhai pai ||
471.e: The goat is killed, cooked and eaten, and everyone then says, ""Put on the sacred thread.""

471.g: ਹੋਇ ਪੁਰਾਣਾ ਸੁਟੀਐ ਭੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਹੋਰੁ ॥
471.t: hoi puraanaa suTeeaai bhee fir paieeaai hor ||
471.e: When it wears out, it is thrown away, and another one is put on.

471.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਗੁ ਨ ਤੁਟਈ ਜੇ ਤਗਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੋਰੁ ॥੨॥
471.t: naanak tag na tuTiee je tag hovai jor ||2||
471.e: O Nanak, the thread would not break, if it had any real strength. ||2||
First Mehla:

471.g: ਨਾਇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਪਤਿ ਊਪਜੈ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਸੂਤੁ ॥
471.t: nai ma(n)niaai pat uoopajai saalaahee sach soot ||
471.e: Believing in the Name, honor is obtained. The Lord's Praise is the true sacred thread.

471.g: ਦਰਗਹ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਤਗੁ ਨ ਤੂਟਸਿ ਪੂਤ ॥੩॥
471.t: dharageh a(n)dhar paieeaai tag na tooTas poot ||3||
471.e: Such a sacred thread is worn in the Court of the Lord; it shall never break. ||3||
First Mehla:

471.g: ਤਗੁ ਨ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਤਗੁ ਨ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
471.t: tag na i(n)dhree tag na naaree ||
471.e: There is no sacred thread for the sexual organ, and no thread for woman.
The man's beard is spat upon daily.

471.g: ਤਗੁ ਨ ਪੈਰੀ ਤਗੁ ਨ ਹਥੀ ॥
471.t: tag na pairee tag na hathee ||
471.e: There is no sacred thread for the feet, and no thread for the hands;

471.g: ਤਗੁ ਨ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਤਗੁ ਨ ਅਖੀ ॥
471.t: tag na jihavaa tag na akhee ||
471.e: no thread for the tongue, and no thread for the eyes.
The Brahmin himself goes to the world hereafter without a sacred thread.
Twisting the threads, he puts them on others.
He takes payment for performing marriages;
reading their horoscopes, he shows them the way.
Hear, and see, O people, this wondrous thing.
He is mentally blind, and yet his name is wisdom. ||4||
Pauree:

471.g: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਸਾਈ ਕਾਰ ਕਰਾਇਸੀ ॥
471.t: saahib hoi dhiaal kirapaa kare taa saiee kaar karaisee ||
471.e: One, upon whom the Merciful Lord bestows His Grace, performs His service.

471.g: ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮਨਾਇਸੀ ॥
471.t: so sevak sevaa kare jis no hukam manaisee ||
471.e: That servant, whom the Lord causes to obey the Order of His Will, serves Him.

471.g: ਹੁਕਮਿ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਤਾ ਖਸਮੈ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਇਸੀ ॥
471.t: hukam ma(n)niaai hovai paravaan taa khasamai kaa mahal paisee ||
471.e: Obeying the Order of His Will, he becomes acceptable, and then, he obtains the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

471.g: ਖਸਮੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਮਨਹੁ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਸੀ ॥
471.t: khasamai bhaavai so kare manahu chi(n)dhiaa so fal paisee ||
471.e: One who acts to please His Lord and Master, obtains the fruits of his mind's desires.
Then, he goes to the Court of the Lord, wearing robes of honor. ||15||
Shalok, First Mehla:

471.g: ਗਊ ਬਿਰਾਹਮਣ ਕਉ ਕਰੁ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਗੋਬਰਿ ਤਰਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
471.t: guoo biraahaman kau kar laavahu gobar taran na jaiee ||
471.e: They tax the cows and the Brahmins, but the cow-dung they apply to their kitchen will not save them.

471.g: ਧੋਤੀ ਟਿਕਾ ਤੈ ਜਪਮਾਲੀ ਧਾਨੁ ਮਲੇਛਾਂ ਖਾਈ ॥
471.t: dhotee Tikaa tai japamaalee dhaan malechhaa(n) khaiee ||
471.e: They wear their loin cloths, apply ritual frontal marks to their foreheads, and carry their rosaries, but they eat food with the Muslims.

471.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪੂਜਾ ਪੜਹਿ ਕਤੇਬਾ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਤੁਰਕਾ ਭਾਈ ॥
471.t: a(n)tar poojaa paReh katebaa sa(n)jam turakaa bhaiee ||
471.e: O Siblings of Destiny, you perform devotional worship indoors, but read the Islamic sacred texts, and adopt the Muslim way of life.
Renounce your hypocrisy!
Taking the Naam, the Name of the Lord, you shall swim across. ||1||
First Mehla:
The man-eaters say their prayers.
Those who wield the knife wear the sacred thread around their necks.
In their homes, the Brahmins sound the conch.
They too have the same taste.
False is their capital, and false is their trade.
Speaking falsehood, they take their food.
The home of modesty and Dharma is far from them.
O Nanak, they are totally permeated with falsehood.
The sacred marks are on their foreheads, and the saffron loin-cloths are around their waists;
in their hands they hold the knives - they are the butchers of the world!

472.g: ਨੀਲ ਵਸਤ੍ਰ ਪਹਿਰਿ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
472.t: neel vasatr pahir hoveh paravaan ||
472.e: Wearing blue robes, they seek the approval of the Muslim rulers.

472.g: ਮਲੇਛ ਧਾਨੁ ਲੇ ਪੂਜਹਿ ਪੁਰਾਣੁ ॥
472.t: malechh dhaan le poojeh puraan ||
472.e: Accepting bread from the Muslim rulers, they still worship the Puraanas.

472.g: ਅਭਾਖਿਆ ਕਾ ਕੁਠਾ ਬਕਰਾ ਖਾਣਾ ॥
472.t: abhaakhiaa kaa kuThaa bakaraa khaanaa ||
472.e: They eat the meat of the goats, killed after the Muslim prayers are read over them,

472.g: ਚਉਕੇ ਉਪਰਿ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
472.t: chauke upar kisai na jaanaa ||
472.e: but they do not allow anyone else to enter their kitchen areas.

472.g: ਦੇ ਕੈ ਚਉਕਾ ਕਢੀ ਕਾਰ ॥
472.t: dhe kai chaukaa kaddee kaar ||
472.e: They draw lines around them, plastering the ground with cow-dung.

472.g: ਉਪਰਿ ਆਇ ਬੈਠੇ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ॥
472.t: aupar aai baiThe kooRiaar ||
472.e: The false come and sit within them.

472.g: ਮਤੁ ਭਿਟੈ ਵੇ ਮਤੁ ਭਿਟੈ ॥ ਇਹੁ ਅੰਨੁ ਅਸਾਡਾ ਫਿਟੈ ॥
472.t: mat bhiTai ve mat bhiTai || ih a(n)n asaaddaa fiTai ||
472.e: They cry out, ""Do not touch our food, or it will be polluted!""

472.g: ਤਨਿ ਫਿਟੈ ਫੇੜ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥
472.t: tan fiTai feR karen ||
472.e: But with their polluted bodies, they commit evil deeds.

472.g: ਮਨਿ ਜੂਠੈ ਚੁਲੀ ਭਰੇਨਿ ॥
472.t: man jooThai chulee bharen ||
472.e: With filthy minds, they try to cleanse their mouths.

472.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
472.t: kahu naanak sach dhiaaieeaai ||
472.e: Says Nanak, meditate on the True Lord.

472.g: ਸੁਚਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਾ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
472.t: such hovai taa sach paieeaai ||2||
472.e: If you are pure, you will obtain the True Lord. ||2||

472.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
472.t: pauRee ||
472.e: Pauree:

472.g: ਚਿਤੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਵੇਖਿ ਨਦਰੀ ਹੇਠਿ ਚਲਾਇਦਾ ॥
472.t: chitai a(n)dhar sabh ko vekh nadharee heTh chalaidhaa ||
472.e: All are within Your mind; You see and move them under Your Glance of Grace, O Lord.

472.g: ਆਪੇ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ ॥
472.t: aape dhe vaddiaaieeaa aape hee karam karaidhaa ||
472.e: You Yourself grant them glory, and You Yourself cause them to act.

472.g: ਵਡਹੁ ਵਡਾ ਵਡ ਮੇਦਨੀ ਸਿਰੇ ਸਿਰਿ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਇਦਾ ॥
472.t: vaddahu vaddaa vadd medhanee sire sir dha(n)dhai laidhaa ||
472.e: The Lord is the greatest of the great; great is His world. He enjoins all to their tasks.

472.g: ਨਦਰਿ ਉਪਠੀ ਜੇ ਕਰੇ ਸੁਲਤਾਨਾ ਘਾਹੁ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ ॥
472.t: nadhar upaThee je kare sulataanaa ghaahu karaidhaa ||
472.e: If he should cast an angry glance, He can transform kings into blades of grass.

472.g: ਦਰਿ ਮੰਗਨਿ ਭਿਖ ਨ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥
472.t: dhar ma(n)gan bhikh na paidhaa ||16||
472.e: Even though they may beg from door to door, no one will give them charity. ||16||

472.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
472.t: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
472.e: Shalok, First Mehla:

472.g: ਜੇ ਮੋਹਾਕਾ ਘਰੁ ਮੁਹੈ ਘਰੁ ਮੁਹਿ ਪਿਤਰੀ ਦੇਇ ॥
472.t: je mohaakaa ghar muhai ghar muh pitaree dhei ||
472.e: The thief robs a house, and offers the stolen goods to his ancestors.

472.g: ਅਗੈ ਵਸਤੁ ਸਿਞਾਣੀਐ ਪਿਤਰੀ ਚੋਰ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
472.t: agai vasat sin(j)aaneeaai pitaree chor karei ||
472.e: In the world hereafter, this is recognized, and his ancestors are considered thieves as well.

472.g: ਵਢੀਅਹਿ ਹਥ ਦਲਾਲ ਕੇ ਮੁਸਫੀ ਏਹ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
472.t: vadde'eeh hath dhalaal ke musafee eh karei ||
472.e: The hands of the go-between are cut off; this is the Lord's justice.

472.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਗੈ ਸੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਿ ਖਟੇ ਘਾਲੇ ਦੇਇ ॥੧॥
472.t: naanak agai so milai j khaTe ghaale dhei ||1||
472.e: O Nanak, in the world hereafter, that alone is received, which one gives to the needy from his own earnings and labor. ||1||

472.t: mahalaa pehilaa ||
472.e: First Mehla:

472.g: ਜਿਉ ਜੋਰੂ ਸਿਰਨਾਵਣੀ ਆਵੈ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥
472.t: jiau joroo siranaavanee aavai vaaro vaar ||
472.e: As a woman has her periods, month after month,

472.g: ਜੂਠੇ ਜੂਠਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਵਸੈ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
472.t: jooThe jooThaa mukh vasai nit nit hoi khuaar ||
472.e: so does falsehood dwell in the mouth of the false; they suffer forever, again and again.

472.g: ਸੂਚੇ ਏਹਿ ਨ ਆਖੀਅਹਿ ਬਹਨਿ ਜਿ ਪਿੰਡਾ ਧੋਇ ॥
472.t: sooche eh na aakhe'eeh bahan j pi(n)ddaa dhoi ||
472.e: They are not called pure, who sit down after merely washing their bodies.

472.g: ਸੂਚੇ ਸੇਈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
472.t: sooche seiee naanakaa jin man vasiaa soi ||2||
472.e: Only they are pure, O Nanak, within whose minds the Lord abides. ||2||

472.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
472.t: pauRee ||
472.e: Pauree:

472.g: ਤੁਰੇ ਪਲਾਣੇ ਪਉਣ ਵੇਗ ਹਰ ਰੰਗੀ ਹਰਮ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
472.t: ture palaane paun veg har ra(n)gee haram savaariaa ||
472.e: With saddled horses, as fast as the wind, and harems decorated in every way;

472.g: ਕੋਠੇ ਮੰਡਪ ਮਾੜੀਆ ਲਾਇ ਬੈਠੇ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
472.t: koThe ma(n)ddap maaReeaa lai baiThe kar paasaariaa ||
472.e: in houses and pavilions and lofty mansions, they dwell, making ostentatious shows.

472.g: ਚੀਜ ਕਰਨਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਦੇ ਹਰਿ ਬੁਝਨਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
472.t: cheej karan man bhaavadhe har bujhan naahee haariaa ||
472.e: They act out their minds' desires, but they do not understand the Lord, and so they are ruined.

472.g: ਕਰਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਸਿ ਖਾਇਆ ਵੇਖਿ ਮਹਲਤਿ ਮਰਣੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
472.t: kar furamais khaiaa vekh mahalat maran visaariaa ||
472.e: Asserting their authority, they eat, and beholding their mansions, they forget about death.

472.g: ਜਰੁ ਆਈ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਹਾਰਿਆ ॥੧੭॥
472.t: jar aaiee joban haariaa ||17||
472.e: But old age comes, and youth is lost. ||17||

472.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
472.t: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
472.e: Shalok, First Mehla:

472.g: ਜੇ ਕਰਿ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਮੰਨੀਐ ਸਭ ਤੈ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
472.t: je kar sootak ma(n)neeaai sabh tai sootak hoi ||
472.e: If one accepts the concept of impurity, then there is impurity everywhere.

472.g: ਗੋਹੇ ਅਤੈ ਲਕੜੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕੀੜਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
472.t: gohe atai lakaRee a(n)dhar keeRaa hoi ||
472.e: In cow-dung and wood there are worms.

472.g: ਜੇਤੇ ਦਾਣੇ ਅੰਨ ਕੇ ਜੀਆ ਬਾਝੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
472.t: jete dhaane a(n)n ke jeeaa baajh na koi ||
472.e: As many as are the grains of corn, none is without life.

472.g: ਪਹਿਲਾ ਪਾਣੀ ਜੀਉ ਹੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
472.t: pahilaa paanee jeeau hai jit hariaa sabh koi ||
472.e: First, there is life in the water, by which everything else is made green.

472.g: ਸੂਤਕੁ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਰਖੀਐ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਪਵੈ ਰਸੋਇ ॥
472.t: sootak kiau kar rakheeaai sootak pavai rasoi ||
472.e: How can it be protected from impurity? It touches our own kitchen.

472.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਏਵ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਉਤਾਰੇ ਧੋਇ ॥੧॥
472.t: naanak sootak ev na utarai giaan utaare dhoi ||1||
472.e: O Nanak, impurity cannot be removed in this way; it is washed away only by spiritual wisdom. ||1||

472.t: mahalaa pehilaa ||
472.e: First Mehla:

472.g: ਮਨ ਕਾ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਕੂੜੁ ॥
472.t: man kaa sootak lobh hai jihavaa sootak kooR ||
472.e: The impurity of the mind is greed, and the impurity of the tongue is falsehood.

472.g: ਅਖੀ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਵੇਖਣਾ ਪਰ ਤ੍ਰਿਅ ਪਰ ਧਨ ਰੂਪੁ ॥
472.t: akhee sootak vekhanaa par tria par dhan roop ||
472.e: The impurity of the eyes is to gaze upon the beauty of another man's wife, and his wealth.

472.g: ਕੰਨੀ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਕੰਨਿ ਪੈ ਲਾਇਤਬਾਰੀ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
472.t: ka(n)nee sootak ka(n)n pai laitabaaree khaeh ||
472.e: The impurity of the ears is to listen to the slander of others.

472.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੰਸਾ ਆਦਮੀ ਬਧੇ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
472.t: naanak ha(n)saa aadhamee badhe jam pur jaeh ||2||
472.e: O Nanak, the mortal's soul goes, bound and gagged to the city of Death. ||2||

472.t: mahalaa pehilaa ||
472.e: First Mehla:

472.g: ਸਭੋ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਗੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
472.t: sabho sootak bharam hai dhoojai lagai jai ||
472.e: All impurity comes from doubt and attachment to duality.

472.g: ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
472.t: ja(n)man maranaa hukam hai bhaanai aavai jai ||
472.e: Birth and death are subject to the Command of the Lord's Will; through His Will we come and go.

472.g: ਖਾਣਾ ਪੀਣਾ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਹੈ ਦਿਤੋਨੁ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸੰਬਾਹਿ ॥
472.t: khaanaa peenaa pavitr hai dhiton rijak sa(n)baeh ||
472.e: Eating and drinking are pure, since the Lord gives nourishment to all.

472.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੁਝਿਆ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
472.t: naanak jin(h)ee gurmukh bujhiaa tin(h)aa sootak naeh ||3||
472.e: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs, who understand the Lord, are not stained by impurity. ||3||

473.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
473.t: pauRee ||
473.e: Pauree:

473.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਵਡਾ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਡੀਆ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ॥
473.t: satigur vaddaa kar saalaaheeaai jis vich vaddeeaa vaddiaaieeaa ||
473.e: Praise the Great True Guru; within Him is the greatest greatness.

473.g: ਸਹਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਤਾ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਈਆ ॥
473.t: seh mele taa nadharee aaieeaa ||
473.e: When the Lord causes us to meet the Guru, then we come to see them.

473.g: ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਾਈਆ ॥
473.t: jaa tis bhaanaa taa man vasaieeaa ||
473.e: When it pleases Him, they come to dwell in our minds.

473.g: ਕਰਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਹਥੁ ਧਰਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਢੀਆ ਬੁਰਿਆਈਆ ॥
473.t: kar hukam masatak hath dhar vichahu maar kaddeeaa buriaaieeaa ||
473.e: By His Command, when He places His hand on our foreheads, wickedness departs from within.

473.g: ਸਹਿ ਤੁਠੈ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈਆ ॥੧੮॥
473.t: seh tuThai nau nidh paieeaa ||18||
473.e: When the Lord is thoroughly pleased, the nine treasures are obtained. ||18||

473.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
473.t: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
473.e: Shalok, First Mehla:

473.g: ਪਹਿਲਾ ਸੁਚਾ ਆਪਿ ਹੋਇ ਸੁਚੈ ਬੈਠਾ ਆਇ ॥
473.t: pahilaa suchaa aap hoi suchai baiThaa aai ||
473.e: First, purifying himself, the Brahmin comes and sits in his purified enclosure.

473.g: ਸੁਚੇ ਅਗੈ ਰਖਿਓਨੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਭਿਟਿਓ ਜਾਇ ॥
473.t: suche agai rakhion koi na bhiTio jai ||
473.e: The pure foods, which no one else has touched, are placed before him.

473.g: ਸੁਚਾ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਜੇਵਿਆ ਲਗਾ ਪੜਣਿ ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
473.t: suchaa hoi kai jeviaa lagaa paRan salok ||
473.e: Being purified, he takes his food, and begins to read his sacred verses.

473.g: ਕੁਹਥੀ ਜਾਈ ਸਟਿਆ ਕਿਸੁ ਏਹੁ ਲਗਾ ਦੋਖੁ ॥
473.t: kuhathee jaiee saTiaa kis eh lagaa dhokh ||
473.e: But it is then thrown into a filthy place - whose fault is this?

473.g: ਅੰਨੁ ਦੇਵਤਾ ਪਾਣੀ ਦੇਵਤਾ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਦੇਵਤਾ ਲੂਣੁ ਪੰਜਵਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਘਿਰਤੁ ॥
473.t: a(n)n dhevataa paanee dhevataa baisa(n)tar dhevataa loon pa(n)javaa paiaa ghirat ||
473.e: The corn is sacred, the water is sacred; the fire and salt are sacred as well; when the fifth thing, the ghee, is added,

473.g: ਤਾ ਹੋਆ ਪਾਕੁ ਪਵਿਤੁ ॥
473.t: taa hoaa paak pavit ||
473.e: then the food becomes pure and sanctified.

473.g: ਪਾਪੀ ਸਿਉ ਤਨੁ ਗਡਿਆ ਥੁਕਾ ਪਈਆ ਤਿਤੁ ॥
473.t: paapee siau tan gaddiaa thukaa pieeaa tit ||
473.e: Coming into contact with the sinful human body, the food becomes so impure that is is spat upon.

473.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਊਚਰਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਰਸ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
473.t: jit mukh naam na uoochareh bin naavai ras khaeh ||
473.e: That mouth which does not chant the Naam, and without the Name eats tasty foods

473.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਵੈ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਤਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਥੁਕਾ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
473.t: naanak evai jaaneeaai tit mukh thukaa paeh ||1||
473.e: - O Nanak, know this: such a mouth is to be spat upon. ||1||

473.t: mahalaa pehilaa ||
473.e: First Mehla:

473.g: ਭੰਡਿ ਜੰਮੀਐ ਭੰਡਿ ਨਿੰਮੀਐ ਭੰਡਿ ਮੰਗਣੁ ਵੀਆਹੁ ॥
473.t: bha(n)dd ja(n)meeaai bha(n)dd ni(n)meeaai bha(n)dd ma(n)gan veeaahu ||
473.e: From woman, man is born; within woman, man is conceived; to woman he is engaged and married.

473.g: ਭੰਡਹੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਭੰਡਹੁ ਚਲੈ ਰਾਹੁ ॥
473.t: bha(n)ddahu hovai dhosatee bha(n)ddahu chalai raahu ||
473.e: Woman becomes his friend; through woman, the future generations come.

473.g: ਭੰਡੁ ਮੁਆ ਭੰਡੁ ਭਾਲੀਐ ਭੰਡਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਬੰਧਾਨੁ ॥
473.t: bha(n)dd muaa bha(n)dd bhaaleeaai bha(n)dd hovai ba(n)dhaan ||
473.e: When his woman dies, he seeks another woman; to woman he is bound.

473.g: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਮੰਦਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿਤੁ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਰਾਜਾਨ ॥
473.t: so kiau ma(n)dhaa aakheeaai jit ja(n)meh raajaan ||
473.e: So why call her bad? From her, kings are born.

473.g: ਭੰਡਹੁ ਹੀ ਭੰਡੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਭੰਡੈ ਬਾਝੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
473.t: bha(n)ddahu hee bha(n)dd uoopajai bha(n)ddai baajh na koi ||
473.e: From woman, woman is born; without woman, there would be no one at all.

473.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਭੰਡੈ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਏਕੋ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
473.t: naanak bha(n)ddai baaharaa eko sachaa soi ||
473.e: O Nanak, only the True Lord is without a woman.

473.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਭਾਗਾ ਰਤੀ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
473.t: jit mukh sadhaa saalaaheeaai bhaagaa ratee chaar ||
473.e: That mouth which praises the Lord continually is blessed and beautiful.

473.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲੇ ਤਿਤੁ ਸਚੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
473.t: naanak te mukh uoojale tit sachai dharabaar ||2||
473.e: O Nanak, those faces shall be radiant in the Court of the True Lord. ||2||

473.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
473.t: pauRee ||
473.e: Pauree:

473.g: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਆਖੈ ਆਪਣਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੋ ਚੁਣਿ ਕਢੀਐ ॥
473.t: sabh ko aakhai aapanaa jis naahee so chun kaddeeaai ||
473.e: All call You their own, Lord; one who does not own You, is picked up and thrown away.

473.g: ਕੀਤਾ ਆਪੋ ਆਪਣਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਲੇਖਾ ਸੰਢੀਐ ॥
473.t: keetaa aapo aapanaa aape hee lekhaa sa(n)ddeeaai ||
473.e: Everyone receives the rewards of his own actions; his account is adjusted accordingly.

473.g: ਜਾ ਰਹਣਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਐਤੁ ਜਗਿ ਤਾ ਕਾਇਤੁ ਗਾਰਬਿ ਹੰਢੀਐ ॥
473.t: jaa rahanaa naahee aait jag taa kait gaarab ha(n)ddeeaai ||
473.e: Since one is not destined to remain in this world anyway, why should he ruin himself in pride?

473.g: ਮੰਦਾ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਆਖੀਐ ਪੜਿ ਅਖਰੁ ਏਹੋ ਬੁਝੀਐ ॥
473.t: ma(n)dhaa kisai na aakheeaai paR akhar eho bujheeaai ||
473.e: Do not call anyone bad; read these words, and understand.

473.g: ਮੂਰਖੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਲੁਝੀਐ ॥੧੯॥
473.t: moorakhai naal na lujheeaai ||19||
473.e: Don't argue with fools. ||19||

473.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
473.t: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
473.e: Shalok, First Mehla:

473.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਫਿਕੈ ਬੋਲਿਐ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਫਿਕਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
473.t: naanak fikai boliaai tan man fikaa hoi ||
473.e: O Nanak, speaking insipid words, the body and mind become insipid.

473.g: ਫਿਕੋ ਫਿਕਾ ਸਦੀਐ ਫਿਕੇ ਫਿਕੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
473.t: fiko fikaa sadheeaai fike fikee soi ||
473.e: He is called the most insipid of the insipid; the most insipid of the insipid is his reputation.

473.g: ਫਿਕਾ ਦਰਗਹ ਸਟੀਐ ਮੁਹਿ ਥੁਕਾ ਫਿਕੇ ਪਾਇ ॥
473.t: fikaa dharageh saTeeaai muh thukaa fike pai ||
473.e: The insipid person is discarded in the Court of the Lord, and the insipid one's face is spat upon.

473.g: ਫਿਕਾ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਪਾਣਾ ਲਹੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
473.t: fikaa moorakh aakheeaai paanaa lahai sajai ||1||
473.e: The insipid one is called a fool; he is beaten with shoes in punishment. ||1||

473.t: mahalaa pehilaa ||
473.e: First Mehla:

473.g: ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਝੂਠੇ ਪੈਜ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਫੈਲੁ ॥
473.t: a(n)dharahu jhooThe paij baahar dhuneeaa a(n)dhar fail ||
473.e: Those who are false within, and honorable on the outside, are very common in this world.

473.g: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਜੇ ਨਾਵਹਿ ਉਤਰੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੈਲੁ ॥
473.t: aThasaTh teerath je naaveh utarai naahee mail ||
473.e: Even though they may bathe at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage, still, their filth does not depart.

473.g: ਜਿਨੑ ਪਟੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਗੁਦੜੁ ਤੇ ਭਲੇ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
473.t: jin(h) paT a(n)dhar baahar gudhaR te bhale sa(n)saar ||
473.e: Those who have silk on the inside and rags on the outside, are the good ones in this world.

473.g: ਤਿਨੑ ਨੇਹੁ ਲਗਾ ਰਬ ਸੇਤੀ ਦੇਖਨੑੇ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
473.t: tin(h) neh lagaa rab setee dhekhan(h)e veechaar ||
473.e: They embrace love for the Lord, and contemplate beholding Him.

473.g: ਰੰਗਿ ਹਸਹਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰੋਵਹਿ ਚੁਪ ਭੀ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
473.t: ra(n)g haseh ra(n)g roveh chup bhee kar jaeh ||
473.e: In the Lord's Love, they laugh, and in the Lord's Love, they weep, and also keep silent.

473.g: ਪਰਵਾਹ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਕੇਰੀ ਬਾਝੁ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਹ ॥
473.t: paravaeh naahee kisai keree baajh sache naeh ||
473.e: They do not care for anything else, except their True Husband Lord.

473.g: ਦਰਿ ਵਾਟ ਉਪਰਿ ਖਰਚੁ ਮੰਗਾ ਜਬੈ ਦੇਇ ਤ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
473.t: dhar vaaT upar kharach ma(n)gaa jabai dhei ta khaeh ||
473.e: Sitting, waiting at the Lord's Door, they beg for food, and when He gives to them, they eat.

473.g: ਦੀਬਾਨੁ ਏਕੋ ਕਲਮ ਏਕਾ ਹਮਾ ਤੁਮੑਾ ਮੇਲੁ ॥
473.t: dheebaan eko kalam ekaa hamaa tum(h)aa mel ||
473.e: There is only One Court of the Lord, and He has only one pen; there, you and I shall meet.

473.g: ਦਰਿ ਲਏ ਲੇਖਾ ਪੀੜਿ ਛੁਟੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਉ ਤੇਲੁ ॥੨॥
473.t: dhar le lekhaa peeR chhuTai naanakaa jiau tel ||2||
473.e: In the Court of the Lord, the accounts are examined; O Nanak, the sinners are crushed, like oil seeds in the press. ||2||

474.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
474.t: pauRee ||
474.e: Pauree:

474.g: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਕਰਣਾ ਕੀਓ ਕਲ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਤੈ ਧਾਰੀਐ ॥
474.t: aape hee karanaa keeo kal aape hee tai dhaareeaai ||
474.e: You Yourself created the creation; You Yourself infused Your power into it.

474.g: ਦੇਖਹਿ ਕੀਤਾ ਆਪਣਾ ਧਰਿ ਕਚੀ ਪਕੀ ਸਾਰੀਐ ॥
474.t: dhekheh keetaa aapanaa dhar kachee pakee saareeaai ||
474.e: You behold Your creation, like the losing and winning dice of the earth.

474.g: ਜੋ ਆਇਆ ਸੋ ਚਲਸੀ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਆਈ ਵਾਰੀਐ ॥
474.t: jo aaiaa so chalasee sabh koiee aaiee vaareeaai ||
474.e: Whoever has come, shall depart; all shall have their turn.

474.g: ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ ਪਰਾਣ ਹਹਿ ਕਿਉ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ॥
474.t: jis ke jeea paraan heh kiau saahib manahu visaareeaai ||
474.e: He who owns our soul, and our very breath of life - why should we forget that Lord and Master from our minds?

474.g: ਆਪਣ ਹਥੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਕਾਜੁ ਸਵਾਰੀਐ ॥੨੦॥
474.t: aapan hathee aapanaa aape hee kaaj savaareeaai ||20||
474.e: With our own hands, let us resolve our own affairs. ||20||

474.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
474.t: salok mahalaa doojaa ||
474.e: Shalok, Second Mehla:

474.g: ਏਹ ਕਿਨੇਹੀ ਆਸਕੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਗੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
474.t: eh kinehee aasakee dhoojai lagai jai ||
474.e: What sort of love is this, which clings to duality?

474.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਸਕੁ ਕਾਂਢੀਐ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
474.t: naanak aasak kaa(n)ddeeaai sadh hee rahai samai ||
474.e: O Nanak, he alone is called a lover, who remains forever immersed in absorption.

474.g: ਚੰਗੈ ਚੰਗਾ ਕਰਿ ਮੰਨੇ ਮੰਦੈ ਮੰਦਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
474.t: cha(n)gai cha(n)gaa kar ma(n)ne ma(n)dhai ma(n)dhaa hoi ||
474.e: But one who feels good only when good is done for him, and feels bad when things go badly

474.g: ਆਸਕੁ ਏਹੁ ਨ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿ ਲੇਖੈ ਵਰਤੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
474.t: aasak eh na aakheeaai j lekhai varatai soi ||1||
474.e: - do not call him a lover. He trades only for his own account. ||1||

474.g: ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
474.t: mahalaa doojaa ||
474.e: Second Mehla:

474.g: ਸਲਾਮੁ ਜਬਾਬੁ ਦੋਵੈ ਕਰੇ ਮੁੰਢਹੁ ਘੁਥਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
474.t: salaam jabaab dhovai kare mu(n)ddahu ghuthaa jai ||
474.e: One who offers both respectful greetings and rude refusal to his master, has gone wrong from the very beginning.

474.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੋਵੈ ਕੂੜੀਆ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
474.t: naanak dhovai kooReeaa thai na kaiee pai ||2||
474.e: O Nanak, both of his actions are false; he obtains no place in the Court of the Lord. ||2||

474.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
474.t: pauRee ||
474.e: Pauree:

474.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਸੋ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਮੑਾਲੀਐ ॥
474.t: jit seviaai sukh paieeaai so saahib sadhaa sam(h)aaleeaai ||
474.e: Serving Him, peace is obtained; meditate and dwell upon that Lord and Master forever.

474.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਕੀਤਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਆਪਣਾ ਸਾ ਘਾਲ ਬੁਰੀ ਕਿਉ ਘਾਲੀਐ ॥
474.t: jit keetaa paieeaai aapanaa saa ghaal buree kiau ghaaleeaai ||
474.e: Why do you do such evil deeds, that you shall have to suffer so?

474.g: ਮੰਦਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਕੀਚਈ ਦੇ ਲੰਮੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੀਐ ॥
474.t: ma(n)dhaa mool na keechiee dhe la(n)mee nadhar nihaaleeaai ||
474.e: Do not do any evil at all; look ahead to the future with foresight.

474.g: ਜਿਉ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਹਾਰੀਐ ਤੇਵੇਹਾ ਪਾਸਾ ਢਾਲੀਐ ॥
474.t: jiau saahib naal na haareeaai tevehaa paasaa ddaaleeaai ||
474.e: So throw the dice in such a way, that you shall not lose with your Lord and Master.

474.g: ਕਿਛੁ ਲਾਹੇ ਉਪਰਿ ਘਾਲੀਐ ॥੨੧॥
474.t: kichh laahe upar ghaaleeaai ||21||
474.e: Do those deeds which shall bring you profit. ||21||

474.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
474.t: salok mahalaa doojaa ||
474.e: Shalok, Second Mehla:

474.g: ਚਾਕਰੁ ਲਗੈ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਨਾਲੇ ਗਾਰਬੁ ਵਾਦੁ ॥
474.t: chaakar lagai chaakaree naale gaarab vaadh ||
474.e: If a servant performs service, while being vain and argumentative,

474.g: ਗਲਾ ਕਰੇ ਘਣੇਰੀਆ ਖਸਮ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਸਾਦੁ ॥
474.t: galaa kare ghanereeaa khasam na paae saadh ||
474.e: he may talk as much as he wants, but he shall not be pleasing to his Master.

474.g: ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਏ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
474.t: aap gavai sevaa kare taa kichh paae maan ||
474.e: But if he eliminates his self-conceit and then performs service, he shall be honored.

474.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਲਗਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਲਗਾ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
474.t: naanak jis no lagaa tis milai lagaa so paravaan ||1||
474.e: O Nanak, if he merges with the one with whom he is attached, his attachment becomes acceptable. ||1||

474.g: ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
474.t: mahalaa doojaa ||
474.e: Second Mehla:

474.g: ਜੋ ਜੀਇ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਉਗਵੈ ਮੁਹ ਕਾ ਕਹਿਆ ਵਾਉ ॥
474.t: jo jeei hoi su ugavai muh kaa kahiaa vaau ||
474.e: Whatever is in the mind, comes forth; spoken words by themselves are just wind.

474.g: ਬੀਜੇ ਬਿਖੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਏਹੁ ਨਿਆਉ ॥੨॥
474.t: beeje bikh ma(n)gai a(n)mrit vekhahu eh niaau ||2||
474.e: He sows seeds of poison, and demands Ambrosial Nectar. Behold - what justice is this? ||2||

474.g: ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
474.t: mahalaa doojaa ||
474.e: Second Mehla:

474.g: ਨਾਲਿ ਇਆਣੇ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
474.t: naal iaane dhosatee kadhe na aavai raas ||
474.e: Friendship with a fool never works out right.

474.g: ਜੇਹਾ ਜਾਣੈ ਤੇਹੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਕੋ ਨਿਰਜਾਸਿ ॥
474.t: jehaa jaanai teho varatai vekhahu ko nirajaas ||
474.e: As he knows, he acts; behold, and see that it is so.

474.g: ਵਸਤੂ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਦੂਜੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
474.t: vasatoo a(n)dhar vasat samaavai dhoojee hovai paas ||
474.e: One thing can be absorbed into another thing, but duality keeps them apart.

474.g: ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸੇਤੀ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਕਹੀ ਬਣੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
474.t: saahib setee hukam na chalai kahee banai aradhaas ||
474.e: No one can issue commands to the Lord Master; offer instead humble prayers.

474.g: ਕੂੜਿ ਕਮਾਣੈ ਕੂੜੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਵਿਗਾਸਿ ॥੩॥
474.t: kooR kamaanai kooRo hovai naanak sifat vigaas ||3||
474.e: Practicing falsehood, only falsehood is obtained. O Nanak, through the Lord's Praise, one blossoms forth. ||3||

474.g: ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
474.t: mahalaa doojaa ||
474.e: Second Mehla:

474.g: ਨਾਲਿ ਇਆਣੇ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਵਡਾਰੂ ਸਿਉ ਨੇਹੁ ॥
474.t: naal iaane dhosatee vaddaaroo siau neh ||
474.e: Friendship with a fool, and love with a pompous person,

474.g: ਪਾਣੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਲੀਕ ਜਿਉ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਥਾਉ ਨ ਥੇਹੁ ॥੪॥
474.t: paanee a(n)dhar leek jiau tis dhaa thaau na theh ||4||
474.e: are like lines drawn in water, leaving no trace or mark. ||4||

474.g: ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
474.t: mahalaa doojaa ||
474.e: Second Mehla:

474.g: ਹੋਇ ਇਆਣਾ ਕਰੇ ਕੰਮੁ ਆਣਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
474.t: hoi iaanaa kare ka(n)m aan na sakai raas ||
474.e: If a fool does a job, he cannot do it right.

474.g: ਜੇ ਇਕ ਅਧ ਚੰਗੀ ਕਰੇ ਦੂਜੀ ਭੀ ਵੇਰਾਸਿ ॥੫॥
474.t: je ik adh cha(n)gee kare dhoojee bhee veraas ||5||
474.e: Even if he does something right, he does the next thing wrong. ||5||

474.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
474.t: pauRee ||
474.e: Pauree:

474.g: ਚਾਕਰੁ ਲਗੈ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਜੇ ਚਲੈ ਖਸਮੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
474.t: chaakar lagai chaakaree je chalai khasamai bhai ||
474.e: If a servant, performing service, obeys the Will of his Master,

474.g: ਹੁਰਮਤਿ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਅਗਲੀ ਓਹੁ ਵਜਹੁ ਭਿ ਦੂਣਾ ਖਾਇ ॥
474.t: huramat tis no agalee oh vajahu bh dhoonaa khai ||
474.e: his honor increases, and he receives double his wages.

474.g: ਖਸਮੈ ਕਰੇ ਬਰਾਬਰੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਗੈਰਤਿ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
474.t: khasamai kare baraabaree fir gairat a(n)dhar pai ||
474.e: But if he claims to be equal to his Master, he earns his Master's displeasure.

474.g: ਵਜਹੁ ਗਵਾਏ ਅਗਲਾ ਮੁਹੇ ਮੁਹਿ ਪਾਣਾ ਖਾਇ ॥
474.t: vajahu gavaae agalaa muhe muh paanaa khai ||
474.e: He loses his entire salary, and is also beaten on his face with shoes.

474.g: ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਦਿਤਾ ਖਾਵਣਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥
474.t: jis dhaa dhitaa khaavanaa tis kaheeaai saabaas ||
474.e: Let us all celebrate Him, from whom we receive our nourishment.

474.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਚਲਈ ਨਾਲਿ ਖਸਮ ਚਲੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥੨੨॥
474.t: naanak hukam na chaliee naal khasam chalai aradhaas ||22||
474.e: O Nanak, no one can issue commands to the Lord Master; let us offer prayers instead. ||22||

474.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
474.t: salok mahalaa doojaa ||
474.e: Shalok, Second Mehla:

474.g: ਏਹ ਕਿਨੇਹੀ ਦਾਤਿ ਆਪਸ ਤੇ ਜੋ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
474.t: eh kinehee dhaat aapas te jo paieeaai ||
474.e: What sort of gift is this, which we receive only by our own asking?

475.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾ ਕਰਮਾਤਿ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਤੁਠੈ ਜੋ ਮਿਲੈ ॥੧॥
475.t: naanak saa karamaat saahib tuThai jo milai ||1||
475.e: O Nanak, that is the most wonderful gift, which is received from the Lord, when He is totally pleased. ||1||

475.g: ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
475.t: mahalaa doojaa ||
475.e: Second Mehla:

475.g: ਏਹ ਕਿਨੇਹੀ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਭਉ ਖਸਮ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
475.t: eh kinehee chaakaree jit bhau khasam na jai ||
475.e: What sort of service is this, by which the fear of the Lord Master does not depart?

475.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਕਾਢੀਐ ਜਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਖਸਮ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
475.t: naanak sevak kaaddeeaai j setee khasam samai ||2||
475.e: O Nanak, he alone is called a servant, who merges with the Lord Master. ||2||

475.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
475.t: pauRee ||
475.e: Pauree:

475.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਤ ਨ ਜਾਪਨੑੀ ਹਰਿ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰ ॥
475.t: naanak a(n)t na jaapan(h)ee har taa ke paaraavaar ||
475.e: O Nanak, the Lord's limits cannot be known; He has no end or limitation.

475.g: ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਸਾਖਤੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਮਾਰ ॥
475.t: aap karaae saakhatee fir aap karaae maar ||
475.e: He Himself creates, and then He Himself destroys.

475.g: ਇਕਨੑਾ ਗਲੀ ਜੰਜੀਰੀਆ ਇਕਿ ਤੁਰੀ ਚੜਹਿ ਬਿਸੀਆਰ ॥
475.t: eikan(h)aa galee ja(n)jeereeaa ik turee chaReh biseeaar ||
475.e: Some have chains around their necks, while some ride on many horses.

475.g: ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰੇ ਆਪਿ ਹਉ ਕੈ ਸਿਉ ਕਰੀ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
475.t: aap karaae kare aap hau kai siau karee pukaar ||
475.e: He Himself acts, and He Himself causes us to act. Unto whom should I complain?

475.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰ ॥੨੩॥
475.t: naanak karanaa jin keeaa fir tis hee karanee saar ||23||
475.e: O Nanak, the One who created the creation - He Himself takes care of it. ||23||

475.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
475.t: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
475.e: Shalok, First Mehla:

475.g: ਆਪੇ ਭਾਂਡੇ ਸਾਜਿਅਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਪੂਰਣੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
475.t: aape bhaa(n)dde saajian aape pooran dhei ||
475.e: He Himself fashioned the vessel of the body, and He Himself fills it.

475.g: ਇਕਨੑੀ ਦੁਧੁ ਸਮਾਈਐ ਇਕਿ ਚੁਲੑੈ ਰਹਨਿੑ ਚੜੇ ॥
475.t: eikan(h)ee dhudh samaieeaai ik chul(h)ai rahani(h) chaRe ||
475.e: Into some, milk is poured, while others remain on the fire.

475.g: ਇਕਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੀ ਪੈ ਸਵਨਿੑ ਇਕਿ ਉਪਰਿ ਰਹਨਿ ਖੜੇ ॥
475.t: eik nihaalee pai savani(h) ik upar rahan khaRe ||
475.e: Some lie down and sleep on soft beds, while others remain watchful.

475.g: ਤਿਨੑਾ ਸਵਾਰੇ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੧॥
475.t: tin(h)aa savaare naanakaa jin(h) kau nadhar kare ||1||
475.e: He adorns those, O Nanak, upon whom He casts His Glance of Grace. ||1||

475.g: ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
475.t: mahalaa doojaa ||
475.e: Second Mehla:

475.g: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਜੇ ਕਰੇ ਆਪਿ ਜਾਈ ਭਿ ਰਖੈ ਆਪਿ ॥
475.t: aape saaje kare aap jaiee bh rakhai aap ||
475.e: He Himself creates and fashions the world, and He Himself keeps it in order.

475.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਦੇਖੈ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਿ ॥
475.t: tis vich ja(n)t upai kai dhekhai thaap uthaap ||
475.e: Having created the beings within it, He oversees their birth and death.

475.g: ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਹੀਐ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ॥੨॥
475.t: kis no kaheeaai naanakaa sabh kichh aape aap ||2||
475.e: Unto whom should we speak, O Nanak, when He Himself is all-in-all? ||2||

475.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
475.t: pauRee ||
475.e: Pauree:

475.g: ਵਡੇ ਕੀਆ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
475.t: vadde keeaa vaddiaaieeaa kichh kahanaa kahan na jai ||
475.e: The description of the greatness of the Great Lord cannot be described.

475.g: ਸੋ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਾਦਰ ਕਰੀਮੁ ਦੇ ਜੀਆ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸੰਬਾਹਿ ॥
475.t: so karataa kaadhar kareem dhe jeeaa rijak sa(n)baeh ||
475.e: He is the Creator, all-powerful and benevolent; He gives sustenance to all beings.

475.g: ਸਾਈ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਧੁਰਿ ਛੋਡੀ ਤਿੰਨੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
475.t: saiee kaar kamaavanee dhur chhoddee ti(n)nai pai ||
475.e: The mortal does that work, which has been pre-destined from the very beginning.

475.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੀ ਬਾਹਰੀ ਹੋਰ ਦੂਜੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
475.t: naanak ekee baaharee hor dhoojee naahee jai ||
475.e: O Nanak, except for the One Lord, there is no other place at all.

475.g: ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਜਿ ਤਿਸੈ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੨੪॥੧॥ ਸੁਧੁ
475.t: so kare j tisai rajai ||24||1|| sudhu
475.e: He does whatever He wills. ||24||1|| Sudh||

475.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
475.t: ikOankaar satinaam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) guraprasaadh ||
475.e: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

475.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ॥
475.t: raag aasaa baanee bhagataa kee ||
475.e: Raag Aasaa, The Word Of The Devotees:

475.g: ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਜੀਉ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੀਉ ॥
475.t: kabeer jeeau naamadheau jeeau ravidhaas jeeau ||
475.e: Kabeer, Naam Dayv And Ravi Daas.

475.g: ਆਸਾ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ॥
475.t: aasaa sree kabeer jeeau ||
475.e: Aasaa, Kabeer Jee:

475.g: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣ ਲਾਗਿ ਹਮ ਬਿਨਵਤਾ ਪੂਛਤ ਕਹ ਜੀਉ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
475.t: gur charan laag ham binavataa poochhat keh jeeau paiaa ||
475.e: Falling at the Feet of the Guru, I pray, and ask Him, ""Why was man created?

475.g: ਕਵਨ ਕਾਜਿ ਜਗੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਕਹਹੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਸਮਝਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
475.t: kavan kaaj jag upajai binasai kahahu moh samajhaiaa ||1||
475.e: What deeds cause the world to come into being, and be destroyed? Tell me, that I may understand.""||1||

475.g: ਦੇਵ ਕਰਹੁ ਦਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਭੈ ਬੰਧਨ ਤੂਟੈ ॥
475.t: dhev karahu dhiaa moh maarag laavahu jit bhai ba(n)dhan tooTai ||
475.e: O Divine Guru, please, show Mercy to me, and place me on the right path, by which the bonds of fear may be cut away.

475.g: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਦੁਖ ਫੇੜ ਕਰਮ ਸੁਖ ਜੀਅ ਜਨਮ ਤੇ ਛੂਟੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
475.t: janam maran dhukh feR karam sukh jeea janam te chhooTai ||1|| rahaau ||
475.e: The pains of birth and death come from past actions and karma; peace comes when the soul finds release from reincarnation. ||1||Pause||

475.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਫਾਸ ਬੰਧ ਨਹੀ ਫਾਰੈ ਅਰੁ ਮਨ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਨ ਲੂਕੇ ॥
475.t: maiaa faas ba(n)dh nahee faarai ar man su(n)n na looke ||
475.e: The mortal does not break free from the bonds of the noose of Maya, and he does not seek the shelter of the profound, absolute Lord.

475.g: ਆਪਾ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੁ ਨ ਚੀਨਿੑਆ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਅਭਿਉ ਨ ਚੂਕੇ ॥੨॥
475.t: aapaa padh nirabaan na cheeni(h)aa in bidh abhiau na chooke ||2||
475.e: He does not realize the dignity of the self, and Nirvaanaa; because of this, his doubt does not depart. ||2||

475.g: ਕਹੀ ਨ ਉਪਜੈ ਉਪਜੀ ਜਾਣੈ ਭਾਵ ਅਭਾਵ ਬਿਹੂਣਾ ॥
475.t: kahee na upajai upajee jaanai bhaav abhaav bihoonaa ||
475.e: The soul is not born, even though he thinks it is born; it is free from birth and death.

475.g: ਉਦੈ ਅਸਤ ਕੀ ਮਨ ਬੁਧਿ ਨਾਸੀ ਤਉ ਸਦਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਲਿਵ ਲੀਣਾ ॥੩॥
475.t: audhai asat kee man budh naasee tau sadhaa sahaj liv leenaa ||3||
475.e: When the mortal gives up his ideas of birth and death, he remains constantly absorbed in the Lord's Love. ||3||

475.g: ਜਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਬਿੰਬੁ ਬਿੰਬ ਕਉ ਮਿਲੀ ਹੈ ਉਦਕ ਕੁੰਭੁ ਬਿਗਰਾਨਾ ॥
475.t: jiau pratibi(n)b bi(n)b kau milee hai udhak ku(n)bh bigaraanaa ||
475.e: As the reflection of an object blends in the water when the pitcher is broken,

475.g: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਐਸਾ ਗੁਣ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਾਗਾ ਤਉ ਮਨੁ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਸਮਾਨਾਂ ॥੪॥੧॥
475.t: kahu kabeer aaisaa gun bhram bhaagaa tau man su(n)n samaanaa(n) ||4||1||
475.e: says Kabeer, just so virtue dispels doubt, and then the soul is absorbed in the profound, absolute Lord. ||4||1||

476.g: ਆਸਾ ॥
476.t: aasaa ||
476.e: Aasaa:

476.g: ਗਜ ਸਾਢੇ ਤੈ ਤੈ ਧੋਤੀਆ ਤਿਹਰੇ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਤਗ ॥
476.t: gaj saadde tai tai dhoteeaa tihare pain tag ||
476.e: They wear loin cloths, three and a half yards long, and triple-wound sacred threads.

476.g: ਗਲੀ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਜਪਮਾਲੀਆ ਲੋਟੇ ਹਥਿ ਨਿਬਗ ॥
476.t: galee jin(h)aa japamaaleeaa loTe hath nibag ||
476.e: They have rosaries around their necks, and they carry glittering jugs in their hands.

476.g: ਓਇ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਨ ਆਖੀਅਹਿ ਬਾਨਾਰਸਿ ਕੇ ਠਗ ॥੧॥
476.t: oi har ke sa(n)t na aakhe'eeh baanaaras ke Thag ||1||
476.e: They are not called Saints of the Lord - they are thugs of Benares. ||1||

476.g: ਐਸੇ ਸੰਤ ਨ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਭਾਵਹਿ ॥
476.t: aaise sa(n)t na mo kau bhaaveh ||
476.e: Such 'saints' are not pleasing to me;

476.g: ਡਾਲਾ ਸਿਉ ਪੇਡਾ ਗਟਕਾਵਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
476.t: ddaalaa siau peddaa gaTakaaveh ||1|| rahaau ||
476.e: they eat the trees along with the branches. ||1||Pause||

476.g: ਬਾਸਨ ਮਾਂਜਿ ਚਰਾਵਹਿ ਊਪਰਿ ਕਾਠੀ ਧੋਇ ਜਲਾਵਹਿ ॥
476.t: baasan maa(n)j charaaveh uoopar kaaThee dhoi jalaaveh ||
476.e: They wash their pots and pans before putting them on the stove, and they wash the wood before lighting it.

476.g: ਬਸੁਧਾ ਖੋਦਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਦੁਇ ਚੂਲੇੑ ਸਾਰੇ ਮਾਣਸ ਖਾਵਹਿ ॥੨॥
476.t: basudhaa khodh kareh dhui choole(h) saare maanas khaaveh ||2||
476.e: They dig up the earth and make two fireplaces, but they eat the whole person! ||2||

476.g: ਓਇ ਪਾਪੀ ਸਦਾ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਅਪਰਸ ਕਹਾਵਹਿ ॥
476.t: oi paapee sadhaa fireh aparaadhee mukhahu aparas kahaaveh ||
476.e: Those sinners continually wander in evil deeds, while they call themselves touch-nothing saints.

476.g: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ਸਗਲ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਡੁਬਾਵਹਿ ॥੩॥
476.t: sadhaa sadhaa fireh abhimaanee sagal kuTa(n)b ddubaaveh ||3||
476.e: They wander around forever and ever in their self-conceit, and all their families are drowned. ||3||

476.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਕੋ ਲਾਇਆ ਤਿਤ ਹੀ ਲਾਗਾ ਤੈਸੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
476.t: jit ko laiaa tit hee laagaa taise karam kamaavai ||
476.e: He is attached to that, to which the Lord has attached him, and he acts accordingly.

476.g: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਪੁਨਰਪਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥੪॥੨॥
476.t: kahu kabeer jis satigur bheTai punarap janam na aavai ||4||2||
476.e: Says Kabeer, one who meets the True Guru, is not reincarnated again. ||4||2||

476.g: ਆਸਾ ॥
476.t: aasaa ||
476.e: Aasaa:

476.g: ਬਾਪਿ ਦਿਲਾਸਾ ਮੇਰੋ ਕੀਨੑਾ ॥ ਸੇਜ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਦੀਨੑਾ ॥
476.t: baap dhilaasaa mero keen(h)aa || sej sukhaalee mukh a(n)mrit dheen(h)aa ||
476.e: My Father has comforted me. He has given me a cozy bed, and placed His Ambrosial Nectar in my mouth.

476.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਾਪ ਕਉ ਕਿਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀ ॥
476.t: tis baap kau kiau manahu visaaree ||
476.e: How could I forget that Father from my mind?

476.g: ਆਗੈ ਗਇਆ ਨ ਬਾਜੀ ਹਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
476.t: aagai giaa na baajee haaree ||1||
476.e: When I go to the world hereafter, I shall not lose the game. ||1||

476.g: ਮੁਈ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ਹਉ ਖਰਾ ਸੁਖਾਲਾ ॥
476.t: muiee meree maiee hau kharaa sukhaalaa ||
476.e: Maya is dead, O mother, and I am very happy.

476.g: ਪਹਿਰਉ ਨਹੀ ਦਗਲੀ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਪਾਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
476.t: pahirau nahee dhagalee lagai na paalaa ||1|| rahaau ||
476.e: I do not wear the patched coat, nor do I feel the chill. ||1||Pause||

476.g: ਬਲਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਾਪੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਉ ਜਾਇਆ ॥
476.t: bal tis baapai jin hau jaiaa ||
476.e: I am a sacrifice to my Father, who gave me life.

476.g: ਪੰਚਾ ਤੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੰਗੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
476.t: pa(n)chaa te meraa sa(n)g chukaiaa ||
476.e: He put an end to my association with the five deadly sins.

476.g: ਪੰਚ ਮਾਰਿ ਪਾਵਾ ਤਲਿ ਦੀਨੇ ॥
476.t: pa(n)ch maar paavaa tal dheene ||
476.e: I have conquered those five demons, and trampled them underfoot.

476.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਭੀਨੇ ॥੨॥
476.t: har simaran meraa man tan bheene ||2||
476.e: Remembering the Lord in meditation, my mind and body are drenched with His Love. ||2||

476.g: ਪਿਤਾ ਹਮਾਰੋ ਵਡ ਗੋਸਾਈ ॥
476.t: pitaa hamaaro vadd gosaiee ||
476.e: My Father is the Great Lord of the Universe.

476.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਪਿਤਾ ਪਹਿ ਹਉ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
476.t: tis pitaa peh hau kiau kar jaiee ||
476.e: How shall I go to that Father?

476.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲੇ ਤ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
476.t: satigur mile ta maarag dhikhaiaa ||
476.e: When I met the True Guru, He showed me the Way.

476.g: ਜਗਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
476.t: jagat pitaa merai man bhaiaa ||3||
476.e: The Father of the Universe is pleasing to my mind. ||3||

476.g: ਹਉ ਪੂਤੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂੰ ਬਾਪੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
476.t: hau poot teraa too(n) baap meraa ||
476.e: I am Your son, and You are my Father.

476.g: ਏਕੈ ਠਾਹਰ ਦੁਹਾ ਬਸੇਰਾ ॥
476.t: ekai Thaahar dhuhaa baseraa ||
476.e: We both dwell in the same place.

476.g: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਜਨਿ ਏਕੋ ਬੂਝਿਆ ॥
476.t: kahu kabeer jan eko boojhiaa ||
476.e: Says Kabeer, the Lord's humble servant knows only the One.

476.g: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਮੈ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੂਝਿਆ ॥੪॥੩॥
476.t: gur prasaadh mai sabh kichh soojhiaa ||4||3||
476.e: By Guru's Grace, I have come to know everything. ||4||3||

476.g: ਆਸਾ ॥
476.t: aasaa ||
476.e: Aasaa:

476.g: ਇਕਤੁ ਪਤਰਿ ਭਰਿ ਉਰਕਟ ਕੁਰਕਟ ਇਕਤੁ ਪਤਰਿ ਭਰਿ ਪਾਨੀ ॥
476.t: eikat patar bhar urakaT kurakaT ikat patar bhar paanee ||
476.e: In one pot, they put a boiled chicken, and in the other pot, they put wine.

476.g: ਆਸਿ ਪਾਸਿ ਪੰਚ ਜੋਗੀਆ ਬੈਠੇ ਬੀਚਿ ਨਕਟ ਦੇ ਰਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
476.t: aas paas pa(n)ch jogeeaa baiThe beech nakaT dhe raanee ||1||
476.e: The five Yogis of the Tantric ritual sit there, and in their midst sits the noseless one, the shameless queen. ||1||

476.g: ਨਕਟੀ ਕੋ ਠਨਗਨੁ ਬਾਡਾ ਡੂੰ ॥
476.t: nakaTee ko Thanagan baaddaa ddoo(n) ||
476.e: The bell of the shameless queen, Maya, rings in both worlds.

476.g: ਕਿਨਹਿ ਬਿਬੇਕੀ ਕਾਟੀ ਤੂੰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
476.t: kineh bibekee kaaTee too(n) ||1|| rahaau ||
476.e: Some rare person of discriminating wisdom has cut off your nose. ||1||Pause||

476.g: ਸਗਲ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਕਟੀ ਕਾ ਵਾਸਾ ਸਗਲ ਮਾਰਿ ਅਉਹੇਰੀ ॥
476.t: sagal maeh nakaTee kaa vaasaa sagal maar aauheree ||
476.e: Within all dwells the noseless Maya, who kills all, and destroys them.

476.g: ਸਗਲਿਆ ਕੀ ਹਉ ਬਹਿਨ ਭਾਨਜੀ ਜਿਨਹਿ ਬਰੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਚੇਰੀ ॥੨॥
476.t: sagaliaa kee hau bahin bhaanajee jineh baree tis cheree ||2||
476.e: She says, ""I am the sister, and the daughter of the sister of everyone; I am the hand-maiden of one who marries me.""||2||

476.g: ਹਮਰੋ ਭਰਤਾ ਬਡੋ ਬਿਬੇਕੀ ਆਪੇ ਸੰਤੁ ਕਹਾਵੈ ॥
476.t: hamaro bharataa baddo bibekee aape sa(n)t kahaavai ||
476.e: My Husband is the Great One of discriminating wisdom; He alone is called a Saint.

476.g: ਓਹੁ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਮਾਥੈ ਕਾਇਮੁ ਅਉਰੁ ਹਮਰੈ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥੩॥
476.t: oh hamaarai maathai kaim aaur hamarai nikaT na aavai ||3||
476.e: He stands by me, and no one else comes near me. ||3||

476.g: ਨਾਕਹੁ ਕਾਟੀ ਕਾਨਹੁ ਕਾਟੀ ਕਾਟਿ ਕੂਟਿ ਕੈ ਡਾਰੀ ॥
476.t: naakahu kaaTee kaanahu kaaTee kaaT kooT kai ddaaree ||
476.e: I have cut off her nose, and cut off her ears, and cutting her into bits, I have expelled her.

476.g: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਬੈਰਨਿ ਤੀਨਿ ਲੋਕ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੪॥੪॥
476.t: kahu kabeer sa(n)tan kee bairan teen lok kee piaaree ||4||4||
476.e: Says Kabeer, she is the darling of the three worlds, but the enemy of the Saints. ||4||4||

476.g: ਆਸਾ ॥
476.t: aasaa ||
476.e: Aasaa:

476.g: ਜੋਗੀ ਜਤੀ ਤਪੀ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਬਹੁ ਤੀਰਥ ਭ੍ਰਮਨਾ ॥
476.t: jogee jatee tapee sa(n)niaasee bahu teerath bhramanaa ||
476.e: The Yogis, celibates, penitents and Sannyaasees make pilgrimages to all the sacred places.

476.g: ਲੁੰਜਿਤ ਮੁੰਜਿਤ ਮੋਨਿ ਜਟਾਧਰ ਅੰਤਿ ਤਊ ਮਰਨਾ ॥੧॥
476.t: lu(n)jit mu(n)jit mon jaTaadhar a(n)t tuoo maranaa ||1||
476.e: The Jains with shaven heads, the silent ones, the beggars with matted hair - in the end, they all shall die. ||1||

476.g: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਸੇਵੀਅਲੇ ਰਾਮਨਾ ॥
476.t: taa te seveeale raamanaa ||
476.e: Meditate, therefore, on the Lord.

476.g: ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਹਿਤੁ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕਹਾ ਕਰੈ ਜਮਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
476.t: rasanaa raam naam hit jaa kai kahaa karai jamanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
476.e: What can the Messenger of Death do to one whose tongue loves the Name of the Lord? ||1||Pause||

476.g: ਆਗਮ ਨਿਰਗਮ ਜੋਤਿਕ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਆਕਰਨਾ ॥
476.t: aagam niragam jotik jaaneh bahu bahu biaakaranaa ||
476.e: Those who know the Shaastras and the Vedas, astrology and the rules of grammar of many languages;

477.g: ਤੰਤ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਸਭ ਅਉਖਧ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਤਊ ਮਰਨਾ ॥੨॥
477.t: ta(n)t ma(n)tr sabh aaukhadh jaaneh a(n)t tuoo maranaa ||2||
477.e: those who know Tantras and mantras and all medicines - even they shall die in the end. ||2||

477.g: ਰਾਜ ਭੋਗ ਅਰੁ ਛਤ੍ਰ ਸਿੰਘਾਸਨ ਬਹੁ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਰਮਨਾ ॥
477.t: raaj bhog ar chhatr si(n)ghaasan bahu su(n)dhar ramanaa ||
477.e: Those who enjoy regal power and rule, royal canopies and thrones, many beautiful women,

477.g: ਪਾਨ ਕਪੂਰ ਸੁਬਾਸਕ ਚੰਦਨ ਅੰਤਿ ਤਊ ਮਰਨਾ ॥੩॥
477.t: paan kapoor subaasak cha(n)dhan a(n)t tuoo maranaa ||3||
477.e: betel nuts, camphor and fragrant sandalwood oil - in the end, they too shall die. ||3||

477.g: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਭ ਖੋਜੇ ਕਹੂ ਨ ਊਬਰਨਾ ॥
477.t: bedh puraan si(n)mirat sabh khoje kahoo na uoobaranaa ||
477.e: I have searched all the Vedas, Puraanas and Simritees, but none of these can save anyone.

477.g: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਇਉ ਰਾਮਹਿ ਜੰਪਉ ਮੇਟਿ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨਾ ॥੪॥੫॥
477.t: kahu kabeer iau raameh ja(n)pau meT janam maranaa ||4||5||
477.e: Says Kabeer, meditate on the Lord, and eliminate birth and death. ||4||5||

477.g: ਆਸਾ ॥
477.t: aasaa ||
477.e: Aasaa:

477.g: ਫੀਲੁ ਰਬਾਬੀ ਬਲਦੁ ਪਖਾਵਜ ਕਊਆ ਤਾਲ ਬਜਾਵੈ ॥
477.t: feel rabaabee baladh pakhaavaj kuooaa taal bajaavai ||
477.e: The elephant is the guitar player, the ox is the drummer, and the crow plays the cymbals.

477.g: ਪਹਿਰਿ ਚੋਲਨਾ ਗਦਹਾ ਨਾਚੈ ਭੈਸਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
477.t: pahir cholanaa gadhahaa naachai bhaisaa bhagat karaavai ||1||
477.e: Putting on the skirt, the donkey dances around, and the water buffalo performs devotional worship. ||1||

477.g: ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਕਕਰੀਆ ਬਰੇ ਪਕਾਏ ॥
477.t: raajaa raam kakareeaa bare pakaae ||
477.e: The Lord, the King, has cooked the cakes of ice,

477.g: ਕਿਨੈ ਬੂਝਨਹਾਰੈ ਖਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
477.t: kinai boojhanahaarai khaae ||1|| rahaau ||
477.e: but only the rare man of understanding eats them. ||1||Pause||

477.g: ਬੈਠਿ ਸਿੰਘੁ ਘਰਿ ਪਾਨ ਲਗਾਵੈ ਘੀਸ ਗਲਉਰੇ ਲਿਆਵੈ ॥
477.t: baiTh si(n)gh ghar paan lagaavai ghees galaure liaavai ||
477.e: Sitting in his den, the lion prepares the betel leaves, and the muskrat brings the betel nuts.

477.g: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਮੁਸਰੀ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਕਛੂਆ ਸੰਖੁ ਬਜਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
477.t: ghar ghar musaree ma(n)gal gaaveh kachhooaa sa(n)kh bajaavai ||2||
477.e: Going from house to house, the mouse sings the songs of joy, and the turtle blows on the conch-shell. ||2||

477.g: ਬੰਸ ਕੋ ਪੂਤੁ ਬੀਆਹਨ ਚਲਿਆ ਸੁਇਨੇ ਮੰਡਪ ਛਾਏ ॥
477.t: ba(n)s ko poot beeaahan chaliaa suine ma(n)ddap chhaae ||
477.e: The son of the sterile woman goes to get married, and the golden canopy is spread out for him.

477.g: ਰੂਪ ਕੰਨਿਆ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਬੇਧੀ ਸਸੈ ਸਿੰਘ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ॥੩॥
477.t: roop ka(n)niaa su(n)dhar bedhee sasai si(n)gh gun gaae ||3||
477.e: He marries a beautiful and enticing young woman; the rabbit and the lion sing their praises. ||3||

477.g: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਕੀਟੀ ਪਰਬਤੁ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
477.t: kahat kabeer sunahu re sa(n)tahu keeTee parabat khaiaa ||
477.e: Says Kabeer, listen, O Saints - the ant has eaten the mountain.

477.g: ਕਛੂਆ ਕਹੈ ਅੰਗਾਰ ਭਿ ਲੋਰਉ ਲੂਕੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਨਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੬॥
477.t: kachhooaa kahai a(n)gaar bh lorau lookee sabadh sunaiaa ||4||6||
477.e: The turtle says, ""I need a burning coal, also."" Listen to this mystery of the Shabad. ||4||6||

477.g: ਆਸਾ ॥
477.t: aasaa ||
477.e: Aasaa:

477.g: ਬਟੂਆ ਏਕੁ ਬਹਤਰਿ ਆਧਾਰੀ ਏਕੋ ਜਿਸਹਿ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥
477.t: baTooaa ek bahatar aadhaaree eko jiseh dhuaaraa ||
477.e: The body is a bag with seventy-two chambers, and one opening, the Tenth Gate.

477.g: ਨਵੈ ਖੰਡ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮੀ ਮਾਗੈ ਸੋ ਜੋਗੀ ਜਗਿ ਸਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
477.t: navai kha(n)dd kee pirathamee maagai so jogee jag saaraa ||1||
477.e: He alone is a real Yogi on this earth, who asks for the primal world of the nine regions. ||1||

477.g: ਐਸਾ ਜੋਗੀ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
477.t: aaisaa jogee nau nidh paavai ||
477.e: Such a Yogi obtains the nine treasures.

477.g: ਤਲ ਕਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਲੇ ਗਗਨਿ ਚਰਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
477.t: tal kaa braham le gagan charaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
477.e: He lifts his soul up from below, to the skies of the Tenth Gate. ||1||Pause||

477.g: ਖਿੰਥਾ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਕਰਿ ਸੂਈ ਸਬਦੁ ਤਾਗਾ ਮਥਿ ਘਾਲੈ ॥
477.t: khi(n)thaa giaan dhiaan kar sooiee sabadh taagaa math ghaalai ||
477.e: He makes spiritual wisdom his patched coat, and meditation his needle. He twists the thread of the Word of the Shabad.

477.g: ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਕੀ ਕਰਿ ਮਿਰਗਾਣੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਚਾਲੈ ॥੨॥
477.t: pa(n)ch tat kee kar miragaanee gur kai maarag chaalai ||2||
477.e: Making the five elements his deer skin to sit on, he walks on the Guru's Path. ||2||

477.g: ਦਇਆ ਫਾਹੁਰੀ ਕਾਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਧੂਈ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕੀ ਅਗਨਿ ਜਲਾਵੈ ॥
477.t: dhiaa faahuree kaiaa kar dhooiee dhirasaT kee agan jalaavai ||
477.e: He makes compassion his shovel, his body the firewood, and he kindles the fire of divine vision.

477.g: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਭਾਉ ਲਏ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
477.t: tis kaa bhaau le ridh a(n)tar chahu jug taaRee laavai ||3||
477.e: He places love within his heart, and he remains in deep meditation throughout the four ages. ||3||

477.g: ਸਭ ਜੋਗਤਣ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਪਰਾਨਾ ॥
477.t: sabh jogatan raam naam hai jis kaa pi(n)dd paraanaa ||
477.e: All Yoga is in the Name of the Lord; the body and the breath of life belong to Him.

477.g: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੈ ਦੇਇ ਸਚਾ ਨੀਸਾਨਾ ॥੪॥੭॥
477.t: kahu kabeer je kirapaa dhaarai dhei sachaa neesaanaa ||4||7||
477.e: Says Kabeer, if God grants His Grace, He bestows the insignia of Truth. ||4||7||

477.g: ਆਸਾ ॥
477.t: aasaa ||
477.e: Aasaa:

477.g: ਹਿੰਦੂ ਤੁਰਕ ਕਹਾ ਤੇ ਆਏ ਕਿਨਿ ਏਹ ਰਾਹ ਚਲਾਈ ॥
477.t: hi(n)dhoo turak kahaa te aae kin eh raeh chalaiee ||
477.e: Where have the Hindus and Muslims come from? Who put them on their different paths?

477.g: ਦਿਲ ਮਹਿ ਸੋਚਿ ਬਿਚਾਰਿ ਕਵਾਦੇ ਭਿਸਤ ਦੋਜਕ ਕਿਨਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
477.t: dhil meh soch bichaar kavaadhe bhisat dhojak kin paiee ||1||
477.e: Think of this, and contemplate it within your mind, O men of evil intentions. Who will go to heaven and hell? ||1||

477.g: ਕਾਜੀ ਤੈ ਕਵਨ ਕਤੇਬ ਬਖਾਨੀ ॥
477.t: kaajee tai kavan kateb bakhaanee ||
477.e: O Qazi, which book have you read?

477.g: ਪੜ੍ਹਤ ਗੁਨਤ ਐਸੇ ਸਭ ਮਾਰੇ ਕਿਨਹੂੰ ਖਬਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
477.t: paRhat gunat aaise sabh maare kinahoo(n) khabar na jaanee ||1|| rahaau ||
477.e: Such scholars and students have all died, and none of them have discovered the inner meaning. ||1||Pause||

477.g: ਸਕਤਿ ਸਨੇਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਸੁੰਨਤਿ ਕਰੀਐ ਮੈ ਨ ਬਦਉਗਾ ਭਾਈ ॥
477.t: sakat saneh kar su(n)nat kareeaai mai na badhaugaa bhaiee ||
477.e: Because of the love of woman, circumcision is done; I don't believe in it, O Siblings of Destiny.

477.g: ਜਉ ਰੇ ਖੁਦਾਇ ਮੋਹਿ ਤੁਰਕੁ ਕਰੈਗਾ ਆਪਨ ਹੀ ਕਟਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
477.t: jau re khudhai moh turak karaigaa aapan hee kaT jaiee ||2||
477.e: If God wished me to be a Muslim, it would be cut off by itself. ||2||

477.g: ਸੁੰਨਤਿ ਕੀਏ ਤੁਰਕੁ ਜੇ ਹੋਇਗਾ ਅਉਰਤ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੀਐ ॥
477.t: su(n)nat ke'ee turak je hoigaa aaurat kaa kiaa kareeaai ||
477.e: If circumcision makes one a Muslim, then what about a woman?

477.g: ਅਰਧ ਸਰੀਰੀ ਨਾਰਿ ਨ ਛੋਡੈ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਹਿੰਦੂ ਹੀ ਰਹੀਐ ॥੩॥
477.t: aradh sareeree naar na chhoddai taa te hi(n)dhoo hee raheeaai ||3||
477.e: She is the other half of a man's body, and she does not leave him, so he remains a Hindu. ||3||

477.g: ਛਾਡਿ ਕਤੇਬ ਰਾਮੁ ਭਜੁ ਬਉਰੇ ਜੁਲਮ ਕਰਤ ਹੈ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
477.t: chhaadd kateb raam bhaj baure julam karat hai bhaaree ||
477.e: Give up your holy books, and remember the Lord, you fool, and stop oppressing others so badly.

477.g: ਕਬੀਰੈ ਪਕਰੀ ਟੇਕ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਤੁਰਕ ਰਹੇ ਪਚਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੮॥
477.t: kabeerai pakaree Tek raam kee turak rahe pachihaaree ||4||8||
477.e: Kabeer has grasped hold of the Lord's Support, and the Muslims have utterly failed. ||4||8||

477.g: ਆਸਾ ॥
477.t: aasaa ||
477.e: Aasaa:

477.g: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਤੇਲੁ ਦੀਵੇ ਮੁਖਿ ਬਾਤੀ ਤਬ ਸੂਝੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
477.t: jab lag tel dheeve mukh baatee tab soojhai sabh koiee ||
477.e: As long as the oil and the wick are in the lamp, everything is illuminated.

478.g: ਤੇਲ ਜਲੇ ਬਾਤੀ ਠਹਰਾਨੀ ਸੂੰਨਾ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
478.t: tel jale baatee Thaharaanee soo(n)naa ma(n)dhar hoiee ||1||
478.e: But when the oil is burnt, the wick goes out, and the mansion becomes desolate. ||1||

478.g: ਰੇ ਬਉਰੇ ਤੁਹਿ ਘਰੀ ਨ ਰਾਖੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
478.t: re baure tuh gharee na raakhai koiee ||
478.e: O mad-man, no one will keep you, for even a moment.

478.g: ਤੂੰ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
478.t: too(n) raam naam jap soiee ||1|| rahaau ||
478.e: Meditate on the Name of that Lord. ||1||Pause||

478.g: ਕਾ ਕੀ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਕਹੁ ਕਾ ਕੋ ਕਵਨ ਪੁਰਖ ਕੀ ਜੋਈ ॥
478.t: kaa kee maat pitaa kahu kaa ko kavan purakh kee joiee ||
478.e: Tell me, whose mother is that, whose father is that, and which man has a wife?

478.g: ਘਟ ਫੂਟੇ ਕੋਊ ਬਾਤ ਨ ਪੂਛੈ ਕਾਢਹੁ ਕਾਢਹੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੨॥
478.t: ghaT fooTe kouoo baat na poochhai kaaddahu kaaddahu hoiee ||2||
478.e: When the pitcher of the body breaks, no one cares for you at all. Everyone says, ""Take him away, take him away!""||2||

478.g: ਦੇਹੁਰੀ ਬੈਠੀ ਮਾਤਾ ਰੋਵੈ ਖਟੀਆ ਲੇ ਗਏ ਭਾਈ ॥
478.t: dhehuree baiThee maataa rovai khaTeeaa le ge bhaiee ||
478.e: Sitting on the threshold, his mother cries, and his brothers take away the coffin.

478.g: ਲਟ ਛਿਟਕਾਏ ਤਿਰੀਆ ਰੋਵੈ ਹੰਸੁ ਇਕੇਲਾ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
478.t: laT chhiTakaae tireeaa rovai ha(n)s ikelaa jaiee ||3||
478.e: Taking down her hair, his wife cries out in sorrow, and the swan-soul departs all alone. ||3||

478.g: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਭੈ ਸਾਗਰ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ ॥
478.t: kahat kabeer sunahu re sa(n)tahu bhai saagar kai taiee ||
478.e: Says Kabeer, listen, O Saints, about the terrifying world-ocean.

478.g: ਇਸੁ ਬੰਦੇ ਸਿਰਿ ਜੁਲਮੁ ਹੋਤ ਹੈ ਜਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਹਟੈ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥੪॥੯॥
478.t: eis ba(n)dhe sir julam hot hai jam nahee haTai gusaiee ||4||9||
478.e: This human suffers torture and the Messenger of Death will not leave him alone, O Lord of the World. ||4||9||

478.g: ਦੁਤੁਕੇ
478.t: dhutuke
478.e: Dho-Thukay

478.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
478.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
478.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

478.g: ਆਸਾ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਇਕਤੁਕੇ ॥
478.t: aasaa sree kabeer jeeau ke chaupadhe ikatuke ||
478.e: Aasaa Of Kabeer Jee, Chau-Padhay, Ek-Thukay:

478.g: ਸਨਕ ਸਨੰਦ ਅੰਤੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
478.t: sanak sana(n)dh a(n)t nahee paiaa ||
478.e: Sanak and Sanand, the sons of Brahma, could not find the Lord's limits.

478.g: ਬੇਦ ਪੜੇ ਪੜਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
478.t: bedh paRe paR brahame janam gavaiaa ||1||
478.e: Brahma wasted his life away, continually reading the Vedas. ||1||

478.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਬਿਲੋਵਨਾ ਬਿਲੋਵਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
478.t: har kaa bilovanaa bilovahu mere bhaiee ||
478.e: Churn the churn of the Lord, O my Siblings of Destiny.

478.g: ਸਹਜਿ ਬਿਲੋਵਹੁ ਜੈਸੇ ਤਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
478.t: sahaj bilovahu jaise tat na jaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
478.e: Churn it steadily, so that the essence, the butter, may not be lost. ||1||Pause||

478.g: ਤਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਟੁਕੀ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਬਿਲੋਈ ॥
478.t: tan kar maTukee man maeh biloiee ||
478.e: Make your body the churning jar, and use the stick of your mind to churn it.

478.g: ਇਸੁ ਮਟੁਕੀ ਮਹਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੰਜੋਈ ॥੨॥
478.t: eis maTukee meh sabadh sa(n)joiee ||2||
478.e: Gather the curds of the Word of the Shabad. ||2||

478.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਬਿਲੋਵਨਾ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
478.t: har kaa bilovanaa man kaa beechaaraa ||
478.e: The churning of the Lord is to reflect upon Him within your mind.

478.g: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਧਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
478.t: gur prasaadh paavai a(n)mirat dhaaraa ||3||
478.e: By Guru's Grace, the Ambrosial Nectar flows into us. ||3||

478.g: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਜੇ ਮਂੀਰਾ ॥
478.t: kahu kabeer nadhar kare je ma(n)eeraa ||
478.e: Says Kabeer, if the Lord, our King casts His Glance of Grace,

478.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਲਗਿ ਉਤਰੇ ਤੀਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੦॥
478.t: raam naam lag utare teeraa ||4||1||10||
478.e: one is carried across to the other side, holding fast to the Lord's Name. ||4||1||10||

478.g: ਆਸਾ ॥
478.t: aasaa ||
478.e: Aasaa:

478.g: ਬਾਤੀ ਸੂਕੀ ਤੇਲੁ ਨਿਖੂਟਾ ॥
478.t: baatee sookee tel nikhooTaa ||
478.e: The wick has dried up, and the oil is exhausted.

478.g: ਮੰਦਲੁ ਨ ਬਾਜੈ ਨਟੁ ਪੈ ਸੂਤਾ ॥੧॥
478.t: ma(n)dhal na baajai naT pai sootaa ||1||
478.e: The drum does not sound, and the actor has gone to sleep. ||1||

478.g: ਬੁਝਿ ਗਈ ਅਗਨਿ ਨ ਨਿਕਸਿਓ ਧੂੰਆ ॥
478.t: bujh giee agan na nikasio dhoo(n)aa ||
478.e: The fire has gone out, and no smoke is produced.

478.g: ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਏਕੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਦੂਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
478.t: rav rahiaa ek avar nahee dhooaa ||1|| rahaau ||
478.e: The One Lord is pervading and permeating everywhere; there is no other second. ||1||Pause||

478.g: ਟੂਟੀ ਤੰਤੁ ਨ ਬਜੈ ਰਬਾਬੁ ॥
478.t: TooTee ta(n)t na bajai rabaab ||
478.e: The string has broken, and the guitar makes no sound.

478.g: ਭੂਲਿ ਬਿਗਾਰਿਓ ਅਪਨਾ ਕਾਜੁ ॥੨॥
478.t: bhool bigaario apanaa kaaj ||2||
478.e: He mistakenly ruins his own affairs. ||2||

478.g: ਕਥਨੀ ਬਦਨੀ ਕਹਨੁ ਕਹਾਵਨੁ ॥ ਸਮਝਿ ਪਰੀ ਤਉ ਬਿਸਰਿਓ ਗਾਵਨੁ ॥੩॥
478.t: kathanee badhanee kahan kahaavan || samajh paree tau bisario gaavan ||3||
478.e: When one comes to understand, he forgets his preaching, ranting and raving, and arguing. ||3||

478.g: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਪੰਚ ਜੋ ਚੂਰੇ ॥ ਤਿਨ ਤੇ ਨਾਹਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਦੂਰੇ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੧॥
478.t: kahat kabeer pa(n)ch jo choore || tin te naeh param padh dhoore ||4||2||11||
478.e: Says Kabeer, the state of supreme dignity is never far from those who conquer the five demons of the body passions. ||4||2||11||

478.g: ਆਸਾ ॥
478.t: aasaa ||
478.e: Aasaa:

478.g: ਸੁਤੁ ਅਪਰਾਧ ਕਰਤ ਹੈ ਜੇਤੇ ॥
478.t: sut aparaadh karat hai jete ||
478.e: As many mistakes as the son commits,

478.g: ਜਨਨੀ ਚੀਤਿ ਨ ਰਾਖਸਿ ਤੇਤੇ ॥੧॥
478.t: jananee cheet na raakhas tete ||1||
478.e: his mother does not hold them against him in her mind. ||1||

478.g: ਰਾਮਈਆ ਹਉ ਬਾਰਿਕੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
478.t: raamieeaa hau baarik teraa ||
478.e: O Lord, I am Your child.

478.g: ਕਾਹੇ ਨ ਖੰਡਸਿ ਅਵਗਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
478.t: kaahe na kha(n)ddas avagan meraa ||1|| rahaau ||
478.e: Why not destroy my sins? ||1||Pause||

478.g: ਜੇ ਅਤਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਪ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਧਾਇਆ ॥
478.t: je at karop kare kar dhaiaa ||
478.e: If the son, in anger, runs away,

478.g: ਤਾ ਭੀ ਚੀਤਿ ਨ ਰਾਖਸਿ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
478.t: taa bhee cheet na raakhas maiaa ||2||
478.e: even then, his mother does not hold it against him in her mind. ||2||

478.g: ਚਿੰਤ ਭਵਨਿ ਮਨੁ ਪਰਿਓ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
478.t: chi(n)t bhavan man pario hamaaraa ||
478.e: My mind has fallen into the whirlpool of anxiety.

478.g: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਕੈਸੇ ਉਤਰਸਿ ਪਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
478.t: naam binaa kaise utaras paaraa ||3||
478.e: Without the Naam, how can I cross over to the other side? ||3||

478.g: ਦੇਹਿ ਬਿਮਲ ਮਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥
478.t: dheh bimal mat sadhaa sareeraa ||
478.e: Please, bless my body with pure and lasting understanding, Lord;

478.g: ਸਹਜਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਗੁਨ ਰਵੈ ਕਬੀਰਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੨॥
478.t: sahaj sahaj gun ravai kabeeraa ||4||3||12||
478.e: in peace and poise, Kabeer chants the Praises of the Lord. ||4||3||12||

478.g: ਆਸਾ ॥
478.t: aasaa ||
478.e: Aasaa:

478.g: ਹਜ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਗੋਮਤੀ ਤੀਰ ॥
478.t: haj hamaaree gomatee teer ||
478.e: My pilgrimage to Mecca is on the banks of the Gomati River;

478.g: ਜਹਾ ਬਸਹਿ ਪੀਤੰਬਰ ਪੀਰ ॥੧॥
478.t: jahaa baseh peeta(n)bar peer ||1||
478.e: the spiritual teacher in his yellow robes dwells there. ||1||

478.g: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਿਆ ਖੂਬੁ ਗਾਵਤਾ ਹੈ ॥
478.t: vaahu vaahu kiaa khoob gaavataa hai ||
478.e: Waaho! Waaho! Hail! Hail! How wondrously he sings.

478.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਤਾ ਹੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
478.t: har kaa naam merai man bhaavataa hai ||1|| rahaau ||
478.e: The Name of the Lord is pleasing to my mind. ||1||Pause||

479.g: ਨਾਰਦ ਸਾਰਦ ਕਰਹਿ ਖਵਾਸੀ ॥
479.t: naaradh saaradh kareh khavaasee ||
479.e: Naarada the sage, and Shaarada the goddess of knowledge, serve the Lord.

479.g: ਪਾਸਿ ਬੈਠੀ ਬੀਬੀ ਕਵਲਾ ਦਾਸੀ ॥੨॥
479.t: paas baiThee beebee kavalaa dhaasee ||2||
479.e: The goddess Lakhshmi sits by Him as His slave. ||2||

479.g: ਕੰਠੇ ਮਾਲਾ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਰਾਮੁ ॥
479.t: ka(n)The maalaa jihavaa raam ||
479.e: The mala is around my neck, and the Lord's Name is upon my tongue.

479.g: ਸਹੰਸ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈ ਲੈ ਕਰਉ ਸਲਾਮੁ ॥੩॥
479.t: saha(n)s naam lai lai karau salaam ||3||
479.e: I repeat the Naam, the Name of the Lord, a thousand times, and bow in reverence to Him. ||3||

479.g: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਰਾਮ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਉ ॥
479.t: kahat kabeer raam gun gaavau ||
479.e: Says Kabeer, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord;

479.g: ਹਿੰਦੂ ਤੁਰਕ ਦੋਊ ਸਮਝਾਵਉ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੩॥
479.t: hi(n)dhoo turak dhouoo samajhaavau ||4||4||13||
479.e: I teach both Hindus and Muslims. ||4||4||13||

479.g: ਆਸਾ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ ਪੰਚਪਦੇ ੯ ਦੁਤੁਕੇ ੫
479.t: aasaa sree kabeer jeeau ke pa(n)chapadhe 9 dhutuke 5
479.e: Aasaa, Kabeer Jee, 9 Panch-Padhay, 5 Dho-Thukay:

479.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
479.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
479.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

479.g: ਪਾਤੀ ਤੋਰੈ ਮਾਲਿਨੀ ਪਾਤੀ ਪਾਤੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
479.t: paatee torai maalinee paatee paatee jeeau ||
479.e: You tear off the leaves, O gardener, but in each and every leaf, there is life.

479.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਪਾਹਨ ਕਉ ਪਾਤੀ ਤੋਰੈ ਸੋ ਪਾਹਨ ਨਿਰਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
479.t: jis paahan kau paatee torai so paahan nirajeeau ||1||
479.e: That stone idol, for which you tear off those leaves - that stone idol is lifeless. ||1||

479.g: ਭੂਲੀ ਮਾਲਨੀ ਹੈ ਏਉ ॥
479.t: bhoolee maalanee hai eau ||
479.e: In this, you are mistaken, O gardener.

479.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਾਗਤਾ ਹੈ ਦੇਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
479.t: satigur jaagataa hai dheau ||1|| rahaau ||
479.e: The True Guru is the Living Lord. ||1||Pause||

479.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਾਤੀ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਡਾਰੀ ਫੂਲ ਸੰਕਰਦੇਉ ॥
479.t: braham paatee bisan ddaaree fool sa(n)karadheau ||
479.e: Brahma is in the leaves, Vishnu is in the branches, and Shiva is in the flowers.

479.g: ਤੀਨਿ ਦੇਵ ਪ੍ਰਤਖਿ ਤੋਰਹਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਕਿਸ ਕੀ ਸੇਉ ॥੨॥
479.t: teen dhev pratakh toreh kareh kis kee seau ||2||
479.e: When you break these three gods, whose service are you performing? ||2||

479.g: ਪਾਖਾਨ ਗਢਿ ਕੈ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਕੀਨੑੀ ਦੇ ਕੈ ਛਾਤੀ ਪਾਉ ॥
479.t: paakhaan gadd kai moorat keen(h)ee dhe kai chhaatee paau ||
479.e: The sculptor carves the stone and fashions it into an idol, placing his feet upon its chest.

479.g: ਜੇ ਏਹ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਸਾਚੀ ਹੈ ਤਉ ਗੜ੍ਹਣਹਾਰੇ ਖਾਉ ॥੩॥
479.t: je eh moorat saachee hai tau gaRhanahaare khaau ||3||
479.e: If this stone god was true, it would devour the sculptor for this! ||3||

479.g: ਭਾਤੁ ਪਹਿਤਿ ਅਰੁ ਲਾਪਸੀ ਕਰਕਰਾ ਕਾਸਾਰੁ ॥
479.t: bhaat pahit ar laapasee karakaraa kaasaar ||
479.e: Rice and beans, candies, cakes and cookies

479.g: ਭੋਗਨਹਾਰੇ ਭੋਗਿਆ ਇਸੁ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਕੇ ਮੁਖ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੪॥
479.t: bhoganahaare bhogiaa is moorat ke mukh chhaar ||4||
479.e: - the priest enjoys these, while he puts ashes into the mouth of the idol. ||4||

479.g: ਮਾਲਿਨਿ ਭੂਲੀ ਜਗੁ ਭੁਲਾਨਾ ਹਮ ਭੁਲਾਨੇ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
479.t: maalin bhoolee jag bhulaanaa ham bhulaane naeh ||
479.e: The gardener is mistaken, and the world is mistaken, but I am not mistaken.

479.g: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਹਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਖੇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥੫॥੧॥੧੪॥
479.t: kahu kabeer ham raam raakhe kirapaa kar har rai ||5||1||14||
479.e: Says Kabeer, the Lord preserves me; the Lord, my King, has showered His Blessings upon me. ||5||1||14||

479.g: ਆਸਾ ॥
479.t: aasaa ||
479.e: Aasaa:

479.g: ਬਾਰਹ ਬਰਸ ਬਾਲਪਨ ਬੀਤੇ ਬੀਸ ਬਰਸ ਕਛੁ ਤਪੁ ਨ ਕੀਓ ॥
479.t: baareh baras baalapan beete bees baras kachh tap na keeo ||
479.e: Twelve years pass in childhood, and for another twenty years, he does not practice self-discipline and austerity.

479.g: ਤੀਸ ਬਰਸ ਕਛੁ ਦੇਵ ਨ ਪੂਜਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਨਾ ਬਿਰਧਿ ਭਇਓ ॥੧॥
479.t: tees baras kachh dhev na poojaa fir pachhutaanaa biradh bhio ||1||
479.e: For another thirty years, he does not worship God in any way, and then, when he is old, he repents and regrets. ||1||

479.g: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਤੇ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਇਓ ॥
479.t: meree meree karate janam gio ||
479.e: His life wastes away as he cries out, ""Mine, mine!""

479.g: ਸਾਇਰੁ ਸੋਖਿ ਭੁਜੰ ਬਲਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
479.t: sair sokh bhuja(n) balio ||1|| rahaau ||
479.e: The pool of his power has dried up. ||1||Pause||

479.g: ਸੂਕੇ ਸਰਵਰਿ ਪਾਲਿ ਬੰਧਾਵੈ ਲੂਣੈ ਖੇਤਿ ਹਥ ਵਾਰਿ ਕਰੈ ॥
479.t: sooke saravar paal ba(n)dhaavai loonai khet hath vaar karai ||
479.e: He makes a dam around the dried-up pool, and with his hands, he makes a fence around the harvested field.

479.g: ਆਇਓ ਚੋਰੁ ਤੁਰੰਤਹ ਲੇ ਗਇਓ ਮੇਰੀ ਰਾਖਤ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਫਿਰੈ ॥੨॥
479.t: aaio chor tura(n)teh le gio meree raakhat mugadh firai ||2||
479.e: When the thief of Death comes, he quickly carries away what the fool had tried to preserve as his own. ||2||

479.g: ਚਰਨ ਸੀਸੁ ਕਰ ਕੰਪਨ ਲਾਗੇ ਨੈਨੀ ਨੀਰੁ ਅਸਾਰ ਬਹੈ ॥
479.t: charan sees kar ka(n)pan laage nainee neer asaar bahai ||
479.e: His feet and head and hands begin to tremble, and the tears flow copiously from his eyes.

479.g: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਬਚਨੁ ਸੁਧੁ ਨਹੀ ਨਿਕਸੈ ਤਬ ਰੇ ਧਰਮ ਕੀ ਆਸ ਕਰੈ ॥੩॥
479.t: jihavaa bachan sudh nahee nikasai tab re dharam kee aas karai ||3||
479.e: His tongue has not spoken the correct words, but now, he hopes to practice religion! ||3||

479.g: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵੈ ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੀਓ ॥
479.t: har jeeau kirapaa karai liv laavai laahaa har har naam leeo ||
479.e: If the Dear Lord shows His Mercy, one enshrines love for Him, and obtains the Profit of the Lord's Name.

479.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਅੰਤੇ ਚਲਦਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਚਲਿਓ ॥੪॥
479.t: gur parasaadhee har dhan paio a(n)te chaladhiaa naal chalio ||4||
479.e: By Guru's Grace, he receives the wealth of the Lord's Name, which alone shall go with him, when he departs in the end. ||4||

479.g: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਅਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਕਛੂਐ ਲੈ ਨ ਗਇਓ ॥
479.t: kahat kabeer sunahu re sa(n)tahu an dhan kachhooaai lai na gio ||
479.e: Says Kabeer, listen, O Saints - he shall not take any other wealth with him.

479.g: ਆਈ ਤਲਬ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਰਾਇ ਕੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੰਦਰ ਛੋਡਿ ਚਲਿਓ ॥੫॥੨॥੧੫॥
479.t: aaiee talab gopaal rai kee maiaa ma(n)dhar chhodd chalio ||5||2||15||
479.e: When the summons comes from the King, the Lord of the Universe, the mortal departs, leaving behind his wealth and mansions. ||5||2||15||

479.g: ਆਸਾ ॥
479.t: aasaa ||
479.e: Aasaa:

479.g: ਕਾਹੂ ਦੀਨੑੇ ਪਾਟ ਪਟੰਬਰ ਕਾਹੂ ਪਲਘ ਨਿਵਾਰਾ ॥
479.t: kaahoo dheen(h)e paaT paTa(n)bar kaahoo palagh nivaaraa ||
479.e: To some, the Lord has given silks and satins, and to some, beds decorated with cotton ribbons.

479.g: ਕਾਹੂ ਗਰੀ ਗੋਦਰੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਾਹੂ ਖਾਨ ਪਰਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
479.t: kaahoo garee godharee naahee kaahoo khaan paraaraa ||1||
479.e: Some do not even have a poor patched coat, and some live in thatched huts. ||1||

479.g: ਅਹਿਰਖ ਵਾਦੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਰੇ ਮਨ ॥
479.t: ahirakh vaadh na keejai re man ||
479.e: Do not indulge in envy and bickering, O my mind.

479.g: ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਲੀਜੈ ਰੇ ਮਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
479.t: sukirat kar kar leejai re man ||1|| rahaau ||
479.e: By continually doing good deeds, these are obtained, O my mind. ||1||Pause||

479.g: ਕੁਮੑਾਰੈ ਏਕ ਜੁ ਮਾਟੀ ਗੂੰਧੀ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਬਾਨੀ ਲਾਈ ॥
479.t: kum(h)aarai ek ju maaTee goo(n)dhee bahu bidh baanee laiee ||
479.e: The potter works the same clay, and colors the pots in different ways.

479.g: ਕਾਹੂ ਮਹਿ ਮੋਤੀ ਮੁਕਤਾਹਲ ਕਾਹੂ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਲਗਾਈ ॥੨॥
479.t: kaahoo meh motee mukataahal kaahoo biaadh lagaiee ||2||
479.e: Into some, he sets pearls, while to others, he attaches filth. ||2||

479.g: ਸੂਮਹਿ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਖਨ ਕਉ ਦੀਆ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਕਹੈ ਧਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
479.t: soomeh dhan raakhan kau dheeaa mugadh kahai dhan meraa ||
479.e: God gave wealth to the miser for him to preserve, but the fool calls it his own.

480.g: ਜਮ ਕਾ ਡੰਡੁ ਮੂੰਡ ਮਹਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਕਰੈ ਨਿਬੇਰਾ ॥੩॥
480.t: jam kaa dda(n)dd moo(n)dd meh laagai khin meh karai niberaa ||3||
480.e: When the Messenger of Death strikes him with his club, in an instant, everything is settled. ||3||

480.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਊਤਮੁ ਭਗਤੁ ਸਦਾਵੈ ਆਗਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥
480.t: har jan uootam bhagat sadhaavai aagiaa man sukh paiee ||
480.e: The Lord's humble servant is called the most exalted Saint; he obeys the Command of the Lord's Order, and obtains peace.

480.g: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੈ ਭਾਣਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥੪॥
480.t: jo tis bhaavai sat kar maanai bhaanaa ma(n)n vasaiee ||4||
480.e: Whatever is pleasing to the Lord, he accepts as True; he enshrines the Lord's Will within his mind. ||4||

480.g: ਕਹੈ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਝੂਠੀ ॥
480.t: kahai kabeer sunahu re sa(n)tahu meree meree jhooThee ||
480.e: Says Kabeer, listen, O Saints - it is false to call out, ""Mine, mine.""

480.g: ਚਿਰਗਟ ਫਾਰਿ ਚਟਾਰਾ ਲੈ ਗਇਓ ਤਰੀ ਤਾਗਰੀ ਛੂਟੀ ॥੫॥੩॥੧੬॥
480.t: chiragaT faar chaTaaraa lai gio taree taagaree chhooTee ||5||3||16||
480.e: Breaking the bird cage, death takes the bird away, and only the torn threads remain. ||5||3||16||

480.g: ਆਸਾ ॥
480.t: aasaa ||
480.e: Aasaa:

480.g: ਹਮ ਮਸਕੀਨ ਖੁਦਾਈ ਬੰਦੇ ਤੁਮ ਰਾਜਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
480.t: ham masakeen khudhaiee ba(n)dhe tum raajas man bhaavai ||
480.e: I am Your humble servant, Lord; Your Praises are pleasing to my mind.

480.g: ਅਲਹ ਅਵਲਿ ਦੀਨ ਕੋ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਜੋਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਫੁਰਮਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
480.t: aleh aval dheen ko saahib jor nahee furamaavai ||1||
480.e: The Lord, the Primal Being, the Master of the poor, does not ordain that they should be oppressed. ||1||

480.g: ਕਾਜੀ ਬੋਲਿਆ ਬਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
480.t: kaajee boliaa ban nahee aavai ||1|| rahaau ||
480.e: O Qazi, it is not right to speak before Him. ||1||Pause||

480.g: ਰੋਜਾ ਧਰੈ ਨਿਵਾਜ ਗੁਜਾਰੈ ਕਲਮਾ ਭਿਸਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
480.t: rojaa dharai nivaaj gujaarai kalamaa bhisat na hoiee ||
480.e: Keeping your fasts, reciting your prayers, and reading the Kalma, the Islamic creed, shall not take you to paradise.

480.g: ਸਤਰਿ ਕਾਬਾ ਘਟ ਹੀ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਜੇ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੨॥
480.t: satar kaabaa ghaT hee bheetar je kar jaanai koiee ||2||
